Text:
January 3, 2011

I purchased these potatoes from Omaha Steaks online last week. I was not sure what to expect ... The au gratin potatoes I had seen and tasted before were sliced potatoes with globbs of gooey cheese sauce, and by the looks of them, this certainly wasn't it ... I opened the box and got out my skillet. The first thing that I noticed is that these things were huge ... like a gigantic tater tot. I browned them on both sides about 10 minutes each. To my surprise, they were very tasty. Texture was light fluffy and the potatoes tasted extra fresh .. not frozen or freezer burned. I liked them alot. I think these are perfect for kids ... none of the flavors were overpowering and great texture ... I give these 4 stars.

Convenient and tasty. Pop it in a bowl covered with plastic wrap, and microwave for 1 minute and 30 seconds. I tear up a mozzarella cheese stick and sprinkle it over the top before nuking. My boyfriend prefers his with a dash of Tabasco. I get a bit nostalgic eating these, since I used to frequently have them as an after-school snack when I was a child. Om nom nom, tasty!

Tip: Use a napkin bib if you don't want a stained shirt. The sauce is a runnier than typical tomato sauce, and somehow, I always manage to get it on my clothes.
This was beautiful! Thank you so much, great price, great product, and my boyfriend has eaten almost all of them! :) BUY THEM! their even better fridgerated

I tried this tea when I had given up on western medicine. I needed help with my pms irregularities. This is a great product to go with DIM and Emerita pro-gest. I had'nt had a period in months and I drank this tea and I finally started. It was great. It also helps with mood swings. Traditional Medincials is a company that can be trusted, I have been drinking their tea for years.

My dog seems to eat this food better than others.  Although, I must say I mix the Blue Buffalo with a handful of Benefeful (for the veggies) and half can of Alpo (for the gravy).  I feel BB has more protein and plan to buy more when this bag is used.
I find so little GF products that I really love. I do without rather than suffer the flavor.  This is, to the best of my memory, as good as Snyders.  This does not taste GF at all!!!

Cat litter sure has improved over the years. The last time I had a cat was quite a number of years ago when all you could really get was Jonny Cat. So no matter what my apartment would always have a cat box smell. ick.
Well this cat litter was amazing. I have 3 cats in a small apartment and nobody would know by the smell! This litter clumps exceptionally well, so it is really easy to keep the box clean. I am amazed at how well it controls the odor. I think this one clumps better than most of the other brands.

Summary: Tasty honey candy, a must for interstitial cystitis patients, no citric acid!
Text: This is tasty satisfying all natural honey candy. While that is fine in and of itself, if you have interstitial cystitis and are avoiding citric acid this is the only candy that I have found so far without citric acid or corn syrup which I am also avoiding.

...Clemetine!  This all natural orangy drink from Izze is simply delicious.  It is refreshing to see an ever increasing trend towards real tasting foods and drinks using real ingredients.  I can't wait to try the other flavors.

Summary: You'll love this if you love macaroni and cheese
Text: Being Kraft how could it be bad? Very delicious and easy to prepare . . . just squeeze out the cheese like toothpaste. No need to add butter or milk, so quite convenient and fast. The cheese product itself tastes a lot like Velveeta when eaten straight, so don't let the word 'sharp cheddar' make you think it's anything near bitter. And why would you eat it straight? Because there's always that little bit left you can't quite squeeze out, to lap up like licking the spoon, and yum!
I bought these berries for help for the kidney.  They are a very rich berry that tastes like a wine-raisin berry.  They are wonderful.  Only five for a woman & 8 for a man.  THis is a helathy snack.
they are ready to eat, I just put fresh lemon juice, a little onion, pepper & a little salt (if needed) and eat them with my salad. Truly a gourmet food.

I've been using this salad dressing since it was 29 cents an envelope (yep, I'm old) and I love it! It's the closest I can come to a REAL Caesar dressing, just add some crumbled blue cheese to your salad and Yum!!

I bought these for easy-to-pack and difficult-to-spoil lunches on-the-go with my two young kids. No more worrying about soggy sandwiches! Now I just throw a couple of slices of bread, a single serve peanut butter and a few of these in a bag and we're out the door. These also came in handy on our recent vacation & have also been there to rescue us when we ran out of jam in the house one or two times. This isn't gourmet jam but it is regular ol' strawberry jam and it is tasty and convenient. I like the more spreadable jam texture better than the jelly texture of some single serve packets.
We have tried 4 or 5 kinds of the K-Cups and Timothy's is our favorite.

After trying anything and everything on the market for the last 11 years, we found happy hips and stopped looking elsewhere. Have never seen my boy bully react the same way to any other snack, and was even more extra tic than him that he wasn't allergic to it either.

Summary: Better nutrition for a salt addict
Text:
Himalania Himalayia Pink Salt in Box with serving spoon 8.8 oz
Previously I had used coarse Himalayan salt and I got tired of grinding it because I use so much, so I was glad to find this salt that was fine grained. It works really well in an ordinary salt shaker.

It doesn't hurt that my favorite color is pink.

Summary: Yummy in the tummy, I don't like the gummies
Text: A fabulous gift that any person, except my grandma would love, but since she has dentures, she did not enjoy this amazing gift. But she gave them back to me and I ate them for her. WOuldn't recommend the gummy lifesaver box.  Have a holly, jolly Xmas, this year, (ding dong ding dong)

I do a lot of gluten free baking and this is such a great deal.  Fresh, effective,and saves us money.  I've purchased this xanthan gum three different times now and the quality and price cannot be beat.
My local store used to carry this cereal and then discontinued it. I decided to try ordering it online and have bought it this was ever since. The price is right and it's easy!

Marinade and/or stir-fry chicken, pork, beef, seafood and vegetables. This is an all-natural marinading sauce that is the perfect blend of subtle, sweet and tangy, with delicious morsels of sesame seeds. Once you try this, it's doubtful you'll ever need another teriyaki sauce.

These are so darn yummy, they are out  of this world good and just are perfect anytime.  They hit the spot and really leave such a great feeling after you are done eating one.  They tate great just right out of the package but you can also microwave them to make them warm and they are amazing tasting that way.  It is the perfect on the go breakfast when you are short on time.  They are so sweet, love the amount of sweet.  The brown sugar is there but it is not overpowering like some brown sugar flavored bars are.  You will fall in love with these.  I have not tried the other two flavores but I dont like raisins and I dont much like bananas so this is my to go quaker bar of choice.
The Brussel's dwarf crepe myrtle is doing beautifully.  It arrived in great condition.
Really nice flavor spice tea. With or without honey, it's delicious! Organic makes it perfect!

I searched a long time this summer for these vines - missed out the first two times Amazon got some in stock, but finally got them in my cart and purchased. I was expecting a bit stronger of a grape flavor (like Jolly Joes), so my first impression was disappointment. But as I've eaten a few more packages, I've come to appreciate the more subtle flavoring. The flavor could be a bit stronger but I can appreciate what Red Vines is trying to do here, I think.  I haven't rushed to eat the initial shipment and am still deciding if I'll order more or just hope to find them at retail, but they are worth at least sampling.  Just don't expect strong grape flavor.

nothing beats em. sure they are on the higher end price wise (though 4 boxes for $15 is pretty good). but nothing beats them for flavor, i used to eat fish crackers, i tasted a Cheez-it. . . never went back.

this stuff sucks. let me explain it does clump nice and is easy to keep the litter box clean, but this stuff gets everywhere. It sticks to the cats feet then gets all over the floor and any furniture the cats may jump on its just a big mess. If your thinking about trying this don't, save yourself the mess and stick to scoop-able clay pellets/balls it actually stays in the litter box unlike this feline pine.

Summary: I am not a tea snob
Text: But, I have tried some other teas to find something to replace that awful Lipton junk that I have been using for my iced tea for years. What I do know is that it has great flavor in iced tea, better than anything else I have tried (although I haven't tried any of the other Davidson teas). Tastes like dirt? That reviewer needs a taste bud tune-up.

I love this tea or at least I did when I first tried it. It has a very effervescent, gingery kinda taste. Now I think my taste buds have gone numb to the stuff. And it's about 80 calories per cup, which is way too much for a cup of tea...really. So I will probably use it only once in a blue moon. But, no worries, each tea bag is nicely sealed in an aluminum paper-like bag which are all then sealed again in a larger aluminum paper-like bag. I'm tell'in you this stuff could last through the Great Tribulation and still be fresh.

We've always enjoyed Snyder's pretzels, so was excited to find they made a gluten free version (recently found out our son is gluten intolerant). They were quite tasty, like a dry pretzel,  it I personally would have preferred a bit more salt.

My problem kitty seems to love this gourmet series from Fancy Feast.  She can't have the bit sized version since her previous owner kicked out half of her teeth, but these have proven to not only put weight on her (she was starved when I got her), but also build up her muscle mass, increase her alertness, develop better skin tone, and well, you should see how shiny her coat has become with these foods.  Great stuff, great job Friskies! Highly recommend!
This is a great tasting product and the price was right for me from Amazon

My dog seemed to enjoy the food, but then again he eats anything. My main concern was the size of this food. I don't think it was meant for big "gulper" dogs. He choked on it often so I had to mix it with his regular food. I have a rescued greyhound that inhales his food.

Summary: Nice, but was sent the wrong item
Text: Nice product. I spent the money on a 35 K-Cup carousel and was sent a box that had a sticker identifying it as a 35 K-Cup carousel. When I opened it, it was not what I expected. It was only a 27 K-Cup Carousel! Had I wanted that one, I would have ordered it (and spend less money). Was disappointed that I did not get the item that I wanted. I am a frequent Amazon.com shopper and this was the first time I've received a wrong product.

The mixed bag is a great intro to Herban Essentials. I first purchased just the lemon, and was so happy with them that my next purchase was the mixed bag. I looooooooovvvvvvve the lavender and the peppermint is great for a zippy energy boost. I've since bought all the differnt kinds of wipes and I love them all and can't live without them. They're the best, most luxurious, pure (no chemicals or alcohol, yay!), fantastic hand sanitizer around...plus they can be used for so much more than just that. Check the back of the bags for genius suggestions...the lavender is also the best dryer sheet I've ever used (I suggest throwing 2 wipes in for the last 2-5 minutes, my sheets smell AMAZING!!!).

I found out about this product in Starbucks. I add to my French Vanilla Tripio (three shots of SF Vanilla; three shots of SF Hazlenut; three shots of Expresso; add soy milk; Cooks Vanilla Powder, cinnamon and raw sugar) OMG!!! Delicious!!!. I googled the Cooks company after looking on the cannister. The Cooks company sells it, but Amazon was cheaper. A must buy. Give it a try if you love Vanilla as I.

Summary: Just what I wanted for my 4th of July cupcakes!
Text: I could not find red or blue locally. I wanted more than little bottles anyway because I decorate mucho cupcakes and cakes. Great to have a nice big sack for Christmas and other baking projects.

Nothing Russian about it. It's cheapo black tea. It is packaged in Chinese ultra-thin plastic bags (unsealed). It is very-finely ground.

A coffee-lover's tea. Not for tea lovers, even at under $5 for 6 tins.

Summary: OK beans not the best around
Text: The beans were kind of very dry. Wasn't very easy to work with. However at the price you couldn't beat them during that time.
These are great cookies. My dog, Kacey loves them. It must be the peanut butter. This deal beats any price per bag that I have seen. The auto ship is great also.

It's easy to become a coffee snob when you really like coffee. I've been just a wee bit guilty of that. Times are tight, though. And I remembered Yuban. And I bought some.

Some of the reviews I've read stated Yuban is arabican. I don't see the word anywhere on the can, and I honestly don't know. But it tastes premium. This is good coffee! Flavorful, medium-bodied, smooth, rich with just the right balance of acidity. I'm not missing the clean-up after the grinder, either. With Amazon's Subscribe & Save, I'm finding that occasional third cup is not an extravagance at all. It's just the pleasure a good cup is supposed to be.

This cookie bar is okay - if you prefer your healthy snacks on the sweet side.

The outside is cruncy and crumbly (eat over a plate) and doesn't taste too bad. The inside is a creamy blueberry concoction that reminded me of eating a cold, blueberry Pop-Tart. Which is not something I would recommend.

It appears to only be 100 calories with a carb count of 18. There are better options than this one out there.

This is one of the best teas I have had.  I have tried a variety of Oolong teas, and this is by far the best flavored Oolong tea I have had.  It is rich without being strong, and smooth.  Add a bit of skim milk or soy milk to give it just a touch of sweetness.  The Prince of Peace Organic White Tea is also a superior tea.  These are sold at reasonable prices.
I was very hesitant about ordering something that I had never tasted but this is the best peach tea that I have had!! I will definitely be buying another box.

I have had my Keurig about 2 weeks now and was kind of feeling these must just make weak coffee until i tried this stuff.
I have 40 cups or so of Tullys French Roast Bold to get rid of now. Wouldnt waste bottled water on those again after trying the Jet Fuel.

Summary: Want to like it, but can't stand it
Text: Sadly, I bought the big bag because it was cheap and because of the great reviews. I put it in smoothies and I just detest the chalky, gritty quality it imparts.  The taste is o.k., but the mouthfeel is horrible. I'll use it up, I guess, but I won't get it again.

Summary: Great coffee at a great price!
Text:
This coffee is a rich dark roast with a smokey flavor to it. If you prefer strong coffee, the Kicking Horse Kick "donkey" coffee is up your ally, In my office coffee club, we ranked this coffee at 8.5 average score. I have a tin for home and a tin for work, and just recently ordered my second Kicking Horse brand coffee.

Great coffee at a great price!
The better then bouillon is very good but has a hint of a sweet taste that my family dosen't seem to care for.

Summary: Glad I found these at Amazon - Unable to find in stores
Text: The classic Wint-O-Green Life Saver has been part of my life since I was a child, but stores only seem to carry the individually wrapped larger candies.  The roll is so convenient to carry in a pocket.  Glad to see Amazon is still carrying these.  They were delivered on time and in good condition.

Summary: So happy to have found this!
Text: As a Canadian living in the United States, finding out that Amazon sells Tim Hortons coffee was thrilling to say the least!  I used to have relatives bring me the coffee each time they visited, or I would drive to the coast of Maine to purchase my own, but now if I order only four bags at a time, Amazon will ship it to me for free!  THANK YOU AMAZON!!!
Finally a strong cup of coffee.  I found that I had a lot of coffee grounds in the bottom of the cup.  Also some of the foil was misaligned allowing coffee grounds to spill throughout the box.

Summary: not sure if Amazon or UPS problem
Text: I just opened my case of Mighty Dog and to my disappointment-9 out of 24 cans are smashed so bad I am not sure it is safe to feed this to my dog. If Amazon is going to continue selling this item I think greater care should be taken with the cans.

These are much more economical than candy and a whole lot less calories!  The flavor is great! These apples are addicting. They are sweet and crunchie. Why eat potato chips when you can have these delicious, healthy, low-calorie, fat-free chips.  They also fit well into my budget since I only work part time and go to school.

I love this tea for my morning wake me up with a little skim milk.  And it makes a wonderful ice tea also.  I've been purchasing it on the internet for years but am very pleased that Amazon is now carrying it.  With my Amazon Prime, this tea was half the price as my last purchase from another vendor.

My wife and i just finished off a bag of these this evening . We also just started eating these this evening . When finished , i told the Mrs. "It's just two servings though" . She responded "two-wonty" . Feelin' kinda gross . Lip smackin' good . For the enlarged heart in all of us .

This cookie was great. It was a little soft, but that's what made it even better. It didn't take long for it to vanish, which might be a bad thing if you lack self control (something I do not possess). I recommend these to everyone unless you are allergic to raisins.
At 9:00 pm each night my cats remind me that they have not yet had their Whisker Lickins treats.  I dread the day that I run out so I always have 10 packs in the cabinet.
Excellent taste, everybody in the family just loved it. Did a blind tasting and everybody choosed it over the others.

I was very frustrated with all of the half full boxes of coffee on the counter before buying this product.  Now with the Disc Carousel my coffee is organized, easy to access and it looks great on my counter.

I have tried a lots of treats for my 7 cats, 3 in door, 4 our door semi feral cats that "adopted us". The Good life brand is great but it is too expensive. Temptation is great for some and miss for the others. But this one everyone loves, and it is more affordable so I can keep them happy all the time. Wish they would offer larger packages and more flavors. The tiny 2 oz packages runs out really quick here.

Happy to see one of my numerous cats  favorites available for mail order.  Given the price, the fact I have to drive a distance to buy it and the general convenience of buying in bulk, I feel it is a good deal.

My mother is a recent transplant to Seattle and she bought me some Market Spice Tea - Cinnamon Orange. It would be FANTASTIC tea, IF I liked that flavor. Is there anyone that can direct me to a website with their tea flavors? The Cinnamon Orange is DEFINITELY NOT my cup of tea, NO pun intended.  Thanks for your help!

These Macaroons taste fantastic; but they are not raw. Hail Merry is advertising this product as raw and it isn't. Out of six ingredients only two are raw. The Coconut oil and sea salt are the only raw ingredients in this product. See back of package for Details.

Not the best price but taste is worth every penny.  Everyone loved this cake and it did not last through the day that it was delivered.  Will order again, no need to recommend because all that tried it said they are going to purchase it anyway.  Very moist and has true lemon flavor does not taste at all artificially flavored.

When I was diagnosed with Type Diabetes last year, a low-carbohydrate diet proved to be the best approach to managing my  blood glucose, along with an oral medication. Pasta sounded like a thing of the past. Dreamfields pasta does not have an adverse effect on my blood glucose. I'm not qualified to enter the debate about whether the product is "truly" low carb. Perhaps diabetics should find out for themselves. I do know that it has a great taste, texture and consistency, and I  am now a repeat buyer of this fine product!
These are the very favorite treat of our dogs, they never get hidden or buried, provide hours of pleasant gnawing with no mess.

Summary: BY FAR, THE BEST COFFEE I HAVE TASTED*** RICH, BOLD BUT NOT BITTER
Text: THIS COFFEE IS BY FAR THE BEST I HAVE TASTED.  IT IS RICH AND BOLD IN TASTE BUT NOT BITTER.  EMERIL'S DECAF IS ALSO OUTSTANDING AND STANDS AWAY FROM THE CROWD AS A F-STAR WINNER.  BAM FOR EMERIL!!
these chocolates are perfect splurges - the perfect pick-me-up when you are having a bad day. I keep them in my desk drawer as a nice afternoon treat.

This calmed my little boston terrier down within 5 minutes.  She weighs around 17 lbs. and had one capsule.  She is very excitable and wild most of the time,  we got this and the first time we gave it to her she was calm as a cucumber within 5 minutes.  I will buy this again for all of our sanity!

Summary: Dogs love it but too pticey
Text:
Our dogs love this stuff and we keep it in the motorhome and on the boat to eliminate the bulk and waste of cans.

The only issue I have is that I can buy Old Roy from Walmart for 1/2 the price and it is the exact same prpduct.

That being said, the box is heavy and they do leave it at the top of my 23 steps to the house.

I heard about these noodles from a friend, so after months of him telling me I need to try them, I finally caved in and bought 10 packs.  Mi Goreng is simply amazing, the best instant noodles I've ever had, I'll never go back to the cheapo Ramen you can get in your local grocery store.
Delicious, amazing. I am not a cheese expert, so I can't use fancy words to describe the flavors. If you love sharp cheddar, this is the ultimate in sharp, full-flavored cheese.
I love this product.  It blends easily in water, it's not so dark like the raspberry ice that I've seen stain carpets.  The flavor is so wonderful.
Airline Bloody Mary's are not hot enough...This packet, easy to take on board, finishes the drink perfectly.

Summary: A very appealing pate for the price
Text:
Once I got over the feeling that I was opening and serving myself a jar of cat food, I was quite pleased by the taste and texture of this pate. It has a surprisingly subtle mix of flavors and strikes the right balance between the earthiness of the mushrooms, a smoky marsala wine, and the rich butteriness of a pate. I really enjoy the pate with Carr's Poppy And Sesame Crackers.

If you're going to serve this to guests, I'd recommend carefully spreading this on crackers or stirring it up in a serving dish ahead of time to avoid any can-shaped chunks from turning people off.

Boom!! Big ol' sack of DME for making yeast starters with.  Makes about 20 starters the way I measure it out (1/2 cup w/ 2 cups water).  About the same price as ordering from the online homebrew stores if you include shipping.  If you just need this one thing fast, its cheaper to do it here.  But, if you bulk this in with ingredients for other batches, just order it there with Annapolis or Austin Homebrew, etc.  Not prime eligible :(

These seeds are exactly as described!  Added them to a smoothie and they filled me up for HOURS AND HOURS.  I also made them into the gel by hydrating them first for my husband's protein shake and just shook the gel up with a scoop of protein powder and some milk-  he loved it!  Because they are more stable than flax seeds and easier to digest to get all the health benefits, we are making the switch!  Love that they are two separate bags in this package as well for added freshness.

I received a package of samples for this product at it's launch party.  One in every flavor.  Each one was delicious in it's own right.  My favorites were the Saffron and Cardamom.  Rich in flavor and invigorating!  I highly recommend this product.  The only thing I would change is the amount of packaging.  It would be better served for the packages containing only one flavor were not individually wrapped in foiled plastic as the waste is not recyclable.  Waxed paper would be better as it's at least compostable.

Fancy Feast Grilled Seafood is the only food my cat will eat.  Being able to order this product on line is so convenient for me.  I can usually get free shipping.  I feel Fancy Feast is the best food for my cat.  & he loves it.

Summary: Really yummy and the best price around.
Text: Very good 5 minute meal.  My son can't get enough of them.  The Amazon price is substantially better than any other I have found.

Summary: Good Tasting and Long Lasting Sugarless Gum - Recommended
Text:
Trident Greenapple + Goldenpineapple Layers sugarless gum has a somewhat subtle but distinctive flavor that lasts a fairly long time. The Apple and Pineapple flavors go well together and there isn't a noticeable aftertaste from the artificial sweetener. Each pack contains 14 individually wrapped pieces.

Recommended!

My strong chewer usually destroys all her toys, but this ring has lasted! She chewed through one part of it within a day or two making it more of a C-shape, but she's had it for almost a year now and she carries it around with her everywhere. She loves this toy and it is really durable!
Flowers were the ugliest color green...and the whole thing was very small...I give it a +0,-1.....I know its basted on colors of the seasons but It was not what I expected
These Strawberry Wheels are very fresh and delicious.  I highly recommend them.
This spaghetti cooks quicker than regular pasta.  It breaks into small pieces as it cooks.  For a healthy, low glycemic spaghetti meal we enjoyed it.
I won a cooking contest using Campbells cream of shrimp soup. It is not available in local grocery stores. So glad Amazon sells it. It is delicious and versatile for cooking many different dishes.

Summary: Best coconut water I've found so far
Text:
I'll keep this short and sweet--Whole Foods sells these for 1.69 and they are awesome. I'm sure I look strange buying 12 of these at once, but I can't resist this stuff!

Not too sweet, not too woody-tasting, perfect for me!

These are really-really good! Take it from a person who tried all the best sugar free stuff there is. It's so good,you won't regret the pricey shipping even. The jelly inside is so fresh and yummy and the chocolate is not too thick, just right. Best experience if you eat them cold - right out of the fridge with a cup of tea or coffee. I'm getting myself more!

I had way too many too small pieces that I ended up not eating. I don't think they are ready and should have been left alone until they grew up. I have been looking for decent Oyster for some time now, beating the Sunday branch at one of the Casino near by and this one wasn't good enough. It's better than up scale seafood restaurant near by but wasn't worth it. Nice packaging though. Maybe I just had bad luck but I don't intend to find out...

I love this packaging, it is very compact and keeps the salt dry. I filled all my shakers and grinders with this salt. The salt is fine but you still can grind it if you prefer (I like salt grinders better, it allows to control the amount of salt more easily). Just adjust the grinder screw from coarse salt to fine salt and it works perfectly. Love the taste of this salt, it is slightly lemony and very mild. Low sodium!!! This package will last probably over a year (2 pounds of it!!!). Totally will buy again.

I was tempted by the price of this product since I drink a lot of loose green tea.  The Dragonwell tea from Coffee Bean Direct does not look like my other more expensive loose green tea which is actually olive green in color.  The color of this tea is very dark, almost black and the taste is more like ordinary black tea.
My dog has had problems with his cruciate ligaments and this food seems to help him.  He also loves the taste!

Summary: The Best Coffee I've Ever Had
Text:
Hawaii Roasters coffee is awesome!!! I discovered it when I received a gift basket from a co-worker last year and have been trying to find a way to buy it ever since!!

It is smooth, full-bodied, and comes in a great package!!

You'll love it!

I have been eating spicy hot food for over 40 years. Ordered this sauce not knowing what to expect.  Not real real hot but very flavorful. Have had it for a month now and am using it on EVERYTHING. will need to order more soon.
This is the only canned food I feed my dog.  It is made without a bunch of preservatives and is good for his skin and coat.  Very good service.  Arrived fast and is a good buy for the money!!

I tried my first bowl tonight after ordering the bulk order from Amazon due to the reviews. I thought they tasted a bit like a cardboard version of Rice Krispies - they were pretty tasteless. I ended up adding a bit of sugar to it to make it more palatable.

The cereal tastes like it would be decent with fruit, but I would probably add a few extra marshmallows if I were to make rice krispie treats out of it.

Overall, I would say that there are other, tastier GF cereals out there -- the Envirokids brand is a pretty good one for instance. However, if you're looking for something to replace Rice Krispies specifically, this is an okay substitute but by no means perfect.

I am new to gluten free foods. I was diagnosed with celiac disease in March. I have been searching for a "normal tasting" saltine cracker. This is as close as it comes. These crackers are delicious
with almost all my new gluten free diet foods. I am so glad I found them. I will continue my orders as long as these crackers are available. Thanks Amazon!

Summary: Kids' Favorite Whole Wheat Mac & Cheese
Text:
My three kids (4, 7,8) love this mac & cheese. They've grown up only eating whole wheat pasta, so that's not an issue for them. To me, the pasta is not much different than any other whole wheat pasta, maybe even a little more palatable, so I am guessing (not sure) that the reviewer who called it gummy is just not used to whole wheat pasta in general.

If you're new to whole wheat pasta, I recommend starting with Angel Hair Pasta (hopefully with sauce). It's much easier to get used to than other types of pasta. Then you slowly work your way up to thicker pastas.

I bought these pickles in a store by chance... I didn't know that much about what a "barrel pickle" tasted like.  After getting them, I think they are one of the best pickles I have ever eaten.  So, I got a winner by chance... If you haven't bought this brand, take the chance, you'll not be sorry.

Summary: My Dogs love to take their meds now!! :>)
Text:
When we kenneled our dogs over the Christmas holidays, our vet used this to give our older dog her Clomicalm. (We had used cut up hotdogs or cubes of spam at home - no wonder she was getting chunky!) They gave it to us to take home since it was a free sample they'd gotten from the supplier.

My dogs LOVE this! My puppy has to take a HUGE (1" long!) pill daily and she gobbles it up in this. They get so excited when they hear me opening the pill containers they sit in "beg mode"!

The only downside is that if you have long nails, it gets caught underneath and can be a pain to clean out. But, even so it's worth the scrubbing not to have to fight them to take their pills every day!

Outstanding, good and reliable food menu item.

Not overly done or seasoned. Thank God.

Sometimes simple really goes so much farther.

Babies love it! I love it! We all love it!

Keep going "Baby food co."

thanks a bunch
