This was my first taste of licorice in a pomegranate flavor and I was not disappointed. These were juicy, sweet and flavorful with just a hint of pomegranate. While I like pomegranate, I don't love it, and was pleased that the flavor was more sweet than strong. If anything it may have been a bit too sweet.

While organic, they are not exactly health food, as they do contain corn syrup. Although if I'm eating licorice my first goal usually isn't healthy, it is something to be aware of. Nevertheless, I loved them, gobbled down the entire package in two days and found them to be almost addictive.

Summary: The subtle but strong smell was overbearing!
Text: I am guilty of not listening to other reviewers' warnings about the horrible smell. I bought it thinking I could overcome the smell given the health reputation of macca. But I was wrong. I could not get rid of the smell no matter how hard I tried to mask it. Plus, I researched some more and found out that there isn't any hard evidence backing up the health claims of macca. Too bad I have a pricey bag of powder sitting in my freezer!

The quality is excellent.  It worked well in my machine.  My problem is with the taste.  It is very light and sweet.  My lattes tasted like sweetened milk.  If you don't like much coffee taste, these are the way to go.  I returned mine.

One of my guilty pleasures.  I've had baklava from many places and of many types.  I'm less enthused about those made with rose or orange flavored sugar water, and love that made with honey.  These are a spiced honey and walnut combination.  For those who prefer pistachios, however, these may not impress.
I have tried 4 or more brands of Earl Grey tea and I like this one the best. It is fragrant and tastes as good as it smells! Very nice flavor, very smooth.

The VERY first time, I had to get used to it as tasting slightly lighter than the usual cocoa powder people buy.  Now I'm hooked. I throw it in my morning protein shake along with a cup of blueberries.  I love it and will be buying more when I run out. This is a quality product.
Although a little expensive, they are one of the best cookies I've ever had.

This was a fantastic gift basket.  The box is a great size and the food packed inside was tasty.  My daughter really likes it.  Oh, and the clock works too.  I would purchase from the company again.  I thought the shipping was rather high, but the quality makes up for it.

This is actually the first time I ordered the 3 grainFeldkamp Three-Grain Bread , 16.75-Ounce Vacuum Packs (Pack of 12) bread. Since i was not sure if the bread comes like this I did not comment on it. I actually gave half of it away as sort of "little gifts" and every body told me the same thing: The bread was brittle and sort of to wet to actually handle it. So know i got thousands of crumbs and try to figure out what to do with them. Very disappointed and would not order again.

This is the best smoothie I have ever had. Its funny I dont really like smoothies at all, but i tried this at a book store once and I can't stop going and buying them now. I totally recommend this item.

Summary: Would be best if Canola Oil was left out
Text: Great ingredients although, chicken should have been 1st rather than chicken broth, the only thing I do not think belongs in it is Canola oil. Canola or rapeseed is not someting a dog would ever find in nature and if it did find rapeseed in nature and eat it, it would poison them. Today's Food industries have convinced the masses that Canola oil is a safe and even better oil than olive or virgin coconut, facts though say otherwise. Until the late 70's it was poisonous until they figured out a way to fix that. I still like it but it could be better.

I wondered if there would be a big difference between regular Splenda and Splenda with Fiber.  I tried Splenda with Fiber in both hot and cold beverages.  It dissolved just fine in both.  There was no difference in taste.  The package is slightly larger and a little heaver.  The fiber appears to be from corn so should not cause any problems.  One gram of fiber is not a lot so unless you use a lot of Splenda you will not get that much of a fiber boost but will get some.  All in all I liked the product.  I did not like the price but hopefully that will come down.

Can't say that I like this soup. Can't say that I dislike it. It's kind of a culinary non-event.  There just isn't any flavor to it to speak of other than potato.  It's a good base though if you want to dress it up by adding more broccoli,cheese, or a little chicken stock.

It's a good product. I use it for my 1 year old great dane that has knee problems. I use it with a anti-flamitory pain releiver so I don't know how well it works by it's self. But my dog will drink it right out of a cup so it's easy to give it to her.

My family absolutely loves this pancake and waffle mix. The texture and taste is the best out there, especially when using our waffle maker. You can add fruit and other items to the mix and be as creative as you wish. Your price is great and delivery can't be beat. We recommend it to everyone!!

Summary: Great price for a fun item.
Text: My daughter is Chinese, and each year we send hong bao (red envelopes) to school for her to pass out to her classmates.  In China, children receive hong bao on New Year (CNY) from their families, with money inside.  For several years we purchased chocolate coins, but due to a child in her class having a severe peanut allergy, we didn't want to use chocolate coins because we could not be sure they were produced in a peanut-free factory.  So we ordered four packages of these bubble gum coins.  The coins are wrapped in bright foil.  It is a bit hilarious that we were using coins stamped with Mexican words and symbols for CNY, but the kids didn't seem to notice or care.  The gum is predictably a bit hard.  All things considered, a fun item.

I fed my cats this food (and sometimes the organic version) for two years. They loved it and were healthy and happy. Then PetSmart stopped selling it and I looked for alternatives. One they hated and wouldn't eat, one was ok, but I settled on Science Diet because of it's good reputation.  Almost immediately, I started finding spit-ups of largely undigested food everywhere.  Realized that we had the same problem with our prior cats on Science Diet.  It may be more costly, especially with shipping, but I am going back.  The savings in time and clean-up efforts are worth it, my kitties love it, and it smells so good I almost want to eat it!

Summary: Wow these make me want to gag....
Text: These have to be the worst tasting banana peppers i had. They taste like battery acid that water to dull the acid. These do not even taste good and they are not hot at all no hint to them. I had about 5 people taste these and they all spit them out in the trash. They would not even take these for free and i got 6 jars what a waste of money and shocked how badly they taste. If i got a bad batch sorry but 2 jars i tried are to bad tasting. I rather eat grass in vinegar then this.
I buy it for the guys at work who cant get enough! Red vines rock their world!! Need to getthem for same price ! Red Vines- Original Red Twists, 5lb Tub

This is a very high quality product, and the taste is awesome. One of my favorite pies in the world is a gooseberry pie. I can't always find gooseberries though. I ordered these and they were enough to make two pies and they tasted amazing. My husband is still raving about them!!
Very good.  Very tasty and authentic flavor!  I ordered these last minute for Christmas, not knowing if they were going to arrive on time.  They arrived at my house on Christmas Eve.

Summary: Quick Delivery, just what I ordered
Text: Can't find these things anywhere in the grocery stores in the decaffeinated variety. Shipping was fast and my handicapped Mom didn't have to go to store after store looking for them.

These potato chips rock.  I've been looking for a low-fat real potato baked chip for a long time and I finally found it.  What's even better, it tastes like a real potato chip.  Not those other baked chips that taste like a salted piece of dried plastic potato mush.  Love these chips.
The Item pictured is for non-decaffeinated tea. This is decaffeinated. it is also not eligible for return so you will be stuck with it. Do not order unless you want decaf.

It is good to have it because:
1. You can use it while running.
2. Only 100 calories
3. Effective in adding energy

Summary: Product packaged tightly but still leaked
Text: The cover was slightly off tilt and the syrup leaked onto the bubble packing.  Packing was wound tightly around the container but does little for the cap not being tightened enough.  Container should have a foil safety shield installed which would end the leaking problem.  If my second auto-shipped one leaks, I will be cancelling the order.  Being opened enough to leak comprises quality, leaving it open to bacteria.

I love M&M's their tasty come in a BIG BAG!!!! has a great price and the shipping was fast and the candies came Good a some where broken but not a big deal. 4 stars because Amazon put ONE Air packet was is that gunna help?? So if they pack it better your tasty treats come in shape.

Why can't the manufacturer remove moisture prior to bagging?  I don't want to pay extra to ship a cup of water along with my salt, nor do I want to dry it.  Otherwise, like the salt, but a hassle to get it dry enough to grind.

The only thing wrong I found with this product is that after a week and a half in my fridge, a couple of cans started tasting "rusty" and the water and pulp were slightly pinkish in color when poured in a glass. Otherwise, when it doesn't do that, it tastes wonderful! The size is perfect for when you're extra thirsty. Very refreshing.

My wife and I have taken trips to the Niagara region of Canada and tasted their ice wines.  This one compares favorably to those wines.  If you look at the low ratings/reviews for this product you will see that none of them actually talk about the wine itself.  If you like ice wine or are looking for a good dessert wine then you should buy this product.  You will not be disappointed!
I had these on several Jet Blue flights and just had to have them. I am not a big potato chip person but these are delicious.
I bought this cat food as a change and/or treat for my 4 cats.  Unfortunately, none of my cats like it, so I'm now feeding it to the ferals.  I went back to Meow Mix cups which they love.

I've always loved this cereal.  However the price was so much better here at Amazon, and the package arrived faster than I expected.  I still have some left but I will be re-stocking my shelf from here!!!!

We use oat bran in muffins, pancakes, bread and a few other home made treats.  It's great to get 12 pounds of the stuff delivered all at once and a lot cheaper than buying it in one pound boxes in the grocery store.  How do they do it?

The marshmallows are fantastic--sweet, a little dense. My issue isn't with the product, but with the date on the package. The best-by date is 10 days from the date I received the package, which is a bit of a letdown. If I'm ordering food online, I expect to have at least a month to consume it.
The coffee lovers collection is a selection of very good tasting coffee.  They are full bodied and rich - if you like weak coffee, this selection is not for you!
Always smooth ...never harsh or bitter ...clean tea taste never muddy or cloudy. perfect Hot or Cold ......when found retail expect to pay double the price here .... Camille Poe
Pure heat. Just like eating fire from hell !!  If you love hot stuff, then this is for you.

This has just the right amount of sweetness and I am so happy it is stevia.  Definitely an eye-opener and good alternative to coffee to wake up and start the day.  If it tastes too bitter it is probably too strong.  If you mix it with black tea it is like Celestial Seasonings Morning Thunder tea.  Yum.

As promised, this pasta was very easy and fast to make.  The whole meal can be made in one pan, which is also a plus.  This pasta is reasonably tasty.  I wasn't expecting gourmet from this, but it was fast and filling- good for a busy night.  The pasta is orzo-like, and the cheese sauce is the sort of fake stuff one expects from velveeta.  My main complaint was that there's hardly any broccoli in the broccoli pouch.  There's a few freeze-dried sprigs, and that's pretty much it.  If I buy this again I will definitely cook some fresh broccoli and add it to the pasta.

These candies are great. I like the taste of ginger except sometimes it can be very hot. These Chimes with peanut butter are a great blend. The ginger flavor comes through tempered nicely by the taste of peanuts.

My son is 11 months old and I just found them at the supermarket last week. He LOVES them!

My one and only complaint, is that I bought the last box at the supermarket and I can't find anymore anywhere! I just had to order them off Amazon so I know I will be able to have some in the future!

But recently the entire recipe was changed! Why? Now it looks and tastes...like the competition. Before, there was no competition.

This product description shows what the soup USED to look like.

Now, there is a different, larger pasta noodle...not as good
The meatballs are made differently, not as tasty and are smaller...
Carrots were added which isn't bad, but can't saved the new soup!
The broth flavor...
Everything...
Was Changed!

I used to buy cases of this soup, especially for the winter...

Why oh why was this great soup changed? I sure hope they realize they lost customers (me!) in doing so...

Had to reference "Fast Times at Ridegmont High"..  Probably should have done a Video review to show the positive effect of margaritas using this mix.  Zero calories and it tastes great... and also makes a better margarita than the margarita mix.  I highly recommend it.

I quit smoking ten years ago but became addicted to nicotine gum.  So a replacement for nicotine gum was required.  I got over the need for nicotine but still needed a gum or mint.  Most gum seemed cloyingly sweet, so I tried Jolt spearmint.  Perfect.  It's a good quality gum, isn't overly sweet, has some "punch" from the caffeine but not so much as to make me feel jittery.  Perfect until - - - our grocery store quit selling it.  Thank goodness Amazon carries it with free shipping!  Perfect!

I didn't buy it here but some where else just to put that out there. The aroma on this smells like a light apple pie really nice nose on it. On the palate the taste is there just enough for you to enjoy, nothing over powering or anything like that. It's one of the better tasting flavored coffees out there. 8/10 for me.

P.S. why are people reviewing this as a tea? this is NOT a tea its a light roast coffee.

These are our top pick of any pretzels.  Great flavor PLUS some fiber.  I've never eaten many pretzels at all before because they seem to be just white flour and water and salt to me.  These are a great improvement on the standard pretzel to me.  Love to dip them in some tasty mustards for extra flavor.  We take them along on road trips as they help to keep you alert with their snappy freshness.  Our lab even stole a bag out of the pantry and ate the whole thing!!  Great product, wonderful flavor.  Thanks Snyder's and Amazon!!
MAUI GAVE US THIS DELIGHT AND WE NEVER LOOKED BACK. KONA HAZELNUT RULES....WE BROUGH BACK ALL WE COULD CARRY AND NOW BUY ANYWAY WE CAN,

Given the claims of the manufacturer I was expecting this to be a really good tasting bottled water. In reality, not so much - it tastes rather flat with a hint of a chalky aftertaste (which I'm assuming is due to the baking soda that is added, as listed in the ingredient list on the bottle). Not horrible, but not great either.

I think the price is outrageous for bottled water, but I didn't factor that into my rating - it gets three stars strictly on the basis of how it tastes, which is not nearly as good as the tap water that I filter at home.

If this is available in your area, buy it locally. you will save money and probably get fresher soda. If however, like me, you can't find this in your area, you must try it at least once. Not only is it some of the best soda i have tasted, but one of the best drinks. It has 200 calories per can, so of course it isn't for every day consumption, but a great treat every once in a while. The flavor is slightly similar to pineapple orange soda available at most grocery chains, but minus the orange. It is quite sweet and in no way bland. Highly recommended.

i was suggested this from a friend and i was kinda skeptical at first... it was different than anything i've tried before but its great on fresh fruit, and im sure other things. i strongly reccommend this product if for nothing else but to try something new.
I ordered 3 bags and they all came melted.  $24 of wasted money.  It is only 40 degrees here so it happened either in storage or in transit.
I purchased this flax oil product and it has a fishy taste! What gives? The irony is that one of my main purposes in trying it is that I hate the taste of fish oils.

We like to have a cup of darjeeling in the evening. It is light yet flavorful. It is sometimes called the champagne of teas, for good reason. We have been drinking Twinings loose tea for several years. Buying the 3.53 ounce tins is an economical way to purchase tea for regular tea drinkers, so I recommend buying the pack of six through Amazon. It qualifies for free shipping, so the price is right, and you can't beat the convenience.

I love this coffee, flavor is wonderful, aroma is good, just the right amount of caffeine, I don't like the high caffeine in the Starbucks coffees, this one is a perfect blend. The other flavors are equally good.

I found these to be quite delightfully fluffier than the consistency of a regular peep. I'm talking about the viscocity of the internal fluff here.  The covering granules seem to be finer than that garnished upon regular peeps.  This combination results in a lighter (weight, not calorie) snack that has a smooth finish of chocolate mousse.  The individual cats are joined to each other at the side of the head and at a point between 1/3 and 1/4 from the bottom.  The head of the snack is most fragile at the neck area, which will sometimes cause there to be a break at this point when trying to separate the cats.

My 1 year old son loves these, and I recently tasted them.  I'm not a fan of the cereal bar normally, but these were very good.  Then, we were out of town and I ran out of the box I had brought, so I bought Nutrigrain and tasted those.  Wow--the Health Valley were WAYYYYY better and not nearly as gooey as the Nutrigrain(which is good if you are allowing a toddler to eat them by themselves).
I made a rainbow cake with this food color and had the best results! Bold colors and no flavor!
with over 40 flavors of jelly beans, it is hard to believe that they only had mess ups on five flavors.

the tea is very fresh but the bags are too cheap and often tear.  and i don't know why they bother with the string.  in the box i purchased, EVERY string fell off before i could even put the bag in the cup.

I like my regular conditioner better.  I didn't see anything special this conditioner did, no glowing or silkiness.  I guess it is just okay.  I wouldn't buy it.  Soybean product in conditioner?  I don't like the idea of soybeans in my conditioner.  Maybe that's why the hair didn't glow or was silky.  This conditioner might be good for some, but not for me.  Oh, it's usable if you don't have anything else, but I wouldn't buy it.  It could have gotten 3 stars, but the soybeans brought it down to one.

While not as good as Pamela's Chocolate Chunk mix, these ready-made treats are tasty.  They are a bit sweeter than they are chocolate, which is a turn off for me, though the dough has a rich vanilla flavor.  They would be much better made with dark chocolate.  If you're looking for a ready-made chocolate chip cookie that's gluten-free this one's the best there is.

Summary: Not bad, not sure if it really works
Text:
I'm giving this four stars because the flavor isn't offensive and there's no aftertaste. It also is not loaded up with sugar.

However, I have no idea if this is actually beneficial to one's health or actually does what it is advertised to do.

If you like to flavor your water with somehing that's not sugary, this is an attractive option. I can also see it being a desirable additive to your water that you take on a bike ride or to the gym.

Summary: EXCELLENT COFFEE - 80 ct cheapest at Sams Club
Text:
This is the only K-Cup my mother will drink. Her actual home brewer preference is Folgers 100% Columbian medium-dark roast from the can. They don't use that actual blend in K-Cups. My mother has Neuropathy, her fingers are becoming numb and nerves have a stinging sensation. Keurig is her easiest way to make a cup of coffee without going through all the stages to make a home brewed batch.

SamsClub.com pricing as of this review...
Newman's Special Blend EXTRA BOLD Keurig K-Cups 80 ct.
$36.88 box
$5.94 shipping (Go to the club to save on shipping)

I bought three boxes.

If you don't have a Sam's Club account, you can still buy but add 10% premium to cost of product.

Putting aside all of the "Vigorate," "Rejuve" and "Awaken" marketing, Trident Vitality is a pretty solid chewing gum.

The peppermint flavoring is not as intense as other gums (there's not a huge spike in flavor when you first bite in that quickly dissipates), but its flavor does last a while.

The gum itself is fluffier than most other gums. That is, it's not as tough and dense as other brands like Orbit and Eclipse.

I received the gum as a free sample, but I would definitely buy it.

This product is surprisingly good tasting for a fat-free food. I am very pleased with the taste and the obvious health benefits of a fat-free salad dressing. Add this to tuna fish for a healthy meal and good bodily health overall.
I love my Tassimo, and I love this flavor of coffee.  I actually prefer it to many coffees as restaurants.  It's strong, but doesn't have a bitterness to it.  Try it if you like strong coffee.

I put a sign up at my workplace that reads, "There is no strong coffee, only weak men." Alright, I'll admit that there are some coffees that are stronger than others, but not very many that are stronger than Jet Fuel. And, this is actually my wife's favorite brew, so no more excuses girly men! This has a very dark, strong flavor with just the right amount of bitterness to round out the flavor. However as mentioned in the title, it's for adults. We drink this as our every day coffee, but also keep some more milder flavors for guests and "weak men".

My dog loves these chews, however they are expensive and at over 70lbs. he goes through one in minutes.  He is still a puppy so I don't know how great these chews work on his teeth...better the chew then my furniture!
I have a persian and a picky little himalayan.  They both love this stuff!  It looks exactly like pictured and is MUCH more expensive in stores.  Try $2.29 a can!  Great deal here!

Summary: Instead of mayo, use Banana Yoplait Yogurt instead.
Text:
This is a delicious, easy pasta salad to make and it only takes 21 minutes to make until you put it on the table. The Bacon taste really its the spot. Just follow the easy directions on the back.
Health Hint: May I suggest instead of adding 1/2 cup of mayonaise, use Banana Creme Pie Yoplait Yogurt instead for a real tasty treat.
Put it in the freezer for 7 minutes to serve cold.

My very finicky cat loves the Sardine and mackeral flavor!  And I like the natural ingredients. However, it is becoming very difficult to find in stores.  Petsmart is no longer carrying it and very few independent stores carry it either.  At least that is the case in our area of NC and in the Myrtle Beach area of SC.  Unfortunately it costs much more to ship it than it does for the product when purchased online.  But I highly recommend this canned cat food.

Summary: These are being taken off the market
Text:
My little Lhasa loved these, but she threw up big balls of starch. Apparently, this is such a common problem, Zuke's is soon taking this line off the market and releasing a new replacement product in the next few months. Small dogs don't have the digestive track needed to process these. They will be switching from the existing potato formula to a more digestible Tapioca line.

I need to hand it to Zuke's though. I told them about the product, and they rushed to send me samples and refund my money.

Summary: Definitely a strong cup of coffee for the Keurig
Text: Although this is one of the strongest blends of coffee I have found for the Keurig, it is a little bitter - in good French-roast style, but I didn't give it five stars because I like the flavor of the Rainforest Espresso blend a little better.  Not quite as strong but the flavor makes up for it IMHO.

Once in a while Amazon recommendations really hit one out of the park. I took a chance and ordered this based on a recommendation and the reviews and I'm glad I did. We use this on almost everything we cook. It spices up chicken, red meats and even fish fantastically. It you like some spice in your food, it's addictive.

There is joy in my heart to have discovered that Amazon stocks UNFROSTED Brown Sugar Cinnamon Pop Tarts.  To my dismay, the grocery stores in my area no longer carry them.  There's nothing more delightful than to experience the warm, fresh-from-the-toaster goodness of an UNFROSTED Brown Sugar Cinnamon Pop Tart with butter slathered on it. I love to make slits in the pastry so that the butter can ooze into the sweet filling. Oh the thought of it!  Thanks Amazon.

This product is superior to almost any other nut bar on the market and the only one I buy on a regular basis, because it is composed almost exclusively of nuts (almonds)and seeds and is not too sweet.

Summary: The Best Funnel cake mix out there
Text: Ive tried a few different brands of funnel cake mix out there. I've even tried making it from scratch.  By far Dean Jacobs is the BEST mix EVER!!!  It taste even better than then ones they have at the amusement parks.  All of my guest enjoy it so much, that when they know they are visiting they will always ask that I make it.  My only regret is that they dont deliver to canada, and I have to wait when my sister visits for her to bring it.
I find pepper blends to have more flavor for uncooked dishes like salad etc and this one does not disappoint. Good price and a nice ratio of different peppercorns, I would buy this again.

Summary: Good eating but not effective dieting
Text: I like these noodles.  They do not have the texture of pasta, but I grew up in Japan often eating osoba with these type of noodles, so it was very familiar.  They also taste good with marina sauce and cheese.  However, my body is not fooled by them.  Less than an hour after eating a package, I'm hungry again.  I tried having two packages at once, and I still get hungry.  So they're a nice treat, but not helpful in trying to control my calorie intake.

Summary: Arizona Arnold Plamer Half and Half
Text: Now how great is this!! To have united two of my favorite drinks, lemonade and tea, was an astounding idea.  And the taste is superb.  Will buy again and again.
This package is a good deal if you use a lot of it. The cost is far less when purchased in this bulk manner. One must consider freshness when buying in such quantities.

These bars are great for a snack, for a pick me up on a hike, or to satisfy a 'need a yummy' pang.  My favorite thing is to smash up a bar and then sprinkle it over yogurt for a really  good breakfast.
AMAZING PIE CRUST MIX!! So far I have made 2 apple pies and some Quiche Lorraine and the crust always bakes perfectly!
This will be a staple in my kindergarterner's lunch box. 100% fruit and tastes great.

This product has been a lifesaver when it comes to mixes that call for eggs.  I'm not sure how the mixes would turn out with real eggs, but I have no complaints on how they turn out using the egg replacer.  I have used this extensively with the Namaste Foods mixes and even though the mixes call for multiple eggs, they turn out great using the egg replacer.  Now only if they could develop a way to make scrambled eggs..
These bars taste great. The ingredient list is nice and short. They're a little brittle and can break easily. That's not a problem for me so I give these tasty treats 5 stars.

As usual, taste is a very individualized preference.

This coffee tastes exactly how I like it. I have compared with Folger's brand and Dunkin' Donuts (mixing Vanilla Cream with Hazelnut to get the same effect) and other "house" brands because I'm a tightwad. Anyway, I like Millstone the best even if it costs me a little bit more.

I've been asking family members to bring it to me from Oregon, since Northern California stores don't carry it anymore. But now that I can get it with free shipping from Amazon, I may buy it here instead.
I bought this exact bag of Krabby patty candies for $4.23 at HEB, don't buy them on here. These candies taste good and everything, but your getting ripped off buying them on here.

Summary: Not the same product that I have bought in stores.
Text: The product that was delivered was a fine powdered spice. The product that I have bought in stores and love had lager chuncks of spices, this was not the same product that I have recomended and used over the past years. Also the top had come off during shipping and half of it had spilled out. VERY disapointed!!!!

Summary: Works... but not as well as energy drinks by any means!
Text: I must say I'm kinda disappointed in this gum as I was expecting the same energy spurt that the Monster drinks gave me (as it has the same amount of caffeine, allegedly). I tried to chew 4 pieces (2 supposedly gives you the same amount of caffeine as in an energy drink) and that didn't give me near the amount of energy that a monster does. You do feel a little tingle after chewing 4  pieces but it's more like the feeling you get when you eat a candy bar or drink hot chocolate. I'm guessing that the claims for containing the amount of caffeine is true, but my body isn't absorbing it optimally (If I caffeine pill it - generic caffeine pills from walmart - then I get close to the energy drink energy burst)

I am primarily using this for macaroons, which require the ingredients sifted before mixing. I find very few large pieces that need to be removed.  The product is fresh, seems to be good quality, and works perfectly. I recommend it.

I've been eating a strict Paleo eating diet for nearly one year and including Ghee has been a huge taste benefit. Ghee has virtually no lactose and is healthier than regular butter. I brush this on my chicken breasts and then bake them with a a bit of crushed black pepper and sunflower seeds. The flavor really comes out with so few ingredients. This brand and another one are two of my favorite and they are usually listed with Prime available.

My seven cats like this product so much that they start every morning off with a couple of cans.  All is eaten and they are happy and ready for the day. This brand Fancy Feast has great cat food and my cats pick certain ones that they like and I order them every month.  That God for Amazon and the food being delivered  because with health problems, I would not be able to go to the store and get the cases it requires to feed my babies.  Thanks Fancy Feast and Amazon!!!!!!!!!!!

I was looking forward to trying this beverage mix. I mixed it as directed with 250ml (8 oz) of hot water. It dissolved quickly.  And just FYI, the color of the drink was darker than that pictured on the box. It was a murky brown color. As far as flavor goes, the ginger was just too strong and nasty. I didn't like it at all.
These took me back decades.  The best part was sharing them with my office and seeing adults line up to get a taste of a fizzie.  GREAT fun!

Summary: Excellent mix for salads, cooking, and appetizers
Text: We tried out a large number of bulk olive mixes from Amazon, and this is the one that we've settled on.  The olives are pitted, so they are super convenient, especially for cooking and putting on salads.  We also put them out for appetizers for a super simple, fast cocktail snack.  In a pinch we use them in martinis too, amazingly enough.

Summary: An answered prayer for Autisic Kids!
Text: My son has autism so as a family we are on the Gluten-free diet and trying to find GF foods that taste good is hard!  So happy that Chex is gluten free and that they are expanding there product.  A great buy for moms who seek to help their kids thru this GF journey.

Summary: Chocolate I can eat on my super strict diet! YAY!
Text:
Just got these bars today. Pricey but well worth it - FINALLY chocolate I can eat on my restrictive low carb no sugar diet - I can't have hardly anything on it, but these bars caused no bad reaction in me. Pure chocolate liquor, stevia and vanilla are the only ingredients! The only weird thing is the packaging, I wish they would come with wrappers. Also - I don't feel guilty about my kids having a taste of these zero sugar bars.
Wonderful!

I bought three flavors just to try them out, this flavor was good. I liked them. If your looking for a sweet snack that is filling and yummy I'd go with the Cinnamon flavor, LOVE those. I would NOT buy the Zesty ranch, those tasted awful. All packs are low in carbs and sugar and have good amounts of fiber and protein.([...])

I am now 5 months pregnant and was looking for something I can drink instead of coffee. After reviewing lot, lots of teas and other drinks, I found "this" and have enjoyed this a lot. It is smooth and has sort of let's say...nature's aroma and flavor.. ^^ It is wonderful~~
We love our Keurig maching and this coffee is rich dark and delicious.  Very smooth and strong. Yum!

Martinson's Dark Roast k-cup was a very nice surprise. My only complaint was that it came in a 48-count box. I had never tried this brand and bought it based on other reviewer's comments. Now that I know how good this coffee is, the larger box is not a problem. I prefer a full bodied cup of coffee in the morning and this brew met my needs and is one of my favorites. It is not over-powering, just very good.  I shared this coffee with two friends that have Keurigs and they liked it but said they couldn't find it at the store.  I would definitely buy this again.

Was so excited to find the rice mixture I had been looking for. Easy to complete the order and just a few days later my product was at my house. I'll be ordering soon again because I had so many people who love this rice that I've about given all of it away.

It does expand pretty quickly when soaked in milk but it doesn't get soggy soft unless maybe it's soaked for 30 minutes.
I love it. It tastes good. Sometimes I also a little bit if the Smart Bran on my yogurt. And it's awesome.

These quinoa noodles are the best!  What is even better?  Knowing that when we eat them we're not eating junk, but a whole grain that gives us a full serving of protein!  What's even better than that?  They taste just like regular noodles that we're used to eating!

These dried cherries, along with the blueberries from this same company, are soft and a nice texture and flavor. They are not the typical tough, dry, chewy, dried fruit you normally get from other places. These work very well in homemade breads or just to snack on. I'm anxious to try some of Traverse Bay's other products as well now that I'm so happy with their dried fruits. Very good quality product.

Summary: Over $3.00 / can - you've got to be kidding, Progresso!
Text:
I LOVED this soup as a child. However, now my wife makes me "Italian Wedding Soup" which is better and MUCH cheaper!

Try making that for a *fraction* of the cost with the ingredients you choose. Easy to make - find a recipe on the Internet.

Progresso, be realistic about your prices and I might buy a few cans...

As anyone who owns a cat knows, cats don't always have the same taste. Two out of three cats I feed this to love it. The other one does not get excited at all. As far as hairball remedys are concerned this is definitly one of the better ones. I would buy this again...I would also recommend it to others.
Just regular breakfast coffee...a great way to start the day! I want coffee not flavors or extra caffeine.  This is my "goto" coffee to fully awake.
Ordered this tin.  It is very large.  Great for sharing.  Product was excellent.  Would buy again.  Much cheaper than purchasing in the store.
I bought this for my son because he loves Key Lime. He says it's great, and he wouldn't share so it must be very yummy!

My older cat loves these treats.  If I'm having trouble getting him to eat his canned food I can break up some of these treats on top of his food and that usually does the trick.  He even starts meowing at me if I forget to give him one during the day.  He has stomach issues and this treat doesn't upset his stomach at all.  The treats are dried white chicken breasts that are cut into small pieces and strips.  It does say on the bag that the chicken is human great but I'll just take their word for it.

Summary: Allergy Girl Finds Something She Can Eat !!!
Text: I have Celiac AND I am allergic to soy, potatoes, corn and dairy.  I can tell you that this is one soup that I can eat without having a reaction!  Thank you for making this; it's a life saver...literally!

Summary: what do you mean this isn't play-doh?
Text:
i'm gonna keep this short and sweet

Tastes like play-doh, if you like to eat play-doh.. BUY THESE NOODLES, you won't be dissapointed.

Update: decided to eat real play-doh after trying to eat these noodles. the play-doh tasted better.

My dog loved this treat, but it lasted all of about 30 minutes...and she's only a 22lb pug.  I'm sure if she was a large breed dog, it wouldn't have lasted even that long.  It's an expensive chew to give her for only 30 minutes of enjoyment.  I won't buy it again, as she needs something that will last longer and help to entertain her.
These were just adorable when used on a bee hive cake!  In the right setting they add that special designer touch to a cake that can turn a nice cake to a piece of edible art.

Really great taste!  Smooth, pleasant, and a nice change from the traditional coffee k-cups when you're looking for something a bit different.  I wouldn't want them all the time, but as a treat, they're awesome!
Love this product! These are snacked in my house constantly. I am a big fan of Go Raw and have subscribe and save to their Spicy Mix and Simple Mix as well.

Summary: Almost as good as the original
Text: I have been looking for fruit filled mini-wheats for about 15 years.  They were harder and harder to find before being discontinued.  These are almost as good as the original; my only complaint being that the original was not frosted, and I would prefer them unfrosted because the fruit adds enough sweetness. I paid $4.96 at the grocery store for one box- so Amazon's price is great.
My doggies love these.  They are just the right size for a small dog and they are nice and soft!
Great vegetarian Food.  Don't have time to make chili?  Just use this canned version - it is great.  Not spicy - add hot sauce if you want it to be spicy.

I bought this cake because I miss the seven layer cakes that are available in New York (where I grew up).  There was not enough cake.  And, the filling was not the light colored chocolate buttercream as shown in the picture. It was more chocolate frosting.
Everyone in our family enjoys these noodles and they are similar in flavor to what we had in Viet Nam.  Very reasonable in price and super convenient.

I know some reviews said that the packaging wasn't adequate, however I think they have changed the packaging. The tea comes in a sealed foil bag, in a paper bag in the box shown. There was no spillage of the tea. The tea flavor was great in a smoothie that I made. I was very happy with the tea.

I've never seen our cats chow down on dry food like this before. It's grain-free which is very important and *without* by-products.  A very quality cat food which they think is tasty. Also, NO vomiting issues at all. Will continue to buy as part of their variety of quality foods.
I like this brand of coconut oil. It is great to cook with and gives a slight coconut flavor to the food or baked good.

I ordered this product because of the rave reviews.  When you open the bag, it smells like Christmas...Wonderful!  But...the flavor is a strong combination of orange, and cloves.  For someone who's diet is relatively bland, this was a little overpowering for me.  I have tried the Apple Raisin Walnut flavor and loved it.
Switch Bev taste great, my fav was the grape but they all have a great taste.  Most important my kids love them!

Summary: Vanilla covering mars the texture and taste of the snack
Text:
I wanted to like this healthy snack, and perhaps I chose the wrong flavor. The blueberries were nice -- tangy and flavorful. The grain is crunchy. But the vanilla covering (or glue or whatever it is that is sticking the grains together) has an unpleasant rough, starch-like texture and a bland aftertaste, kind of like that chalky aftertaste you get from Pepto-Bismol (although NOT that flavor.)

I think I will give this brand another try in another flavor.

Summary: Lower in sodium, yes. LOW sodium? NO!
Text: This tastes just like the regular soy sauce but if you're looking to reduce sodium, keep in mind that a serving (15g or about .5 ounce) is 575mg of sodium. Don't be fooled by the "lower sodium" label.
better than grahm crakers and they do not spike your blood sugar (at least not mine.)
They're not kidding, this is more sweet than sugar.  I'm loving it in my coffee in the morning.  The bottle still has a way of leaking (the one fault) but it's not that big of a deal.

This is great gum!  I have never been big on chewing gum but I really like the Trident Splash.  I walk 2 to 4 miles every morning (weather permitting) and I chew gum when I walk (helps me think.  No music stuck in my ears! I want to hear the birds singing.).  I find the Trident Splash is the best for keeping its flavor!  When I found the Trident Splash Peppermint Twist I would buy all of it from the drugstore that carried it.  They do not carry the Trident Splash anymore nor does any other stores that I can find.  I'm just happy I found it on Amazon.com and hope the company who produces it does not discontinue this gum.  Thank you, Maxine

My cat, like most cats, is a picky eater.  So it is kind of hard feeding him because either he doesn't like the food or he gets bored with the food he likes.  He makes life a bit harder for me.  Luckily for me he like this stuff.  Now he doesn't wait for me to feed him, he goes right into the bag and feeds himself.
Can you say sugar high? LOL That was the point in ordering a case. I sent it to my husband who's deployed overseas. He loves them!
Make an instant espresso latte or add a dash to your regular cup for a smooth flavor.  Once you try it, you'll always want to have it on hand.

Lowrey's has changed it's microwave pork rinds. I used to love them. The last order I received was put up in a generic paper container with really flimsy cellophane wrapping. There is no writing on the paper sack whatsoever. The taste is sub par as is the amount of rinds. As I said, I used to love the product. I will buy no more Lowrey's microwave pork rinds.
these just look like coffee beans. they are dry, old beans even though the expiration date is 2 years off. i don't recommend them.

Our mixed breed medium sized dog normally eats most of her food right after her 2 feedings, 1 cup in the morning and 1 cup in the evening. When she would eat this food she would come in the next room where we were, almost gagging - like a cat with a hair ball. Plus she would not finish what was in her dish.

Perhaps it is the corn meal which is the main ingredient, after all dogs are carnivores, or the funny shaped pieces that are included... who knows but this was not a hit with the 4 legged member of the family.
The bag is nice with a zipper closure though - that's about the good we found for this brand.

My daughter has gluten and dairy allergy, and these brownies have the flavor, texture and feel of
regular amazing brownies. They smell wonderful and have a super taste, not weird or pasty... really
worth the price... and the convenience of instant...priceless... really...

Summary: Sell by date of food items
Text: This item is sold containing four bottles of HP Sauce, each bottle has a sell by date that is only 2 and 1/2 months away, I think that this self life is far to short and I will not purchase food items from Amazon again.

Summary: No mess low sugar puffs for baby
Text:
I love the low sugar and that they are made from organic ingredients.
I am always looking for a healthy low sugar alternative to Graham crackers that don't make a mess.
I use to buy mmm-mmms that Until I Read on the lable that they are manufactured in china, which I just dont trust.
These happy baby puffs have been great. So far my son has tried the green puffs and sweet potato
And loves he them.

I have 2 German Shepherds and both have very sensitive stomachs. We used to deal with diarrhea frequently. Once we switched to Royal Canin everything got better. Also, the pieces are pretty big so unlike other food the dogs can't just swallow these without properly chewing first. I highly recommend this food to all the German Shepherd owners.

I love Manna Soy products.  As a gluten-free vegan family (celiac issues), these products are a dream come true.  I've used them in wraps, stir-fries, slow cooker recipes, and plain (since they're pre-seasoned).

I found this at our local grocer ( at a fraction of the price here ) labeled as a fruit spread ( not fruit conserv ). It has lots of strawberry pulp, seeds, etc. and is not overly sweet. The best tasting spread I've found so far.
What can I say....it's dog food and my dog loves it.  I am pretty sure any dog would love this product too...its food!

This product has loads of pink peppercorns in it.  Great flavor profile and excellent ratios of pink & green corns vs less of the white and black corns.  very good value and very nice mix.  Love to cook and this is my new FAVE for value and flavor.
good deal for the price!  but i do wish they would sell the la llave in the cans aswell as the bags

My wife and I have had a SodaStream for about a year now. It hasn't changed our lives, but we like it.

Some flavors are excellent, most are passable (think generic soda), and a few aren't so good.

But this Cherry Cola flavor, oh my goodness, it is AWFUL.

If I had to describe it, it's kind of a mediciney black licorice. Just terrible. They need to abandon this flavor, because if this were the first flavor I'd sampled, I'd immediately walk away from the SodaStream display.
We love spicy food, but this was way too spicy (even for my husband, who is always ordering his food extra spicy). The flavor was pretty good, but we just couldn't handle the heat.

I like this product because it contains both meat and veggies and it does not contain grain products at all.  The foil pouch is convenient to  open (with scissors) and store unused portions in the refrigerator.  It is a good value for the price.
This really does make a difference in making pizza.  I will continue to buy this flour for any pizza dough.

Summary: Very strong taste, best when combined with other roast
Text: This has a very strong flavor. I love this coffee as long as I mix it with another roast. I prefer this 25% and a french roast 75% or 30/70 with another hazelnut roast.

If there is one good thing about a cold Winter's day it is hot soup. The Women's Bean Project provided me with one of the best and it is good for me too. How often can we do something that is good for us and so enjoyable at the same time?
I have told all of my friends about it and I hope they will, in turn,spread the word so that the women of the Bean Project are kept busy and prosper.

When you take the pleasant burn of alcohol out of a cocktail like an appletini, you end up with a taste hardly distinguishable from Jolly Rancher candy.  Not to say this is a bad drink.  Just that "Appletini" is not what comes to mind when I drink this.  It does have a pleasantly sweet taste, exactly what you'd expect from Crystal Light.

It's Branston pickle, what is there to say. If you've never tried it you most likely wont like it. If you grew up in the UK its a staple on cheese of cold meat sandwiches. It's on my lunch sandwich today! :)

A massive sherried whisky, balance is not in the profile of this monster. I think everyone should try it once. High ABV so just take smaller sips to avoid anesthetizing your tongue.  If you choose to add some water do so slowly to avoid drowning it. I prefer the earlier batches, but if you have nothing to compare then you won't know the difference. Not for every day, but a great one to have around when you have some educated scotch drinkers over.  Good stuff.
My dog is one picky eater..But she loves this dry food, when I mix it with Beneful wet dog food..She's happy..I'm happy....
That's exactly what I was looking for to bake some chouquettes (puffs with small sugar pearls on top). Works great, yum!!
My dog loved these, but they gave him very bad diarrhea. He woke up 4 times during the night to go. Never buying these again!

My little girl will pretty much eat everything - she's not particularly picky.  She definitely enjoys her jar of Apple Butternut Squash.  My only complaint is that it's a bit runny which results in a fairly messy meal.  I myself have sampled the goods - pretty tasty!
I have ordered cereal from Amazon twice and both times everything was great.  I will order food from them again as it is so simple and it arrives very quickly.

We decided to buy a movie style popcorn maker out by warner. It is awsome the Paragon Coconut Oil is alright although lacks true movie theatre taste we was hoping for. I recommend organic coconut oil with very little sea salt, it is by far better tasting and much healthier.

With 190 calories, 12 grams of fiber and 6 of protein, this little bar packs a lot of nutrition in one small package. It will keep you from being hungry for hours. I love the combination of chewy and crunchy.

Summary: Delicious! Best Blueberry coffee I've had!
Text: This coffee is just the right amount of blueberry taste. When brewing, the smell of freshly baked blueberry muffins spread through the house. It is absolutely wonderful. At first I was skeptical if the flavor would be tasty, but if you imagine the combination of flavors of a blueberry muffin and sipping on coffee, that is the taste of this coffee. I have even mixed it with cheaper, regular coffee--it still tastes delicious and lasts twice as long. In my opinion, this is the best blueberry coffee I've tried yet.

Summary: Great quality coffee at a reasonable price
Text: I am a coffee snob, I'm also a coffee snob who drinks a lot of coffee (is there another kind?) While this is not the best coffee I've ever had, it is a very good dark roast that is neither bitter nor bland. It has a slight nutty, almost chocolaty undertone that I really enjoy but doesn't make it taste like an artificially flavored coffee. Each bag is sealed tightly and always arrives fresh. I have this coffee on subscription and for the price it just can not be beat.

Fiesta Seasoning Pinto Bean, 4.5-Ounce (Pack of 6) Pioneer Woman, Ree Drummond uses this seasoning in her Pinto Beans with corn bread recipe. Not finding it here in the Phoenix area I ordered it online. Didn't know what I was going to do with 6 bottles but started handing them out to family and friends.

Everyone loves it!

Daughter uses it on steaks and hamburgers on the grill. I liked it on my pintos. I recommend it to everyone.

Just add a little at first because it gets stronger as it heats.Daughter disagrees with me and adds a lot more so try it , you'll like it.

This tea is the first cup I have in the morning.  Follow the directions with almost boiling water and a 5 minute steep.  I have not been successful using a bag more than once, however. A little stevia intensifies the flavor.  I always order an extra box so I never run out, a problem since I am often giving some to friends.

These chews are excellent for the dogs' teeth and they love them too.  When I need some time to myself or if I am working on something that requires 100 percent of my attention, I give them one to chew and it keeps them quiet and occupied for quite a while.

I know the purists cringe, but these pods are very good.  I never had the talent/time or inclination to learn how to make a real cup of espresso from scratch, so this is the perfect compromise.  Develops a better crema than Illy, almost as good as a coffee shop could produce.  And the decaf means I can have a cup in the evening and not end up watching the Late, Late, Late Night Movie.
My wife and I are both milk intolerant. There are several recipes we could not make without this product, and they taste just great with it.

Summary: I love this stuff and I'm not a vegetarian!
Text:
Ok! I like to eat vegetarian when I can. Read about Nature's Burger in a book about the Greatful Dead. Well, this stuff is awesome, I've used it to make veggie nuggets for the kids, all kinds of burgers (including my favorite with siracha cucumber sauce and hosin)....have also improvised and made stuffed peppers with quinoa, nature's burger and beans, as well as stuffed cabbage with nature's burger, rice, and tomatoes. I just wish there were more recipes out there!

Also, for people that have had probs....the trick is as it is spelled out on the box. One part Nature's Burger to one part boiling water. Let it sit for like 15 minutes. Rub oil on your hands when making the patties if it is too sticky.

Summary: Zero calories and zero everything else!
Text: This stuff rocks! Yeah, it has a little apple cider vinegar taste but I like it. The flavor is not overwhelming and it's a healthy, clean and refreshing drink. It is almost impossible to find good-tasting bottled drinks with ZERO CARBS that taste good and don't have aspartame or Splenda in them.  The other Bragg's Apple Cider Vinegar drinks have carbs in them but this Ginger Spice flavor is ZERO. This one is a keeper for me. On a hot day it's just perfect and it doesn't affect my weight or my blood sugar.

This wooden tea chest makes an excellent gift, and is an elegant, useful piece in any dining room setting.  The teas are mild but not bitter, each distinctive in its own right, and perfect as a breakfast tea or afternoon sipping tea.  The tea chest compares quite favorably to the more expensive chests, without the cost!!
Great service!  Arrived in great time, and things were perfect!  Look forward to ordering from you again.
My wife did several hours of research, and found that this product is best for cat's nutrition. Low ash and fat content, real meat, no grain. Also, cats love it!
This is very high quality olive oil for the price.  Nice flavor and color.

Summary: Unsatisfying flavor --- and too much work
Text:
I've tried several of these Annie Chun noodle dishes and soups with noodles. I don't find any of them very good as compared with 'real' Asian food. Some aren't too bad when doctored with some soy sauce, hot sauce, or other sauce. And some aren't too bad for ease of preparation.

This one isn't easily doctored, nor is it that fast/simple to make. Therefore I don't see any reason to keep in the pantry. If I don't feel like spending 20-30 minutes to make my own Asian food from scratch, I'll stick with better/easier ready-made products to keep on hand.

Summary by Durkee said their Steak Dust was the same as Tone's Steak Dust, and in fact Durkee makes it for Tone's. Well, the results are in after several cook-outs and I don't believe they taste the same. The Tone's flavor is much more intense and I usually use quite sparingly, just a dusting. If I do the same with the Durkee's - I can't taste anything !

The original Steak Dust I tried was called Montreal Steak Dust, but now I can't find that anywhere, nor the Tone's steak dust.

Bummer !

atl
We received a box of truffles as a gift and I just had to have more.  If you are a chocoholic, like I am, you are gonna love these truffles.  Ordered on Friday and received on Monday ~ AWESOME!
Arrived on time - it's less expensive at Amazon than in the gocery stors, assuming you can even find Seneo's decaffeinted coffee, which I usualy can't.

Too "crunchy," "made in China," are you kidding me? This is justification for the two stars reviews?

These bars are an excellent value (less than a buck apiece), have a great shelf life, taste great and are about as healthy as you can get. Yah, I suppose I'd prefer them to be made in the U.S., but I'm reviewing their taste, not their country of origin.

i vaguely remembered this cereal until my Aunt reminded me. She made me look for this cereal. it arrived on time and the pkg was in good condition. My Aunt gave me 1 box....OH MY GOD. now i remember, this cereal is the BOMB.
i followed the directions on the pkg. I added non dairy milk chocolate chips(ghiridelli)for to sweeten and added raisins and sprinkle some (ceylon cinnamon)....i almost ate my hand off.
this is great and the price was good....try it

I was afraid that exactly what happend, would, and it did! I am a huge fan of the "Organic" Fair Trade from Coffee People, but of course saw that it was out of stock, which led to my order of the Tree Hugger blend with some hesitation. I was right!!! It tastes like, perhaps, one would expect Tree bark would taste. It is no "fair trade" at all for the Organic. Will never order again, nor do I have the heart to even give it away. It's going back to the earth in which it came, via: Garbage pick-up.

Summary: Fabulous Honey At A Fabulous Price
Text: This is fabulous honey. It tastes like clover honey, but more fresh, as it is raw, but not overpowering. The container is nice. You cut the tip off to the size that you want. Easy to squeeze and the honey doesn't drip all over and make the bottle sticky. The price is great, especially for raw honey. It's cheaper than the pasteurized and refined clover honey at the grocery store. I will be purchasing this again.
Best rub I've ever used on my pork ribs. This was my first use of Szeged, but it certainly won't be my last. I loved getting all the raves that I received from my guests.

Summary: Easy and you can substitute oil for butter (for cupcakes - I haven't tried it for the cake).
Text:
I JUST used this mix for the first time and I was so excited that I had to review it immediately. We substituted canola oil for the butter and made cupcakes which came out perfectly! Be aware that this mix only makes 12 cupcakes (or a small one layer cake) - so it's not your typical Betty Crocker cake mix in quantity but it is very easy and costs much less than buying gluten free prepared cupcakes (or cakes etc) that we have found.

We all LOVED the cupcakes including my husband who is NOT entirely eating gluten free (yet). My sons who are 6 and 4 LOVED them (of course).
I don't know about the others, but I agree wholeheartedly with the previous reviewer who said the Ginger Cookies were AWFUL!  Mine went into the trash after I tasted one of them. Save your money!

If you are tired of eating soup that tastes like it has been in a can for years, continue eating your Campbell's and Progresso soups. Wolfgang Puck's soup is outstanding, the best you can get out of a can. His corn chowder is the best corn chowder I've ever eaten. Fat is flavor, so if you want a delicious soup, get this one.

I love coconut water. It's so refreshing. I've been wanting to try some of the flavored coconut waters and grabbed this when it was on sale.

I'm sorry to say that I didn't like this flavor at all. It had a sour taste to me that I really disliked. I drank down one, but was not happy to think of drinking the other 11! sigh... I gave the rest of them to my brother and I hope he enjoyed the flavor more than I did. I wont be getting this flavor again.

Summary: I Have Been Looking For This For Awhile
Text: I love this as a snack between meals as well as at work. The individual bags makes it easy to take anywhere I go. This has a great flavor . Love the pretzel and the crunch. This came in to large boxes

Summary: Taste bud, pocket book, and environmentally friendly
Text: I would give it a 4.5 if the grading system would allow. Taste bud friendly: I love a dark and oily bean and this one satisfies the foodie in me. Pocket book friendly: Buying bulk beans and using super saver helps save money. Environmentally friendly: This last Earth Day I learned about the importance of shade grown coffee; buying it is one small thing I can do to have a positive effect on the environment. Although these are not listed as shade grown beans, after contacting the company I've learned that they are. I like that I can save money, satisfy my foodie nature, and help the environment.

Summary: Hooray! Large quantities with minimal packaging
Text: I made pans of jello "bites" for snacking by using 4 packets of Knox, 3 large boxes of jello and water (by eye) to a large, flat pan. That takes a lot of gelatine, and I appreciate having large quantities available instead of the small 4-piece boxes which contribute so much more cardboard to my recycling bin.

ICIO is a wonderful product, the packaging is dynamite.  It is, however, quite pricey.  I wish that I could drink it on a regular basis but my purchases are limited to make this a "treat" rather than a "staple".

This product is good a trapping the insects that land on it.  However, while it claims that the yellow color attracts the insects, that doesn't seem to be the case.  They seem just as likely to land on the plant itself as they do the traps.
Really great flavor - a little goes a long way - But man what a punch! Tried it on shrimp, then with chili - both were great! It's very tasty!
My kids and I love Vanilla Bean Cooladas and wanted to make them at home.  This is the exact flavor as Dunkin Donuts.  We have it coming in every couple of months on Subscribe and Save.
We use this for our dogs digestive system. We can't find it locally. It is a great product and our dogs love it.

Summary: You know the product is good...
Text: You expect the product to be good. The cool thing was the shipping ended up being free and it only took a couple of days to get to us. Our total out of pocket was less than retail. Besides, we were hit with some major snow and didn't have to go out to get it...
This cereal was good but it is inconsistant with the sweetener and cinnamon flavoring. Seems every box varies in taste.

First of all I would like to say that my puppy LOVES this food! I have a 4 month old Lhasa Apso and he licks his bowl well after he has finished eating. When I first got him the breeder had him on Purina Puppy Chow. The first thing I wanted to do was to switch him to a high quality, no grain diet and after alot of research and reviews,Taste of The Wild always came on top(dollar wise). After the switch I immediately noticed a difference in my puppy.His coat is starting to shine and is sooooo soft to the touch. He has so much energy now and he has less eye discharge and less ear odor(due to being allergic to the Puppychow).
Don't hesitate to buy this olive oil.  This is the best ever! I have been using this product faithfully for years.  I use it for cooking, salad dressings, dipping bread, etc.

Summary: Great way to start the day
Text: I have tried a lot of waffle mixes and when I want a basic "no wild flavor" waffle this is the one I always use. It is quick and easy to mix up and the taste and texture can't be beat in my opinion. It is moist and airy inside and crispy on the outside, with a delicious taste. Pour on your favorite syrup or fruit spread and enjoy.

Summary: great taste, more fat than i expected
Text: Tastes great and I'll happily finish the box but my mistake for not checking the nutritional info more carefully before ordering... 15g of fat per bar is pretty damn high. I was hoping for a protein snack that was pretty lean otherwise. This is sweet and delicious but not as 'healthy' as I was hoping for.

Summary: Catch is not a British product
Text:
Catch Bar was first produced in 1976 at the HB Chocolate factory in Tallaght, County Dublin, Ireland. Soon after its launch CATCH became 'the' best selling chocolate confectionery item in Ireland out performing all its competitors including major imported brands. The Catch Bar became synonymous with the ever popular television advertisement from 1976 featuring the jingle.....'Catch it if you can'

Thirty four years on, it remains one of the most recognisable candy bars in Ireland and The Catch Bar is now sold in more than twenty countries throughout the world.
