A truly unique syrup may be made by combining 1 Cup Turbinado and one cup water, bring to a boil for one minute, add 1 tsp of Arrowroot powder with a whisp, boil gently for 2-3 minutes, add 1 tsp each of Pure Vanilla and Maple flavoring, remove from heat and refrigerate when cooled.

Summary: Coffee for People Who Don't Like Coffee
Text:
These are my two favorite k-cup coffees - primarily because any coffee taste is easily masked.

The mudslide is delicious, you really do taste the caramel and chocolate in it. I mix it with French Vanilla creamer, and then it's like a mudslide a la mode.

The chocolate glazed donut smells like a donut, and there is a subtle taste too. The donut is a lighter roast than the mudslide which is also noticeable.

My coworker was set on the Nantucket and French Roast k-cups, but even he started drinking these.

This item is very tasty. It actually tastes better than bouillon. When I made pilaf using this chicken base it tasted exactly the way it tastes when I use homemade chicken base. Lots of flavors, kosher/halal, 100% natural product with number one ingredient being chicken with natural juices and reasonable price. What else to expect from a jar of chicken base.
Exactly what I ordered and super fast delivery. So much easier than grocery shopping, expecially when its not a common ingredient.
I give these to my 2 year old instead of juice boxes,which are basically sugar water. She loves them and they're good for her, so I love them too!

I received a cactus "stick" a little over six inches in height.  It is in the process of being rooted.  They advertised "one gal plant. Blooming, fruiting size."  This is completely false.  There is nothing blooming, and this is not "fruiting size."  I know, because I have a collection of these cacti.  The "stick" has no branches or segments on it.  The "one gal" was a plastic pot, one-third filled with dirt with the "stick" shoved down into it, the rest was empty and was totally unnecessary but was presumably used to help drive up the cost of shipping and handling.  They are claiming that the current price is marked down from $49.99 suggesting a great deal of savings.  That, too, is an outrageous claim.

I was a little leary on ordering this soda as I have never tried any of it. I am trying to get products that are more natural without all the additives. I decided to try this one because my 6 year old really loves Dr. Pepper. He loved the taste of it, it does have the taste of dr. pepper, just not as sweet. I would buy this again.

Mauna

These are tasteless. I usually buy Mauna Loa, which I LOVE, but Costco was out of them.

So I bought these for my birthday. This brand needs to change to a different oil or something to add flavor. UGH!

I'm returning them.

Summary: Got sick from this product, not GF
Text: My daughter & I are GF and we both got very sick from eating only these. We didnt eat anything else at night and in morning we were very sick, like we ate alot of gluten. I dont get it, it says GF and Certified, etc. They tasted good, but I felt so bad I couldnt do anything the next day and my poor 3yr old told me her belly hurt. I wont ever eat them again.

This is a good cereal. I've had others by this brand, and like them as well. Not as crazy about the vanilla in my cereal, and probably won't get this exact one again - but that is a personal preference. I would definitely recommend it to anyone who likes the vanilla idea.

MarketSpice Tea is the best tea I've ever had the pleasure of enjoying.  Whenever I visit Seattle, I do ensure my first stop is Pike Place Market.  I stock up on this tea, take it back home, and then throw my stock into the freezer for months worth of future enjoyment.  It's also great that I may also replenish my stock right here at Amazon as well!  Do know that it does go rancid if not stored properly.  I find that the freezer the best place to store and prolong its life well after expiration.  This special blend of black tea with natural spices, cinnamon, orange peel, and essential oils is quite pleasing to the palate.  If you haven't had the pleasure of sampling this tea, do so!  You won't be disappointed.

these fruits are really a great gift for someone ....interesting looking and great tasting!  i love them!  i have sent them to family and friends and they too loved them a lot!  really tart and sweet at the same time....

I'm surprised Haribo allows their name on this product. It's nothing like their more traditional fare (Golden Bears and the like). It's something that I would expect to see from Brach's. I won't eat it (and neither will my grandkids). As it's said, live and learn.

Summary: Great taste but way too much salt...and I like salt
Text:
Great taste but way too much salt...and I like salt.
So I tried mixing half of this stuff with equal amounts of all purpose flour.

Just not the same.
I wish they could reduce the amount of salt and let us add salt if we desire
It'll bring tears to your eyes!! Tastes as good as the best homemade horseradish you've ever eaten and the tears are real because it's delightfully "hot"..

If you all want a tasty, light, crispy wheat free cracker I recommend KOYO brand organic rice crackers.  They have a few flavors like garlic and I think teriyaki (though I can't find that one lately).  These mary's things taste like card board and sand.  Who would review these so highly?  Maybe they like the flavor of cardboard and sand.  I myself like a light, crispy, more flavorful cracker.  I like teh KOYO but I am getting bored of just that one brand so I keep looking for more organic wheat free crackers but when my husband and I tried the "Mary's" we both almost threw up.  I instantly threw the whole box in the garbage.  Also the KOYO are sturdy enough for dipping too.

I have used it many times and the flavor is wonderful. I highly recommend it, it is free of processed sugars and flours. I sauteed chicken in a little organic cold-pressed extra virgin coconut oil and added a little punjabi garam masala, I added the soup mix and I used So Delicious unsweetened coconut milk for the liquid. I served it over brown rice, my family LOVED it!  I have used it in other dishes as well, and am planning to use it in tuna casserole.

Summary: Zico Rules on the Soccer field
Text: I didn't think they could improve on the original which has sustained me on the most hot and humid days in the mid-atlantic after a grueling soccer game. It works better that any Gatorade-type product I've ever tried. When I was in LA last month, I tried the new original flavor in the bottle and couldn't get enough of it. The only drawback is that it's in only a few stores on the Maryland area. Everyone has the Vita Coco which is always in stock--wonder why?

This is "low calorie" It contains aspartame. This is not made clear in the item description or on the box. The individual K cups aren't labeled low calorie or diet either. Just "natural flavor" It has the disgusting chemical flavor of artificial sweetner.

My cats like the Friskies fillets. Will continue buying the product until they change their appetite for it. So far, they are still looking towards having it. I think the fact there are some bits of either meat or other hard things to chew on, they will like having it.

I am not the the cook in the family so I can't really comment on the product itself except to say my wife asked me to find and buy this specific product. As is often the case Amazon was by far the best deal when you can use the quantity. Apparently shelf life is not a problem when the product is unopened.

My wife used it in a sauce for grilled tenderloin and it was a great sauce.

I seldom give five stars to products, but these are a delightful treat. It's basically an incredibly soft marshmallow, covered in chocolate, and dry coconut. The combination is surprising. They taste very good. Quite sweet, but I haven't it to be overly sweet like other British sweets. This will satisfy your sweet tooth. Of course you must be a fan of coconut and chocolate.

The flavors of the spices are right on for what I expect from jerky we've bought at the store, but making it ourselves made the taste much better because it wasn't stale and hadn't picked up any off flavors from being stored with other products. One seasoning packet flavors an entire pound very strongly. Used with 2 pounds it was a bit too weak, so I wouldn't try to get more than 1 1/2 pounds out of 1 packet. The instructions indicated the jerky could be stored in a cool dry place and did not need refrigeration. Also, it was very informative on how to store the jerky, how long it would last, and what containers it could be kept in.

Great tasting organic product! I have been on a somewhat organic diet since I was a child. My parents always had an organic garden and now I have one. My son also loves organic food and this was a great alterative to regular store brands with character pasta.

Adding organic sour cream or extra cheese to it just enhances the taste. Amazon is a great way to purchase this product if you do not have a Fresh Market or a health food store in your area.

Summary: Love the fresh taste of Blueberry Essence!
Text: When you don't want artificial additives or flavorings and just want a fresh sparkling drink this is the one to get!  Some people come home from work and first thing is have a glass of wine.  I look forward to my Sparkling Blueberry Essence. I always serve it in stemware as it deserves to be. I love that Amazon has automatic delivery available for this item so I always have it available and the cost is less than buying in a supermarket.
I have been drinking the regular and fruit flavored Zico Coconut waters for a few years, and they are good, but the chocolate is wicked awesome!

I ordered these green beans because we like the quality of Libby's products. I got the whole case because I could get free SuperSaver shipping on an order of over $25. And, the 14.5 ounce cans are big enough for our family meals.

But the main reason we like these beans is the simple, natural ingredients. Beans, water, salt - grown and packed in the USA. Unlike another reviewer, I didn't find these green beans to be overcooked or soggy - although they aren't crisp like frozen green beans would be.
I have always been a big Twingings Tea fan and was glad when I got my Kerug that they have K-cups too!!

I am in search of a good German Christmas stolen. Such a stolen should have powdered sugar on it and dried fruits inside. The consistency should be cake like and firm. This stolen was a complete waste of my money (with shipping, almosty $30).
The sugar covering was not powdered by a glaze that cracked when I cut it. The cake was dry and tasteless and crumbled when I cut it. I was okay with paying $30 for what I thought would be a good stoeln but this was not good at all. The stolen looks nothing like the picture and was a huge disappointment.My suggestion is, if this is the only stolen you can find, forget about buying one as you will be disappointed.

Summary: Smells great, but my hair didn't feel clean
Text: Perhaps I have really odd hair texture, but unlike others who have reviewed here, my hair didn't feel clean after using the shampoo. I have very fine, straight as a board hair, that has been colored with a semi-permanent color to hide the grey. It can get dry, but not overly so. I liked the smell of the shampoo., and it lathered up nicely. But after I rinsed, my hair felt greasy, as if I hadn't used shampoo at all. My scalp also felt itchy afterward. Unfortunately I think I'm going to have to keep looking for a shampoo that works for me.

What can I say about cat food?  Well, my 19 year old Tabby will only eat this flavor.  Trout.  Has to be trout. One can every day. Nothing else will do. At this age, she can have whatever she wants!  So that makes finding this item a top priority!  I used to get this at a local PetSmart, but this flavor is hard to find in stock and it's not at the grocery stores.  I love the convenience of the subscription service, the discount and free shipping.  No more worrying about running out to PetSmart and then finding they are sold out. I never guessed I would find this at Amazon, but I was pleasantly surprised.  Sign up for the subscription, get a sweet discount and free shipping and your cat food hassles will be a worry of the past!

Summary: Great Way To Get Sweet Tea Without Sugar
Text:
When we moved to New Jersey I could not find many southern type products.
My mother used this to sweeten tea when I grew up in Georgia. She tried to avoid too much sugar.
Left the south for a while in new Jersey for work and could not find it anywhere! Sad!
Our sweet tea tasted like Splenda which is gross
Was told to go to Amazon for groceries--who knew--and here it is.
Great product thank you Amazon!

to my great-grandmother's house in upstate New York. She was 1st generation Irish American and in her house she followed the Irish tradition she grew up with: coffee is only served at breakfast. Tea, and good strong tea, is served at lunch/dinner and supper.

This tea is very similar to what I remember drinking as a child. It holds up well to milk and sugar (which is how we always drank it).

The price here at Amazon is Amazamazing! I can't even get the price lower than this here in Chicago during a sale.
This blend is very flavorful and lots of polyphenols for health.  I usually drink just white tea but this is a refreshing change of pace.

I found these treats for my cats when we were traveling in our RV down through the US.  My cats could not get enough of them.  I could get them to come into the RV anytime I wanted all I had to do what make a noise like I was opening the bag of Treats and they came running.  They turn their nose up at all the other one's now.  I live in Canada and can't buy them here, so I have to order them from Amazon.

Zuke's baked dog treats are so good for your dog. No wheat or corn added. My little guy really liked the peanut butter n' blueberryz so I thought I would try the chicken n' cherryz. Yep, he really liked these too!!

I am not a coffee drinker, but wanted the Keurig for the ease of offering coffee to clients.  I was excited to see this product and bought 24 (at about .75/cup).  I was incredibly excited when it was making it, as the smell was quite heavenly.  That said, and it may be that I didn't know what to expect, but the drink itself was nice but didn't quite match up to the incredible smell.  I will keep these stocked, but I doubt I will often reach for it over the Cocoa or Teas.  That said, it truly is almost worth making just to grab that wonderful smell!

I was very nervous about ordering this after reading all of the reviews.  I am glad that I went ahead and took a chance.  My box included a great selection of at least 20 different flavors.  Most of the flavors had 2 pods each, with a few singles and three of two flavors.  All of the pods were flavored coffee.  It looks like this company is responding to complaints that others have had, because the box was labeled with an expiration date (although as others have said, the pods were just thrown into the box).  The coffee was not damaged in any way, and I would order this product again.
They are known for curry powder. In Japan I got mustard, wasabi and ginger paste in tube and it was really convenient and delicious. They also have a nice recipes in their web site.
lots of healthy ingredients, even DARK chocolate on the soybeans (which are as soft as marshmallow!), but if you're watching calories, beware! Each little packet costs you about 260!

The first thing you notice about the New Guinea bean is the size. These are large, heavy beans and I had to turn the air to full on my roaster to get the beans to circulate. Not a problem as long as your roaster can handle it. I didn't experience any burned beans.

I gave it a full roast and the results were quite good: full-bodied, well-balanced complex flavors. The taste is similar to the Sumatra beans (one of my favorites) so if you like Asian beans in general you won't be disappointed, especially at the price. I'll be buying this one again after I exhaust this bag.

This product is not mild!  Also, it is bitter to the taste.  If you're looking for something mild, this isn't it.  It's a waste of money -- if you want something with great taste and a milder form, try Tobasco's brand of 'Green Pepper Sauce' (in green bottle).  It doesn't have the bitterness of this product and it is readily available in supermarkets.  The shipping cost on this product is tantamount to highway robbery!

Received the shredded coconut in a very timely fashion, but am very disapponited at the dry, stale, tasteless condition of it.  Therefore am cancelling any future orders of it.  Sorry to say, but I want coconut to taste like coconut!
This is a mixture of half coffee and half hot chocolate and it is delicious.  I often have one in the afternoon for a treat!
I do add an extra can of beans to this soup.  It is a meal by itself.  Best White Bean Soup fit for company.
Items arrived in a timely manner and in excellent condition.  Will do business again with this vendor.
perfect for brother and family(4 kids and dog)  who moved from San Francisco to Maryland.  Package is very cute, home bucket  very appropriate  for welcoming gift

I have very serious period cramps problem. I have to take painkillers every time to stop me from kicking pillows and rolling on my bed. SInce I've been taking painkillers for many years, I was looking for a healthier natural solution than chemical painkillers. I found this product, read some reviews and decided to give it a try. Last month, I drank lots of this tea during my period- about 5-6 tea bags a day, and to my surprise, I experienced my first period without pain in many years! It also reduced my tiredness. I don't like the taste too much(I added lots of honey) but I don't care because the effect is satisfying and it's natural! : )  Love this product!!!

When you pay for 50 K-Cups you expect to receive 50 not 42. The K-cups are expensive enough already.

I think a new K-Cup counter needs to be hired at Amazon.

Valentines gift for my husband. Gobbled them up
quickly because they were so fresh and yummy.

Was wondering how they got this so cheap, now i understand. Sad to say other than the large raisins it's pretty bad. Cashews are not wholes, but more like halves and pieces.

I give it a two star since I still would prefer sunflower over peanuts.

Zapps potato chips are absolutely delicious.  Every flavor is marvelous; we buy them at the grocery store and order the multi-flavor packs online.  Voodoo is our family favorite; it has a perfect amount of Cajun zing but is not hot, just very flavorful.  A bag has never lasted more than one meal at our house - it is constantly being passed and devoured.  The lucky winner is the one who steals the seasoning from the bag liner at the bottom of the feast!  After finding Zapps, we eat no other type of potato chip.  Certainly everyone has his own opinion but for us, Zapps Voodoo is as good as it can get.  Bon Appetit and Laissez Les Bontemps Rouler!
These were NOT good.  They were hard and chewy and my kids wouldn't eat them.  That says a lot b/c my kids will normally eat anything!

Summary: Rainbow Tye Dye Sugar Free Lollipops

Too sweet not enough chocolate for me. I guess I am getting use to the dark chocolate. It was just okay for me. I have tasted better milk chocolate.
Bought these for the office. This is a nice big pack with a good variety. If you're looking for a nice mix of herbal teas, this is an excellent choice.

After going thru at least 10 brands of coffee, the Lavazza is hands down the best on the market. The Super Crema is their flagship selection. I love the aroma of this variety of beans. Its not too wet with oils and therefore works great in my automatic espresso machine. It doesn't get jammed.

Keep it coming!

Summary: good substitute now that Postum is gone
Text: I have tried a number of different coffee substitute hot drinks. This is fine for me.  Actually I like all the brands I've tried, Pero, Caffix, and one other.  They are all very similar. I'm not real particular but I do miss real Postum.

I love these gluten-free Peanut Choco Drizzle Crispy Rice Bars. I was so excited to find these on Amazon and at such a great price. I cannot buy these locally as our gluten-free food items are very limited.

I love that I can buy such a large foil bag of certified organic orange peel at reasonable cost.  No matter the cost in the grocery store I had to be concerned if the peel was food grade or not after sprays and dyes.

Summary: Tastes exactly as described; not hard to get used to.
Text: At first, I had to add a little raw sugar to this to kind of calm down that burnt taste (as the product was described), then I found I was okay with just the coconut crystals.  I actually got these for my husband as he has (well-controlled) diabetes and I dislike artificial sweeteners, but he had purchased a huge supply of those yellow packets and said "talk to me about it when I'm finished using these up".  So I still have some, and may be back for more.  I can see this being delicious for a glaze over a cake or flan as well as everyday beverage use which is all I've done with it.  Product arrived fast and in good condition.

I bought this instant whole milk powder specifically to replace powdered creamer.  It blends well and tastes great! I brewed my cup of coffee and sprinkled in the milk powder, stirred it with a spoon and it was good to go.  Just FYI-  the can is 14.1 oz.  Don't expect a huge can!  It's about the size of the 1 pound can of coffee in the grocery store (you receive 2 cans in your order).

Summary: Good stuff, just don't get caught up in antioxidant properties
Text: This is a great tasting tea.  It smells fantastic, and it really does taste sweet without even adding sweeteners.  I love it.  I wouldn't pay any extra money over their regular tea though.  I seriously doubt the acai is adding very much.  I have a feeling they are just trying to capitalize on the acai craze.  Even if acai helps you, the amount in this tea isn't very much in the long run.

I eat one every morning for breatfast. It was hard for me to give up granola bars but theses have become my favorite on the go choice. If we're going shopping and we might be gone long I always have some stashed in the car. It is always so hard to find things that are tasty and gluten free but these bars fill the bill

These little morsels are absolutely the best mints I've ever had. I call them "nipple mints" because each one has a little nipple-like curvature. I usually put two in my mouth at the same time, and it feels like I'm motorboating my mints.

It also has the perfect amount of mint flavor -- not too strong (like Altoids), but stronger than weak mints like Tic Tacs. I love these things. But mainly because they're nipple-shaped.

I need a girlfriend.

wow, my local grocery stores discontinued this product and the only thing I coud get was beef and chicken broth.  I decided to look this up online and amazon came up as a carrier.  I am very pleased with my order and shipping was free,  It was only pennies more than what I had previously paid at the store.  cool deal thanks amazon and thanks swanson.

It tastes great. Made with real sugar, not high fructose corn syrup. So this is healthier compare to the American Coke Cola but still don't drink too much of this stuff. I give this pack a 10 out of 10.

I would give this blend 5 stars for the smooth start but it does have a little bitterness in the after taste.  Some people love this in a coffee so I would not say it hinders the quality of the Baronet Coffees.  They are individually packaged for freshness and that is a real plus.  I do enjoy the richness and I can get an 8oz cup out of just one pod.

Really good addition to any picnic. This condiment adds a little zest when added to a hotdog or burger. I mix it generously in cottage cheese to enjoy its dill taste. Ounce Bottles (Pack of 12)

Text:
Although it uses (organic <:-) cane juice as a sweetener, it did not give me the usual sugar crash that other sweetened fruit drinks do. I though the taste was wonderful -- not bitter, not too sweet -- very blueberry-ish. And it's abut time someone used the "once forgettable" and often discarded coffee berry, which in fact was what led to the discovery of the coffee bean itself.

bai contains caffeine in abundance but also in abundance are the antioxidants -- so this is a good fruity fun drink that gives you a lift, and IS good for you. Nothing artificial here.
The best pasta on the market for those who need gluten free. And it is a great price. We will keep buying from Amazon for our gluten free needs

Fasatchi makes some outstanding nut-butters! Bought 3 flavors (Hazelnut, Pistachio, and Pecan) and they all tasted true to flavor, surprisingly vibrant, and rich. If you like hazelnuts or want to adventure beyond Jiff and expect a terrific reward, then look no further! =)
I will be buying more in the next couple days. It's great. Hard item to find and am very happy with it. Only wish there was a recommendation for how much OI should use because I'm new to loose tea.

It is a lot for a single user in the home, but I will use every powder particle. This is definitely the white chocolate taste I remember. second sugar product bought from this company, and very pleased I gave them a try!
This olive oil is great. Well worth the price. Has a light taste of basil- great for dipping bread. Package arrived quickly.

As a lover of Kind bars, I was excited to see this granola. I'm generally not a fan of grains unless they're sprouted grains, but this was great. Low glycemic and tasted SO good. It's full of amaranth, quinoa and millet as well as flax which provides the Omega 3. I love how the blueberries add a nice sweet/tart taste but was disappointed to learn that they're blueberry puree as well as apple and plum puree. I wish they were just dried blueberries.

All in all, it's a great granola and has a nice depth / complexity of taste.

I am VERY pleased with this purchase!!! They got here in ONE DAY!! I didn't expect them until Monday. Also I just found out that I got robbed by Hurts Gardens!!! I thought I bought Bhut Jolokia plants and took awesome care of them just to find out they were scotch bonnets!!!!! Hence this purchase. Thanks for the save Angelina Gourmet!!

This is very good!, It has 5gms fiber which helps make you feel fuller,and 0 calories, low sodium. I love it. I had the pink lemonade flavor. I've only been able to find the individual packs. I plan to stock up from Amazon

This is a delicious product. I had not heard or seen anything Quaker-based other than the oatmeal, which I have as a household staple, so I figured that since it's a Quaker product, it must be good!  Guess what?  I was right!  It was moist, chewy and not overly sweetened.  It had just the right amount of everything.  I had it as an afternoon snack along with a cup of coffee and it was awesome.  I'm looking forward to finding them at my local supermarket and having this as a treat every so often.

Text: agave nectar is such a awesome product for pancakes,french toast,or on any thing else you use syrup .and what a good price.

While the beans can be overly soft, their flavor and quality are very good. Eden Organics is one of the few companies that use safe BPA-free can lining. I bought this in bulk because I'm in my 3rd trimester and need to drink this daily to prepare for labor... it's amazing. Am in a small town and couldn't find Vanilla Beans even in the specialty store.  Was afraid to order online thinking the beans might not be fresh. Be extremely cognitive with shilajit! It's expensive but you need just a tiny bit for it to be effective. It is dark brown, and has a smell like smoke, unlike some of the cheap shilajit products sold out in the wilderness.

It's good, yummy, tasty, crunchy and good for you!!

This is my husband's favorite Super Cookie flavor right now!

Enjoy!

I just finished making some cupcakes and they are great!
No funky aftertaste at all! My GF kids said they taste just like "real" cupcakes. That's the highest compliment.
The stick of butter and 3 eggs make them pretty high in calories but the chance to make a good birthday cake for my kids is worth it.
At this price, I was expecting 3 bottles; got a nasty surprise when 1 bottle got delivered.  Amazon sells other brands of 3 bottles for the same price that taste just as good.

Summary: After taste is not to taste
Text: While this product does have some resemblance to brown sugar and cinnamon it can not cover up the horrid after taste of artificial sweeteners. I unfortunately bought 3 bottles and am finally getting used to the fake flavor but should I have to get used to a flavor?

Summary: Great product but price keeps going up!

I wish my dog liked it because it is a healthy organic product. She ate a couple the first day and then she would not touch them. The candy bar itself is one of my favorites. Has all the items that I would want in a bar except I would prefer dark chocolate to the milk chocolate.

The packing was bad. It came with bottle of lotion. One end of the box was mashed making bars on the end mashed together. The lotion had leaked out an inch of lotion making a sticky mess. I didn't report it but was surprised this happened. A first for any item I ordered from amazon.

I have been on a GF diet for ten years. I've used these buns several times over the years and still can't get used to the odd smell and taste. As soon as I open the package I put the remaining buns in the freezer so I know they're "fresh" (maybe if I let them get freezer burn it'd kill the taste?). So why do I continue to buy them? Like the others I'm desperate to have burgers.

I agree with another review in that homemade buns (and bread) are a lot better (but they are so much trouble to make!).

I really love this cereal. It is warming, comforting and great for anytime. The cracked wheat and rye are perfectly balanced by the softer oats and barley. The flax seeds add health benefits without you even realizing that they are there save seeing them. This is quick to cook and even quicker to gobble up. If you like the flavor of whole grains, then this is for you. I highly recommend that you try it and the price with subscribe & save is very fine.

Wow ... this stuff is life-changing.

I normally like my coffee black, but this stuff has transformed my coffeeing habits. I pour tons of it in the bottom of a mug (about as much as can possibly dissolve in the coffee), pour the coffee on top aggressively (to reduce the need for mixing), and enjoy. It probably can no longer be called coffee at that point. I think it tastes like one of those expensive fancy pants "italian beverages" that people richer than me buy every morning. But I don't really know because I am not affluent.

And if you buy 6-packs of CoffeeMate on the Internet, you probably aren't either.

Enjoy life. Drink chocolate-enhanced coffee-like beverage. Made possible by CoffeeMate.
My cat preferred the chicken treat over the beef.  For that reason, I'm giving it three stars.  There was nothing wrong with the product...more of my cat's preference.

Summary: Good, but doesn't beat the real thing
Text: When I see the word margarita on a drink, it just makes me smile.  This Crystal Light version is tasty enough, but you won't ever mistake it for a real margarita, but that is fine too.  It does make a big pitcher, 2 qts/8 cups, which is a good option and something different that the whole family can drink.  My one downfall is that the nasty aspartame is in it, as well as artificial colors.  I am by no means a food purist, but I try to avoid foods/drinks that have chemicals in them that aren't necessary.  Still, as a treat now and then, it is worthy.  And yes, I even added some tequila to mine.  Makes a good drink even better.

Summary: Beware - you might get a "standard" assortment box
Text: In some ways this is false advertising - the box I received was the standard fun assortment which contains chocolate, grape, cherry, orange, and green apple.  The box I received does not match the picture, and I wanted to get this particular assortment because of the lemon-lime, strawberry, watermelon, and blue raspberry - none of which come in the standard assortment.  Even though I still do like every flavor of tootsie pop that's available, I don't mind this standard assortment, but I was definitely caught off guard when what I received did not match what I had ordered.  After sending in my complaint, they did issue me a refund so that was a nice gesture.

If you are looking for a traditional condiment with a little kick, this is your product.  Chicago Fire has a nice heat - not too much, but enough to know you've had something different.  I've also used it in place of traditional mustard in various recipes with great success.  Would highly recommend this product!

First off, I don't think there is anything wrong with the taste of this tea. It has a subtle fruity/berry flavor. I almost didn't order it because of some of the comments in the reviews.

I've been using the Yogi vanilla energy tea in the morning and drinking this after dinner. I do see a difference in my skin. It is more glowy and I haven't had a breakout since the first week of drinking the tea. My husband has also commented on my skin so it must be working!!

I would recommend this. I will continue to purchase this even if I didn't get any results because it does taste really good!

Summary: It was exactly what I asked for!
Text: The product was fresh and packed well. It's was exactly what I wanted and the package was sealed tight. Thank you.

I've ate Mangosteens and drank Mangosteen juice, but this just wasn't as good as the others. The price was good but I would not purchase it again simply because it wasn't tasty like other juices. I usually mix it in smoothies and such but the taste was so bitter it just couldn't be solaced.

Tried this for the first time the other night and was I impressed!!!  It cooks and tastes just like regular whole wheat pasta - can't even tell the difference!  Highly recommend for those of you looking to add true whole grains to your diet and for those with wheat allergies!

Summary: great product that does what it is supposed to do.
Text: The colorful bags are easy to carry while on walks with your pup and do exactly what they are intended to do.
This is a very tasty gum and is hard to find in the stores around here. The ten 15 piece packages are really nice too. Won't run out for awhile.

These muffins are great.  I've tried many gluten free foods and wasted so much money on things that tasted like cardboard.  I make these muffins  by substituting milk for the water and add 2 mashed bananas and 1 tsp. of cinnamon.  I've tried adding pineapple but didn't like it as much as my version of banana muffins.  My daughter's boyfriend loves these muffins and has no idea that they are made from rice flour.  Another great Namaste item to try is the Spice Cake.  Just add some grated carrots, pineapple, coconut, walnuts and raisins and you've got a kick-butt Carrot Cake.  Thanks to Namaste for the wonderful products......I'm hooked!

If you're tired of the sugar laden junks sold as Ovaltine by major retailers across the US then buy this product. It taste just like the old fashioned Ovaltine. I cannot wait for Amazon to carry the original Cadbury Bournvita too. Great taste and highly recommended.

I have been trying to find this cereal for years and i found it.  Its just as good as i remember it. I poured a bowl and it was like using a time machine it felt like i was 10 again! Thank You for bring me back to a good time!

Summary: Taste old...  not like store bought
Text: I love Ostrim Natural Flavor and used to buy it at local deli and/or GNC, decided to buy on amazon to save money.  But this one taste dry and old, like its past its expiration date or something.  I was looking for the expiration date on the box and found none

I purchase Earth's Best baby foods for my GrandSon.  He loves it, perferring it above all other baby foods his mom buys for him.  I am confident that he is getting quality organic foods to begin his life.  Amazon delivers right to his door within two days of ordering.  How easy is that??

This doesn't really taste like a Mojito on its own - perhaps if you used it as a non-calorie mixer. Adding alchol would add colories. Sadly, non of the Moctails in this line are worth a 2nd taste. Crystal Light Mocktails Margarita, 1.62-Ounce (Pack of 4)was poor as well.
This product was a surprise as I have finally found a delightful,tasty, full body caraway rye that cooked up so easily in my bread machine.It is a must have on my list now!

I am not typically fond of very sweet cereals, so that opinion affects this review.  This cereal has a taste somewhat like peanut butter.  It is shaped liked Cheerios, but tastes a bit like Captain Crunch.  However, the cereal is overly sweet on its own and I didn't care for it.  After the initial try, I mixed it half and half with plain Cheerios and liked it quite well.

I have 7 cats (yeah, I know). I've tried to get them on a healthy diet for years now, but any "healthy" cat food I give them they refuse to eat. I've tried Pro Plan (though they do like SOME flavors), Max Cat, Eukenuba, Iams, etc. ALL FAIL. I decided to try this food for them and low and behold,they absolutely love it. My only gripe is that it doesn't come in larger cans. But I am very happy with this brand and plan to stick with it.

Summary: Lovely tea - afraid I may develop an obsession here...
Text:
I bought this first in an Amazon promotion - I'm a total cheapy, not as involved with tea as some of my friends. I roast my own coffee, and only think of tea as sort of a break from espresso.....
That said: this is lovely black tea. the flavor is exquisite, cleaner and less muddy than other brands I've tried. The silk tea bags are so luxurious,but the tea inside tastes much better than the gift store silk triangle teas.
It's so good, I think I'll have to pay full price and check out some of the other estate teas!
What a great way to get a serving of fruit?! These fruit ropes are delicious.  I love that they are organic and all natural!!  All of the flavors are wonderful.

Summary: I Begin Every Day with a Cup of Chai Latte
Text:
This is my favorite hot drink. I feel deprived if I don't have my Chai Latte.

Everyone on Facebook knows this is my favorite way to start my day. I always offer a cup to anyone who visits and he/she are always delighted by the wonderful taste. It's just sweet enough and quite smooth.

I make sure I always have enough Chai Latte on hand and this is the brand I always buy.
My daughter loves this peanut butter.  It is low in fat and although it isn't exactly like peanut butter it is a great substitute.

It's a great barbecue flavor,my husband went through the entire six pack in under a month. I tried it before too and it really is truly a nice smokey barbecue flavor!  I came here to buy more for him per his request and sadly,it says you no longer have it'. Hubby is very upset,so please bring it back! Thank you&God bless you!

My cat who is about eleven years old had a stomach problem. I had to purchase special food from the vet that cost more than forty dollars per bag. I could not keep buying this food because I could not afford it. I discovered Friskies Gravy
pouches at the grocery store. However, you get a better deal at Amazon.com.Sidney is now a happy, healthy, kitty.

Summary: If it's from Paul Pruddhomme, you should buy it.
Text:
OK...I's serious here. If you like Cajun food or even if you don't, you really need all of his seasoning blends in your pantry. He's now got a special seasoning for just about everything and I've yet to run across one that was not tasty in the extreme.

Also, you should order a gallon of his hot sauce. It's the most flavorful hot sauce I have ever tried and it's not so hot that you can't eat what you put on it.

If the US Government operated like he does, we might actually have a good news day once in awhile.
I love Eight O'clock coffee but when shopping check your price per ounce.  The price/oz on this site doesn't look right?

I recently discovered these at a local Walmart priced at about $5 or $6 a bag (about 4 servings).  I decided to check on Amazon and loved the lower price.  A case of 12 bags for about $31.  I have not been diagnosed with Celiac disease (so far), but I am very sensitive to gluten and to oats (migraines, intestinal pains, diarrhea).  These pretzels have never once caused a reaction of any kind , even if I pig out on an entire bag in one weekend.  The only negative thing I could say is that the fat count in higher than I'd like. 8 grams for 32 pretzels.  Salt content is moderately high at 540mg, but they are pretzels after all.  I highly, highly recommend these pretzels.

Can't really call these kcups because they aren't like conventional kcups. but they work just fine in my keurig. The coffee is excellent, and at .41 cents a cup (with subscribe and save)  very economical. love them!

I like the price for this dog food plus free shipping. It seems to have good ingredients. All very good EXCEPT my dog doesn't like it, so back to Pedigree which is also sold on Amazon. Hope this helps.

I had this mustard when I visited my daughter in Florida. It was soooo delish! When I came back home, I could not find it in any NY stores nearby...so I purchased the case of 9 from Amazon. I will continue to buy it as long as they have it for sale...you'll LOVE IT!
Perhaps it's the high fat content but this product will simply not dissolve in hot coffee. Which is a shame as it's fairly tasty.

Many people are now turning away from conventional medicine for common ailments (as a side note, if you haven't seen "The Burzynski Movie" yet, it streams here on Amazon and will jolt many of you to the core, as it did me, regarding seeking conventional medical treatments). Adding turmeric to your diet will help keep you away from the MDs. To find out the value of adding turmeric to your diet, just type it into any search engine and you will find more hits than you could get to in a year.

That said, this brand (Frontier Herb Organic Ground Turmeric Root)is awesome, great taste, shipped quickly and is very reasonably priced. You can't go wrong with it.

These treats are great for training or if you don't want your dog to have too many calories in their treats. I was buying these at the local pet store and the bags were small and almost as expensive as these 1lb. packs.
My dog loves them and will gladly do a trick or two to get her Zuke's.

I just received this tea and I'm trying to drink a couple of cups per day to see if it has any effect on my BP. So far so good.  To enhance the flavor of this rather sour tea, I've added some Teavana Orange Blossom Herbal Tea, or Peach Bloom Rooibos Tea.  These combinations make the hibuscus tea quite enjoyable to drink.  I'm sure there are many other teas that would complement the Davidson hibiscus.

My 50lb lab/shep mix loves these things. The problem is just like someone else has noted she has figured out how to unroll them which greatly shortens the life of these. She can now get through one in an evening when at first it would take her a couple of evenings. Of course I am finding this problem with other rolls as well and currently trying some different things to see if I can find something else that works. I will say that these are the best rolls I have tried. The price has gone up quite a bit since I started buying them, but still probably the best value out there, but no longer a no brainer decision like it use to be.

This excellent tea comes from the UK where it costs about $3 (50 bags) at supermarkets. A few purchases like this ($19 including shipping??) may well add up to a ticket to London.

Fortunately, the leaf version of the same tea is available at a decent price from amazon.

I have a golden retriever that had severe allergies. He had ear infections several times and a recent skin infection. My vet recommended Purina pro plan sensitive skin and stomach formula. Since he has been on it (about 3 big bags) there have been no issues with allergies at all. His ears look excellent and no sign of skin rashes or infections. A little pricey but my Hank is worth it!

I wanted to like MIO. The peach mango taste was disappointing. I tried more concentrated taste, which was only more disappointing; and less, which was faintly disappointing. Other members of my family also tried it, to see if it was just a taste thing I lack, and no one liked it enough to take a second sip. The flavor reminds me of the smell of a sweaty steam sauna.

I love gummi bears and these are by far the best!  I would have never thought that there are big differences between gummi bears, but there are. Some are too sweet, too mushy, too chewy, too sticky, etc.  These bears are just right.  Germany carries some of the best candies and chocolates and these gummi bears are the best of the bunch!  If I order 5 pounds gummi bears, I will eat 5 pounds in a short amount of time, so I cannot order from Amazon.  I have to get them in a retail store and get one small bag at a time, otherwise I will gain lots of weight in gummi bears!

My wife went to Costa Rica a few years ago and brought back a bottle of this Salsa.  We made it stretch as long as possible and have looked everywhere for it and couldn't find it.  Imagine our surprise when we saw it here.  It's just what we wanted and are completely enjoying it!

Summary: good treats but dog did not like them much
Text: My dog liked the smell of these at first and got really excited, but she got bored after just a couple of these treats. I had to use them as filler treats during training to get rid of them. I will not buy these again, since she doesn't like them, but the treats themselves are good, healthy and low-calorie.

Summary: Is it the best chili in the known universe?  No, but it's darned close.
Text:
I've rarely had better chili than Wick Fowler's, even by people who really know their stuff. It's a wonderful blend of spices, full-bodied, flavorful, warm but not hot. I usually swap out beer for the water, and I find that using a really rough grind on the hamburger makes a huge difference on its deliciousness. I also toss in a can of Goya kidney beans. Prepared exactly according to specs, it's a very good chili. With a little minor tweaking, it's epic.

It's much, much cheaper to buy this product at Amazon than it is by me, where the packages run about $4 each.

I've been using Sleepytime to relax at night.  No real problems sleeping but it did help me shut down.  I saw the "Extra" and thought I would give it a try.  Same good sleepy affect but I started having dreams, lots of very long lasting dreams about all kinds of stuff.  Nothing scary, some are replays of things in the past some are fantasy like assaulting a meidieval fortress over and over until I get it right.  I don't think I dream normally, at least I don't remember them if I do, but with the Sleeptime Extra I almost always have very vivid dreams and it really is an enjoyable way to spend the night.  No adverse affects as far as I can tell, well except for run on sentences I suppose!
I ordered Lemon Blossom tea, but I received Stash MEYER Lemon Blossom tea. This is a very different product and I do not like it as much as the Lemon Blossom.
This product, Xylosweet, has no aftertaste and is used just like sugar.  It's all natural.  It's more expensive but well worth it.

This stuff is like crack in a bottle for me, I can't stay away from it!  Wonderfully spicy, great tang to it and just all around great taste.  Even the consistency is just right.  I don't even add alcohol, just pour it over ice and sip on it.  I'm completely addicted, this is the best tasting Bloody Mary mix I've ever come across.  I buy it at my local Wal Mart for less; can't seem to find it online for a good price.  Zing Zang's website sells it for a bit less but shipping is a killer.

Quality is good, because sometimes with pieces you tend to get the crappy leftovers, but that wasn't the case here. Good product for a reasonable price.
The flossies arrived before scheduled and were really easy to order.  Will order again.

We timed it. It took my german shorthaired pointer 1 minute 37 seconds his first go around.  Pieces slide to easy sot hey will open up with the first wack of the paw. Anyone know of anything that actually makes the dog work for a treat?

My dog MoJo love his deer antler. He chews on it a lot, and if he's not chewing on it, he's carrying it around. He doesn't seem to have done much damage to it in the month he's had it. Usually he destroys things in a couple of hours. If you've never gotten your dog an antler, here is the scoop- they don't make a mess, don't smell, are all natural and no deer are harmed in obtaining the antlers. They fall off the deer each year, and are cleaned and sanitized before they are sold. Our dog is very large so we get him the giant size, but smaller sizes are availble for smaller dogs.

Summary: "Enjoy Life Semi-Sweet Chocolate Chips" -- Mediocre Taste and Texture
Text:
.
We were really looking forward to these little chocolate chips! After all of the praiseful reviews
on Amazon, we expected something wonderful.

Pros:

1. Tiny-sized chips. Conveniently shaped for baking or snacking.
2. Good expiration date (more than 6 months from now).
3. Manufactured in a dairy-free facility.

Cons:

1. Mediocre in texture and taste. They are waxy, in fact. The flavor is pretty one-dimensional.
2. They don't label how much cacao it contains (in % terms.) For ex., our preference is 71% content.
3. If you've ever had awesome quality, complex dark chocolate, then you might be disappointed when you taste these.
.
The variety is ok.  The expiration date is 3 1/2 months away(could be better) but I only received 33 k cups.

After eating Jerky Treats from Costco for a couple of years, my dog died at the age of 6 1/2 of cancer. I do not have evidence naturally, but after reading numerous posts on BHA, this could have been a contributing factor. BE CAREFUL.

Trying something new with this coffee. Didn't blow me away but for the price, it's excellent. I don't have anything bad to say about it other than it's a BIG bag and I am mildly concerned with freshness toward the end, but we burn thru beans pretty fast =D
Great chocolate. The taste has not changed in about 4 decades. I had it as child and my girls now have it too.

I started ordering popcorn from Amazon because out local grocery stores only sell one brand of regular popcorn. Most of the popcorn they sell is microwave. I tried many of the different Amish Country Brand popcorns. This was by far the best. The price is very reasonable even taking shipping into consideration.

However, my local grocer only carried original and cheddar. I had never venued onto Amazon to buy food before but I am so glad I did.

This is a great way to try out all the flavors to figure out what you like, and also if you have someone else working with you on weight loss, you can both try them.

I am very impressed with this product and how strong the flavors are.

I will defintely be buying again.

These teas are wonderful! Couldn't recommend them more.

I was introduced to these teas in Portland, OR by my sister. Now I can't get enough of them.

I'm extremely glad I ordered these mushrooms.  The price per ounce, especially rehydrated, ends up being quite reasonable.  I usually rehydrate with warm water (and make sure I use the water in the recipe for extra flavor) then add the morels to sautees, soups, and stir-frys.  Really excellent product.

Summary: Pretty good dessert. Nom nom nom!
Text: I have no experience making or eating fresh treacle pudding, but I find the Heinz version to be quite good.  It isn't cheap to buy here in the States, but as an occasional treat it's fine.  I enjoy the syrup that comes on it, and it really needs to be heated to be good.  This definitely isn't on the healthy side, but how many desserts are?

I have an office in an extremely remote and often frigid location and sometimes have co-workers visiting.  I try to make the workspace welcoming and hospitable.  I set out a box of other assorted teas and a box of this Numi assortment and visitors ALWAYS go straight for the Numi.  This also serves me well because I can pick out a tea to suit my mood, whatever the occasion.  All of the teas have great, deep flavor.

These remind me of a grown-up version of Captain Crunch cereal. Have the same kind of texture, but not as sweet. The flavor is prominently cinnamon, with almond overtones, yummy! These make a great high protein snack with my afternoon cup of coffee!
For those who love Pommery Mustard Meaux Moutarde , this is a very smooth version with a "kick" in the finish; goes quite well with coarse pates; cheeses; sausages; and, gourmet burgers.

Great, high quality, organic apple sauce for kids with no added suger. My kids really go through this, they eat one per day eat (2 of them) and it is so much cheaper than the grocery store to have the packets on hand and in bulk via Amazon subscribe and save.

I'm a big fan of good, strong British tea like PG Tips but have been told that I can't have caffeine anymore. I tried this tea and am so happy to find a reasonable substitute ~ I don't really care for herb teas with lots of flavors added. The best way I can describe it is to say it has a sort of "earthy", full, yet mild (I know that sounds like a contradiction) flavor.  I like to brew it a bit strong but that doesn't turn it bitter. Some have said it's milder than red rooibos but I think it's more flavorful. It has a nice aroma too.
I am admitting to being addicted to M&M's - the size I just purchased is the largest I've seen.  I am trying hard not to gobble them up in a short period of time!

There are multiple berries (blackberry, black currant, blueberry, raspberry,) but the vanilla flavor seems somewhat lacking. Also, vanilla is not even listed among the ingredients. I presume it falls under "natural flavors." Still, it is a flavorful tea. I would have been quite happy if they hadn't mentioned vanilla. Lipton is using an unusual tea bag shape; a pyramid. Long story short, this sauce is packed with flavor and certainly packed with heat, it isn't the 'hottest in the world' but if the novelty of insane sauce heat has worn off and you're looking for a flavorful heat, this is for you.

Summary: Best tasting wheat free, gluten free cake mix available

Text:
so I mix them together and the result is very pleasing.

The acidity of the tomato juice enhances the extraction of the BPA.  This is a tasty product in addition to being safe.  Because it is pricey, I freeze any left-over tomatoes to use in other recipes.

These are super bright, the packaging (which is all recycled cardboard) states them to be 100watt incandescent equivalent. These emit white light, super white; best used for task lighting; i.e. you don't want them as overhead or lamp lights in your dining room, or living room.
Very quick (about 30 min), simple to make and very tasty. I always have a few in the cabinet, it makes a perfect quick meal or fun dinner. Highly recommend.

Summary: Endangered Species Chocolate Tiger with Expresso Beans
Text: This is delicious chocolate.  It has crunchy bits of espresso beans in it.  The 72% cacao contains healthy antioxidants, so I don't feel guilty eating it.  The company contributes to endangered species conservation, so it supports a good cause.

I started eating this as an alternative to oatmeal and steel cut oats in the morning. There is a decent amount of fiber in this product, so I would highly recommend this as part of your diet if you are trying to lower your cholesterol.

If you already are a fan of this Muesli, you know how much better of a price this is than the small packages you normally find in your grocery store.

Larry's Beans were given to me at Christmas as sort of a Joke ( I go by "Larry")  but I was blown away!  Way better that that other brand from Washington state.  Never burned, always smooth.  I have tried 9 different types of Larry's Beans and have never been disappointed.  Even the decaf (Sammy Decaf Jr) is terrific.  I will continue to use it and give as a unique gift.

Summary: Sadly not what I was hoping for
Text: So I'm a deployed soldier and there's a disappointing lack of any pumpkin here. I bought this so I could have that nice fall pumpkin coffee experience. I was sad to discover that this tastes not evenly remotely like pumpkin. The shipping time was the only thing that pleased me about this order.

these pink little candies pack alot of pink punch to your taste buds!!!very true to the taste of a pink grapefruit. this is one of my favorite bulk candies its a hit with everybody who has never seen or tasted these until i show them. now i am out better order more!!! also ups delivery man approved!

As I work at Noodles & Co, I had the Pad Thai we made and loved it. After that, I was on a quest to find other variations or make my own.

This brand happened to be the best in the few others I tried. It has a sweet taste to it, and the ground peanuts and baby corn give it a nice texture. The normal dish is actually spicier than this, but it is delicate enough for you to embrace the true taste of all other flavors such as the fish sauce and tamarind.

Though, I admit the smell of it coming out of the microwave isn't that appealing, once you love this dish, it really wont matter.

Summary: Best canned Peach Slices for the price
Text: I love this canned peach slices and just ate a pack of 12 cans in 3 days.(Ordered 2 packs/24 cans).I planned to move in January 2012 so I will order more after i move to another city/state.  Best of the best canned peach slices.

We bought this salsa regularly at the local grocer when we lived near Houston, TX.  But, when we moved to VA, it wasn't available.  Amazon to the rescue.  Try making a quesadilla with monterrey jack cheese and this salsa, accompanied by your beverage of choice.  We love the raspberry flavor heated by the chipotle and smoothed by the cheese.
love this product and love the subscription service very convenient. can't get this product locally so this is very helpful
I use this coconut oil anytime I am baking and it adds a slight coconut flavor. I like it much better than using a regular veg oil, plus coconut oil is so much better for you.

PG tips is my family's favorite tea everyday. Full body and not harsh when left in the water. And these 240 boxes last! Glad to have found them. I just wish American restaurants would serve them...and use boiling water.
I love these deluxe nuts, and the price is not bad at all if you order it in the Subscribe & Save program. I do wish it had more pecans though.

Summary: Great tea at a good price
Text: PG Tips is our tea of choice. We go through this big stash of teabags quickly enough that they don't get stale. Great deal at the price.
The product had little to no peppermint flavor!  I was very disappointed in the taste of the coffee.  I would not recommend this coffee if you like a true peppermint coffee.

Love Yoshida! It is great for everything from grilling to baking to saute! We first learned about it in Alabama when my mother marinaded chicken in the product. We purchased it from Sam's Club and used it on everything! Even our kids liked it at a young age. When we moved to VA, we couldn't find it anywhere, then we started looking online. Thanks to Amazon, we have Yoshida back in our cooking regimen.

Summary: I think they forgot to include the taste.

I really enjoy Timothy's decaf.  Late afternoon, into the evening.  It has a flavor all it's own. I haven't found another as good as this.

I was really impressed by this item. It was delicious and very satisfactory to taste. I added it to a lemon lime soda and had an instant Shirley Temple drink. I would have waited a long time for a drink like this to be fixed for me. Now I can have one any time I like.I am very pleased with the value of this purchase also.

I usually get chocolate type bars, but wanted something different. These were a nice change and taste great too. A little on the sweet side, but overall a tasty meal replacement.

Excellent, sweet with good coffee flavor? Better than Starbucks or any of the others at 1/10th the cost? Would buy again and again.

Summary: Relaxer for those with a stressful life...
Text: We all have stressful lives these days.. I knew this wouldnt put me out because I do suffer from insomnia in a bad way, and generally have to take perscription sleeping pills. But I wanted to find something that would keep me from taking them every night.. This tea does mellow me out to where I can relax enough that I do not have to take as much of the sleep meds. This chocolate chai packs a great am punch - gets my energy level up in the morning.  I am a coffee drinker, not tea, but I really love this stuff.  Great taste, just wish it was packed in a bigger container!

Summary: I too, am justifiably wary of this MADE IN CHINA pet product!
Text: I just purchased a bag of this Vitality Chicken Breast dog jerky product from a large national retailer today (I liked the natural, wholesome ingredients), and was VERY concerned and upset when I read that is is made in China. Summary: Sadly I've yet to find a decent American mustard.
Text:
Been over here in NC for approaching two years now and have noted the usual Englishmans complaints - the bread, the beans - although plain pintos have grown on me (must see a doctor about that), the chocolate, the brown sauce etc.. and obviously the mustard.

I really must come across as being pompous with all my culinary gripes - but what can I say?

Colemans mustard is what mustard is supposed to be like, not a pickle.. not a tangy yellow ooze - but a rip-roaring, eye-watering, cold conquering addition to all kinds of meals.

Too much of it in a sandwich will mean a minute or two to recover from each bite though.

If anyone can recommend another I'd be happy to know of it :o)

Truly, I adore these brownies.  I am always reluctant to use mixes for anything but an extra crazy schedule forced me to grab this at the store, and boy howdy am I glad! I will be buying this again and again, and was so impressed that now I'm embarking on other Pamela products.

Don't love that it doesn't last too long, but then again, I have the same complaint about pretty much every gum I've ever had.

I have used this trap before.  I was able to eradicate the my vole problem fairly quickly with these traps.  They are great long lasting traps that get the job done.  They do not fair well under a lawnmower though!

I have tried many X-Bold coffee K-cups and find Jet Fuel the only ones strong enough for me. I Keep coming back to these, so now I am sticking with these for good. I don't understand, though, why the company took the "X-Bold" out of the name.

This is an excellent product. The fruit was fresh and very tasty and delightfully colorful. You can't buy this type of fruit in supermarkets anymore. Glad I bought a three-pack. Two went into home made holiday brandied fruit cake, one tub into home made mince-meat, with real meat! Both our fruit cake and mince-meat came out great. Whenever you have need of this hard-to-find glazed fruit, go for Pennant!

I normally get an iced grande caramel macchiato at Starbucks for almost $5, this taste just as good to me and it's just over $1.  I don't add any water and just use milk when I mix it up and it is really good!

My wife and I eat these things like peanuts! You can't eat just one, you know! Planters is the best and buying them from Amazon makes it simple. They're cheaper and delivered to my door on a specified schedule. We never run out like we used to and finding these in the stores is not always as easy as one would think! Yeah - GREAT!

I've always liked Trisquits. It goes way, way back, at least 70 years to my childhood. My mother always thought they were better for us than plain white saltine crackers. I think she was right. I like the saltyness, the flavor and the crunchy texture. Thus it was when I found some Triscuit Cracked Pepper and Olive Oil crackers (9.0-ounce box) at a nearby Fresh and Easy store. Oh, that sounded good. Well, they were! Excellent! All the good texture and flavor of the Standard Triscuit plus the bracing taste of fresh pepper with a little olive oil. Plus, they're a whole-grain product and have a lot of fiber. Good, good, good.

Gary Peterson

We have owned a Senseo Coffee Maker since 2007 and positively love it!  Even though our family prefers the Dark Roast pods, the decaf is very good (we just keep it on hand for friends and family who can't drink the regular coffee.  Thank you for the large variety to choose from.  Respectfully, JoAnne O'Connor  P.S.  We purchase all of our pods from Amazon.com ONLY

Summary: Very quick, tasty enough for a nostalgic adult, and organic
Text:
I've been eating Annie's Homegrown Organic P'sghetti With Soy Meatballs since I was pregnant with my first son, craving "comfort" foods, but trying to eat as organically as possible while meeting the high protein requirements my doctor ordered for my "delicate condition". Admittedly, this isn't a perfect taste match for the mainstream (fatty/salty/totally un-natural) Spaghetti O's of my childhood. Still, it is quick and easy to prepare, and I find it tasty and of reasonable nutritional quality.

Amazon's case price works out to 90% of the price I pay at my local natural grocery store, so I would be happy to Subscribe & Save if that becomes an option in the future.
YUMMY. I am addicted to these chips--only problem is I have put on 40 pounds since I discovered how good these chips are. Terrible, I know, but what can I say I AM addicted.
My dog loves these treats and the 96 count box is the best deal. They come in a foil package in the box so they stay fresh till the last one.

I got a 5lb bag of rolled oats from the farmer's market in Detroit.  Little did I know how hard it was to properly flavor blan oatmeal without adding 2lbs of sugar.  This solved my problem and makes my morning breakfast that much faster - boil, add, stir.  But why did they add like 6 packets of the plain stuff?  The cat won't even eat it.
This is the best balsamic vinegar I have ever had.  It is the consistency of a light syrup.  The flavors are rich and deep.

"I was very pleased by the service. It arrived before the predicted time. The plant was healthy with some broken leaves at the stalk. It was surprisingly small. Previous person mentioned a 10' plant. This plant was probably 3-4' plant. 4 star was giving for some broken leaves(shipping or the really small box) and knowing that I received a smaller product then previous customer. Order from Hirt's!"

The Switch Kiwi Berry drink is good tasting and all natural.  It should be emphasized that it is full-strength juice, not a "flavored water" type product.  For that reason, I found it a bit strong because I am not accustomed to drinking much juice.  The carbonation does add a bit of lightness to it though.  I like that it didn't taste too artificial.
Does not work at all: the cats feel quite comfortable leaving their droppings in the same spot these granules were applied.
This is amazing stuff, reminds me of the pancakes my dad used to make from scratch.  I love that it's organic and easy to make.

My husband and I are water drinkers and this is by far the best carbonated water you can buy.  It used to be sold in our area but has been discontinued. The price is a bit high compared to the $10.00 per case we had been paying. It is a great product! Doesn't taste surgary or sicky sweet.

After trying many gluten-free products, with great disappointment, I was dubious about the glowing reviews for these crackers.  However, the gluten-free world is not a delicious place, so the reviews convinced me to try them.  I found only the white cheddar flavor at my local heath food store.  I must admit they are delicious. Without a doubt, the best gluten-free product I have had.  I agree with the other reviews, the crackers are crunchy and flavorful.  Since my local store only carries the one flavor, I look forward to ordering the others from Amazon.  I wish other gluten-free products could be this good.
Yummy, taste very good and is good for you. Will order many more times over. Im not much on waisting words. but thanks very much
This is a great healthy food for dogs and my two are giving it 4 paws up from each of them !! I's all natural - you can't go wrong!
This is my first dendrobium - and my first orchid that is mounted.  My order arrived quickly and the plant is young and healthy.  Looking forward to it blooming.  Thanks.
These are the best cookies I have found that are gluten free.  I love them!
i want to cancel my order for the lapanzanella crackers because of the condition of the crackers, they are always crushed up and in terrible codition when i get them.

Summary: Amazing delicous!  Better than I expected!
Text:
Namaste Foods, Gluten Free Say Cheez Pasta Dish, 9-Ounce Bags (Pack of 6)

My sons are die-hard boxed mac'n'cheese addicts, but I recently discovered that keeping one of them off of gluten and casein really helps him out (he is hyperlexic). I tried this, not really expecting the kids to like it, but it was a hit! I was so in love with the aroma that I ate a serving myself--something I don't usually do when I make boxed mac'n'cheese. I still like my own recipe for vegan cheese sauce better, but this will be great for a time pinch, or for the babysitter to prepare. Not exactly like kraft (or even Annie's or Back to Nature), but delicious in its own right. Five stars!
I purchased this product for a friend.She loved it and is buying it now for herself.I may try it myself one of these days.
I carry a bottle of Also Salt in my purse to use when we go out to  restaurants.  It taste like salt unlike the bitterness of other substitutes.  I am delighted to have found it.

I quite liked it, the flavor is a bit harsh at first but then it becomes more mellow. It is most certainly caffeinated which is good. It is too expensive to buy more than once though. All in all I liked it.

These are awesome treats. They are extremely healthy and my dog seems to really like them.

There are three flavors (turkey, salmon, and duck). We have tried the duck and salmon, of which my dog preferred the duck.

I drink this every night after dinner and before bed. I've tried lots of other brands of chamomile but this one tastes the best and I love how each one is wrapped sealing in the freshness. I find other brands really bland, I mean this is a bland tea in itself but this brand has a great taste and seems somewhat stronger than the rest. Mixed with fresh REAL local honey, it's really relaxing!!!
This agave has a wonderful light taste . To me its no different than sugar it has no aftertaste or strange flavor like stevia does.

I hesitated purchasing this olive oil fearing it would not be like my usual brand. Although it was dark in color, the performance was the same as my usual brand. The price is what I really liked. Quart for quart it was a more economical product to use.

I have to say that my family totally enjoys these lentils to the point of other family members bring their empty tins over to "share" in my bounty of lentils.  They cook up fast and have a wonderful taste cooking in just chicken stock.  I will go to the ends of the earth to find these as the flavor is so tasty and does not need a lot of additives for a wonderful flavor.
This is without a doubt the best tonic water I have ever had (and it mixes quite well with some lime and Bombay Sapphire).

This is delicious! It makes a really tasty glass of tea, though it takes a few tries to determine just how much you need to acheive the proper proportion. The container is small enough to carry in your purse, and it can be easily added to bottled water. It is a great improvement over powdered instant tea--more natural flavor and no cloudy or foamy surface. I tried the peach, but I am open to trying other flavors as well.

I sent the steaks to my daughter for a gift..she told me they were not good..she pan fried 1 and no flavor..she cut the rest up for stew..I wont buy again from Omaha steaks

Summary: Kool-aid is for kids... and adults
Text:
This is a great new flavor of Kool-Aid, a non-carbonated drink which I have enjoyed all my life. This particular product contains a little less sugar than the old Kool-Aid but I couldn't taste the difference. This flavor is very refreshing and it's incredibly easy to mix. I often make it a glass at a time to avoid clogging up my refrigerator with yet another pitcher.

Highly recommended.
This is a lovely flavor and makes a lovely presentation.  I made pink rose cupcakes with rose icing, it was a big hit with the office ladies.
I love these k cups!! One of my favorites! I am someone who likes very light coffee which ends up making the coffee cold very fast and with these you don't need to add anything so it's great!!

What's better than a chocolate chip cookie filled with fudge? A WARM chocolate chip cookie filled with fudge! I pop one of these cookies in the microwave for a few seconds (experiment to find your perfect temperature), then sit back with a warm cookie and a cool glass of milk. Pure bliss! Granted there are plenty of calories in this treat, so do consume in moderation. It is a wonderfully decadent treat!

tastes good, but a little on the sweet side.  may not be for everyone.

This product does everything that was advertised. I am a diabetic and had been looking for something other than the sweeteners found in the grocery stores.
All I can say is that this product workse as advertised and that I am completely satisfied.

Good soup and I have eaten a lot of it. However the other day while I was eating it, I felt something poke into the roof of my mouth. The coffee smells great.  I was so excited to try it because of its wonderful aroma.  I was very disappointed in the taste.  It was very weak.  Maybe I used too much water but not more than I normally use with other coffee.
