Summary: YUCK!  They smell (and taste) like moldy plastic
Text: I spent nearly double the amount of money that I normally spend on flour tortillas when I bought s pack of these low-carb tortillas.  They looked very delicious while inside the package.  But once I opened the bag, the smell made me nauseous.  These tortillas smelled like moldy plastic.  And they tasted just as bad as they smelled.  I threw them into the garbage and settled for typical flour tortillas - instead of settling for a ruined Mexican meal.

Summary: Free of additives, but also free of flavor
Text:
The texture on this jerky is similar to other bad jerky, like Oberto. It's very dry, not hard but firm, and kind of falls apart in your mouth - but not in a good way. The flavor is dominated by smoke, whereas most jerkys also include soy sauce or worcestershire sauce.

All in all, I'd eat this instead of stuff at the gas station like Oberto or a Slim Jim, but when push comes to shove I'll order Wild Bill's jerky, Big John's, or pick up some jerky at the local meat market.

Summary: Does improve energy during a run
Text:
I like this product because of the caffeine and sugar do seem to help about 30-40 minutes into a run, esp. if I run after work but before dinner. Plus they are really portable (stick them in your pocket and go) Like a cup of coffee in your gym bag. Taste is good with a just the slightest bitterness from the caffeine but no aftertaste. Eat ten minutes before a long run with a drink of water and you will notice more energy when you hit the last mile of your run, at least that is what I seem to notice.

Not candy; keep away from your kids. My 5 year old took a pack as a snack to kindergarten. Needless to say, he did NOT take a nap that day. 50mg of caffeine in a little guy is like rocket fuel. . .

These strips are not very generous,kids would want more sugar They taste just o.k. Very adult. I'm sure If you are old like me they might be perfect. I still think each serving should be  bigger that's all

Like many others, I too was looking for the gas station coffee taste, as I find gas station coffee to be the sweetest and tastiest for an amateur coffee drinker like me. If you prefer the strong, exotic, even authentic taste, this is not the coffee for you. But if you are looking for coffee that is sweet, and tasty without having to do much, this is it.

awesome toy! my pup loves this.  he did already manage to scratch the crap out of the bottom and make cracks in the bottom due to his teething.  he didn't get it at first til i showed him how to hit the bottle to get the food out.  keeps him entertained for 5-10 mins at a time.  we love it.
Shipped exactly as advertised. Tasted AMAZING!  No damage on the bag and product was fresh! Make sure to buy two bags.. all 360 pieces will be eaten up quick! ;)

We often pick up boneless pork when it's on sale because it's versatile.
Having this coating on hand allows me to toss together a quick dinner that we always enjoy.

I often add a little ground sage and black pepper to the coating. Sometimes a little parmesan cheese.
If you're only preparing a small amount and have plenty of leftover coating for another small meal, a trick my brother shared with me is to use a good sized ziplock bag for the coating. The leftover coating can be labeled "Pork" and dated and tossed into the freezer instead of throwing it out. Same with chicken coating. I often mix up my own coating and have plenty leftover for another meal.
Not only is the sweetener great in coffee or ice tea it makes a slammin skinny margarita.  Also try their Agava Simple Syrup - LOVE IT

The pack I got was great.  It had  a lot of different flavors: pumpkin spice,mudslide, butter toffe, French vanilla, Jamaica me crazy, Khalua, cinnamon roll, chocolate glazed donut, and hazelnut. Will definitely buy again!

Theo's milk chocolate coconut curry bar is not for everyone -- it is very spicy and the sting of curry powder is the highest note in the taste, at least initially.  But this is my favorite of Theo bars, not just for the spiciness, but also because the spice quickly dissipates as the chocolate melts on the tongue, and the sting is soothed by one of the best milk chocolates I've ever tasted -- silky as it dissolves.  The coconut adds a bit of crunch to the texture.  This is a highly unique bar, and very rewarding if you like sophisticated taste combinations.

Opened the box.....washed the tray per the instructions.....added some bacon and microwaved. The bacon was perfect! I had really long pieces of bacon so I just scrunched up the strips a little in the middle and it was fine. Would definitely recommend this to anyone who likes bacon without the mess or smelling up the house.

Summary: the only tomato sauce for me!
Text: This is the only tomato sauce I will use.  It has a bright, fresh taste that does not need any alteration except fresh basil and garlic.  Unfortunately it is no longer available locally.  Amazon to the rescue!

Nice and spicy which I like, and a good buy (which I like too), but it's part pork and I didn't know that before hand. I would have preferred all beef, which is why I rate only three stars instead of five.  I won't buy it again, but ONLY because of the pork; otherwise, it's very good.
I am so glad I can buy this online. I have a hard time finding it in stores. It's a great drink!

Friend magnet! Everyone loves Gummi Worms!! My friends and I had this 5 pound bag gone in a weekend. I was a little worried buying food online, but turned out really well. Didn't taste at all like they were sitting on a shelf for 6 years....

I've been feeding my six cats Newman's Own organic food for years. Their coats are sleek and healthy. They are healthy. This is certified organic food, not that phony 'all natural' stuff. Terms like 'all natural' and 'human quality' are meaningless. Take a look at what is in regular pet food--google '4 D meat.'
This is the one food I really trust.

I wanted some healthy cereal that would very nutritious. I was already familiar with Ezekiel bread, so why not try the cereal?

It's good. I don't eat it plain, however. I always chop up a banana in it.

It's healthy, inexpensive (when you consider how much nutrition you're getting), and tastes good. I eat a bowl of this most mornings.

My dog loves these and so do I : ).  No yucky texture or greasy feel such as with hot dog pieces or cheese pieces and no grossness in your pocket or treat bag.  And my dog will do a lot for a taste of these treats.

Summary: Incredible cereal at an incredible price
Text:
I've always been a fan of Kashi GoLean Crunch. I find that it's the perfect balance of taste and health. The best part is that my kids actually love this as well. This is significantly healthier than many of the sugar cereals that are marketed to kids. Even my 1 yo enjoys eating this dry. Between this and Honey Nut Cheerios, I don't have to feel guilty about giving my kids "bad" cereal.

From a price perspective, you can't beat Amazon's Subscribe & Save. My family of six will work through these four boxes pretty quick. Thanks Amazon!

This split pea soup is nearly perfect. It is organic and gluten free. On top of that, it is so delicious, filling, and versatile. What else could I ask for? Being celiac and having multiple food allergies, it is difficult finding foods I can eat. This is one food I can eat and enjoy safely. I actually heated this up and put it on top of a baked potato for a change. It made a great topping. I also used it as a dip for crackers and chips. Even my husband who is not a fan of split pea soup ate this up and loved it. For the price with subscribe and save, it was cheaper on Amazon than in our local store.

Summary: Great-Tasting Cereal (even without a fruit topping)
Text: it's very filling, satisfying and has an excellent taste. I've put apples and mangoes on top and that's delicious!  Glad to see that it's offered at organic supermarkets, warehouses and Amazon.
All the box of milk came intact. The taste of the milk is reall off. I can not drink a cup of filtered coffee with this milk.

Summary: Wonderful Huckleberry Coffee! Give it a Try!
Text: After trying a small portion of the huckleberry coffee, I had to buy the larger size. If you don't like flavored coffee, then skip the Huckleberry. If you savor the aroma of a flavored brew, give the Huckleberry a shot. It smells wonderful and tastes even better. It's not as acidic as other brand coffee. It's definitely unique and a great gift for anyone who goes for something different.

I mean yum.  Caramel with sea salt is like the best thing ever.  The pieces are big and just the right combination of salty and sweet.  They are really, really good. Also arrived timely, and unharmed.

I consider myself a bit of a foodie, and recently returned from Provence where I sampled many olive oils from that region. They were for the most part delicious.
I enjoy Italian olive oils also and so was looking forward to trying the Biancolilla single estate oil from Oilo Taibi in Sicilly. It is really good - a wonderful flavor, delicate and full at the same time. I would have rated this a '5' were it not for the price, which I consider high. I never mix this for a vinaigrette (to me it would be like using a 15 year-old estate bottled rum for a rum & coke), but rather just use it with some freshly baked bread when enjoying a salad and some wine. Yummmm.

I absolutely love both the pink salmon and sockeye salmon from Wild Alaska! The taste and quality is fantastic. The people from the company are so nice and I highly recommend ordering any of their products!!

The candy arrived with some white waxy stuff on it; almost as if it had partially melted at one point.  Tasted chalky.  Not interested in a partial refund.  Next time find a way to make sure candy is not stale.
you can't go wrong with these unless you are sending them to a diabetic, then you are bound to get into trouble because they will not be able to resist these!
Supreme Lebkuchen very fine taste. Also the tin can  reflects images of ancient Nuremberg in a very special way. Elisen Lebkuchen is the finest Nuremberg has to offer.

I have looked high and low for this product after seeing it advertised on Facebook. I found some locally and couldn't open up the jar fast enough to try it. OMG, it is horrible! I bought this and the Gevalia Swiss Hazelnut for my husband who is a coffee drinker but always disliked Starbucks coffee. Well, he loved it! Text: This tastes very much like cherry flavored cough syrup.  A few drips of vanilla extract (maybe 1/2 tsp per bottle) completes the illusion.

Summary: Good as it gets for a mix
Text: These have a "made from scratch" flavor and texture.  Very good quality chocolate.  I recommend cutting them in squares and placing in a covered container overnight.  They taste much better the next day (as with many baked goods).  I'll buy again for sure.

Thought I would give it a try since we love the velveeta shells and cheese.  This is NOT a good meal at all. The "pasta" was like thick, thick rice pieces that once it was in your mouth it felt as though you were eating bugs, I've never had a pasta with that shape and texture before.  The "broccoli" was dried powder. The kids didn't like this meal nor did my husband and I.  I think Velveeta should just stick with their shells and cheese.

I am giving up candy and sweets for one month and then going to continue best I can. I am loving this as an alternative. It has the hard candy shell which I really need right now. Is a more firm gum so it won't stick. If you like the really soft gums, then this is not for you. Since I am using it for weight loss I like that I have to chew a bit. Perfect cinnamon bite. Not too hot, but has that little bite. Average lasting in flavor.
Great for travel.

I bought this product after reading all the favorable reviews.  I loved that the product was organic, with no added sugar or preservatives.  But when it arrived, I found it to be too thinly sliced and too dehydrated -- not at all soft or chewy like the dried mango I usually get.  It also wasn't very flavorful.  Maybe it was just a bad batch, but I won't be ordering it again.

Milka is one of the leading producers of chocolates in the world. Founded in Switzerland in 1901, the brand quickly spread throughout Western Europe. In 1990, the company was acquired by Kraft, and their wonderful chocolate is now available throughout the world!

I love Milka's Alpine Milk chocolate. It is absolutely delicious - not as sweet as many American chocolates, and with a rich and creamy texture. Want to try a great chocolate? Get Milka's Alpine Milk chocolate!

(Review of Milka Alpine Milk Chocolate 100g)
My dogs absolutely love these!  They are a bit pricey but seem to be good quality.  Thanks dingo!!  I have small dogs.  If you have larger dogs, get bigger bones!
I was using extracts and Torani syrups to flavor shakes in a meal replacement program, and it took just a drop or two to add a nice flavor. Excellent product, great price - about $2 @ the store.

Summary: Now Just a Jug, But Still Awesome
Text:
My 35 pound pit bull mix chewed the rope in half in less than 20 minutes (I knew it didn't stand a chance), but she still has a blast with it. I put two ping pong balls inside so it's not too easy to get the treats out. Often she would rather chew on the rubber around the bottle neck than try to get the contents, and it's stood up pretty well. It does have a couple bits and nubs missing.

Also, it your dog is playing with it on a hard surface, it is LOUD! For me, this is a small price to pay for knowing my girl is having fun with something other than my sneakers.

My wife and I received these as an unexpected Xmas gift through fed-ex on Xmas day this year. I had never heard of The Tea Room, the makers of this item, nor the product. After having tried one, I picked up the receipt and made it a point to learn what it was called and who made them. Simply put, this was one of the most exquisite little bites I've put into my mouth in quite some time.

There's a variety of flavors, all sweet, but it's the consistency and texture of these little pillows that hook you. Also, receiving them as a gift was just perfect - as I don't know that I'd buy them for myself, but I sure would as a gift for a special someone. A bit expensive? Sure. Luxurious? Absolutely! Outstanding product. Recommended!

Having greatly anticipated trying these at the recommendation of some New Zealand friends, I can definitely say I was not disappointed. These chocolate bars are delicious. If you don't eat them too fast, they melt in your mouth. They don't sell these in the states for some crazy reason, so I was very glad to find them here. They shipped quickly, and arrived in perfect condition.

Summary: ROYAL OAK GOURMET VIRGINIA REDSKIN PEANUTS
Text: I love redskin peanuts, but I haven't been able to find them anywhere in my area (N. California) for a few years. These peanuts are treated with artificial butter flavor should this be a concern, but these redskin peanuts are the best I have ever had. I really enjoy them and I just placed another order. YUM!

Summary: Try w/ chicken broth vs. water-yummy!
Text: A friend of mine prepared this oatmeal in chicken broth instead of plain water saying you could then eat it plain w/o milk or sugar. I was skeptical, but it was incredibly delicious!!! It reminded me of coucous and I thought if I added some spices and pine nuts it could easily become a dinner side dish. Crazy, I know, but try it and you'll be amazed. Also, a local health food store sells this for $10/can, so this is a great deal.

A great type of high, balanced protein Quinoa.  Red quinoa seems to take longer to cook than the white kind, but it is delicious.  I make like goulash-y type dishes with mine, and I have a coworker that raves about it.

The creamers themselves are fine, but I expected to receive them in the dispenser pack.  Instead, there's just a big cardboard box and they're all loose in there.  I'll have to come up with another container to keep them in on the counter.  I realize this was my assumption, but I wish it had been more clearly stated.

The chiquilin pimenton ahumado is one of the best condiments for all my dishes.
The taste of so delicated and aromatic that make me feel like in spain myself.
Oleeeeeee.

Summary: Easiest way to get high fiber cereal
Text:
I'm working to boost the fiber in my diet and I've tried every "high fiber" cereal on the market. Most of it is barely edible -- and some simply isn't.

Kashi's GoLean (and GoLean Crunch) are my favorites. It's sweet, but not overly so. It's got serious crunch and holds up well to milk. It's a satisfying breakfast (and I take the crunch version in a zip lock baggie to have easy to access high-fiber munchies on the road.) And, ten grams of fiber per serving (8 on the crunch version) is not bad, not bad at all!

Even my highly-resistant-to-health-food-of-any-kind boyfriend likes the crunch version!

Ordered from this company back when they first started, City Roast Colombian flavor, it was very good coffee, and I thought I had found my favorite. However, recently ordered Dark Roast House Blend and this is the best. Smooth, full bodied, excellent flavor, but not bitter. We mix it half and half with Great Value Dark Roast to stretch the cost. I don't think you will be disappointed! We recently had a friend visit who has been an avid coffee drinker x 50 years and he commented it was the best coffee he ever drank!

Bought this along with the Yogourmet yogurt maker.  (In retrospect, I probably didn't need to buy it separately because there was a package deal that included it).  The starter makes amazing yogurt, but it seems like it takes a long time to get going when starting with the starter, rather than saving yogurt and using that as a starter.  So, I'd recommend using this to start the culture, but then using yogurt from then on.  The probiotic blend does take longer and you have to start at a lower temperature, but the flavor is great and the health benefits are even better.  Oh, yeah, it's important to note that for 2 quarts of yogurt, you have to use 2 packets--something that isn't really mentioned, but each packet is only 5 grams.

In the past I had purchased a bag of another co's Birthday Cake coffee and it was beyond delicious, especially when mixed with other flavored coffees.  I got this in hopes...  but it doesn't taste like anything except plain old coffee.  I was expecting too much I'm sure but it could have had a little taste to it - the description sounded tasty - but the product?  Not so much :(

Celestial Seasonings best de cafe green tea. We like the mint flavor.
Green tea has many health benefits and is great change from the coffee grind...

Jelly Bellies are absolutely the BEST jelly beans! I purchased these for Halloween candy, because we don't usually have many trick-or-treaters, and adults love the leftovers. This box has 36 sealed 1-oz. packets (2-3/8" x 5"), each with about 26 jelly beans in assorted flavors. The flavors vary from packet to packet, but include licorice, buttered popcorn, watermelon, and bubble gum, in addition to the usual vanilla and fruit flavors. For smaller packets (.35 oz.) that are also suitable for Halloween, take a look at these: Jelly Belly Jelly Beans, Assorted Flavors, 0.35-Ounce Bags (Pack of 80).

MAYBE IT'S MY DOGS WHO SEEM TO PREFER CHEWY TYPE TREATS OVER HARD COOKIES BUT THEY HAVE LITTLE TO NO INTEREST IN THESE ALTHOUGH THEY SEEM TO BE A HEALTHY PRODUCT.  THEY WILL EAT A FEW HERE AND THERE WHEN THEY GET HUNGRY ENOUGH BUT OTHERWISE PASS IN HOPES OF GETTING THEIR CHEWY TREATS INSTEAD.  BUT DON'T LET MY DOGS' TASTE AND PREFERENCES INFLUENCE YOUR DECISION.  THEIR INGREDIENTS ARE HEALTHY AND THE AMOUNT YOU GET FOR THE PRICE IS UNBELIEVABLE.  CRUNCHY IS ALWAYS BETTER FOR THE HEALTH OF THE TEETH, TOO.  THE GINGERBREAD SHAPE IS CUTE AND A GOOD SIZE.  DOESN'T HURT TO TRY...I DID CONSIDERING THEIR INGREDIENTS AND PHENOMENAL PRICE.

Summary: You'd be surprised they are worth the try.
Text: The texture might seem chewy and strange at first, but it's because inevitably you compare it to traditional pasta.  If you had never tried pasta, I'm sure you'd say it tastes great, and it does.  I mean, it doesn't really have a taste but it absorbs the taste of the sauce or the ingredientes you add.  I prepared the shirataki mixed with chichen and other vegetables and even with butter, herbs and spices; and I loved it.  I also had a psychological satisfaction too, knowing I was cutting down on a lot of calories and adding more fiber to my diet.  It's definitely more expensive to eat these noodles than regular pasta, but not for much.
I love this gum. Very tasty and no gluten or nasty sugar alcohols. I had to really search for it but it was worth it. I will definitely buy this again.

Over the past few years I clearly have developed a problem with drinking coffee and indigestion. I tried quite of number of coffees and this one just works for me. Coffee flavor is very good even though I make somewhat thin brew. I find it easy to drink black, and the coffee really remains ok even if it sits around my desk a while. Whenever I switch away the indigestion problems start again.
I don't know if this type of coffee would be of benefit to others but it sure has been for me.

Slightly more than 100 calories and packed with some fruit and whole grains, this makes for a great breakfast when you have very little time.  My son, Hubby and I like eating these quickly in the morning before rushing off to work.  They're easy to eat and yummy and make very little mess.  The only thing that would make me love them better is if they were organic.

Summary: Good Trail mix. Heavy on the Sunflower Seeds
Text: I like this trail mix. good mix of nuts and raisins with sweet chocolate bits. Some yogurt pieces would be nice. Of course because of their size, the sunflower seeds do sink to the bottom. Leaving a LOT of seeds at the end of a great bag. I have ordered this pack a few times. I think its definitely worth it as a healthy snack.

Summary: Great taste; super easy to prepare.
Text: This tea is very tasty, so much better than bottled tea. Also very easy to make a glass any time of day.
Good reliable cat food that cats like!  Morsels are traditional size - not too huge which my cat and my friends cats do not like.  Food was delivered in good condition from the warehouse.

Been trying to get away from soda the past couple of months and was looking for something to "liven up" my water, so I decided to order a couple of these.  This product did just that: a great taste with very little calories.

As always most of the things I order from Amazon have be very good and the sniping has also been very good.
I have orderd this product before and have enjoyed it very much, that's why I have ordered it again.
Thank you

After shopping around for some K-cups that were affordable, I decided to give Donut House a try.  We don't like the heavier French roast types or flavored coffees, so this brand and type are a good one for us. We like a light  to medium roast coffee.
This coffee is delicious and it arrived very quickly.  I am very happy with this product.  Anyone who enjoys a good cup of Joe in the morning will enjoy it too.

Summary: Tasty...vitamins aside, it's making me drink more water
Text:
Very glad I read the label...when I selected it from Amazon I thought it was an energy drink...it's actually an additive you put in your water to make your water an energy drink!

Actually very tasty...very reminiscent of Kool-Aid Fruit Punch flavor. One long squeeze is good for me in a 1/2 liter bottle of water. I do like that you can make it stronger or weaker to taste based on how much you add.

Needs to be refrigerated after opening...one more thing to take up space in my fridge, but oh well.

I notice I'm drinking more water later thanks to this, so that's good!

And if I'm getting more vitamins, well hey, that's cool too. 0 calories...has caffeine.

Wow. I realize that this product must be going away as you can no longer find most of the coffees for the Dolce Gusto Machine at any of the stores.  I ordered these on-line because my kids enjoy the hot chocolate from the Gusto and they are easy to make.  I did not think that I would be sent 3 boxes that expire in approximately 3 months!  I have not idea exactly what that means (it says best by). So maybe it won't matter if we use it past the date of 7/12? The idea was to buy this many so that they would last a long time.  The taste of the hot chocolate is very good though.

This is a perfect product for my little morkie who gets tear stains easily and icky eye boogers.  I try to use a pad on him everyday.  I'm sure he'd wipe his own eyes if he could, but I have to do it for him.  The pads do the job right without leaving a greasy residue or a weird smell.  Clean and textured for a slight scrubbing effect. The dog seems to enjoy it.
I love the packaging! soo cute! the vanilla is very fresh,the smell is so strong! i like this purchase!Thank you Beanilla!
So looking forward to drinking 100% coconut water, but instead I got coconut water with sugar, which I cannot have w/SIBO condition.  What's up with the description of 100%?? Buyer beware!

These definitely have a cakey, chalky like texture, but they taste really good.  The chocolate taste is really good without having the weirdness that some diet bars have.  You can tell there are chocolate chips throughout them too.  I usually can't control myself once I start eating cookies and things like that,  but even though these are small, just one takes care of my craving for something sweet.  I'd say give them a try.

For many years, I used Dessaux wine vinegar exclusively.  I am glad to say that Roland French Aged Red Wine Vinegar is a fine substitute and once again, I enjoy making my own salad dressing.  I was a bit anxious to order vinegar on line but the packaging was more than adequate - I was impressed.
This is by far my favorite black Peach tea. The little messages aren't bad on certain days too!
I love this coffee!  I have not found one I like better.  I like to make it extra strong, and it really seems to have a kick to it.  Ordering this from Amazon is pretty handy.

Summary: My dog is addicted to these
Text: My westie wakes me up at 5:30 for her "breakfast cookie" She is in LUV with these cookies. They smell good too.
This is one of the best dark comedies ever!  If you haven't seen this yet...you need to.  Watch it with friends and family.  You will be hooked!!

I can do without a lot of things but I can't function (or be happy!) without my coffee.

I like a good,strong (not bitter) cup of coffee. TULLY'S Italian Roast is excellent. If you're looking for a bit of variety, TULLY'S French Roast is also delicious.

These look and smell pretty tasty, no wonder my dog loves them. These are perfect for obedience training because you can hold a lot in your hand. One thing though is that they dry up pretty quickly--but my dog doesn't seem to mind! She's had both the salmon and the chicken, but she seems to prefer the salmon.

Summary: Not as good as reviews make it out to be
Text:
I don't drink decaf, my wife is the one who drinks this coffee. I bought this going off the great reviews from Amazon and the Lavazza name.

I would have to say that the coffee is over hyped in terms of a taste/price ratio. When I purchased it, it was approximately 9.4/lb. We all know coffee has gotten more expensive over the last year or so, so I was expecting a medium-good coffee for this price.

My wife says it doesn't taste much better than other "lesser" brands of coffee. She actually prefers a local brand that generally doesn't cost more than 7-8/lb.

The Green Mountain Extra Bold Dark Magic decaf is a very good, strong coffee. It does have a slight bite, but then I like that in a coffee. Many decaf coffees have little to no taste, especially using K cups, but this decaf actually tastes like coffee! For those interested, the caffeinated version of the Dark Magic coffee is great too! That is why I ordered the decaf to try. I highly recommend that you give it a try.
This could be a good dog food - but if the dog won't eat it, it does not help. They won't eat any other dog food either. I just thought this would be different. NOT!

I love these creamers.  I count calories every day so it makes it easy to know how many calories I have in my coffee.  But most of all I love the taste.  I haven't been able to find these in our local grocery so I get them at Amazon through subscribe & save.

This product is becoming hard to find in local stores here in the Seattle area. I love the fact that I found it on Amazon, and for a price that beats all others, hands down.

If you enjoy Potato Dumplings from Germany, these are the ones to get.

Hint: Drop a beef bouillon cube in water where you cook the dumplings. It adds a discreet, yet delicious flavor to them.

Summary: Intensely spiced ginger snaps, but texture is not my favorite
Text:
First the good news: I love the spiciness of these gingersnaps. These cookies have both ground ginger and candied ginger.
The part I don't like: perhaps because these are vegan, they don't have a very pleasant texture. They are more than just crisp, these cookies are just plain hard. For me this is a deal breaker, but for someone who likes to dunk their cookies in milk, these may be more likable.
didnt like them, i know they are in salt water, but too much salt, i cant even give them away.

A friend bought me this product because I love Cosmos.  I wasn't real excited about trying it because most mixes are too sugary.  This, however, was excellent.  I am now trying to find it, to no avail, in Michigan.  Guess I have to order on line.  Great with Orange Vodka.
I really like the Splenda Coffee Flavors and they are difficult to find locally in the grocery stores.  When I found them on Amazon I was very happy!

since this particular flavor of Bigelow tea seems so difficult to find in the stores, i have ordered it twice on Amazon.  it is the only cinnamon tea my daughter likes since it has such a lovely cinnamon aroma & flavor.  if you are a cinnamon lover, this should work for you!

I was so sorry to be notified that this is no longer available as a subscription.  This is my favorite instant coffee.  I've had many comments from guests saying that it tastes like brewed.  It made me give up brewing coffee in the morning.  Hope it becomes available on Amazon again.
Just what I was looking for!  It was exactly as I expected, and arrived very quickly.  Very happy with the purchase.

Summary: Beware! So tasty they cause trouble!
Text: A hit. Healthy. Tasty. Memorable. Can't say enough. Fussy eaters will gobble them up! I have been studying the ingredients and can not find anything to complain about. Not one criticism. Good price. Free shipping. Thanks Amazon.

I really love this maca powder.  It has a nice texture and tastes very good to me.  (I may be weird, but I like to take it in small amounts right off the spoon and love the taste.)  It's great in smoothies if you don't want to taste it.  Gives me energy and also energy of the root chakra kind if you know what I mean.  If your sex drive is low, give it a try for a few weeks and see what you think.  It seems to help with hormonal balance or something wonderful.  I take a spoon every day and sometimes skip a day or so if I can stand to, just to help my body stay responsive to the maca.  Wonderful stuff.  Keep it coming!  Is there such a thing as too much maca?

It's so very hard to find real non-meat products so was taking a chance with ordering the 6-pack specially since I had never tried this brand before.

The soup is very tasty and perfect for on-the-go meals. To be on the safe side, I would let it sit for about 20 min after adding hot water.

I had some problems with the spice powder getting stuck in clumps inside the pasta shells, but if you mix it very vigorously after you open it, they dissolve.

I did not try the microwave option

I have always gotten their cards before and my dogs loved them for Christmas. However, this time, after a couple of weeks of not getting the cards, I emailed the company and asked if they could send a couple of other cards. They replied that I should wait to see if I would get them and if not let them know. They never came and as it was too close to Christmas, I just gave up.
I made these brownies with nothing  but one cup nonfat yogurt. The came out very chewy and rich minus egg and oil!

We love these crackers, and weren't able to find them at Costco anymore, so when I found them on Amazon I was thrilled.  A healthier choice than most crackers, though a little more expensive, for us they're worth it.
Good taste and easy to heat up. Just too much salt in this prepared food (about 1/2 a days total intake in a bowl) to use on a regular basis.

Summary: Pay for it but don't taste it
Text: You pay for no palm oil yet still get it AND you're still blessed with the oil slick atop the product. Next time I fork over a premium, I'd expect a superior taste or at least better ingredients.

Summary: Snack Bars - not what I wanted...
Text:
I switched my standing order to Meal Bars (10 gm of Protein) from Snack Bars (4 gm Protein.) Today I received both... What do I have to do to stop this.
Kellogg's Special K Protein Snack Bars, Chocolate Peanut, 6 ct
Light in flavor, not bitter at all.  If you like the sort of tea often served in Chinese restaurants, this is a good choice (not to mention, pretty cheap!).

Summary: Great Noodles Even When Served Cold!
Text: This is one of my favorite gluten free rice noodles.  They work so much better than most GF noodles because they stay soft even when refrigerated.  They're perfect for making cold noodles dishes.  I love them!

Much better than Nutrisystem. I bought the Nutrisystem plan for 8 weeks, less than half the food was edible, comparing this to their breakfast bar this is by far better tasting and it does make you feel full longer.

I'm NOT a coffee drinker. I have too much of a sweet tooth to tolerate the taste of coffee. This product will not change that.

However, my coffee-drinking spouse with acid reflux liked this coffee, and was able to drink a second cup because the acidity was lower, and bothered his stomach less. He normally can only have one cup of coffee in the morning, because his stomach doesn't feel well enough for a second cup.

This coffee allows him to enjoy more coffee without suffering the sour stomach. Does it still taste like coffee, complete with bitter aftertaste? Yes.
Makes it taste just like the popcorn you get at the movies. Dont need alot to do the job so this carton should last along time.

I've been feeding my cats this food for over a year now but this case was different.  When I opened my first can the consistency was completely different, waterey more than normal, smelled different & the color is different.  I compared it to a can from another case that I had & it was completely different.  I almost wonder if it sat in a warehouse in the heat all summer, it looked like it was boiled.  It creeped me out so I switchy cats to a different food & did not feed them this.

The product was ok. I like that it has no dairy, as I was unable to find any that my son, who has a dairy allergy, could have. I ordered 2 vanilla boxes and 2 maple boxs. The vanilla arrived fine, but both maple boxs came broken. I did not feel comfter able giving my babies broken pices. I emailed the company twince to see if they would replace them and I have not heard anything. i also tried to call them, but their coustomer service number doesnt work. I WILL NOT be buying anything from this company again!!

It is as if you took your generic store brand mac and cheese, took a teaspoon or less of the fake cheese powder, and sprinkled it over oily popcorn. Entirely inedible, not what I was looking for at all. Fake cheese taste, doesn't pop up as nicely as other Orville products, and not what I would have expected from the Redenbacher label. Disappointing.

This was the first and only flavor I have ever bought from Timothy's. This flavor was so ungodly undrinkable that I threw the remainder away and will never risk buying anything from Timothy's line. If Timothy's has the courage to sell this swill, they can't have any taste buds.

I absolutely love belgian waffles. I always look forward to staying at hotels where they have a "make your own waffle" breakfast. Those waffles always seem to be the best. Well, look no further, this is why. I received a Waring Pro flip style belgian waffle maker for christmas. Makes real, deep-pocketed, belgian waffles. Using this mix with that iron makes the best belgian waffles ever!

Sorry to say, but need to warn others that this tea is tasteless, like it wasn't properly made.  It is so bad that we can't drink it, tastes like tea colored water without the tea flavor.  We have drunk Oolong for years and enjoyed all other brands of Oolong, so this was a terrible disappointment.  Wish we could return it as it was about $20 wasted on this 16 oz bag.

This is a really great tea. I used to drink rose-hip tea in my childhood, and now I do that again. If you want the tea to taste better - you might want to add some sugar in it (not honey or something else, sugar!). Better if you make it in a thermos. In this case the taste will be much better.
We really liked these at first then we started getting a few bad pieces in each bag and lost taste for them.

Summary: candy from my youth in Hawaii
Text: This brought back the fond memories I have of growing up in Ewa Beach, Oahu, HI! Delicious, and it brought back times I spent in movie theatres watching samurai films eating this and crack seed.

Summary: One of the best sugar free chocolates around.
Text: This milk chocolate is one of the best sugar free chocolates I have found on the market.  Just try to eat part of one bar at one seating!!!  Good luck.

I use this in coffee drinks, so I can't comment on it for baking, but it's fabulous for those! It's great in mochas and other coffee drinks that you want to add chocolate to. I've been able to make several different coffee drinks at home for less than the coffee shops thanks to this stuff! It can be used for hot chocolate, baking, or other things as well, but it's been so good in coffee that I haven't used it for anything else yet. Great stuff!

Summary: Expensive... but a real treat for us!
Text: Its as close to the real deal as you can get!  It is a treat for my kiddos and myself who don't do refined sugars etc.  Blows great bubbles!  A bit expensive ... wish it was a little more affordable .

I love this coffee and usually have my mom ship it to me from overseas. I like to make it with nestle Nido powdered milk and a little sugar. It's more like desert. I also think it has more caffeine than other coffee and seems to get me moving once I drink it in the morning. Ill be ordering it from here next time even though it is a little pricey, but to me it's worth it, yummy!

Our Ruby is a tad over ten yrs old and, although our Vet said try Science Light, the only kind of that available was for cats 6 yrs and under.  Then I saw the Royal Canin Light.  She's dropped 0.3 of a pound in a little over two weeks. Which is cool 'cause she likes to leap from her condo onto my lap. And the Vet says she likes this food.  It is a bit pricier, but Amazon has a bargain for the 15 lb bag w/free ship.

Delicious and I know those who are looking for gluten free snacks will love this one. What I liked about the bar was the fact that it was soft. I'm not fond of those that are so hard you have to break them just to get a bite.
I truly enjoyed this bar, it's taste, and I felt like I was eating something good for me.

I just had this for dinner tonight! Added some cajuan spice and olive oil and it was great. I'm so glad amazon added this. This pasta has a great texture and taste. You wouldn't even think it is brown rice. I actually like it more than regular wheat pasta.

Summary: I didn't like the cocoa Peanut Butter
Text: I am currently on Weight Watchers and love peanut butter.  When I saw this I figured I would try it.  Well the regular peanut butter is not bad but the cocoa was not tasty at all.

I'm not to keen on it being greasy. I used it for the first time, but I'm sure more uses and I would like it more. I will say I like it better as opposed to Wilton's fondant once it is dyed a color like red or pink. The Wilton's brand dries out far to quickly.
A must have for giving pills to dogs. I actually split them in half for my toy poodle. You get more for your money with this size as opposed to small dog size of pockets

I use this granola as a treat on my low carb diet since it does have a fair amount of carbs, but they are mostly the "good carbs".  It is just sweet enough to satisfy the sweet craving, and not too sweet. The granola has a good cocoa flavour and is very filling - you don't feel hungry 30 minutes later. I love that it does not get too soggy too fast and yet it is not like eating rocks. I originally purchased Lizi's at a local grocery store, but now they don't carry it. I was extremely happy to see that I could stock up with a 6-pack for far less than I would have paid for individual packages at any store or directly from Lizi's website.

I'm baking bread with the "Artisan Breads in 5 Minutes a Day" book.  Just an observation:  I seem to get a stickier dough when I use Red Star as opposed to Fleischmann's.  Good rise and flavor with both brands, though.
I love these chips so much that I have to order them on-line because I can't find them anywhere. I had tried them once when  co-worker brought them in to work.

If you are looking for a good organic dry cat food I would recommend this one. My cats have been on Organix for years. They have the shiniest coats and are quiet active indoor boys. My 11 1/2 year old acts like my 3 year old. With all the GMO feed out there, antibotics, and etc. I know I don't have to worry about them being on this food. Great product. :)

Summary: The item is great, the packaging is very poor
Text: I received my baking soda today. They came in a box, which contained inside  another box from Bob's Red Mill, with a label "ready to ship" from Amazon.  When I opened this second box, the mess was all over my living room. Two of the four bags were punctured. Please, do something about it!

Summary: Kasha As Good As You Cook It!
Text: Kasha is can be a tricky product to cook and requires an extra step if you want it flaky, not mushy.  Many people, especially in Russian-speaking countries, eat kasha as a hot cereal for breakfast.  In that case you simply cook it 1 part kasha to 2 parts liquid with some butter and it will get to the consistency of thick oatmeal.  To serve it as a side dish say as classic Kasha Varnishkas (Bow tie Noodles), you need to first mix each cup of kasha with a beaten egg and toast it in a dry skillet until grains are all separated and browned. Cook them as you would with 2 parts liquid and whatever seasoning and vegetables you desire for PERFECT kasha.

I use treats for obedience and agility classes.  I need a treat that is not crunchy, but chewy and capable of breaking up into small bits.  This product is already a perfect training treat size, so I do not have to spend time cutting the pieces into soy bean sized bits.  Have yet to see them in action but I am sure my pup will love them.

Forget that store bought jerky.  Make your own premium jerky with American Spice's Hot Beef Jerky Blend.  Regular so called "hot" mixes just don't stand up this product...If I could give it six stars, I would.

I drink this green tea blend almost daily. I rank it high among my favorites. Probably the only negative is the packaging: Each tea bag "tag" has quotes from various individuals. These are mostly inane blatherings not worth reading. I usually pitch this portion of the product in the compost pile.

Huy Fong band Sriracha Sauce is an outstanding hot sauce, and relatively inexpensive. Plus it comes in a fun squeeze bottle!

Its medium heat, slightly less hot than the original Tobasco Sauce. There is a strong garlic flavor and a little sweetness. Its called an Asian sauce and is wildly popular in the American-Asian community but it truly can go on anything. Its strong flavor and heat tends to overcome other flavors in food but sometimes that is exactly what you want. College students love it to pep up the food they eat. This brand contains preservatives so it doesnt need to be refrigerated. If you like some heat in your food but am tired of Tobasco Sauce give this a try. Highly reommended.

I looked at every store in Lafayette, Lake Charles, Baton Rouge for the BAR B QUE. SEASON. One store had it, Albertsons in Lafayette. When they sold out their stock-that was it. The stores carries other flavors.

When an items is going quickly-the stores do not restock. What the deal? Store manager is going insist there is no demand for it?

We went to Breaux's supermarket in Lafayette on Moss street. We were checking for this item. Did not have it. When we walked out the store, manager runs out the door to ask us why we did not buy anything. He told us at the end of the week he would have it. End of week, nope-didn't have it. two months-did not have it.

I checked here-got it, love it.
My little boy is 8 & he loves them...we have tried ALOT of other kinds but this is his favorite and it doesnt have that werid smell when you toast or microwave them.
This is a great mix to put in your hydration pack for mountain biking.  I never bike without it!!

These mocktails are surprisingly good, and the fun part is telling your boss that you're going to drink a margarita at your desk! I'm thinking you could probably use this as a base for a real cocktail, so I'm going to go out on the web to look for recipes.

For some of us who cannot drink coffee or do not wish to ingest caffeine this healthy drink is the answer.  The powder  version is very good, but I prefer the crystals.  This beverage can be prepared black or milk/cream/Half andHalf added.  Also can be prepared as a cold drink.  When I decided to stop drinking coffee for health reasons, I was looking for a product that would satisfy me.  I tried other brands of coffee substitute but Cafix did the job.I highly recomended.

This is the best purchase I have made online. The Bonsai Tree I chose to have delivered came on January 5 instead of the promised January 7th. Being shipped in the dead of winter, I expected some leaf drop, absolutely none. Leaves were green as could be and soil was still damp after two days in a package. The package was well packed, cardboard and peanuts everywhere that could be imagined. Everything about this purchase was way above my expectations. Thank you.

They sell cups containing 1/3 the coffee that Starbucks filled in its cups, and except the same flavor.  Of course, it fails.  This manufacturer continues to disregard the decaf coffee drinkers.  No wonder, Kuerig beats them, hands down.

Summary: great coffee at fiar price, No 3 or 4 bucks a cup
Text:
Want a great cup of coffee at a fair price? Try Senseo
with a wide selection of flavors. We prefer Breakfast
blend or Medium blend for breakfast. Skip the $3.00 or $4.00
dollars a cup, and put it in your piggy blank!!

Summary: Not as good as the meat version, but quite good for vegetarians
Text: My wife is vegetarian and I was eating some traditional canned chili. She said, "I wish they had canned vegetarian chili!" So I came right to amazon to see and sure enough! IMO, it's not quite as good as their meat version, but it's still good. There is a lot more tomato base to the vegetarian chili. My wife thinks the flavor is good. It could be improved with more TVP. I give it a 4 because I can identify improvements. The ingredients are all good and pass a vegetarian label inspection. I recommend it. I do wish it had more TVP though.
I first came across this brand of granola from Whole Foods.  Unfortunetely, I can no longer find it there so I purchased it on-line.  It is simply delicious but a little pricey.
Just what I was looking for!!! Couldn't find it where I live. Want it for cooking several dishes and for my new automatic salt grinder.

Summary: Warning:  May not be Key Lime juice
Text:
I saw another review saying this, so I called the company and asked: Is there ANY key lime juice in this? And guess what, they REFUSED to answer me.

If you want real key lime juice I would avoid this product.

If you wanna taste Cigarette Ashes, this is just the right item for you.
Horrible, Just Horrible! Took One Bite and threw away the rest.

I prefer the fresh New Mexican chile but these are very good - they have a firm texture and a great taste - I only regret that they do not can the really hot chiles.  I would recommend these chiles to anyone who loves or likes New Mexican or any NM type chile.
These lollipops are a healthy tasty treat. I enjoy them around the office and at home.
My Italian Greyhound loves these treats and it makes him so calm without any side effects. I first bought Mellow Mut at Whole Foods, but they stay sold out.

We really miss the Starbucks breakfast blend discs. I have tried most Tassimo products and none compare.
Oh woe. Any word of new coffee blends coming?

My cats love freeze dried meats.
They absolutely love these treats.
They are the cheapest of all the treats I buy.
The quality is good, too many small pieces though.

Do not buy freeze dried beef liver as it is too hard on there tummies.

I only give them a couple of pieces a day but they know what time that is!

If you're looking for a never-fail, works-every-time dog treat, look no further. Far superior to any other chicken jerky we've tried, and we've tried at least six. Terrific product at a very good price.

Again Brussel's did a great job of packaging. Very fast shipping. Mine dosn't have flowers on it yet, but it's pretty to look at. This is the fourth tree I have bought from them, I have not been disappointed yet!! Their trees are very healthy & priced well.

This is rich full bodied tea that is never bitter. I perfer drinking it "English style", with milk and in a proper tea cup. It never gets old either. One bag will make a full pot for 2, about 8 tea cups. Any leftovers can be used the next day for iced tea. Just remove the bag before cooling.

Summary: A great gift or collectors item
Text:
I originally purchased this set not knowing who was going to receive it. I have a family member that collects Pez, but I also have a daughter who enjoys it. Both I'm sure would love it, so I may have to buy another.

It comes as a cute reusable mini lunch box that contains a set of 4 separate Pez dispensers. (3 Hello Kitty and 1 My Melody) It also provides 6 packs of assorted flavor Pez and a candy bracelet.

Individually these Pez would cost anywhere from $6-$8, so you add in the additional candy and collectible tin and you have a nice deal!

I'm always on the hunt for the best Scottish Shortbread and after several other brands, I found Lu's to the the BEST for any mass made shortbread cookies out there. Visitors always comment how good they are and often switch to this brand after trying it just once. Scottish Shortbread is supposed to be buttery, dense and not sweet, just a bare minimum of sweetness.

Don't even bother with Wxxxxx's...blech! If you like Scottish Shortbread, almost like homemade, then this is the one! I'm so happy it's available on Amazon's "Subscribe and Save" program.

Summary: Remember it's flavored-good to very good
Text: Very nice and the ladies love it-I didn't see it was flavoved and should not have bought it for a bunch of ladies who mixed it with Jack Daniels

Well I haven't had a chance to use this product but I'm glad now to have it for thickening because of my getting away from flour now.  The condition and packing was excellent and I know this will be a regular when I need more.  Thank you for being so prompt in sending it.

Summary: Great product, but can be cheaper.
Text: Excellent stock, the best flavor with the least additives I have seen. However, the price of $32 for 6 or $5.33 each is over double the price I have just paid at my local Supermarket. Would love to  see a more competitive Amazon price.
The product was great quality with the great price.  Shipped on time and was delivered on time.  The quality was better than some florists I have used in the past.

This product is very good.  Taste great and the whole family uses it.  I highly recommmend the product to anyone who wants to feel good about what you are eating.  Great buy also as the price was very fair comparied to others who offer the product.  Very happy customer indeed.

When it comes to soup, I'm somewhat finicky. I normally don't care for packaged soups, but Imagine's Garden Tomato soup has won me over. The light sodium is just the right amount. The soup is creamy and tastes fresh and refreshing. What more can you ask for from soup? It's really good.

I was browsing amazon, looking for a cheese-puff type snack. On a whim, I ordered Pirate's Booty Aged White Cheddar sight unseen.  I was delighted to find a very tasty cheese puff snack.  I will order these again!

I love Jolly Rancher sour candy. They wake up you mouth with the
true flavor of the fruit. I just wish they would make seperate
bags of them. I am not a fan of the sour watermellon and it seems
like every bag has more of them than the green apple ones which I
love!!!!!

Summary: It's next to impossible to find flavored decaf in Portland, OR
Text: In Atlanta, where I previously lived, at least one large farmer's market made its own flavored coffee, in a multitude of flavors.  Alas, not so here in Portland.  This coffee is okay, but not great.  The flavoring in a little to subtle for my taste.  Acceptable, but...

Summary: I like it, but it's a product of Taiwan...
Text: While I love the product, if you read the label carefully, you realize that this is product of Taiwan, not France. For those who try to avoid groceries from China/Taiwan/Hong Kong, thought I should let them know....

Since I am a big fan of sesame seeds, I found these pretzels at a local grocery store and tried them. Pretzels have always been a favorite food of mine, but these are definitely the best ones that I have ever had. Not too salty and the sesame seeds are such a great addition. I was so glad to find them on Amazon at such an incredible price.

Summary: Goji Berries are fresh and reliable - free shipping too!
Text: I bought two bags of these so I could get free shipping.  I am glad I did because they are great!  I have been eating them everyday and would buy this exact kind again!  I am hooked.  I use the goji berries with fresh ginger ground up in water as an anti-inflammatory and they work.  I have a lot of inflammation and drinking this goji drink keeps it down.  I have to drink this drink throughout the day everyday as prescribed by my accupuncturist doctor.

I have been buying this from the local market for months. They recently clearanced it -- I am so happy to find a convenient source! I like to heat Uncle Ben's brown rice single serving and add the salmon pouch. It makes a great dinner for one.

Summary: Not bad, funny smell and taste when first opened.
Text: These had a distinct medicine smell to them when I first opened the bag, it dissipated after a day or two so I'm assuming it is tied to some sort of preservative agent used when packing them.

Summary: All right coffee. Somewhat better than folgers.
Text: This coffee is alright. The taste is rather sourish and a bit bitter. It just does not taste very good. Maybe its because I am used to Lavazza and Sturbucks beans, but thats how I feel about it. I tried making it in my drip coffee maker (I have a very good coffee maker that releases most flavor) and french press, still it tasted mediocre. I ended up giving this coffee away.
really good snack pricey but worth it get em in bulk start grubbin keep some in the car great for bike rides forget powerbars!
Haven't bought Africafe on line yet, but got it in Tanzania and fell in love with it.  Overjoyed to hear that it is now available online!
very good transaction. Got the product in time. may do another transaction when the supply is over. for the users, i forgot to keep the product in cool place and left in my car. chocoloate melts.
This gritty parched blue corn snack will leave your mouth parched afterwards and begging for a drink.  To me this snack ate like really tough, dense Corn Pops cereal.  I'll see if my rabbit wants it.

This is great candy, smooth and flavorful with a great 'mouth" as the TV chefs like to say.

However-- six bucks for ten pieces of hard candy? The dollar store stocks this pretty regularly. Same brand, same size-- one dollar.

Summary: greenyoung kefir  -  tiny tot amount of kefir
Text: I don't think the seller, greenyoung, could have possibly sent a smaller amount of kefir.  will buy from another supplier.

for our miniature poodle.....so far so good.....she seems to like it and......I know this will sound gross to some but to those who know the importance......her poopoo doesn't smell and easy to pick up with a tissue....it's important!
I love this coffee.  I signed up for the subscription and the shipper is always on time with my orders.
These snacks are great but the price is beyond absurd.  These are $3 - $3.50 each in Wal-Mart.  Here it is $7 each.  Price gouging at it's best.  What a joke.

I needed two vanilla beans for the Love Goddess cake that my husbands adores. So you can spend exorbitant amounts of money at the grocery store for more vanilla beans than you need, or you can order the amount you need with free shipping. Each bean was in its own plastic vacuum package that looked like it could keep for awhile if you needed it to. The cake was, of course, delicious, and my trash smelled great from the two little plastic vanilla bean packages, so maybe you could use them to make something else smell nice.
Even though I adore licorice, the citrus is very bitter.  I suppose that it will last longer that way.  Not bad but not something I would highly recommend.  A middle of the road review...

I've had a lot of brownies, both from mixes and homemade and I think these may be the best brownies I've ever had. The chocolate chips melt and create little pockets of amazing. They're perfectly chewy, high quality chocolate, and just the right amount of sweet. Absolutely amazing.

Per the earlier post.  I have purchased this product in this size can for about this price, so I see no problem.  I'm trying to feed my cat grain free food and this is the only one I've found so far that she will eat.  It's a good product and good value
These are absolutely the very best gluten free ginger snaps I have found. They are crunchy, not too sweet, and provide a great ginger burst

I am the type of person that has been addicted to PB my whole life.  So when I saw this, believe me I had my doubts as to whether it was going to be good.  Well, I can't say enough good about this product, it comes out just like creamy PB and it tastes just as good as the regular PB.
I was thrilled to find a source for smoked paprika - this product is the "REAL" thing - wonderful, smokey flavor.  Also, speedy service.  I will be using this website for all my gourmet spices!

I enjoy GF products, make many from Bob's Red Mill and am used to the taste. I read the reviews, many of which were very positive, and decided to try these crackers despite the high price.

The taste, texture and smell of the crackers is very unappealing and the price is absurd.

I do not recommend these crackers.

Summary: The best Wheat Free, Dairy Free, Egg Free Cookies
Text: I have tasted almost every wheat free, dairy free cookie available and these are the best I have tasted.  The cookies actually taste like real homemade chocolate chip cookies:).

The package arrive with the seals broken, but in a plastic sealed bag, so kinda strange... there were 50 in there, and expires March 2013, so good that way too.
Tried it, its probably the best instant coffee I have tasted... BUT to those who think it tastes like the store coffee at Starbucks (which I do like very much), I am not understanding what those people are drinking...
If I rated it against other instant coffe, it 4.5 stars, if I rated it against Starbucks coffee at the store, its a 2 star. So I gave it 3 based on vs. other coffee, but being more expensive. its maybe about as good as a Kurig coffee or passable, for comparison. That being said, I like great coffee... most coffee at the supermarket is is swill.

I see a lot of reviews complaining of the size. Mine arrived yesterday and is 7 inches long and as thick as the one pictured. I have no complaints whatsoever. Maybe it's the luck of the draw. Has more marrow than any other antler I have bought. Dog loves it.
Works really well for indoor plants.  I used to have fungus gnats and they don't exist anymore.  It is a great product.

I am very happy with this product. I am using it everyday in my morning oatmeal. Very tasty.
It was delivered in a very short time from date of order.
Thank you for having such a good product available online. I have been unable to find anything in the stores nearly as reasonable in price.
Joan

Summary: Great tasting Earl Gray and Lavender Tea
Text: It's a lovely combination of earl gray/lavender tea, the menthol of the lavender is not overwhelming and the earl gray is the perfect combination, since earl gray denotes hints of bergmont which has citrus undertones. Please do not let the smell when you first open the bag deter you from brewing it. If it's a bit overwhelming in flavor cut it with some black tea. I personally love the lavender and do not want a weak insipid flavor, I wanted the full lavender experience.

I did indeed get 91 assorted coffees and what might be a limited edition print but the packaging was atrocious.  The box was a plain cardboard box & it looked like they had just dumped all the coffee from damaged boxes into a bin and had counted out 91 k-cups into the first box they had found handy. (At least the selection seemed extensive.)  The tube with the print was so stiff that I couldn't get the print out. Since this was the last one in this shipment I sincerely hope that there was a shipping accident at the vendor's and they chose to send something rather than cancel an order and the one that I ordered as a gift went out in a proper box.
While there is no  sugar, the natural sweeteners are high. Too ugh we think. Also we wonder if some upset stomachs for us was from this since it was common to all. We decided to discard.

Hi all;

Recently discovered in a grocery store in Western New York, this is my new favorite baking item. It doesn't raise my blood sugar when I make pancakes!!! The taste is absolutely amazing...seriously!

I also ordered a bunch of other Pamela's products as well, and they are all incredible. I can't believe I've finally found something that is not only healthy and gluten free, but also tastes good and doesn't make my blood sugar go crazy.

Fell absolutely in love with this hot sauce at Big Sur while lunching at Nepenthe's.  I bought a small bottle at their gift shop  after I was told by the waitress I could purchase it there. I was hooked .  It didn't last long while camping down the coast, Hwy 1, found a BIG bottle in Cambria and it's empty now. Going to order 1/2 gal on line. YAY, best hot sauce I have ever had.

Summary: Awesome! You can get this online!
Text: And here I thought I could only get this spice from HEB in San Antonio...I have been having it sent by friends living and traveling through San Antonio for years now....this product is awesome from eggs to chicken/tuna salad to steak rubs...it adds every bit of flavor and brings out the best in the dish!

Thus was ordered for someone else that loves the endangered species chocolates...especially the dark. Well, I tried a piece and it was not tasty to me at all. Of course I am not a fan of dark chocolate either so it's no surprise I don't care for it. I think I'll stick with my other chocolates.

I recently tried Higgins & Burke's green tea and thought that the taste and quality of the tea was excellent so I jumped at the chance to try the Earl Gray as this is one of my personal faves. Again, I wasn't disappointed. No fancy packaging here, just 20 individual tea bags full of high quality and excellent tasting Earl Gray tea.

If you are a fan of Earl Gray you would not be disappointed. I would definitely consider buying more of the Higgins & Burke teas as I have been very pleased with both teas I have tried.
Love this product.  I have a peppermill and use this all the time.  The peppercorns are of a size that seem to grind evenly.  I Would recommend this product.

These were purchased to go in goodie bags at my sons 6th birthday party.  When the kids arrived the found their seats and started building with them and eating them.  The flavor is like smarties, and you can really build with them!  I had plenty to go around for 10 kids at the party and they all also were given about a 1/3 cup to take home.  I would buy these again and recommend them for any lego loving kid!

This is fantastic quality Allspice.  If you don't mind having a large quantity, this beats the pants out of buying it at a grocer for $7.00 per ounce.  I use Allspice primarily for making carribean types of dishes like jerk chicken or pull apart jerk pork.  It also can add a really unique flavor component to gravies.  Although I don't do too many desserts, it's also good for spice cookies and I can imagine a cheesecake with a graham cracker + allspice crust being really good.  Another great quality spice from Frontier.
This is good if drank cold, it could be used as a mix too. It is a little steep in price and high in calories too. If you don't mind the price and want a natural alternative to soda it is good.

Candy is delicious, as is all Godiva. They don't skimp on the flavor, so it's not a "cheap version" of Godiva. But it's overpriced here, as they are sold in most drugstores for $5.99 a bag. If my arithmetic is still good, 6 x 3 =18, so there is no need to buy it online, unless you live somewhere very rural. Thanks!

While a bit spendy, I have to say that getting an organic product that tastes this good is worth the extra price (which is still a pretty good deal).  One of my sons and I really like granola and yogurt for breakfast, and we both find ourselves snacking on this product throughout the day.  I will be adding it to my regular orders.  Is very tasty, and has a very light crunch for granola.  It's fairly sweet, as other posts have pointed out, but mixed with an unsweetened or plain yogurt, it works great.  I have also taken to eating it with unsweetened non-dairy milk replacements (coconut, soy or almond) and it's very good.

This is a great alternative... it feels more like whole milk and tastes like oatmeal. I prefer the vanilla flavored one but they don't sell it on Amazon, at least as of now.

Shipping from these sellers is crazy. If you have a local Whole Foods, just buy it there for about three bucks each.

Summary: The only salad dressing I like
Text:
This stuff tastes better than any other dressing I've tried. Other Italian dressings -- both light and regular -- taste comparatively bitter and low-quality, but this is sharp, salty and savoury. A sprinkling of bacon bits and shredded cheddar on romaine enhances the flavour even more.

The spray bottle concept may seem a little strange, but it creates a perfectly light and evenly-distributed flavour for your salad. 15-20 sprays on a small salad will create plenty of flavour and still be extremely low calorie.

It's fantastic and the only dressing I care to use. If it ever goes out of production, I'll be stock-piling :)

Our Shiba loves these. Over a three week period we have observed a reasonable reduction in the amount of tarter on his teeth, especially the molars.

We would continue to buy them from Amazon if the price were lower. However, a large shopper's club sells essentially the same product (ingredients, and including the capped box and inner packaging), while offering the product at a consistently lower cost: 10%-12% per unit.

This is the best hot cocoa I have tried for the Keurig.... Rich, chocolate flavor (I used the 6oz setting) and it is not watery.  If you like hot cocoa, and the convenience of a K-cup, this is the one to get!

Summary: This is the best candy ever if you love coconut!
Text: I love the creamy coconut filling in the center of this candy.  The problem is, I have gotten some of my grandchildren in love with it also.  I should be buying this in bulk!!!!!!
I Sprinkle these on my non sweetened cereals and love them.  They are also a delicious snack!  I am going to purchase another box right now.

Summary: A potentially healthier alternative to Soda
Text:
I discovered this at Whole Foods a few years ago and have since been a fan. The flavor is closer to Fanta or another classic Orange soda vs a energy drink like Redbull (which, IMO, is undrinkable without Vodka). It is made from organic ingredients and the quantity of caffeine is not insignificant. I've tried other flavors, though they don't work for me as well as the Orange. If you haven't tried it, I'd recommend ordering from here or picking up a pack from the nearest Whole Foods.

One of the reviewers pointed out the tea like taste. I ordered a 24pk from Amazon in Nov 2009, which had a distinctly tea-like flavor. I believe this was an experimental batch, because the flavor since has been reverted to orange soda flavor.

This package contains 2 1-dram bottles of cherry flavoring (stronger than an extract).  Each bottle made enough cherry candy to have a solid cookie sheet full.  It's just the flavor you'd expect from cherry candy.  The recipe included was easy to make, as long as you have a candy thermometer.  My kids enjoyed watching me make it.  I have some other flavors, and I look forward to trying them as well.
These were a huge hit at my daughter's reptile themed birthday party. They were fresh tasting and cute and priced right.

My coffee arrived quickly and efficiently. However, the taste was nowhere near the excellent taste I had expected and experienced in the past with this brand. Looking at the expiration date explained the stale flavor; it was at least a year past date for selling.
I have tried several types of hot chocolate since purchasing my Keurig and this is by far the one I enjoy the most.  I have it shipped every month so that I don't worry about running out!!!

Summary: Great snack for anyone, or age.
Text: I got this item, not from amazon, but at a local Korean Grocery at a much cheaper price. It was my first time to try it after numerous failed times of buying when I'm visiting Asian stores around the valley. The teriyaki flavor in the nori makes things interesting. My only gripe may be of how many small sheets u can eat in its bottle! Maybe next time I go back at Greenland Supermarket, I'll get more. It costs less than $2 per bottle so, that's way cheaper than the one advertised here at twice that price...! ;)

These are the best! They may be a little more expensive then regular applesauce in a cup but it is so worth it when your kids (any age) suck them down one after another and you have NO mess to clean up. They don't even know they are healthly!
Really great product- taste wonderful. I put mine in a plastic container in the freezer --the bag was not that easy to squeeze to get the contents out once frozen

Summary: Just as good as in the restaurant
Text: You know who you buy things with the name of the restaurant where you first tried it expecting to get something in the ballpark in taste and more often than not be totally disappointed?  Well that does not happen here! It is good and easy to prepare.  Use it on meats even if they are not Ribeye roasts, I think you will like it as well.
I have really started enjoying stronger coffee and this is about as strong as it gets in the K-Cup variety.  In fact, I'm enjoying a cup right now!
These Kind Healthy Clusters are quite tasty and definitely extremely healthy.  Easily usable as granola they can just as well be added to different nut/candy mixes.  Also ideal with yogurt.

I have long since wanted a soda that had great flavor from real juice, carbonation, but no sugar or preservatives. This is really tasty, refreshing, and has a fabulous watermelon and strawberry flavor that can't be beat! And it is something I can feel good giving to my kids.

My cat goes crazy for this food and it's human grade and doesn't contain a bunch of highly allergenic FLAX seed (google it, flax can be very allergenic for both humans and pets if ingested on a DAILY BASIS).

It smells really good too but I'm not brave enough to try a bite so I'm giving this 5-stars from Kitteh who definitely loves it.

And, Amazon.com, what in the heck is going on with you taking this item off of subscribe & save? That was an awesome deal, man. Please don't keep doing this to us pet owners. We RELY on you sometimes. I don't even know where else I could even FIND this cat food.

Have a heart, man!

I received my order fast. I am a repeat customer for this product. It taste quite good and is very advantageous for your health.

Kathy

Summary: Makes a Nice, Rich Cup of Coffee
Text: Some reviewers say you can't teabag these pods, because the coffee will be week. However, if you put the pod in a cup, pour boiling water over it, then set a spoon on top of the pod, so it doesn't float to the top, leave it in the cup for about twenty seconds or so, then use two spoons and gently squeeze the pod over the coffee cup, voila, you get a nice, rich cup of coffee.

I have bought this before direct from the site and let me tell you it keeps your eyes wide open. I instantly noticed how much caffeine was in it after one drink. Kept me wired to the point of jittering for hours after 3 cups.
The taste was fairly decent; better than most commercial blends.

Summary: Perhaps if acid is a HUGE concern
Text:
If not for the low acid, I would never recommend this coffee. The taste was uneven and flat, not a French Roast by any stretch of the imagination.

I like my coffee strong and smooth, and I figured that low acid would be reflected in a smoother taste, but it was not. To be fair, I have not had a lot of low acid coffees for comparison. I suppose that if acid is a real concern, someone could drink this. I don't take milk and sugar, so maybe the addition of those would disguise...er, improve the taste.

I am really disappointed in this beand as they are marketing this to kids.  4% Iron and no other vitamins??  With childhood obesity a t epidemic proportions, why would ANYONE feed their children all of these empty calories?? It is like giving them Coke or Pepsi for BREAKFAST!! OK ORGANIC Coke but still Coke!! I am sad because I have heard great things about this brand and really like what they are doing for endangered species!! But they are not thinking about their target consumer CHILDREN!

I tried rice green tea for the first time at a Japanese restaurant the other day and was blown away by the flavor. It can be described best as smoked rice and nuts, I think.

Immediately had to see if such tea was available for purchase...of course, trusty Amazon came through. 4 stars due to the high price, but worth it in my opinion. If you're a person who typically drinks green tea as a bland but healthy alternative to coffee, you definitely should give rice tea a try...you'll soon be drinking it for the delicious flavor as well!

The Hawaiian Isles Kona Coffee Co.'s Chocolate Macadamia Nut Kona Coffee is hands down the BEST coffee I have ever tasted.  It is a rich, dark, and exceptionally smooth brew that makes one want to keep making another pot of coffee.  It is that good. The other two coffees I had were exceptional as well...one was the Sunrise Blend and it was delicious too, but I am partial to the Chocolate Macadamia Nut.  My advice is to buy, and enjoy!
This tasted good and did not have the after taste that canned icings have. It's not too creamy but a little stiff going by the directions.

My dogs destroyed this ball in less than 20 minutes. They chewed on the little flaps, removed the treat, and made the ball useless (it didn't hold the treat anymore). Not that everlasting for strong chewers!

I purchased these to keep at work for sandwiches at lunch and for toast for breakfast ! They were packaged great and are the perfect size for a single sandwich. I will be rebuying once I run out ! These are awesome !

I really enjoy Starbucks' pumpkin spice lattes and wanted to try to recreate it at home. I looked around the reviews and settled on this one since everyone gave it 5 stars.

Know the candy hot tamales? This syrup has the aftertaste of the candy's flavor profile. More hot cinnamon than pumpkin flavor I'd say.

Also the safety cap on mine didn't work --the ring below the cap did not break when I twisted it off so I have no guarantee it was not opened before...
