When you receive them put them, immediately into your freezer and they will remain fresh tasting for months. You can take one out of the freezer and eat, no defrosting necessary. Goes great with your morning coffee!

Summary: Great product but do not buy on amazon
Text: I love Mio The Berry Pomegranate is my ultamate favorite. For years I only drank soda and that's not healthy so I wanted something with flavor to satify my taste but not expand my waist.I recieved this as a sample from facebook about a year ago and it is all I drink. it cost less than 4.00 a bottle at Target where I am at so amazon charging about 6.00 is a rip so try to find it elsewhere first. If anything email mio  and find out where they have it avalable in your area. I also love it cause you can control the amount you use in your water and small enough to carry with you!!

Summary: Great product to keep cats out of house plants
Text:
I heard that cat grass is good to keep cats out of houseplants, which had become a problem for me. I also heard it was good for their digestion and helps with hairballs. I have seen outdoor cats eating grass and know it is natural for them to want to do so on occasion.
So I gave this product a try. It sprouted in a few days. At first my cats weren't sure what it was and were not eating it so I snipped a few tops off with scissors and put some in their dry food dish and also around the vita greens bowl. They caught on quickly and in no time all three of my indoor cats were nibbling on the cat grass. They have since nearly entirely stopped eating houseplants. I will definitely buy this again.

Summary: Great Spicy Ramen but Not Microwaveable
Text: I really am enjoying these spicy noodles and love the spicy flavor. However, I am very disappointed that you cannot microwave these (yes, I have tried and the foam almost buckled). Anyways, if you enjoy ramen that is hot you will like these. Two in a sitting is perfect.

The quality of the bamboo was very good.  The vase that was sent only partially resembled the picture on the website.  It was the same shape but was a lighter green, with little to no glazed sheen.  There was also no detail on the vase (the picture has a leaf sculpted onto the side of the vase).  The vase was definitely of a lower quality than what is pictured.  A good value but a little disappointing based on the picture.  You can understand that the vases will vary but to be such a substantial change in appearance from the picture is disappointing.

Summary: Remarkable Product at a Great Price
Text: My 15-year-old, 50-pound mixed breed has only been on the Nutramax Dasuquin Soft Chews for just under 2 weeks and I'm amazed at how much better he seems to feel already.  He is lying down and getting up more easily and quickly along with walking around with a little more pep in his step.  My 8-year-old Pug, who has shoulder issues, is now walking around without even a hint of the limp she has had for a few years now.  I am encouraged by the progress they are both showing in such a short time and I am quite optimistic this could be the one thing I do for my dogs that greatly improves their quality of life.  The seller had a great price with super fast shipping, I only wish I had bought more at that time.

Summary: Crammed full of Sugar - 21g per serving, 168g per can
Text:
I spent days trying to find decent mango puree in order to make mango shakes, and since I'm a health nut, I try to control my sugar intake. Every mango puree I look at is full of sugar, and this brand is no different. 21 grams of sugar per serving, and an amazing 168 grams for the entire can. An average can of soda contains 45 grams, for comparison. I know they make unsweetened mango puree, but I can't find it.

Other than that, it's a decent enough product if you don't care about unnecessary sugar intake. Nice and creamy, good product from good fruit. Very sweet, but these manufacturers don't understand that you don't need to add so much sugar to a naturally sweet fruit! There IS a market for unsweetened fruit, guys.

Summary: It's ok, but after a few uses...
Text: ...If you don't intake much caffeine, and use these once in a while they are great. However, if you are a coffee drinker, or consume large amounts of caffeine, you will lose the effect fast. I got a nice little "high" off the first couple and it helped A LOT with the day. But now they practically have no effect, and I rarely consumed caffeine. I would recommend for sparingly, but don't think this will help constantly, take it everyday and if it works, it's just in your head.
I have a Saeco super automatic.  Starbucks and Caribou beans are too oily and gum up the machine.  Illy is too expensive.  All of the Lavazza's work well, but this one tastes the best.

These are the very best Macadamia Nuts anywhere.  The Onion Garlic flavor is perfect - not too much and not too little.  I recommend them highly - every time I serve them, I'm asked where I get them.  A great product!

For years I purchased Tasty Eats soy jerkey because it was gluten-free. They are discontinued.

I had wrongly assumed that your soy jerkey would be gluten-free. They taste fine but I won't order again.

Bobbaaayyy!!!  My cat loves this stuff and now ignores her regular kibble and wet food in lieu of her treats.  She's over 16 years old and at that age it's good to see her get excited over something as simple as a handful of kitty snacks.

I really like these bars, mine looked just like the picture on the box.  Many reviews I read talked about a cream filling but mine only had the cinnamon filling.  They are very good and perfect in the morning.
My husband is a paraplegic and was having UTIs constantly.  Since he started drinking a cup of this tea every morning, he hasn't had a UTI for a year.
This brand of rice cakes tend to fall apart when removed from the bag, the crumbs do make good ceral tho. They are organic and whol grain brown rice, healthy.

I've tried all the Sprouts with my son and he's loved them all...except this one.

He'd already had peas and green beans I'd prepared for him fresh prior to trying this and I figured he'd like this too.

He literally recoiled.

Naturally I had to try it as he hasn't turned down a single food item I've introduced to him yet (including Greek yogurt and Indian lentils by 8 months)...you couldn't pay me to eat more of this stuff.

Yes, the mint was the primary culprit, but overall the flavor resembled peas and green beans very little.

If you want to try it, get a single pack from the store before buying a case.

Summary: Tasty healthy snack, but if damaged unable to request return
Text: I love this product, the texture is different than similar ones I have tried.  Unique because these are nice and crunchy, but almost melt in your mouth. Satisfies me the way candy or chips would, but are better because pineapple is so much healthier. This was the first time I ordered these from Amazon. I ordered the three pack and two out of three were great, but one package had a hole in it and the pineapple was too chewy and actually un-edible.  Unfortunately, Amazon does not accept returns on this product.
I was surprised how good these taste. They remind me of apple pie and are far better than the powder stuff you can by in the packets.
Becareful if you plan to use these more then two months after you order them, they expire quick. I can't use these, I ordered them to use in my November wedding but they expire in March :(

These bars are the best ever, delicious beyond compare. I will always buy these yummy bars,they are the best! The nuts were fresh, crunchy and delectable. This is an elegant cinnamon nutty bar with indulgent dark chocolate. Also this bar has fiber 7g, protein 5gm and only 5gm of sugar. The fat content is a little high at 16gm. You will swear this is a sugary treat and not a healthy satisfying bar. Have them with a glass of no fat milk or chobani yogurt and you will feel full for hours. And they are only 5 points on the weight watcher point system.

Summary: Quite good - can be hard to find
Text: These are quite good - 90 calories each - .77 ounces.  Taste like chewy chocolate covered pretzels.  Very satisfying.  Currently not available on Amazon.  I found at Walmart for $2.50 per box of 6.

I've been gluten free for 7 years and have been eating regular Rice Krispies nearly every morning with no problem. What a TERRIBLE decision to go with brown rice! Did they even TALK to someone who is GF? I put tons of sugar on it just to get through it, but I'll go back to Chex and Honeycombs.

Summary: Best value for a K-cup coffee
Text: Green Mountain Breakfast blend coffee is a mild roast that goes down easy in the morning.  My wife actually runs a cup through the Keurig twice.  Buying it this way breaks down to 50 cents per K-cup versus a dollar at any store.

I am a bit disappointed with this tea. It has little of the aroma I expected, and the taste was somewhat bitter. I am a consistent hot tea drinker and love good tea. I will keep this one and try it iced in the summer. I will also experiment by mixing it with some of the other loose tea I have.

EDIT: I've experimented several different ways with this tea. It is tasteless and bitter. I wish I could say differently.

I like this as much as my favorite Haribo. Just like the later, Black Forest started from Germany and got it here in the US when Haribo cannot meet the demand when gummy bears became such a big hit. It is not as rubbery and more fruity in flavor. It is not sticking to your teeth. Not too sweet neither. If you like Haribo, you should try this brand too as individual tastes is very subjective.

I bought this for my teething 5 month old Pitbull and she seems to love it.  Of course, I don't think she quite uses it the way its intended.  She mainly just chews on the bottle but I think she might also be trying to open the end that screws on because she opened it once and got the treats and since then she goes straight to that part of the toy.  Either way it keeps her busy.
Of all the teas I have tried, this is the best. Great flavor, not bitter.

I am totally heartbroken that Maxwell House has discontinued this product.  It is my all time favorite, and I have found nothing else on the market like it.  Instead of using water to make this, I use coffee and it is perfect!  I do not have to add any cream or Splenda (which I prefer over sugar).

Summary: Texmati Long Grain American Basmati White Rice
Text: This long grained white rice is one of my favorites.  When I'm not cooking with brown rice this is the one I use most often for its lovely flavor and good texture.  It goes well with stir fry or as a standalone side dish with a little butter, salt and pepper.  Works well in casseroles too.

Summary: Aromat, the Classic Swiss Seasoning Salt
Text: Aromat is the classic Swiss seasoning salt, often found as a condiment on restaurant tables on Switzerland.  It's great on vegetables, and particularly good on sliced ripe tomatos.

These snack bars are only about the size of a single Twix bar, which would be fine if they were less expensive. The flavor is good and the texture is nice, overall a very tasty snack to nip a sweet tooth in the bud.

I took a star off for value, if there were 10 tiny bars in the box like the Special K Fruit Crisps snacks then these would be perfect.

This tuna is (without any close competition) The Best I've ever eaten. I used to love albacore packed in spring water, but now that tastes absolutely tasteless & dry compared to this one. So, even though this one is chunk light, it's not heavy tasting at all. I can't stand regular canned chunk light, since it tastes way too strong. And this one is also not greasy tasting at all. I've also tried the water pack pouches, but they're harder & drier in texture & not nearly as soft & delicious as the oil pack. I used to be able to find both large & small oil packs in my local supermarket, but now they sell only the small ones. So, I was thrilled to find the large ones here on Amazon. I will buy it . . . forever. Many thanks!!
I just love these noodles, I wish they were sold in stores. I would buy them more but I can't afford the shipping. I am on a really fixed income.

Bought this for my mom after her local Starbucks stopped offering the Pumpkin Spice Latte (I guess it's a seasonal drink they don't offer year-round). It tastes pretty good, nice and foamy, though the flavor is slightly different from Starbucks'. It makes crackling sounds (must be the cinnamon) when you add it to the warm milk, which I thought was cool. You really get your money's worth with this one.

When reading the label in the store, I discovered that this contains sulfite, a preservative that can cause serious allergic reactions in some people. I only get migraines from it. It is listed as an ingredient on the McCormik website.
Why isn't it listed on the Amazon site? Are there other products with an incomplete ingredient list? It would be wise to check the manufacturers website before you buy.

Text:

This is the best chocolate I have ever had, bar none. The fact that it is also so healthy is just mind boggling.

I used to love this tea. I would drink it every morning but than the stores I  would buy it from stopped selling it, so I decided to buy a case of it on amazon. My whole family really enjoyed this kit. The sauce was fresh, flavorful, and super easy to make. The coconut flavor was noticeable and you could smell it too. It really did only take a few minutes to have a great meal ready. I used chicken instead of beef and it was really good. I'd imagine it'd taste good with pork as well.

Summary: Excellent pasta for hearty sauces - Lidia's Rigatoni
Text: I bought Lidia's brand of rigatoni pasta for a change. We had not tried it before but we were pleased with the flavor and texture of this rigatoni with a Bolognese sauce. The pasta cooked up perfectly al dente and the ridges on the rigatoni held the sauce very well. The family really dug in and polished off the pasta course in no time. Summary: med dark with a bit of light spice.......
Text:

Enjoy!

Tazo Passion is my one of my favorite teas.  I was so happy to find it here at a great price.  Always a lovely way to end the day!

My cats just Love this Cat Food and I have 3 of them to test it out.  I've bought this several times now in this size and also the smaller size.  This 15# is just a tad more reasonable. I have many different chews for my sweet 6 month old puppy Bella and this is one of the 2 she will eat in it's entirety! Thank You for such a great product!

This is an awesome product!  I used it religiously once a day and then smothered lotion on top of it on my thighs, butt cheeks, stomach, sides, chest and bikini area.  I went full term with my pregnancy and came out with not a single stretch mark.  How awesome is that!!!

Summary: i cant believe how much my dog loves these

This is the absolute best snack pretzel you can buy, IMHO. Great flavor, just enough salt, not too hard and perfect for dipping or eating plain.

These were awesome. I mean, pumpkin seeds are good, but these ones really do hit the spot. There is enough salt to taste, but not overpower them. And being dehydrated, they aren't overly dried out or too crunchy.

I like them, and look forward to getting more once I run out.

Great Mate! I like the flavor. I drink it every morning. Thank you for the fast shipping, and I will be buying from you again. So far I have recently opened up the second bag. I like buying these larger bulk orders from you.

Summary: My daughter always asks for more
Text: What can I say... most portable baby food, with a resealable screw top. Tasty organic fruits I trust and great nutrition in a pouch. My daughter has been loving these since she was 8 months old (she'll be two in two weeks). It travels very well and doesn't take much space in the diaper bag. If she doesn't finish it (which is extremely rare), I can always put the cap on and refrigerate for later.
My dog loves these treats and they help with her aging dog breath.  These arrived fast and fresh. Two Paws Up!

Summary: Great Gluten Free Soup as a Cooking Base
Text:
When I found that I could no longer eat gluten, a number of crock-pot meals were off the menu because (to my knowledge), every Campbells soup has gluten (yes, even the tomato soup has wheat).

A number of months later we found and tried these. They are a great drop-in replacement for Campbells, and in fact they taste significantly better (a quick review of the ingredient list shows why).

I would never eat these plain, but then again I would have never eaten then Campbells cream-of soups plain either; they are just too plain. But these are a perfect replacement and a great sauce-base.
Mrs. May's is a great snack.  Healthy and delicious.  Not much in it--simple and yummy.
I couldn't find this product in a larger bag at a local store, so I bought it through Amazon.  My cats love the food and I found it at a reasonable price.

The first time I tried this I thought, wow, this is great! It's as satisfying as eating regular potato chips, but sweeter and presumably healthier. So had I written the review then I would have given it 5 stars. The reason I hesitated was that I took it with me to work, and the more I tried it, the more I began to question the sweetness. There's no question that sweet potatoes are slightly sweet, but I felt it only fair to let readers know that they might find this product to be TOO sweet. Hence the reason for the 4 stars. It is still quite good, but if you find sweetness to be cloying, you might not like this product for long. But all in all, I would still recommend it.

Summary: Pretty good coffee, I just don't care for the "pod" makers
Text: I think the whole "coffee pod" thing is a fast fading fad. Constantly having to open, pour, clean out, a little maker is a pain compared to just making a pot of coffee. Never found a pod brand I loved either, though Community was pretty good, just takes two to make a decent cup of coffee. I bought a Kithenaid drip pot and packed away the little pod maker.

Summary: The only canned food Zoe will eat.
Text: We have 3 cats, but our smallest is the pickiest.  Out of dozens of canned food, which we feed occasionally as a treat, this is the only can that Zoe will eat.  In fact, she comes running when the wife bangs her little bowl because she knows she's getting the treat.  When I found Amazon.com had the food, I started buying it by the case.  I can't find it in the store any longer.  I hope they keep making it.

I love cherry jello. The great thing about this is its fine taste for a diet jello. The fact that you can eat this with a dollop of cool whip and not take in enough calories to sneeze about, is just wonderful.

It's a staple of my diet. Some say gelatin promotes better absorption of vitamins when eaten with a meal. And we need to take in some gelatin for other reasons as well.

Enjoy this dessert without guilt!

I have been using this to control the green alge...I have been using it for over a year, without any damage to the plants..
Works great for me. Price is good, e-bay is more expensive. Hydrostores are alway more expensive.

I have never in my many years of life and purchasing bread, ever found something that appeared to be as fresh and tasty as these. Well, the bread itself is wonderful. Very tasty and only 110 calories per bun. I use these for everything that one would use regular bread slices for and more. Super happy with purchase. :)

This is very good. A nice berry flavor with just a hint of kiwi, and very sweet even with no added sugar. The fruit flavors are strong, but very natural, without the unpleasant mouthfeel and aftertaste some fruit beverages can leave you with.

The carbonation is nice - it's not too bubbly, but just pleasantly effervescent.

This is a product I would definitely buy at a convinence store instead of a soda, but I had to take away one star since I think it is a bit overpriced for what it is.

This a good treat and my dog loved it, but Sergeant is a very strong chewer.  He finished it in about 10 minutes and was asking for more.I'm looking for something tougher. I have trouble fining an edible non-rawhide chew toy that will last with my German Shepherd.

Ick. I knew I'd messed up in getting a case of this stuff with the first bite.  I know it's fish but, this kind has a nasty fishy taste.  Ya' just don't expect that with albacore... Summary: Excellent blend to wake me up in the morning

Recommended for any Senseo lover tired of the regular blends found in the retails stores.

you may get a product only 4 months towards the expiration date. so if you use alot, you have no problem

Always been a huge fan of the Tabasco flavored Slim Jims. In stores these go for over a dollar minimum a stick. This is a rather good deal considering it's free shipping.

Summary: Food Allergies - Beware - Product ingredients listed is not complete
Text: The only comment I will make is in regards to the ingredients listed.  On Amazon it is not listed that this product contains Citric Acid.  When the product arrived I reviewed the ingredients on the jar and there was Citric Acid on the list. If you are allergic to yeast then you will be avoiding any product that contains Citric Acid.  According to my M.D. yeast is used in the manufacture of Citric Acid.  My M.D. advises those allergic to yeast to avoid Citric Acid. Therefore, sadly, I will not be eating this sauce which I was really looking forward to doing.
My order of crystal light came very quick and it was great I did not have to go shopping for it.  If you drink alot of crystal light this is a good way to have it on hand
This is another of my favorites from Dr. McDougall's Right Foods.  It's very filling and I can make it quickly for a healthful lunch.

Sure you can get them cheaper if you buy them in bulk, but in my house we don't use them a lot. Actually only for spice wine. If we bought a pound of this stuff, we would be throwing out 3/4 of it, if not more. Yes it is expensive, but I got 3 for $29 vice the price at a grocery store of ~$15 a piece (that is if you can even find them)
The quality is great, but I give it four stars because even at ~$10 a piece it is still overpriced.

Summary: Shame on me for not reading the reviews
Text: Okay, the brown bag was a surprise; I should have read the reviews first. Because my mix is nowhere near as interesting as the other reviewer's, I have a vision of a bunch of people sitting in a room, smoking, watching t.v., and just tossing random K-Cups into brown bags. I still get to try a variety of coffees, teas, hot chocolate (2), and cider, but something about the brown bag just turns me off.

Some reviewers claim not to like the taste or smell of gunpowder green tea. To each his own. It should be noted that preparing green tea does require more care than other teas. Never boil the water in an aluminum kettle, or steep the tea in an aluminum container. This ruins the taste of the brew. It is also important to let the water cool before pouring it onto the tea leaves. Once the water has boiled let it cool for 2-3 minutes, and then steep the tea for 2-3 minutes...no more. I have found Temple Of Heaven Gunpowder to be a superior and delicious green tea.
My one year old pup absolutely loves these things with or without the Busy Buddy Bone.  Of course, he spends much more time with it when they're on the Busy Buddy Bone.

Summary: I never got this. It has not shipped.
Text: I'm sure it's a fabulous tea, but it never came. Still waiting...will I get it? It's been a very long time.

What a surprise!  I was hesitant to order but with 2 Narnia loving kids I decided to risk it.  These arrived well packaged/sealed & were incredibly fresh.  Great flavors & generous portions of nuts.  The rose & hazelnut are superb with the rose tasting exactly like we've imagined a homegrown rose would taste if you took a bite :-)  Have already purchased this brand again here on Amazon.  Highly recommend!!!
We love this baby food! The best part is the consistency - it is NOT runny at all. My son loves the taste and eats it all up. We have ordered this multiple times, as it's a huge hit in our house.
This is the only brand of gluten free pasta that my husband will eat.  The whole family has eaten this pasta.  Out of all gluten free pasta, this one tastes the most like the "real stuff".

The numerous 5 star ratings on here sound like they come from ghiaradelli marketing dept. This peppermint bark is the worst I've ever had. Waxy and tastes like cheap chocolate that skimps on quality. Peppermint oil not even listed as ingredient and instead Filled with preservatives and artificial coloring and flavorings.  Save your money and buy some quality chocolate instead.

Exactly what the product says... dissolves beautifully in cold liquids, and tastes much better than other instant coffees. I've gotten into the habit of adding it directly to some soymilk to make my own iced soy latte. It's on the sweet side (I prefer my coffee to have some bitter notes, this one is all sweet) but since the sugar actually dissolves in cold liquids I'm not complaining too hard. The caffeine level is pretty strong though; I normally have a cup or two of coffee a day and I'm fine, but one packet of this and I was bouncing off the walls. So be warned that while they claim that 1 full packet is a serving, it might not be the case for you.
i do not like these they where not tasty at all so do  not waste your money like i did they are not good trust me...
I love these gummy bears but I can buy the same bag 6 lb bag for $5.96 at SamsClub.  Thus the Amazon price is a rip off.  I wish Amazon would work to provide us the lowest prices.
All the subtlety of coconut milk with the richness of almond milk. It has a much more neutral taste than plain almond milk, which I love. If it were organic it would be even better.

The Aroy-D curries in the can are surprisingly delicious and make super easy meals.  I eat them several times a week.  I make my own curry from time to time, but this is just so tasty and easy that I can hardly resist just opening a can, tossing in some meat and vegetables and having delicious Thai curry in a few minutes.  I even serve this to guests who are always impressed.  It is a bit on the spicy side, so when I know that my diners won't like that, that's when I have to make my own. Also, I keep several cans at work for lunches; I can just bring in some leftover meat and veggies to toss in and heat and eat! Yum!

the rice is beautiful, just as i expected from whole grain brown rice, but when i checked out the price i got it here (including the shipping), it didn't really compute to a deal compared to my local grocery store.  it came out about the same- my grocery working out a few cents cheaper. so i guess if you can't find this grain of rice locally then it works out well to order it here.
I have bought lavender from this seller and just the same it seems so fresh and I am loving it!! I will continue to be a customer of Catey!  Thank you ~

I'm still on the fence with this tea. I've been drinking Lipton decaf iced tea blend & thought I'd change things up with a different decaf iced tea. This tea is really strong & so full of tannins, if I oversteep it, it's awful. It's almost a reddish color when it brews. It brews much faster than Lipton does, and using 2 bags for iced is almost too strong. It goes from good to too-strong in no time at all. I do like the bags they use, maybe that's why I'm getting it too strong, it def. brews faster with the style bags PG uses. I'm hoping this tea grows on me.

This product is good for many uses.  We use it to cook with, as lip balm, as body lotion, and as massage oil.  It smells great and leaves your skin soft and silky.  It absorbs quickly and does not leave a greasy film on your skin like other oils can.

Summary: Doesn't taste like maple at all
Text: I grew up in maple country and was so excited to see a non-artificially flavored maple nut butter. The problem is I can't detect even a hint of maple flavor. It might be good almond butter but I can get that a lot cheaper than this brand. Their chocolate varieties are to die for, I won't try the maple again.

Summary: It is good if you like rubber bands
Text: This product is chewy like rubber bands.  I am on Atkins diet and was excited to learn about a low carb pasta.  Very disappointed in it chewiness.  Bought a six pack and threw five away.  And I am not a picky person

Almost all low carb breads I've eaten taste like cardboard. Not this one! It has a coarse, nutty texture that is great. It soaks up egg for a great french toast and just toasted, it comes out crispy on the outside and still soft on the inside. The other breads from Health Express that I've bought were the Flax-yummy! And the sesame seed and the oat of which makes the best grilled cheese sandwich I've ever had!!

I had trouble finding whole wheat better for bread flour when I found your Unbleached Wheat Bread Flour thru my computer internet.  Using Sour Dough is different than with yeast so I could not find  anyone to help me.  I have just today baked my four loaves of bread using your Organic Bread Flour Unbleached Wheat.  My loaves did rise really good.  The taste of the bread was excellent.  I am very pleased with my purchase and will continue to use it in my baking.  My family loves the wheat bread.
Exactly what I was looking for!  I love gummy bears, but all the brands in the store contain high fructose corn syrup.  The only drawback is that they don't have more flavors.

I was stationed on Grand Turk Island for 2 years while I was in the Navy,  one of the local delicacies in the Caribbien is Conch Fritters.  I am going to make some fritters soon and from a recipe From Grand Turk.  this turned out to be more pricy than I originally thought.  in a 15 oz can, you get 4.5 oz of conch meat and the rest is water, I paid almost $30.00 for less than a pound of meat.  I'll be looking for frozen product locally  or from another distributor.  Some of the Conch they sell from Amazon is over $100.00 a pound.  I don't mind spending $10.00 a pound no more than I will make this, But I can't afford these prices.  If you want to pay that much, then by all means go ahead.

Summary: Pup loves them but our wallets don't
Text: Our dog is crazy for these Gourmet treats.  They come in various combinations of flavors including carrots, apple, sweet potato and chicken.  Packages are zip locked and have a small stay-fresh insert to keep the treats moist.  They are small, maybe the size of your thumb, and they're chewy and smell pretty good, unlike other dog treats we've tried.  I am not happy with the pricetag on these goodies, however, and finding them in stores is hard to come by.  Buying them online is costly enough but then adding the shipping fee puts the purchase way over the top for a simple dog treat.  If they would come out with bulk package, I'd justify the higher price tag, but this sized bag is just a rip off.

I love raw honey, both for the health benefits and the flavor. But I'm not a big fan of pieces of bees knees and wings, or other bee parts - and I don't like chunks of bees wax in my honey. My husband feels the same. This is perfect for us, as it has been filtered enough to get that stuff out, but has not been heated, processed or otherwise tampered with - and the price is decent. Will buy from them again.

The best cookies ever! I ordered them directly from the cookie company Joey's in New Jersey the second time, and saved a bundle of money. Cookies are of a cake-like consistency with chocolate icing on one half, vanilla on the other. Eat more than three of these large cookies at one sitting, and you might feel sick from the sugary rich ingredients! Far better tasting than Entenmann's you find at the grocery store! Highly recommend these cookies as gifts!

Yummy chocolate easily prepared in the Braun Tassimo way. This treat comes with its own milk and is hot and delicious. Add some peppermint schnapps and a dollop of whipped cream and you have a decadent treat in cold weather.

Summary: Rare organic apple sauce in cups!
Text: It's hard to find organic apple sauce in our small town but so glad to find these on Amazon. Being individual cup makes it easy serving! The price of this product is not bad if you use subscription. Taste great, my kids love it!

This product combines ease of use, convenience and is also very healthy at the same time. We have carried it for our long road trips with simply dropping it in a insulated bag without refrigeration and yet it stayed fresh for consumption.

I am usually a non flavored coffee drinker, but I do like to mix things up every now and again. This is a lightly coconut flavored coffee. The coffee itself is a medium brew and it goes well with the tropical undertones of the coconut. It is a nice summer drink.

I've bought this tea a couple of times now, and I really like it. I'm no fancy pants tea connoisseur, but I drink at least 4 cups of this tea a day, and certainly enjoy it. Definitely a good every day tea and at a good price! I'll buy it again when I'm out.

THESE DINNER ROLLS TASTE AS GOOD AS THEY LOOK.  I WAS SO SURPRISED TO SEE THAT THE PRODUCT LOOKED LIKE ITS PICTURE!  THEY TASTE GREAT.  I CUT THE ROLL IN HALF, SLATHERED ON BUTTER, AND PLACED IN THE MICROWAVE FOR 25 SECONDS.  MY, MY, MY, WHAT A GREAT TASTE AND TEXTURE.  I WILL BE PURCHASING MORE DINNER ROLLS.

I have been using these treats for years.  I believe that dogs need some organ meat in their diets and I actually add these to their food (which is all homemade, FYI).  Be careful to calculate the cost on the different sized bags. Apparently Amazon, or Pooch Passions is not concerned with saving the planet by reducing packaging materials and shipping costs.  The smaller sized 14 oz. bag 1s currently the best price per ounce (11/27/08).  It's a shame.  I would have ordered the largest size bag if not.

I looked into this product for a friend who has cancer. The information sounded so promising, I decided to try it once for myself. I have mixed mine with a super-green juice every morning for about 10 days. I don't feel hungry, I haven't had headaches, best of all I don't hurt anywhere. I'm 55. I've had pain somewhere for years. I've added this to my daily routine like I did with vitamins years ago. I thought it would be good for me...I never expected to feel this good.

When I selected this dip, it is because I missed the savory flavor of onion dip... this dip is SWEET!  DISGUSTING! Why would they put fake sugar into an ONION dip?!  It just tastes soo gross!  If they made this and stayed off the splenda it might be better... this is the first item I have EVER returned to the grocery store because it was just THAT bad!

My husband loves these 2-in-1 products and this one performs as well as his normal anti-dandruff shampoo and conditioner.  The scent is also quite pleasant.  There's not much more to say about it other than it works just fine!
these wafer cookies are wondefully light and crunchy, but they do NOT taste of chocolate.  they are simply sweet with brown filling; get the vanilla, they are what they claim to be.

I love this flavor, but I must be one of the only ones because it is hard to find in the stores anymore.  I like to put it in milk (regular or flavored)and drink cold, very rich that way!  I recently discovered how great it is to take on road trips - just add to single serve milks and you have a great treat right in your car!

I was a little worried about this one because of a bad (weak coffee) experience w/ the My K-Cup, but this product worked remarkably well!  I didn't think it was difficult to clean using the spray nozzle on the faucet.  Also, be careful not to use super fine grounds (as suggested on the package).  They will plug up the mesh and result in a half brew of coffee so strong it can not be consumed!  Kirkland 100% Columbian-fine ground works well, however.

I have a 2 year old who was born allergic to peanuts. I felt very confined to what he could have, since he also can't have dairy, eggs, or peanuts. I bought this since growing children need fat in their diet to develop their brains. It has helped immensely. Especially since I found it online, since we are stationed overseas. I got tired of having to ask family members to send it to us. Give it a try. Taste like peanut butter, just with a different nut taste to it. It's actually pretty good stuff!
I went looking for cheap bulk tea, and I found it. Quality is pretty good - if you over-steep it, it gets a little bitter. A good choice for some every-day tea.

I love lima beans but these are a little off for some reason. Maybe because I'm used to frozen and its the taste of the can? I will go back to the frozen or dried. At least these are not lined with the BPH plastic that leaches into your food!

This Shake 'n Bake was really yummy. It made the chops crispy without adding all of the fat. The flavor was delicious without being overbearing as well. It had caramel color in it, though. I prefer to use products without added coloring. So, I won't get it again. If you aren't funny about added colors, you will love this stuff!

Summary: Delicious Jelly (From A Big Fan of Cherries)
Text:
I love cherries, and this is about as close as I can get to putting cherry pie filling on my toast. :-) The number of whole cherries in the jar complements the amount of jelly perfectly. If you're a fan of cherries, it's worth trying a jar of these preserves next time you're out shopping.

For an extra-special treat, put real butter on your toast before you put on the jelly. Delicious!

I will definitely be buying this again!

This is one of the best tea bags you can buy, decaf or not. I love the bold rich flavor and its deep color, which, to me, is essential with milk. It is also perfect with lemon (with sugar). Other than Harrod's Blend #16, which costs way more, this is my favorite (everyday) tea! My kids love it too - okay, maybe because they like to say "Poon-jana"; but i like it because i don't have to give them some diluted tea so as to cut down on caffeine. But then, this can't be decaf tea, can it?
I had difficulty finding hazelnuts before the holiday season arrived, but was pleased when I saw them offered here.  The price and convenient recipe size made me a happy foodie.

I have two siamese cats that have had digestive problems since I bought them as kittens.  The vet stated that it was a new virus that could not be cured without many tests.  The cats had all worm and other shots.  I purchased all the organic and other foods with no change.  One cat developed severe hairballs.  I tried all the treatments, but she still had them.  I then bought a 15lb. Bag of intense hairball and within aweek the hairballs ended.  And also no more digestive problems in the litter box!  The cats love the taste of the kibble and they are finicky eaters.

In very small quantities this tea made me feel really hungry, and if I drank more I started feeling really nauseated having other uncomfortable gastrointestinal symptoms.  I finally did some research and found out that some people are sensitive to sceletium tortuosum, and I guess I'm one of them.  I tried it a few times to see if I would desensitize, but it didn't appear to be happening.  I understand some people have benefits from this plant, but would recommend trying a sample first, with caution.

I tried this while I was out of state and I'm hooked. I didn't know how available it was in my area, it just takes some searching. The best ginger ale out there. I use this as a treat since it's fairly healthy and mildly sweet. If you don't want to order online, you can usually find it at Whole Foods and Kroger.
Although I prefer regular grits, this product really comes in handy when I am in a hurry.  The flavor is really good.  Would take a lot of work to duplicate the flavor using plain grits.

When I gave up coffee I also gave up one off my greatest joys. I love to get up early and sit and drink a warm beverage in the morning. It is my time, the time I use to plan my day and to talk with my Higher Power. I have tried: hot Cider, Hot Chocolate, Herbal Teas. Everything was too sweet or fruity tasting. Dandy Blend is awesome not to sweet and not bitter at all. So if you have given up Coffee and Tea here is something to try.
Good tasting, cheap, all around good...but made in China.  I had to dig around to find out, where these are made.

i have a lot of intestinal pain from IBD and my doctors wore not helping me so i did my own research on ginger and have been using this 3 time a day in cols water and in soup hot and this had helped me more then all the pills my doc gives me.
The coffee "Blend" is really lean on Kona and really fat on fill. I could not get a full bodied taste no matter how I ground it. If you want real Kona taste, spend the bucks and buy real Kona!!!

I thought the shelled pistacios would be a huge time saver. It's certainly nice, but the product itself isn't as fresh. Once that pistachio leaves the shell and is exposed to the open air, it really starts to lose out on flavor and texture over time.

Basically, big time saver, but you lose a lot in flavor. I'll go back to the shell.

Friends recommended this to me.  It has a strong "coffee" taste & I use it for an iced coffee mixed with almond milk & a bit of hershey syrup if I want to give it a mocha taste. Make sure you use the amount it says, you don't need much.
This was a little misleading as it is meant for a large machine - not home use.

This is the first Chai k-cup that I have tried and SCORE...it's amazing. I'm actually drinking my first cup as I type this. It's so good that I couldn't wait to review it. It's sweet and tasty and simply deliciuos. I used the small cup setting on my Keurig for this cup. I enjoy both my coffee & tea very sweet, but I actually don't need as much sugar for this chai tea. I put in the same amount I normally do for tea, and it's extra sweet (but still great) so next time I know not to use as much sugar.

I will definitely continue buying this one.

I took advantage of the 50% off special last summer to try some new-to-me products, including 4 flavors of these sesame seeds, and loved all of them! This was probably my favorite of the four I tried; the plum/sesame flavor combination is tasty with a LOT of foods, both savory and sweet. The plum flavor is perceptible but not overwhelming. Try it on ice cream!

Nature's Path Organic Toaster Pastries,Frosted Strawberry are so good.I've been buying them for years.I'd tell anyone to buy and eat these.
Heated up with a glass of milk....HEAVEN.

there still are ants in my bedroom and after I use this powder.
The ant were not afraid of this powder at all. Even I put it on the powder.
I don't know what this mechanism is.
IF YOU OWN/BUY A KEURIG, IT IS A MUST-HAVE!  BUY IT IMMEDIATELY! I have one and am buying another - it's totally hidden,operates smoothly - it's a fantastic product!
the candy is great. I really enjoy the great flavors. i am reminded of when i was just a young kid and used to go to the store and get some of this penny candy. I see more orders in the future.
This is my new go-to tomato sauce for anything Tex-Mex, Mexican, or southwestern.  So much deeper flavor than the can of Hunt's sauce I'd used previously.

One of the tastiest brands of canned salmon I've tried. I put it in salads or eat it with a little mustard. I don't get why people complain about the bones and skin that are included... They're totally edible and delicious.

These pigs were included in a Christmas package!  The recipient and I both think they're too cute to eat, so we may never find out how good they actually taste!  The looks alone were worth the price of admission!

Summary: Made in china!  Do not buy these!
Text: My dogs love these too and I never thought to check where they were made.  They look all healthy cage free chicken, omega 3s, blah blah blah.. Someone at the store brought this to my attention as she was looking for treats not made in china.  To my horror just about all dog treats are NOT even made in USA.  So sad and disappointing. ZERO stars!
This coffee is full bodied for a decaf and has a very good flavor. Can not tell the difference with regular coffee. Bought from Amazon.

I bought a small package of Bottarga di Muggine (grey mullet roe) and was not quite sure how to use it.  Received an e-mail from Gustiamo with encouragement and recipes.  Made all the difference.  This is a small company who takes great care of its customers, and I will certainly make purchases from them again.

This sauce isn't really hot, but has a great flavor and is good on nearly everything.

In Houston, we call this "ketchup"
This is so delicious. But I dont think I am going to buy any more - too tempting and fattening to get a 6 pack all at once!

Summary: No pumpkin taste-buy Timothy's pumpkin instead
Text:
If you want pumpking flavored coffee buy the Timothys perfectly pumpkin coffee instead.

I bought it at Kohls a couple weeks ago with a 30% off coupon I had and some Kohls cash and glad I didn't waste a lot of money on it. Green Mountain Coffees are usually good, and I loved the Timothys pumpkin I got last year, so decided to try this and was disappointed.

Like others have said it is weak and taste nothing like pumpkin. The flavor isn't bad if you want a weaker nutmeg/cinnamon flavored coffee, but it tastes nothing like pumpkin.
Inside the sack are two great one pound coffee bags of great dark costa rican coffee, I am going to grind a little more and use in expresso machine.  Excellent price, came USPS.

Summary: Good coffee, price a little high.
Text: Green Mountain coffee is by far the best. I thought the price was a little high for these K-cups, but the service and delivery were prompt, so I think it was overall a good experience.
I started using Celsius over two year ago. Gives just the right boost I needed to exercise in the mornings. No crash or after affects. Has a great taste, nothing strong or overwhelming.

New Update, Well as it turns out the Ethical Coffee Company has came through. They contacted me about the problem I had and have replaced my machine, so they do stand behind their word and will honor their guarantee. It took a few weeks but they did what they said they would. Therefore I will continue to use their products.
received the product quickly in perfect condition and reasonably priced I would continue to order all special items like these candies again and again

I needed saffron threads for a paella dish and this product worked out well. Threads were fresh, fragrant and added that distinct flavor only saffron can to my seafood paella dish. Good price, good product.
Great quality bars! The flavor is exceptionally tasty and you can't beat the price! Would certainly buy again! Note: does contain 96 bars as is advertised!
If you like sweet, this is for you.  Sweetest of the nugo bars too much for me.
Being premade and not homemade I figured these would taste pretty bad.  Actually they taste great, much like the gnocci at Olive garden.
I love the way this cooks up! Tasty and way better than the blue box!!

Summary: Really Good Tasting Gum - Highly Recommended
Text:
This Extra Dessert Delights "Apple Pie Gum" tastes remarkably like a very good apple pie. The flavor starts out strong and lasts a reasonably long time. Being a type 2 diabetic, I enjoy sugar-free sweet tasting treats like this gum.

Highly Recommended!

CFH

Summary: THE BEST COLD COFFEE I'VE HAD!
Text: I've tried a lot of cold coffee drinks and this one wins on all counts (even over Frappacino). I have to have one every afternoon for a 'pick-me-up' treat! You will LOVE this, I'm on my 2nd case!
great taste, good price... Always looking for some flavor to add to my tea muixture, this works better than most of the ones I've tried

Summary: Yummy rehydrated food, not an oxymoron.
Text:
This meal is something I always look forward to when we're backpacking. In it there is elbow macaroni, lentils, bits of chili, and cheese (along with other spices). It takes about 10 minutes to rehydrate after you put the water into it. The thing I like most about this product is that there is no clean up; you cook it in the bag, then you burn the bag afterwards.
The only thing I do not like about this product is that it makes both myself and my tent mate have horrible gas. ("Chili-mac attack")
All in all, get it, eat it, enjoy it.
I love these crackers!! They don't sell them in individual packets anywhere near me!! Only the PB ones!! And these are so much cheaper!! Thanks Amazon!!!

I just got this today and put one in the freezer so I could drink it ASAP.  OMG.............I was a little leary about it but it is WONDERFUL!!!  Some people don't like the little pieces in the drink but I love them.  I am amazed at the great taste.  There are a few too many calories (70) in it for me so I may just add a little to my vitamin water that I normally drink.  I am  enjoying a bottle now and it is very refreshing!!

I have been searching for years for the instant version of americana custard pudding. I am allergic to eggs and this was the only egg free product I could eat, and I loved it. Just mix it in a blender with milk, refrigerate and enjoy. Always got compliments from guests too. Now the americana cook and serve I'm sure is great, but what happened to my instant?

Shipping is more than the price of the product when you get it from DAB Nutrition! Best breakfast! Like to carry some for a snack at work - no sugar dump, but sweet enough. Also, add nuts, or frozen berries, or a pinch of cocoa, or a tbsp. of steel cut oatmeal - use your imagination! Never boring.

Summary: Great for me and the little one!
Text: I loved the chewyness of the cookie. I was initially worried that it would be cloyingly sweet but the oatmeal gave it a lovely texture without adding too much unnecessary sugar. Will definitely purchase this product. Thanks to Influenster I got to try this product for free!

We use mustard packets in our lunches.  It takes several months to use up a box.  According to Heinz, the shelf life of mustard packets is 9 months. The product I received is 5 months old.  I will have to donate most of it to a food bank. This is a good product, but should haver been fresher for extended use. I will purchase at GFS after this. I am very disappointed.

I think I'm thoroughly hooked on the Timothy's Columbian decaf.
It has a great flavor and not at all bitter. I started out with
the 24 pack and have since ordered the 50 in a box. I think I
will make a cup right now!

This candy set I ordered mostly for the kids(as best we can, we limit candy in the apartment), to put in the stocking(I order early).  Yes, I snuck a couple pieces they wont miss.  But what did get my attention is this mircle berry.  Wow, what a sentation in the mind and mouth, thinking and seeing you are tasting sour and its sweet!

Summary: Great Bone but Wish I got a larger one
Text: Our dog loves her bone and it's a really great product, but when we leave her in her crate it falls through the cracks of the crate onto the floor.  I would have preferred a larger bone even though I bought the size appropriate for my puppy.  Other than that it is a great product and I recommend it.
I was really disappointed in this coffee.  It's a darker roast than i was expecting and the bag has no expiration date.  My coffee tasted quite stale and old.

Another excellent mix from Namaste and once again, people can't even tell it's gluten free. And unlike some other gluten free products they actually hold their texture and I don't need to microwave them to bring the texture back.

If you don't have peanut allergies - toss in some peanut butter chips with the batter. Peanut butter brownies :)
This frappe mix is yummy.  It is positively loaded with little java chips.  I buy several Mocafe flavors; this is my favorite.

Summary: Great tasting natural sweetener with slow uptake for those who watch sugar levels.
Text:
Since this product is from the agave plant, it is a safer choice for those who need to be careful with sugar levels in their blood.
The taste is wonderful, I really don't know if we could distinguish the difference between a spoonful of this and a spoonful of regular sugar dissolved in water.
The consistency is nice to use as a pancake syrup, or on toast if you have a sweet tooth. We use this exclusively as our sweetener of choice -
not because we have to, but because we like to.
All those fake sweeteners taste terrible. This stuff tastes great.
You won't be disappointed.

I ordered and recieved my cookies.  The cookies are not shortcake, but the maple cream is good.  The cookies are packaged ok in the box but are sloppily put in the plasic trays.  Some cookies broken, some just the cookie without any maple cream.  Not what I expected.  We love Maple Leaf Shortcake Cookies from Canada, but are not able to get them anymore.  We will order again, but wish they would put a little more care in the product.  I can guarantee they would not be able to keep them on the shelf.

Summary: Good taste, good nutrition on a Gluten-free diet
Text: It is hard enough to get good tasting gluten-free foods so this was a delicious surprise. This company makes tasty and safe products to enjoy.

Summary: Against all logic, it's a whole shark! What craftmanship

That is what I call attention to detail. So rather than being, as some might describe it, half-shark, half-banana, it's actually whole-shark, whole-banana [peel]. And each piece is fun. Summary: Don't Get Milked Out Of More Money!
Text:
I was initially excited to see this product in my local grocery store. I love the original Macaroni and Cheese recipe.

But after inspecting what this product is made of, I realized that also buying a 'store brand' and just adding more milk to that product is what produces the same increased cheese taste. And I can save money in today's ever-tight economy. This is very important when every penny counts.

Given a choice, I'd rather save money for a product itself. I don't want to pay money for the packaging.

Hopjes are small hard coffee flavored candies that I remember from fifty years ago. Many people prefer them to other candies. Occasionally one has come out of its wrapper, but they are not particularly sticky. Summary: Great Honey That is Packaged in a Not So Great Bottle
Text:
Ambrosia Pure Honey is delicious and, unlike most honey available at the grocery store, this honey is produced in the USA.

My only complaint about this honey is that it comes in a bottle that is very inconvenient to use. The main drawback is that there's nowhere for the honey to come out of the bottle unless you unscrew the whole cap and pour the honey out of the bottle. If you want to be able to squirt honey out of the bottle's nozzle, you need to make a hole in it yourself. This is no easy feat because the bottle cap is made of hard plastic that can't really be cut with scissors. I usually end up pouring this honey into a different bottle in order to be able to use it more easily.

4 oz water
1 scoop Amazing Grass
1/2 cup frozen organic berries
1 Tbs flaxseeds
1 Tbs organic coconut oil
2 cups fresh organic spinach
4 oz organic juice (POM, acai, etc)

it's made of very cheap materials and it's over-priced. The plastic is so cheap that it warps after you use the machine a couple of times, and the lid will never again fit properly.
