If it saves time by being an all-in-one machine, it kills more time by requiring a complete dismantling of the bowl (5 parts need to be separated from each other and washed separately EACH TIME YOU USE IT!). When I read other reviews about mold growing in the reservoir, that just did it for me. I packed it up and returned it. Worst purchase and waste of time ever.

I ordered this as a treat for my wife, and the salmon was delicious. In the past, we had eaten smoked salmon from another maker, but our local store stopped carrying it. We had been checking for it for a while before we thought to check amazon. This worked out very well, and now even comes directly to our door.

The salmon is cooked/smoked, comes in a sealed foil pouch, and does have liquid/oil in the pouch. The taste is really wonderful. We eat it with crackers and capers.

I believe the product would be excellent if it had the right packaging for shipping; other than losing over half the contents of the m&m"s due to combustion caused by poor packaging care what was left was edible for the children even though I wasn't able to use it for its original purpose

These are okay. I've been getting Brunswick as long as I can remember and thought I'd try these because they cost a bit less. These are much, much milder. They are not as smokey or fishy. I think I like the consistency of these better, they aren't as flaky and each filet comes from a single fish. If the price difference between this fish and King Oscar and Brunswick remain as high, I'll probably get them again.

Feline loves the salmon --when I was with  two felines, they used to eat chicken and salmon.  However, with one feline now, she is enjoying the salmon more....it is a feline food that seems to be easier to digest and leaves my gal a happy feline!

I bought this because of the supposed health benefits. Was concerned that the 70% cocoa would have a bitter taste.
Not so. Very smooth and delicious. Great that something that tastes this good is healthy too!

This is one of the most difficult products to find: real Anthon Berg chocolate liqueurs, particularly because of the drinking age in the USA. Usually, I only ever find these at airports in the tax-free shops. I was SO happy to find this on Amazon.com because it's one of my mother's favorite treats and I wanted to get it for her for Christmas. Perfect purchase!

I had just enjoyed this tea at a restaurant this evening. I enjoyed 6 or 7 cups with my meal. It does not have the bitterness that most green teas have, after leaving the bag in too long. I like to leave the bag in to get as much from the tea as I can, for the health benefits, of which there are many. I believe everyone should drink green tea, and this one tastes great. Maybe a slight bitterness but not much, it was a very smooth, fresh tasting green tea. It had that classic green tea flavor that I enjoy. As I don't care much for black or oolong teas. This was one of the best brand name green teas that I have ever had, so much that I looked it up when I got home and am now posting this review.

My 15 month old ligts up at the sight of a yummy spoonfuls tub- the food has made that much  of an impact on her. I thought she was a picky eater- UNTIL I gave her a tub of yummy spoonfuls food.  The sweet potato and adzuki beans mix is no different.  She absolutely loves it and laps it up!.  Its awesome to not have to worry about my baby not eating!
Always the best quality and does not burn your mouth when you have them in your cheek. Its all I buy and very hard to find here on the west coast.

I use these rubs to make a pastrami like meat. I begin with a corned beef briskette, rub on the bilardo's and smoke for 8-10 hours. The end product is a very peppery, great tasting snack. Amazon had the best price I could find on these, I purchased a dozen boxes, they contain two packages per box. That makes 24 briskettes!!! I strongly recommend these products.

~Earth's Best Infant Formula Soy Iron, 13.2-Ounce is a great alternative formula for the baby who is lactose intolerant and for the parents who want a formula that is balanced nutritional. It is easily digested even by the most finicky eater.
Our granddaughter had gastric surgery at 3 weeks of age and continued feeding with the formula right after surgery without any problems. The powder easily mixes unlike most formulas.
I have bought other Earth's Best products and all are great.
At Earth's [...] they have gift baskets sampling of all there products.
The Amazon price of the formula for one can is the same online as in my store. But not all stores stock it yet. Thus why I buy online.
Have been using this product for over a year. Sturdy enough even for our large dog.  Buy this product with confidence.

Summary: only food my cat will eat
Text: I've been feeding my calico this since it first appeared in the supermarket; now it's the only thing she'll eat.  No hair balls or vomiting when she's on it, unlike just about everything else we've tried.

Summary: Top of the line dog food.
Text:
Nowadays I have my dog on the Raw/Prey diet. However, I still keep wellness in stock and handy on days where I cannot prepare her meal. The reason is simple, Wellness is top of the line dry dog food.

Taking a quick glance at their ingredients and you will see the major difference between Wellness and your average, everyday, popular and cheap dog food.

However, don't just take my word for it. I encourage everyone do their own research and read about all the great benefits and possible cons associated with Wellness.
Good deal, but a bit weak.  Can't add more water than directed or you'll be drinking coffee-flavored water. Other than that, not bad for decaf.

I didn't like these, but then I don't care for many of Snackwell's products, most of which seem bland to me. This was especially bad because it had the feel of packing peanuts instead of real popcorn.

Summary: Should have purchased a smaller amount as a test first.
Text: The taste/flavor is not bad for sugar free but the texture is like hard rubber.  You end up swallowing the candy half-chewed just to get it down.  And I bought the 5lb bag!  I would not buy this again.

If you enjoy a DARKER ROAST Coffee,you will enjoy the BLACK TIGER.
I laid off it for awhile,as it had a ever so slight Hazelnut aftertaste...YUCK.
I think they cut back on the amount of Coffee inside as it tastes a bit weaker to me.
But all that said, it's a VERY Good CUP of Coffee. Janis

wolfgang puck jamaica me crazy coffee makes my mother crazy about coffee so i buy it for her all the time and the best deal for these coffee pods has been on amazon so this is where i get them...good coffee...good price and free ship with amazon...glenn

I love licorice, but I have to admit that my "go-to" licorice is definitely Twizzlers. But, when I heard about this intriguing flavor, I had to try it. And I am glad that I did! It was really tasty! Not overpoweringly sweet, or too overwhelmingly fruity, the balance of licorice flavor and pomegranate fruit was quite perfect. They are also, unlike Twizzlers, already in a perfect straw style, ready to spruce up a summery lemonade as a fun licorice straw! I definitely am not interested in sampling the other flavors.
The only downside is that they are rather sticky, both to the touch and to the teeth after eating. These would not be possible for people with braces or fragile dental work! But the strong-toothed will definitely enjoy them!
I bought these peanut butter canisters for a food pantry I support in Texas that does fantastic work. Support your local food pantry! People in the US are hungry!

My wife and I have been ordering Larry's for over a year, and we're very happy with it.  It's very good quality, consistent roast, and with "subscribe and save" discount plus the free shipping, at Amazon, it's about $9 a pound delivered whenever we want it.  It's also Fair Trade and Organic, so you can feel vaguely happy for some coffee grower in a far off place while drinking it.  Great coffee, convenient availability, we'll be ordering this as long as they keep sending it at this quality and price.
excellent product! and the best price anywhere. you get 2 pouches for the cost of one when compared to other companies.

I bought this curry paste for a recipe and followed the recipe instructions and failed to look at the recommended serving size on the container.  HUGE mistake!  My recipe called for 3TBSP, while the side of the container lists 2tsp as the recommended serving size.  Even after trying to dilute the sauce it is way too hot.  The taste is fabulous but it is HOT, next time I will know to start very, very slow.
The transaction when fast and the price is good, especially compared to other offers. thanks!

Yes these are tasty little bears and even better when soaked in vodka. One should always save calories for booze and thought these would counter the calorie guilt of alcohol.  Alas the reviews are true and if you think you are in for a drunken night of romance think again you may be in for a night of flatulence and skid marks. Beware and indulge moderately.  Good price, less than half of retail stores.

Summary: Around our house we call them "chicken nanners"!
Text: I never feel guilty about giving my dog any treats from Free Range Dog Chews - they are nutritious, clean and healthy.  I love this line of chicken wrapped treats and my dog always finds them interesting and tasty.  I have a fussy 3 year old Irish Jack Russell Terrier; but, he never refuses to accept an offering of Free Range Dog Treats!  The "nanners" have always been his favorite; however, he is really loving the new liver ones, too!

Different brands of red tea have slightly different flavor undertones. Many have a hint of something that reminds me of things like olives or cough syrup. This brand just has a vague vanilla undertone, which is exactly how red tea should taste. It's delicious, and I have a cup every morning and sometimes another cup later in the day.
We love these salsas. They are roasted salsas with bits of burnt pieces that set this flavor off! The medium red is perfect for dipping with the right amount of heat. We will definetely buy again.
How  come it's so easy to tell you something is good and impossible to talk to someone when something is bad? Ken

Summary: All natural ingredients and very tasty
Text:
This product is well made from all natural ingredients. It's very tasty on crackers or with hard goat cheese. I have ordered these several times.

You can freeze these with no loss of quality.

Don't order if the weather is hot because they ship it in cool bags with cold packs instead of styrofoam with dry ice. My orders usually arrive cool but not cold.

I was so disappointed bc this seems to get great reviews.  It has an extremely weak taste and is bitter.  Also, I find that Gloria Jean's coffees (hazelnut, french vanilla, butter toffee) are weak and taste like you're drinking perfume.  I love a stronger, smoother coffee... this is just not good.

Summary: Consistent shot, beautiful crema, wonderful flavor
Text: I couldn't get a good consistent shot of espresso before buying this brand. It's just perfect every time. I didn't really believe that trying a different coffee would make my morning espresso, but it does!
First time I've seen my favorite nut in a spread, but was disappointed, the consistency was really watery and hardly any taste. Don't know what to do with it.

Summary: If I had a tail, it would be wagging...
Text: "Oh, My Stars and Garters!"  These are nothing short of absolutely delicious!!  Almost heavenly!?!  I love the combination of cilantro and jalepeno, in these crackers.  (I love all the flavors of "Flaxies!")  I'm due to order more, as I'm down to my last two bags.  What a TREAT these foods are, for anyone who is  health-conscious, and seeking ways to get raw, whole, and GOOD super-foods into their diet.  If you treat your body like a temple, you will NOT want to be without these incredible, delicious, healthful, raw food snacks ~ !

I know there are a million uses for baking soda but here are mine.
Excellent for brushing your teeth.
Awesome for cleaning out the bath tub.
Works great for deoderizing the fridge.
All in all, one of lifes little necessities.
Highly recommended.

I found the Sumatra to be bitter, I like my coffee black and strong. It's cool though, there are so many other Starbucks Coffee's I do like. I'm glad I tried Sumatra, it received alot of positive reviews, it's just not for me.

Been experimenting with Coconut Oil. The Nutiva Organic Extra Virgin is very nice with barley a hint of coconut taste. Been using it mostly to cook eggs and it does much better than the vegetable oil it replaced.

One side effect of taking this oil in teaspoon+ quantities a day is that I sleep much warmer at night. It could be placebo or some other factor but I almost immediately noticed this effect this winter.

I would buy this product again, though it would be nice to pay about half. Might go for a larger quantity next time.
I purchased this as a gift and the recipient said the coffee was good but not as good as other Kona they had tasted.
Tasty, easy to use, ingredient list full of actual veggies and things I would eat...what isn't to like?  Nice to see Rick Bayless sauces on the market, can't wait to try the rest....

My cats love this stuff, but last week I found Bonita flakes in a 3.52 oz. bag and a 16 oz bag for $4.57 and $25.99 respectively while shopping at a Global Foods market.  This is exactly the same stuff as in the cans but a whole lot cheaper.
This doesn't have a lot of flavor and the flakes are real small.  I will have a hard time getting my family to eat thru the 6 boxes before they go stale.
These are my favorite candies, and it's so nice to have them delivered to my door.  Love coming home to find a nice surprise on my porch.  Fast shipping from this vendor.

This is basically undrinkable. I like the other V8 Fusion canned flavors such as Strawberry Banana, Pomegranate Blueberry, and Concord Grape Raspberry very much, and drink them consistently, but this is just abysmal. It's hard to describe the taste though, it's sweet, yet it still makes me want to gag. You can taste the peach mango too. I think that the taste factor might have more to do with the fact that this is 50% juice and 50 calories, while the other flavors are 100% juice and about 120 calories. This diet/energy version is like a watered down nasty version of the original.
Great product. Very crunchy, naturally sweet, low calorie, great snack! I will get these again for sure. They are great for kids lunches as well. My 11 year old and 3 year old love them. :-)

This might have worked for some others, but neither the herbs (esp. mint and lemon) nor the fluid helped the sleep in our cases.

I double checked the packaging material, the only "clinical data" is about another line of product from this company.

I do love my candy! These are grat if you like sweet tarts and I do so buying them in bulk just makes sense, and yes I ate all f them before they went stale!!!  I am more of a licorice, gummi, sweetart, lemonlead person though :-)

Summary: Not the best but not the worst.
Text: After using Almond Powder in Europe, I decided to try my luck with it in the US and couldn't find it anywhere. Finally I bumped into this and decided to try my luck. Personally I thought it still too coarse to be called a "powder". But so far I still haven't found any other company that holds this product around here so if I am ever in need of Almond Powder again I'd probably go back to this company for more.

This is the only flavor that I like.  For some reason the sweetness goes well with the the softer consistensy of the dried chickpeas.  I would buy this flavor again, but not the other ones.  These have a slightly chalky, soft consistency compared to nuts. I was expecting something a little crunchier. I love that they are beans and have fiber (6 grams). The #2 ingrediant is evaporated cane juice and #3 is brown rice syrup. And if you are watching carbs then nuts are lower. These have 23 grams total carbs and 6 grams sugar. The fat on the other hand is much lower then nuts - only 2 grams of fat. 140 calories for 1/4 cup so about the same calories as most nuts.

Incredible! Worth every penny and then more. I've had Bernaise in fine restaurants in Montreal, Chicago, San Francisco and this is in their league.

Swoony on grilled tenderloins. And you only need a dollop so it's really quite inexpensive -- usually six servings per $6.50 jar.

I found this to be thin, have poor taste and overly expensive when we dipped strawberries in our Wilton Chocolate Pro Electric Melting Pot as a test we then put plain old chocolate chips with a bit of oil in it and it was much better (thicker stayed on berry, better taste, cheaper). I think the name should be changed to remove the fondue and just for fountains. If you have a fondue with a melt function such as the one listed avoid this product.

This is one of my favorite Justin's products! My house is constantly stocked with it and I make sure all my friends and family try it and then spread the word. Everyone I know loves Justin's and always wants more. I run out very fast but it is worth it!

This product was very easy to install and works great!  I followed a recommendation from another reviewer and used the screws to install it.  This does a great job of keeping you k-cups organized and out of the way.  If you're short on counter space, this is a perfect addition to your kitchen.

What an amazing find. The price on Amazon blows away any deals to be found locally. These are the whole seeds which absorb moisture well. They offer a great crunch and go with just about any dish you want to use them in.

This is an absolute MUST HAVE item in any kitchen!  I can not live without it.  Adolph's Unseasoned Meat Tenderizer is the best you can use, in my opinion.  No MSG, and I have never found a better working product.

They're almost as good as the original raisin biscuits. Although they're not as sweet, there is no egg wash on the top and the biscuit is more crumbly, still a pleasant taste. I give them a 5 star because they are a great reminder of good stuff from the past.

Also, it's cheaper by the dozen. Mine arrived 9/14/2011 and the expiration date on the 12 packages is March, 2012. They will be long gone by then. Yes, I will order more.
This is a very good English Breakfast tea and I am enjoying it very much.  With the amount in the order I do not have to worry about running out soon.
the best bitter sweet chocolate.  If you like coffee, it has the perfect combination. It is also not too sweet.  Best thing is to try it.

This is the ultimate British pickled onion! A strong flavour - sharp, crisp and most definitely not sweet. Just perfect with a sharp cheese and crusty bread. A little bit of Britain, in one, perfect, mouthful.
I enjoy snacking on these saltines. They're  also good with sardines, cheese spreads and peanut butter.
I add grated cheese and some sliced green onions and make the cornbread as directed. It is a terrific "bread" for those of us who need gluten free food.

Our cats rarely get excited about food - unless their dish of dry food is empty. Then they get a little pissy. So imagine my surprise and delight when I opened a packet of Meow Mix Savory Morsels and had to fend off an attack from these suddenly ravenous beasts. If I had waited just a beat longer in getting the food into the dish, they'd have gone after me like I was a raw steak being carried to their plates by a dozen fat mice. I'm not sure what the folks at Meow Mix put into this stuff - and maybe I don't want to know - but it's enough to send my kitties into a feeding frenzy!

I love this coconut water. I have tried a lot of different brands, on my quest to acquire a taste for the stuff (on my chiropractor's recommendation). This not only does need to be refrigerated until you want to drink it (definitely refrigerate ANY coconut water before drinking), but comes in several delicious flavors. It is not sweetened at all, and has a very light flavor with no haunting aftertaste. Previous to this brand I liked a brand that had to be kept frozen until you were ready to drink it, which took up too much space!! I actually signed up for Amazon's suscribe & save program on this product, which is not only convenient, but really does save you money!

Summary: Madras Lentils a good side dish
Text: I've been eating various Indian retorted veggie entrees for a while now -- we use them as side dishes when I cook main dishes that may be, but aren't always, Indian. The Madras Lentils remind me a lot of really good Louisiana Red Beans (as in Red Beans & Rice--with or without sausage). Very flavorful and actually a bit meaty in taste. I first encountered them at Trader Joe's but it seems that they are going over to their own labels and they wouldn't admit that they were using TastyBite (see someone else's review of Punjabi Eggplant)so I'll stick with the original. I've also tried, and liked, the Punjabi Eggplant.

Summary: Too hard - choking hazard - go with the bites or vines instead.
Text:
I give this product 2 stars because the taste is really good, and the ingredients are natural and I did not have an allergic reaction.

But this product is really hard. Nearly impossible to chew. I almost choked on it a few times before giving up. I'll have to throw the whole case away - I can't eat them. I even tried microwaving the laces for about 20 seconds, which helped, but as soon as they cooled down they went hard again.

My advice is to stick with the vines or the bites, the bites being the softest of all. I am off to order a case of raspberry bites....

I gifted about 14 of these to my staff last year, along with a number of other bacon-themed items. They reported enjoying them all but especially this item. It has solid chunks of bacon included and bacon, perhaps obviously since it's salty, is a great match for chocolate. Definitely a great buy.

Summary: It's not for everyone, but I like it.
Text: I used to drink this years ago, as a kid. Apparentely it wasn't all that popular, as it vanished from local store shelves. I was happy to see that I could still order it off Amazon! It tastes exactly as I remember, chocolatey but not too strong, and it's not overwhelmingly sweet either. I think it's pretty darned good, and I don't normally care for diet soda. If I had to liken the flavor to something, it reminds me a bit of chocolate tootsie rolls. If you like those and you're looking for a diet soda to help to satisfy your sweet tooth, give these a shot.

It was shipped in a very nice package and I have no complain with the seller. My plant growing bigger and now I am looking for a bigger pot to transplant. It's good....if you are looking for a a workspace plant that needs minimal maintenance this is the plant you might need.

If you think of this as good for you candy, it is ok.  They contain doses of several B vitamins and vitamin C.  As far as making you feel energized, they aren't an energy drink, but they do contain energy type vitamins. The taste is pretty good and I'm sure they are better for you than most candy.  They come in a convenient packaging that can be carried in your purse easily so you can grab when you like as a good alternative to hard candy.  Overall, they have some benefit and if you are in the market for a good way to get some extra vitamins, give these a try.

Summary: Was a good idea for school lunches...BUT!
Text: So, so not fresh; they were stale. Stale. Stale. Stale, so stale. Disappointingly stale. Stale! And oh yeah, all the bags were stale.

These gummies are the most delicious I have tasted. Compared to their American counterparts, these are practically the real fruit. Their flavor is fresh and bright, and they taste just like the real thing, but with that fun gummy texture.
The lychee gummies are no exception. They have the aroma and pleasant aftertaste the fruit has with the hint of tanginess--they taste a hint more like the fresh kind than the canned, for those of you that have had both.
The fruit chews by Jolly Rancher have become my favorite candy. Sometimes I can't wait to unwrap them, so I eat the rice paper wrapper. Love the variety of flavors!

Summary: Thought this was a good deal...
Text: I bought these for emergency food storage, and for that purpose they are great. I priced them at our Kroger and they were well over $2 a can so I bought a case from Amazon. Little did I know that our local Dollar General has them for $1.69! A net loss of me of $6+. Usually Amazon has the best deal but not this time...

There's a French saying, "le vrai luxe, on ne voi pas," which means real luxury is not obvious. Tiptree knows about luxury. I think this Raspberry Seedless Preserve is the single most luxurious of all the jams and jellies they been offering at least since the 1930s when I first encountered them. I hope you won't run out and order some. Everything really good is always in short supply.

Gunpowder tea is supposed to have a delicate flavor and emit a smokey bouquet that does not interfere with the taste.

Numi gets the delicate flavor. Unfortunately, there is no aroma to their version. This improves if the drinker tears open the tea bag and steeps Numi's offering as loose-leaf, or if the drinker tries to go the "whipped tea" route, but the experience is still only about half there.

Three stars out of five: if you want gunpowder with a less intense experience, go for Numi. If you want the full shot, seek out Twinings.

I love this stuff!  It settles the stomach like nothing else, and during that morning sickness time of pregnancy, which for me was every afternoon, I really couldn't make it through the afternoon without my sanbitter.  I have a large collection of empty bottles now, and they make great vases!
Dried pears can be bland and tough. These by Bare Fruit are tender and tasty. Healthy and Organic too. How can you go wrong. Great price at Amazon.

Summary: Great coffee but the brand cheaped out on the packaging.
Text: We ordered the sample pack to help decide which flavors to get down the road.  So far the ones we've tried tasted great, but the packaging itself seemed to a bit off from all the other Keurig cups out there.  There seems to be an extra pleat near the top of the cup making the top wider than the other cups, which in turn is causing some of the cups to explode upon brewing and leaving grinds in the coffee.  I'm not sure if this has been corrected in the newer batches, but the sample pack contains these flawed cups which is making the experience less than ideal.

I was truly amazed at how good this tastes given that it is healthy for you.  If you mix with milk, it is best if you mix with 1 oz water first to avoid all the lumps and clumps.  It tastes okay with water, but tastes better (to me) if mixed with milk.  I have used skim milk, almond milk, and low fat vanilla milk plus I add a scoop of ground golden flax seed.  This is my morning breakfast drink - it fills me up and gives me energy.  One 8.5 oz container yields 30 servings.

Blue Monkey Coconut water is delicious, pure and natural without any additives.
We like it very much. Amazon has best price!

Summary: Only Food My Beagle Girl will eat!
Text:
I hesitated about this food...because of grains....but I researched the ingreds and they are top notch...no garbage no fillers. My puppy Beagle wasn't like most puppies who love to eat 24/7 she is...extremely...picky..but this....she actually scratches the empty bowl like she trying to dig up more lol...Im thrilled!
Just order the dry water and duck samples..Hope she will love these too or her sister beagle will eat it up :O)
These bags were bought for our school function use, and were great!  They are a great size and so easy to use.  I would definitely buy these again, so convenient and you get 500!!

The original Ricola lozenge is my favorite cough drop, so when I saw this tea, I had to try it out.  My first can is getting low, and I have now bought three more.  This is a very sweet herbal tea, and very soothing.  I have not yet used it when I have a cough, so I can't say whether it can substitute for the lozenge.  Note that is is an instant tea; it consists of granules which dissolve immediately, not leaves of tea or herbs that require steeping.  Purists may not like the instant aspect.
More stores now selling this oatmeal so shop around.  It's great to take on a trip where you have access to a microwave oven.

The pomegranate molasses arrived on time and in good condition.  I encountered this as an ingredient in a Mollie Katzan cookbook and it did not disappoint.  We thinned it just a little with warm water and used it as a side sauce for roasted asparagus at a barbecue, and got many rave reviews from our guests, vegetarian and non-vegetarian alike.  I recommend both the vendor and this item.

This is the easiest thing to use in the kitchen... besides a spatula.  Just mix it with oil and pour on salads, use as a marinade for chicken or simply dip bread into it.  The flavors are great and my kids loved making it themselves (or at least assisting me).  I gave some to my friend and she agreed.  She even shook it on a baked potato with butter!  Yummy!

Sprout foods are amazing! From the moment you open the package you know this is not your ordinary baby food.  You can smell all the natural ingredients.  My son's favorite is the Sweet Potato & White Bean.  Secondly, because the packaging is narrow, it is great for travel (don't have to worry about broken glass jars or smooshed plastic.

Summary: Another wonderful tea from Mighty Leaf
Text: For some reason this tea is listed only as Jasmine, but for those of you looking for "Mountain Jasmine" this is it!  This tea smells of Jasmine and makes a glorious afternoon tea as it is light on caffeine.

Ever since ordering these chia seeds, my breakfast has consisted of 2-3 tablespoons of seeds, 1 tablespoon of coconut sugar, and 6-8 ounces of coconut milk. Delicious! Just soak the seeds for 10 minutes or so, stirring every few minutes and you basically get something very similar to tapioca pudding, but with nearly 10 grams of protein and fiber. Plus it's delicious. My two-year old calls it ice cream :-)

Stored propertly, these seeds will be good for at least 2 years, though there's no chance they'll even last through the end of 2011 at this rate.

For a tasty dessert, try soaking the chia seeds in So Delicious Chocolate Coconut milk.

Highly recommended.

This was hands down the worst coffee I've ever had.  I bought it because Amazon had it on sale for a fantastic price...little did I know that it was going to be so bad that no one in my office could drink it.  This coffee is a waste of money and I would not recommend it to anyone.

I am a black tea (with caffeine) fan. Still I like the aroma of this tea. Not a bad flavor either. Goes well with honey (even fresh ginger, if you like ginger) But, as some other reviewer said, it is better to try it (I did) before you order 45 tea bags.

Wife tried all the usual over the counter and prescription anti-motion sickness meds... meclizine oral and patches, oral diphenhydramine (benadryl) etc... either they didn't work or the side effects were too much.

Looked up non-medication alternatives and found ginger to work well, but most of the candies were just terrible tasting.

This works awesome for my wife's plane and car trips. Never failed her. And it tastes good. Hence the 20 pack purchase (hard to find, even in the nice grocers).
have been eating pickled eggs most of my life (75 yrs old).in bars & home made,these are o.k.,but to RUBBERY.

Although our dog loved the taste of these bully sticks, they smelled to high heaven.  I know that bully sticks aren't supposed to smell like roses, but these things were the worst!  It smelled like the worst case of foot funk ever.  I thought that maybe if I aired them out it would be better, but that did not help.  Our dog was so excited to have this treat, but in the end, we threw them all away because we couldn't handle the odor any longer.

Couln't find rye bread mix anywhere. Hodgson Mill Caraway Rye Bread Mix, 16-Ounce Units (Pack of 6)Thought I'd try this product. Best rye bread you could find. I highly recommend this product if you really like rye bread. Better, and obviously fresher than you'll find in any store.
These are good pumpkin seeds - well roasted with a fare amount of salt - actually they are pretty f--- addictive. Watch out!
this has a nice pea nutty flavor  but lacks the punch and fat, of course, of the real thing  pb sandwiches are a bummer with this product

Summary: Misleading item picture by Amazon or the vendor
Text:
The actual package received is not at all as shown in the product picture. This seriously reduces the value.

Beware the other Black Friday or Cyber Monday savings from this company.

Shame on Amazon for kicking off the holiday season with this bait and switch.

I'm happy with Amazon 95% of the time. They missed on this one.

Postscript: Amazon refunded a large enough portion of the purchase price to satisfy me. Kudos for their honorable response.

I found these accidentally when I was searching for Greenies Dental Chews for dogs. My Husky seems to like them, but they are "smoke" flavor. I don't quite know if it does help with his joints, I just wanted to prevent any future problems.
This would be a good product for camping, rafting, or hiking trips where you need to save weight.

Never trust the descriptions.  This product is or was, I won't be surprised if it gets changed, represented as Kona Coffee more than once.  It is neither 100% Kona or a Kona Blend coffee. I received the package and could not find one reference on it to Kona coffee.  I checked the company's website and they list Surf's Up! country of origin: ... Guatemala.  I haven't brewed it yet but hope a two star review would make everyone read up on the product to make an educated shopping decision and verify what is described.

Summary: good tea but has lemon taste
Text: I've been trying to find a drink to replace the sodas that I drink daily and while I like tea, I don't like the amount of sugar I have to put in the tea to enjoy it. I've read several reviews and thought I would try it. Well I guess I didn't read all the reviews and thought it would be important to let people know that while this tea is pretty good, it has a lemon taste to it. Now for some people they like lemon in their tea, but I don't like lemon at all. I will say that the lemon flavor is not as strong as some lemon teas i've tasted, so I will try to develope a taste for it, but if you don't like lemon in your tea you probably won't fall in love with this tea.

Summary: Light, crunchy and just sweet enough.
Text: Nature's Path Crunchy Vanilla Sunrise is light and crunchy, rather like other puffed cereals I've tasted, but it is lightly sweet: a pleasant breakfast or quick snack that isn't just like eating sugar. I like it with soy milk.

yoga tea's women's moon cycle is a godsend. i have suffered from pms since i was a teenager (for me it is manifests as irritability, sensitiveness and exhaustion). i start using this tea at the first sign of pms symptoms, usually a day or two before my period, and then continue to use for the first two days, when my cramps cause pain.
this tea smells and tastes wonderful - reminds me of baking something with cinnamon and nutmeg.
i try to squeeze a few cups out of each bag. if you are using this for cramps, go ahead and drink it throughout the day. it really does help!! better than advil!
if you are considering trying this tea, don't hesitate. really. it is wonderful.
highly recommend this raw organic coconut oil...I enjoyed this product from the very first time i used it...better than all others I have tried

I first stumbled upon chinotto at a Italian  food distributor.  We decided to purchase this particular product because the cashier said that it was by far her favorite, although an acquired taste.  I now know why.  My first sip was.....interesting to say the least.  The flavor journey passes through sweet, sour, and unknown tastes.  Initially my favorite element of the sip was the middle, the beginning too sweet, the end too bitter.  After many tries, I can now appreciate every aspect of this unusual but tantalizing beverage.  I encourage anyone who wants to venture beyond the traditional and insipid American drinks to buy a 6 pack, your opinion will change.

Great buy

This white hot chocolate has a great taste and richness.  I am a big fan of white chocolate ,so to me , this is really very good.  If you like regular hot chocolate , you may not like this but if you are a fan of white chocolate, like me, it is very good.

They have no filter in them, it's like instant coffee grounds every time thick mess in the bottom of my cup! Not a good deal at all! I will stick with brand name kcups from now on!  Big waste of money I would rather pay $10 more and get great coffee! I will be throwing these away, for sure!  Do not buy from this company.

Summary: Premium Saltines are no longer premium in taste.
Text: I agree with most of the reviewers in this review.  I too have bought Premium Saltines all my life (I'm now 63) and they are now:  1. flimsy - will break in half or in pieces when spreading with peanut butter, 2.  poorly packaged - have many broken crackers in each tube which as another reviewer pointed out is due to flimsier cardboard packaging, and most importantly 3. have virtually no taste any more.  It is indeed a sad day that one of our old standbys has fallen victim to cost-cutting to enhance company profits.  Thanks to the reviewer about Keebler crackers....I'm switching.

This mix doesn't taste anything like the Matcha Green Tea Latte from Starbucks!!! It tastes more like French Vanilla Slim Fast powder (which is okay if that is what you are expecting to drink). It's hard to taste the green tea at all; just a lot of vanilla and sugar.

Stash products such as jasmine tea are by far the best availble.
They com in a very good bag, so it will not loose aroma.
I have tried many others but prefer Stash tea
Hans Vogt

I gave her one during a storm and she calm down enough for her to take a nap. She really liked the taste and they are good for her since they contain antioxidants.  The bag comes with 50 stixes which will last me a little while.  I will order more from Amazon again when I do run out. They are a very good value.  Thank you!
Great product, great tasting teas. Great service, the package arrived in less than two days. The peach tea is orgasmic.

This is one of the only treats that my cat will eat. But boy does he love them. We can shake the bag when he is 100ft away and our 10 year old runs like a kitten!!
I order a number of packages at a time so that we don't run out. God forbid they stop making them. If that happened our cat might never speak to us again.

Thank you Goodlife for great cat treats!

Not mutch to say, but my wife and I are both on a diet and we are trying to drink only water.  Water gets very boring after a short time and I love this fruit punch stuff.  We keep a gallon made at all times and its pretty much all we drink.  We get it off amazon for almost half what you pay at giant eagle.  Then we sav any extra 15% for auto reorder.  Can't say enough...

The delivery was prompt.  The product is attractively packaged. My students found the strawberry taste to be overpowered by the sweetness.  The candy was too sweet for their liking.  Recommend this for the novelty not necessarily for the taste.

Summary: If you have no means of making this dish yourself, buy this subsitute
Text: I was surprised that these Habichuelas con Dulce do not taste subpar at all! I actually think they taste about average, but I'm disappointed by the lack of yams, raisins, and other tasty complements that are usually found in this dish!
My husband works graveyard and can't live without it. It helps without the crash you get from other enery drinks

Summary: Make your old kitty feel young again
Text: Two in the morning and two at night makes her feel like a kitten--they must be packed with catnip. I've tried other favors, and they weren't at all the same. The chicken flavor is the one that stones her the best. She's an old ferrel cat we took in, who has remained afraid of anyone not part of the family. Two of these and strangers become her best friends. I see no reason whatever why she can't stay stoned the rest of her life, purring.
This was the strongest cup of coffee I have had since I was in France 15 years ago.  It was REALLY good, if you like them strong, you will love this one.

If you like hot sauce, but not too hot where you can't enjoy your food, then this is the sauce for you! I love this sauce, it's great on everything. I use it as like a steak sauce on my meat and if yo uput some in on your wings, mmmmm...tasty!

Not for the faint of heat, it is hot!
Almost delicious straight from the can. Add some corn or pepper cheese and it is fantastic. A great base for a wonderful main dish.

I was very disappointed by Silk Pure Almond Original. The taste is`t very good and it is`t made with pure almond. We don`t know what is the percentage of almond.Silk Pure Almond Original, 32-Ounce Aseptic Cartons (Pack of 6)

Tried these on the basis of other reviewers and am glad I did. Great flavor(assuming you like cinnamon)and texture.
These are great to keep in my desk at work for a healthy alternative to most other afternoon snacks. I also keep some in my purse and car for unexpected commuting delays. I have tried several varieties of Nature Valley and these are one of the best.
This, also, isn't worth the money they want for it. I sprayed my carpet & guess what!!! I still had fleas 3 days later! Don't waste your money!

Really like this coffee. It's very bold and very smooth - not harsh or bitter at all. I'm not sure how much of an extra boost the ginseng and guarana actually gives you but it can't hurt. Will buy again.

I purchased this as a gift, but there was enough to share.  I kept some and used it in my chili recipe.  We don't like real spicy food but the smoked paprika gave the chili a great taste without too much spice.  I have used it in several other recipes since with great results.

Great texture, much more like regular left over meat. Makes very good homemade hash. Very different from the canned corned beef I grew up with, the fine textured kind, like Libbys or Hormel.

But, you must shop around for price. Prices vary considerably. Also, if you live in an area with good Asian grocery stores you can often find it there and avoid paying for shipping.

Cooking tip. The meat has a fair amount of moisture and fat. I heat it gently in a sauce pan until the fat & moisture separate, dump it into a wire strainer & then back in the pan. Makes for a much leaner and tastier result.

Summary: Overpriced and at that more expensive than advertised
Text: This product as packaged was advertised at $14.99 but I was billed $19.99.  That's $6.66 per 7.05 ounce pack.  Had I checked the Carr website I'd have found that any local CVS Pharmacy carries the same product in 7.05 ounce packages, and had I visited my local CVS I could have bought the cookies for $3.69 per 7.05 ounce pack. I bought this for a friend and we both had fun remembering the candy from our childhood.  It still tastes as good today!

Summary: Yes, Amazon, get this in stock!!!
Text: This chocolate is off the chart wonderful and yes Wal-Mart did discontinue it.  I bought up like 24 bars on clearance, but they are long gone.  Amazon, you have had long enough to get this in stock and I am in chocolate withdrawal for this product.
Great product. Good price. I will buy at this store again. Superb quality. I use it for baking paleo style.

Having remembered Red Velvet cake from the south as a child, I found this cake mix to be excellent and it has received rave reviews from adults and kids alike.  Rich like chocolate, but lighter - this is a solid favorite of all who try it for the first time. The color is enticing to some, scary to others, but once tasted - with a cream cheese frosting - all are fans.  Easy to make, perfect every time!

Nice Aroma, very tasty and the crema....

very smooth coffee with no coffee shakes to follow even after 6 shots of espresso in the mornings.
These seeds are Great for COOKING and very Clean and processed. If you want truly unwashed seeds for a great price try the Frontier brand.

Better Cheddars aren't as good as they used to be, although they are still a good snack. They tend to crumble in the shipping, however, which makes them less desirable. I will go back to getting them in the local grocery, even if they cost more per box.

Summary: Awesome, I eat them every day!
Text: I boil 4 cups of water, then put my cup of oats in the pot, cover it, and turn down the heat. Half hour later I have oats for me and my roommate! They're good with brown sugar, ground flaxseed, and milk. Mmmmm. You can also refrigerate a batch and reconstitute them in the microwave with milk. Oats are great!

I think this product is horrible.  It has basically no odor control properties, it's expensive and the litter box needs to be emptied way more frequently than with other litter products. Worst of all it contains completely round crystals that end up rolling all over the floor (unlike other crystal litters which contain irregular-shaped crystals) making it nearly impossible to clean up from hard surface floors like tile and hardwood - I have better things to do with my time than chasing round crystal balls with a broom!  I thought this product would be a good substitute for Tidy Cats Crystals but it's essentially worthless. Very pretty packaging - very bad product :(

Summary: Not so good Diet Root Beer
Text: I wasn't at all impressed with Boylan Diet Root Beer! With the great reviews it had I thought it was worth the price. The Root Beer had a strange aftertaste and it was very flat. I'll stick to Stewarts Diet Root Beer.

My hair needed some extra TLC after a summer of swimming in lakes and traveling and this product was amazing. I found that it brought life back to my hair and made my scalp healthy. This bottle went missing -- found it in my pre-teens bathroom , another satisfied customer.
This product is EXCELLENT just what was needed for my homemade marsala sauce that I served with my Veal Saltimbocca over homemade fettucini!!

Summary: WITHOUT A DOUBT THE BEST COOKIE IN THE WHOLE WORLD
Text:
These are one cookie I Dont like to offer guests,because the whole plate is gone in a few minutes! Thats HOW good they are.
They come in both Dark and Milk chocolate,and although I normally dont eat dark chocolate I dont care for the ones with the
milk chocolate on them ,The Dark on top are the ones to get. They are Heavenly and will always remain My Favorite Biscuit in
the World, just try them Once and you,ll be Hooked !

Quaker Instant Oatmeal cooks up very quickly. Add hot water and thats all. Vary the amount of hot water to adjust the consistency. I like the oatmeal a little thicker than "normal" so I put about a tablespoon less water into the mix. It works great. The consistency is the same time after time. I really like the maple and brown sugar oatmeal. It tastes great, and the smell is out of this world. Just smelling the stuff makes me want to eat about 6 packets. I normally put two packets into the mix because one is not enough quantity wise. If you like oatmeal at all you will like this.

AD2

Somebody gave me this bottle when cleaning out her fridge. She doesn't use syrup much but it was brand new and had a long way from expiring. Well, she gave away a great tasting syrup!

Compared to the store bought brands out there, this one knocks them out of the water. You can taste that it's much more natural than the preservative laden stuff out there. The sweetness is just right and it's nice and thick like you want it. I kept mine in the fridge so that it'd stay fresher.

I was sorry to see that we've finished it and I even rinsed out and kept the bottle. Now that I've seen it here, I may purchase the bigger bottle. Looking at the price, I'd say it is worth it!

I know Crisco from our days of helping Mom make all sorts of pies for Thanksgiving and Christmas. I could not find this in Japan so this website came to my rescue. I'm from Pa. Dutch country and tried to make corn pie. I used frozen pie shells but the taste just isn't the same as using Crisco. Now I am excited and hope to make pie just like Mom's.
I made all 3 kinds for a big family gathering.  Everybody liked different kinds, and worked for a mix of raw vegies and chips.  Big hit.

Summary: We thunk the Franoia Extra Virgin is slightly inferior to the Sacilian.
Text: From our experience the Extra virgin, while very good, is slightly lacking in the flavor and fruitiness of the Sicilian also by Frantoia and available at a slightly lesser price from Amazon.  Maybe it is just us - what do others think?
I ordered these for my father and ended up eating a few bags myself.  They are better than the ones at the candy stores!!

At around a buck a can, very expensive for 8.3 ounces of carbonated apple juice (with lesser amounts of grape juice, aceola whatever that is, raspberry juice, and finally actual strawberry and kiwi juice, plus some vitamin C added).

With the 100% juice banner all over that can, you might be led to believe it's 100% strawberry/kiwi juice . . . it's not. Taste is not unlike a typical Strawberry soda pop, but not quite as good. Expected sugar content (natural). 135 calories. I'm not likely to make future purchases of this one.

I really like several teas of Taylors of Harrogate, so I decided to try their Earl Grey. I was really disappointed: although the tea did smell deliciously of bergamot, there was no taste to it to speak of. Now, I can only drink it mixed with other Earl Grey teas to have a nice combination of taste and smell (and can recommend it in this capacity).

I bought what was left from this site due to Gerber decided to discontinue the glass jars and use the plastic containers. Well the glass jars are much easier to travel and heat up with and easier to store in the fridge. I will miss the jars once these are used up.
You people are crazy giving a bad review. I got a great bag!

I love these healthy dog treats. My dog has trouble with a lot of processed dog foods and treats. These are a great way to give her a little something extra when she's a good girl and not have to worry if she will get sick or have an allergic reaction. I will warn you, though, they often arrive broken in pieces, even though they are packed fairly well. They are very delicate, crispy treats. I usually break them down into pieces anyway, so it isn't much of a drawback for me, but it may bother some of you.
I carry this to family gatherings to make pancakes for everyone.  Even the gluten eaters love them.
I always have this in my kitchen. It adds an extra herby dimension to everything - more flavor than just salt.

I like to drink my tea hot and with a splash of milk. I also prefer 'plain old' black teas to anything fancy or flavored. I found Higgins & Burke to suit my taste, although it's not a very strong tea when compared to something like Pg Tips 80 Ct Tea Bags, even when I increase the steep time to 7 minutes.

Each teabag is individually wrapped in a 'stay fresh' foil sachet. The tea blend is Assam and Ceylon black tea, with 180mg of Polyphenols per serving (8oz water). Overall, I found Higgins & Burke to be a good cup of breakfast tea, with a medium strength taste.

Summary: it doesn't worth the price, after-taste is awful
Text: I expected something better from this tuna, i don't know why!!! however, this tuna doesn't look good, dark like cat-food, the taste is strange the oil is not like olive oil to me, the fishy-taste stays in your mouth like a dead fish!!!  i don't like this tuna!

I am currently using from my second order of these wonderful eggs. They are shipped promptly and the packaging is outstanding. Big,brown,beautiful eggs,so large the cartons barely close. I hope they will be available for a long,long time.

There are miles between me and my family. As a surprise I try to send my niece and nephew an off the wall gift from time to time!  I sent this one and they loved it.  The delivery was fast and the contents fresh! Will send again in the future.

Summary: product was stale and past expiration date
Text: I have been using Breathies for my dog for years and this is the first time I was disappointed with the product. When I opened the bag I thought they seemed harder than usual. The packaging states "best before 03/23/2012" and these were ordered on April 29th. I believe this is the first time I ordered from this particular vendor (Happy Dog Place, INC) and am disappointed that this happened.

my doberman puppy refused to eat these treats and I when i mixed these treats with his regular food, he refused to eat his regular food. Furthermore,  some of these treats accidentally got spilled into a bag of cat food, after removing the dog treats, the cats refused to eat their regular food! Had to throw out the entire bag. Not sure if it's something wrong with the particular bag I got or if my pets are completely different from the other reviewers' pets.
Tastes great. Seems to have slightly less fizz than a regular soda, but with none of the harmfull stuff. Wish it was a bit cheaper, as $1+ per can is a little steep, but it really is great stuff.

Summary: OK, but not what I'd hoped for
Text:
As a Tabasco/hot sauce lover, I had big expectations for these....but they were not to be. The flavor was..."eh," with barely a hint of Tabasco. And also, these things were greasy. And I don't mean the kind of greasy that you know and expect from a Slim Jim, I mean GR-EASY!

Don't get me wrong, they are OK....and edible....just not what I'd hoped, and certainly not my first choice.
The tea was fine ground, not full leaf with hibiscus and raspberry pieces.  I was disappointed because that is when you get the best flavor.  Otherwise it was okay.

I'm not sure what the people expect who do not like this product.  I use this as well as the OTB 0 calorie mix you can buy at grocery store and I think they are both great.  I love the margarita but had all the calories.  Give it a try and you will not be sorry!

I have been using this product for years.  So easy to use.  Am not sure why it's so expensive on Amazon.  I get this same product/size at my grocers and pay $4.99 and I'm buying the Organic brand.  I didn't know how to rate this, so I rated it on the product itself.  It's such a convenience, but I'd never buy it here.

Summary: Tastes good, but kicks off my reflux
Text:
The taste is decent. Not good, but not really horrible. If it didn't kick off my reflux, I could live with it. But, unfortunately, it does, so I can't, so the taste is irrelevant. I appreciate them trying! Maybe a dark french roast isn't the best flavor for a low-acid coffee drink though?

I'm rating this three stars because I think someone with less severe reflux might be okay with it.

Summary: I love the product - that's why 5 stars, but not the price fluctuations
Text: When it comes to the cereal itself I love the product and agree with others that this is the best tasting cereal on the marker, however I also agree with others that the price fluctuations are annoying. I too had to cancel my subscription when the price skyrocket and it was no longer cheaper than what the local store is offering. Now that the price is more reasonable, even though still more $ than what I paid the first time, and it's a 3-pack not a 4-pack, I will buy it again. Lesson learned, next time the price goes down I will buy multiple order.

I used to live in Watertown, WI where this company is located. I fell in love with their coffee 10yrs ago, and my fondness for it hasn't lightened in the least. When I go home to visit family in WI a pound of this coffee is always in my bag on the trip back. It can be purchased directly from the website, but this is a better deal. All their coffee is superb.

Summary: We use this in a our 6 Qt. Stir Crazy Corn Popper!
Text: Smells so good, we like it.  Taste great and we found the popcorn we like.  Took me forever to figure out what kind to buy for the stir crazy popper.  Hope this helps you.

I bought these thru warehouse deals so I could take orange juice to work daily.  These are quick and easy to take and just enough for a quick beverage in the morning to take some vitamins.  Would buy again once I finish this large box.
Great bone for the price.  My Lab will chew on this for hours, and will last at least 3 days.

Summary: Great Coffee at a Great Price!
Text:
If you have ever lived or spent some time in Michigan, then you likely tried BIGGBY coffee (formerly Beaner's Coffee) at one of their coffee shops. Their Michigan Cherry coffee is one of their most popular flavors, and I highly recommend it if you haven't tried it. The cherry flavor tastes great and doesn't overpower the coffee flavor like with some flavored coffee.

The Amazon pack comes with 3 bags of coffee. Mine arrived well sealed and packaged from BIGGBYs and the coffee inside was very fresh and flavorful!

The price here is much lower than in local stores. Our JRT loves the 'Veggie' treats. She cannot have the chicken ones. They held up well in shipping (unlike the 'sweet potato' variety). This is a treat that is good for her that she is crazy about, and a great size
for small dogs.
I have used this product for years and it lives up to it's reputation.  Before bed it will relax you and help you sleep soundly.  I would recommend this to anyone.

Summary: great straight or as base for vegie soup
Text: I discovered this juice about 2 months ago and drink it every day.  I really enjoy it as a soup base... add some chicken stock, some vegies, onions, garlic, brown rice... way yummy! I pretty much just go through the fridge, freezer, and pantry and add leftovers.  The soup comes out different each time... great with linguica!

Summary: Why bother with an artificial syrup?
Text:
Of course orgeat is a key component in the classic Mai Tai, but so was 17 year old, high ester Jamaican rum. You can bet Vic's Garnier Orgeat was made with real almonds.

This product does not contain any almond or even almond extract. It is chemically flavored. Now if you love artificials then this is your product.

But as for me, it's way too easy to make your own. A great and easy recipe is available at kaiserpenguin, though you have to find your own link.

But it's easy, much better and real!
The Wheat Thins Lo-Sodium Crackers are delicious.  I especially appreciate the lo-sodium feature. It is just right. I will order this item again and again.

Summary: I will never go back to Senseo pods as long as these are available.
Text: First of all, it is wonderful to have these pods delivered to my door free of charge.  On auto delivery, they are cheaper than the cheapest Senseo pods that I have found (Target/Walmart).  But check out the weight of coffee per Senseo pod vs. this particular Baronet coffee pod.  Not all Baronet pods are this weight, however, so check out the products carefully.  I guess I had better mention that the coffee flavor is great!  One order is for three boxes of these pods.
This tea is really good,my cholesterol went down already,from 289 to 229! I won't stop drinking this tea!it really works!

These arrived in the mail at about the same time my children came home from school.  They were literally gone in five minutes.  My mom and sister were here and we were all fighting each other off to get to the last one. These are not necessarily a healthy snack when you eat the whole bag but they sure tasted great!! :)

I bought this toy a year ago for my Golden girl who would wolf down her food and forget that she had eaten. I saw this in a store and was hesitant that she would 'get it', but after a few tries and showing her where the food came out she mastered it. When she's hungry she'll bring it to me and place it at my feet. It takes her a lot longer to eat and she's content and happy while doing it now. I've since bought her the round version of this because she's mastered Tug A Jug.
We have ordered the Oolong Tea from this source many times and from the beginning they have been a top notch buisness.

Summary: Do NOT buy Salad Greens Seed Kit
Text: Despite what the package claims, namely that the seed kit contains a mix of Red Leaf, Green Leaf, Butterhead & Romaine, it, in fact, had seven pots of the same seeds, namely Butterhead lettuce.  Had I known this was the case I'd not have bought it, and feel deceived by the packaging.

Summary: Terrific for Thanksgiving and holiday tables
Text: I made this mix for Thanksgiving and it was a real hit. Had the pumpkin on hand as I had been planning to make a pie but this was better!!! Have used Dassant mixes before and find them consistently great. I usually bake my own bread and pies- but when time is short these mixes are the closest to homemade.

Summary: Tasty, healthy food you can feel good about serving baby
Text: My son loves the Sprout pouches of food, and I think this one may be his favorite.  I taste all of his baby food, and I must say that this one is very tasty.  (I don't want to feed him anything that I would find disgusting, as is the case with a good deal of baby food out there.)  It is made with wholesome ingredients, and it is great for travel or on-the-go meals because you don't need to refrigerate before opening.  My son gets very excited when he sees that I'm opening up a Sprout pouch!  I've been very happy with all Sprout products I've tried, and this one is no exception.
haven't got the chance to look at this product, still in the box. however, price was good and the deliver was great.
I have the celiac disease and love it when I can find food, treats, candy, etc. that I can eat.  I've purchased several of the different flavors and am a fan.

These coffee pods were delicious. I, my co-worker and a doctor with whom I had to share these with so they could experience them also loved this Cinnamon Swirl flavored coffee. The deliver was super fast. A great transaction.

I really prefer the Hormel pasta packages.  They only need to be put in the microwave - there's no subsequent stirring, etc. like you have with the Barilla packages.  These are very tasty though - don't get me wrong.  I like the food.  I just find the Hormel pasta packages preferable because they're more convenient.  Otherwise, these are quite good.
This is the second order of this coffee for my husband.  The coffee is always fresh tasting & much better than regular instant coffee.
The search for a popcorn topping to match that of theaters is over. I use this on my popcorn, and it's the  movie-theater flavor I have been searching for.

I drink a LOT of water every day. There are times I want something sweet and tasty. This fits the bill.

It took a while for me to understand the amounts to use in my big mug, but it is a nice little package. Easy to carry, and seals tight.

I'm used to to frozen Sambazon acai pulp that I use for smoothies.  This was tasteless, I needed 3-4 scoops for one smoothie and even then could not taste the acai flavor.  Usually acai will make the smoothie a rich purple color, this powder didn't do that and watch out, it will give you gas.  I couldn't read the expiration date because there was a sticker over it.. hmm... It was a very small amount for 12.00 too.  I'm going back to frozen sambazon.

Served this pasta with our home made sauce on Christmas Eve and it was wonderful.  Lots of compliments and really showcased our sauce.  Will use this pasta all the time.  Great to be able to order on Amazon and delivered right to our door!

The Newman's Pomegranate Twists have a great chewy texture, and a fruity not-too-sweet flavor that make them good for kids and adults. I usually go for loose leaf tea, but there are a few good kinds I have only seen in stores in the typical tea bags. I had never had yerba mate, but the varied ingredients such as green tea, spearmint leaves, green rooibos, black pepper and such was like Tazo had asked me what most of my favorite tea components are and mixed them together! Delicious and invigorating, I recommend this tea.

Summary: Boldo is the natural way to treat fat-liver
Text: I found that best way to brew this is to use the drip-style coffee maker. 1 tea bag for 12 cups of coffee. I tried in a pot of hot water but coffee maker extracts the most tea out. It tasted funny at first but it's not unbearable. It's much easier to drink while it's hot or warm. At first, I couldn't drink it cold because of its strong flavor. I also found that this helps with digestion too. After a big holiday meal, I drink this and I never get indigestion.

This is great tasting stuff. I make cherry malted milk shakes and put it on breakfast cereal. The Lime flavor goes good with lemonade. Comes as two-pack. Goes a long way. Ive ordered several times from amazon of course.

I chose this formula to supplement my daughter because our first choice (similac organic) had been recalled and there was a shortage of the RTF. This was extremely constipating for her, because of the rice. The ingredients are some of the best if you have to use formula, but I wish they'd make a version without rice in it!
My cats love all Friskies and I try to give them a variety. They prefer the "fillets", but a little of other cuts mixed in makes them so much happier.
Creamy chicken is an awesome flavor.  Very tasty, and I haven't seen this in the store locally.  Great for a quick snack.

This product was not what we though it was going to be. the Cinnamon Sticks were going to be used for chewing on as a means of releaving stress. This is a coping skill used in Reh. The inside of the Cinnamon sticks just crumbeled once place into you mouth. We didnt know there was a differnce in Cinnamon Sticks. We now know to watch out.

In general I advocate against consuming grains or cereals. However "Love Crunch" is made with reasonably good ingredients (the primary ingredient is rolled oats) and blended to an enjoyable chocolate flavor. Spelt is one of the healthier forms of wheat, it's far more desirable (nutritionally) than modern wheat.

The sugar to fiber ratio is three to one (six grams of sugars to two grams of fiber per serving) which isn't the best of all cereals but it's reasonable.

You've got to love all the healthy ingredients: chocolate, flax seeds, coconut and fruit.

For a "processed food" this one isn't too bad.

Fell in love with this Thai paste years ago. I put a big dollop next to my jasmine rice or thin it down a bit with lime juice and use as dip for crudités, shrimp or sticky rice (Thai variety).
It is not for the timid. But it you have a taste for the exotic I think you will enjoy it.
One problem: a little jar seems to be gone in a flash :)

What a relief that Tinkyada rice pasta exists. The other brands don't compare in flavor, consistency or the way that they cook. Most need to be rinsed several times after cooking in order not to be gloppy, but we don't find this with Tinkyada.

Because we're purchasing this for children, we're so pleased that Tinkyada offers several different shapes of pasta. Often, I can cook the same shape of rice pasta and classic pasta for my husband. My only hope is that Tinkyada will add even more...farfalle, Tinkyada??

Great product, and amazon offers the best price. Hopefully, it will one day be offered as a s&s item.

This is the easiest and most delicious margatira mix that I have ever tasted. My first purchase was from a little gift shop and then I had a hard time locating them.. Finally found them online Yeah!!  The convience is wonderful! Easy to take along anywhere...From outside on the patio, to the lake,or to a Bed and Breakfast... that way you know exactly what you are getting and you know you will enjoy it...easy to do... just load in the ice chest and voila...Instant party wheather your are at home or away... Enjoy!!!

My 2 labs absolutely love bully sticks and I've ordered bully sticks from Amazon prior to this order.  I decided to go with these as the price was right, well now I know why the price is right-these things are very thin or skinny and they have a stink that's stronger then the normal bully sticks.  My 2 labs gobble these things down within a few minutes that's how thin/skinny they are.  And the smell of urine is strong!  Will go back to the sticks that are a thicker and less stinky when this batch is done, which should be just about now...
I received this fast and love it. I grind it up in a coffee grinder and keep it in the refrigerator. It is a very good deal and I will buy again. thanks
