the gummy bears are always fresh because they are individually wrapped.  The value is great you get 3 bags for the price.

Love coffee and always looking for one that has no acidity and no heavy oil, yet sooooo tasty.
This is it!! I no longer have to hunt and order this on a regular basis.

Summary: It is OK. I had better golden teas.
Text: I used to love this teach much more but I notice decrease in quality lately. It is not bitter but is not as delicious as it used to be either.
I have no idea what everyone else is complaining about. First of all this is a great price. In NYC, one box is $5. And second of all the taste is great and the portion size is too. Give it a try!!!

We have tried other chew products for our dog and these are by far her favorite. They don't get messy like other chew treats and her breath smells so much better, even better than the dental milkbones out there. She really does prefer these over any other dog treat.

I love these.
Well seasoned but not too much. Not over cooked.
The taste of the collard greens is still dominant.

I'll definitely be ordering more.

This product was very nice, The pods all sprouted before or on the listed germination date. They are continuing to grow very fast. They have not produced peppers for me yet but that is not their fault. It's just not time yet for harvest. But when they do I suspect I will get more than I want/need so I will share with neighbors.

I wish I could have loved this rosemary because I usually am very happy with Frontier's excellent quality spices but this was OLD and stale with NO aroma. I've grown and dried my own organic rosemary so I know how freshly dried rosemary should taste and smell.

Huge disappointment.

I purchased these, Oreo Sandwich Cookies (2-Count), 0.78-Ounce Packages (Pack of 120),  to give as part of a "Thank You" birthday celebration favor.  Unfortunately, many of them arrived opened, and thus the Oreo cookie was stale.

Summary: Comparison with Bigelow Asian Pear Rooibos
Text: I love all rooibos tea as a decaf wind-down in the evenings (incidentally I've heard South Africans pronounce it closer to roy-bos with a long O). I started out with the Bigelow Asian Pear Rooibos and loved it but thought I would take one for the team and try this one too. To my taste, this is less sweet, less woody and more earthly - I prefer the Bigelow but this might be a better choice for black tea drinkers.

I was going to order this for my little shihtzu but knowing how picky he is I bought a can from the local pet store first.  Glad I did, because Sheldon would have nothing to do with it.  The chunks in it are huge for a little dog so I cut them up, but he still would only sniff it and walk away.  Disappointing because I see now that they have the smaller cans I would have bought for him.  Not sure if the pieces in those are smaller as well, but it doesn't really matter.  He won't eat it.

If I could give this 10 stars I would.  This tea is definitely the most delicious tea I've ever enjoyed. When serving it to non-tea drinkers, they get hooked. It's very fragrant and infused with tropical fruits. It's not sweet, it just smells and tastes great. Quite addicting. Downside is the price, but each bag lasts through two 12 oz refills of hot water, and it truly is worth every penny.

I bought this item as a gift for my sister. After speaking with her a few days ago, she confirmed that the pretzels are very good and has gone through one of the bags faster than intended. However, I can't give the item a great review as the tin that the pretzels came in had a large dent in it. Apparently it wasn't enough to damage the contents, but it was something that happened prior to shipment as there was no damage whatsoever to the box that the tin came in. Just something to be aware of, especially if you intend this item to be a gift.

Summary: I enjoy it a lot, but it is extremely overpriced
Text:
It seems like Teavana is always extremely overpriced. Even in the store, a cast iron tea pot is $250 for example, and that's the norm.

4 stars for satisfaction. -2 for being overpriced.

We have been buying these for years now. My husband loves them in his lunch every day. They just reduced the size of the bag by 3 oz due to rising ingredient costs. Amazon had the best price on the smaller bags. The product is the same yummy chocolatey cookie as before, you just get less of it per bag.

Last year, a co-worker brought Ginger Snappish tea to work and it was my first time trying this brand of tea. I went to my local grocery store to purchase only to learn this type of tea can only be purchase online.  I was hesitant in purchasing because six boxes are a lot of tea bags, but they make great stocking stuffers; not to mention I love the tea and went through quickly.

Summary: Celestial India spice chai tea k-cups
Text: I brew this in a keurig 60 model, i like this tea, its good any time of the year. It is on the spicy side and will leave your pallet with a spicy after taste. But oh so good late at night. Good tea for every once in a while, i could not drink this every day as is a little on the strong side.

My grandson is autistic and doesn't eat very well, so we give him Carnation Instant breakfast with  his milk to give him the vitamins he needs.  The problem is he only drinks strawberry and we cannot find it in the stores. I am so happy that I was able to get this on Amazon. Thanks for carrying this product.
Good, light taste.  Not too strong of a flavoring, and very little, if any, aftertaste.  They go down easy,...MMMmm.  Definitely happy with the purchase.
A little on the salty side but I like it that way... great vegetarian alternative!

The price with Prime shipping is much cheaper than buying in a store.

My younger son drinks a lot of this so it makes since to buy in this bulk.

Awesome quality; will be ordering from you folks again! Cinnamon sticks were exactly what I wanted/expected/needed! Mahalo for your product & service!
-L-

This is my second order for the Kahlua flavor from Timothy's World Coffee on Amazon.  I'm usually not a fan of flavored coffees, but this is very unique and smooth.  It has no aftertaste at all.  Quite enjoyable.  Try it, I think you will enjoy it...

This tea smells great  - I love Rooibos teas  --  I love the smell of cinnamon  --  I brewed up  a cup and the cinnamon is overwhelming  --and there isn't any other chai spices  in it  like  cardamon  allspice cloves anise star -  you don't taste the Rooibos at all - I am finding that flavoring in teas is bad  --  you have to have the right taste or it will ruin it  --  I will probally won't buy again --

I first tasted this item at the Georgia Aquarium and brought back some as gifts. Once they ran out, everyone was addicted. These are THOSE SAME candy pebbles and they're GREAT! Authentic looking and great tasting.

Summary: Tasty enough, just hard to chew
Text: The granola was alright and tasted good.  My issue with it was that it was very hard to chew.  I couldn't eat much before my jaw was exhausted.  It was so terrible because I was so excited about cinnamon, almond, cocoa granola - I found it addictive but it wore out my face!
I use this product to make my udon noodle soups and also miso soup. It is a very reputable and popular brand and it is very good.

Summary: Green Tea on the bland side
Text:
I guess when I was using tea bags that I must have brewed my tea to be quite strong. This leaves me disappointed in the strength of the cup of tea regardless of the size of cup I brew. Obviously the larger the cup the weaker it is, but I just don't think that leaf tea can be brewed effectively in under a minute...

Not sure how they would remedy this problem, I think it is a lack of steeping time. I love my Keurig for coffee, but the teas in general have been a bummer as they all seem weak to me.

it appears expensive, but for $24, it's the biggest antler in terms of both girth and length than anything i could ever find at a pet foods or specialty store. well worth it to keep my big chewer occupied and happy! plus it doesn't smell bad like some of the other antlers, and this one is cut just enough to give them a little hint of the "marrow" but not cut so much that it gets destroyed too quickly.

Yum! Light, crunchy, fruity, with a little bit of tasty icing. I love the blueberry and will now hunt up other flavours too. What a great little snack! Kind of like a cracker, which is my special weakness. Well done, Kellogg's!
These are great, the only problem is they don't offer them in cases, because you're going to want more.

The product was shipped well packaged and even contained two surprise samples and recipes for their other products.  I have enjoyed experimenting with the pollen and look forward to ordering another product soon!

Summary: As a Seller of the Organic French Sourdough Starter on Amazon I know Sourdough
Text: As a Seller of Organic French Sourdough Starter I know sourdough starters. The world has a few famous sourdough starters and America can claim a few of them. San Francisco Sourdough Starter is one of them. One of the earlier starters I tried. A classic, it is known for a real sourdough taste and these folks keep that alive. Nice Product.

This a simply good Chex Mix flavor(B B Que)and is great sprinkled on a green salad or anything you might want to try it on or with. My idea was on a green salad and it works very well, it is also good as a snack. I will get it again as I like the flavor which to me is very mild with out a bite to it which is a plus as far as I am concerned. Experiment and have fun trying it on different things.
We love TAZO Herbal Teas and this one in particular.  The price was really good and shipment was quick so we would re-order from this site as needed.

Come on, this is 2005. Twinkies aren't "food" anymore than Cheez Whiz is. Twinkies were invented back in the 30s before science understood the impact of the product on our bodies. Consider that in those days doctors were used to advertise cigarettes in magazines. Everyone needs a sugar fix every once in a while - I'm just as guilty of that - but eating Twinkies is practically self-mutilation. Look at the ingredients list and do some reading. Yikes! Everyone's family deserves tasty snacks that happen to be healthy too. Sorry Hostess, that definitely does not include Twinkies.
I didn't think Hormel would make chili as bland as this.  The hot version is so much better than this stuff.  I was truly disappointed in this product and will not buy it again.

I used this fondant for the first time to cover a two layer cake. It took blue food coloring gel very well, was pliable, easily handled, rolled thin, and worked wonderfully for my purposes. I had used marshmallow fondant in the past and it came out very lumpy on the cake- and was a pain to make. This was so much easier and looked much more smooth. I also bought at Michaels with a 40 percent off coupon. The best part was, my guests actually enjoyed it! The taste was definitely sweet, but not offensive as some premade fondants are rumored to be, and tasted better than the MMF!

Growing up in Asia, i had fresh coconut juice very often. This tasted funny with the passion fruit flavor. Good coconuts don't taste sour but this did. Maybe without any artificial flavors would make this juice more desirable.

Summary: Best biscuits you can buy for daily use
Text: This is the first time I am using McVities brand biscuit, and I am impressed. Unlike most made in "US" biscuits, these are not overly sweet or smelly or buttery. Just a perfect balance of light flavor, sweetness and baking make this biscuits phenomenal. If you never tried McVities, this is the time to do it.

I didn't know what to expect from this purchase as the "On the Go" packages are significantly larger than other flavors of Crystal Light.  The product description on Amazon did not explain what type of sweetener, if any, is in the drink.  It is sweetened with the new sugar substitute, Stevia, which perhaps is why the packages are so large. I will definitely purchase this item again.

I tried these chips about 4 years ago before the blue corn tortilla chips were popular. The second I finished eating one chip I knew I would be a customer for life. These are absolutely amazing. I wish all of the ingredients were organic but i won't be too picky. The 12 bags are quite a bit to get in one order but it is much cheaper than getting it at a local store. If you like to entertain these would be a good idea to keep handy for a more healthy option for your guests. I love these little guys. I would recommend to anyone.

Summary: My dog hates to take pills
Text: This product works well for the dog who runs away whenever the daily pills show up.  I lie and tell her that this is a chocolate ball and when she remembers it isn't, I tell her it is a liver ball and that gets her every time.  I like this as much as the pouches now on the market.  The product is worth the price, but care is necessary so that the pill is covered and doesn't become uncovered in the process.  My dog is smart, though not all that smart, and needs to take several pills daily to keep from being in pain, to control her thyroid.  Youth is in the mind of the beholder, and with aids like this even my 11 year od Old English Sheepdog behaves like a puppy.

We first tried this root beer (Saranac) when we were visiting our daughter in Rome, NY. Since then, that root beer is the only kind we like.  Whenever we go up there (from Florida) we buy a couple of cases. I wish we could find it down here, but we can't. I am so glad I found this on amazon.com!  Five stars, for sure!

Summary: If you want bold, get this one
Text: Most Keurig coffees come out weak, but this one is nice and strong.  Not too strong, just about right.  I use each pod twice to make a larger cup and this one works great for that.

I didn't purchase this fruit from Amazon, I got it from my own grocery store.

The bag I bought was very heavy on the plums but they were good. I didn't like the apricots at all, they were huge and had some sort of grit on them that crunched my teeth when I bit in.

A positive though is that everything was nice and soft - even though it's called dried fruit for a reason that doesn't mean I want petrified. Also all the pieces of fruit were larger than what I usually get, at least two bites per piece.

She loves this toy and I love watching her toss around the jar and fiddling with the rope to get the kibble out.

Just try to imagine a green apple jolly rogers wrapped in sticky caramel. YUMMM!!
Unfortunately, my local store carries only the small cans of Yuban, so I had to order the large ones online. This is by far the best tasting canned coffee.

Summary: Excellent flour for a tasty porridge
Text:
This is the best barley flour I ever bought. Delievery was swift and the product was fresh.
I use 2 tbspoons with one cup of milk to make a daily cup of porride sweatenned with honey. A great recipe for a healty happy heart, this porridge is excellent for the depressed. I also use it in my bread recipes.
I gave some bags to friends as gifts and kept the rest in the fridge to keep it fresh.

Summary: Rich, thick, creamy, and spicy; put it on anything but dessert!
Text: Taco Bell Bold & Creamy Spicy Ranchero Sauce has a nice balance of spice, cumin and rich creaminess. It's too high in calories to slather all over everything, but a little slather adds a lot of taste. It seems particularly well suited for sandwiches and wraps, but it would also make a dynamite chicken salad. Oh, just put it on everything - except ice cream, ok?

Summary: Cookie good -- chocolate not so much
Text: I couldn't wait to try these Chips Ahoy cookies. I mean, how do you make chocolate chip cookies better -- by putting more chocolate inside (yes, I'm a chocoholic).  The chocolate has a strange taste to it.  I definitely prefer the plain, soft batch chocolate chip cookies by Chips Ahoy.  However, they weren't so bad that I didn't finish the entire package!!!!!

This coffee will make you wait every morning to enjoy it. The flavor is smooth, yet dark enough. I am not an instant-coffee person but this product changes my mind. My colleagues like this product now and ask me where to get them. I will recommend this coffee to all my coffee buddies.

This is a stone-ground mustard that is just wonderful on a sandwich or in recipes that call for mustard where it is not completely blended into the other ingredients but is still visible on its own.  The flavor is wonderful; not too strong or too hot.  This isn't a Dijon-style mustard and there is no hint of horseradish.  Try it and you'll be hooked.

These apples should come with a warning -"Addictive". They are very crisp (not chewy like air dried apples) with a tart/sweet taste and as impossible to put down as a bag of potato chips. Fortunately, they are just Fuji apples with no flavorings, chemicals or preservatives added. My kids are nuts for them and they are great for school lunch. A no-guilt healthy snack and they are good with fruit dips. Have not tried to reconstitute them to cook with yet but planning on trying them in fried apple pies like my grandmother made with air dried apples. Have been through several packs and have not found any with the musty taste mentioned in other reviews. They MUST stay in the mylar bag to stay fresh. Will be ordering a lot of these apples.

This is a great product that keeps you going without the crash! It works immediately, so there is no waiting for it to work! Although, you might want to take this early in the afternoon or mid morning! It sometimes keeps me up at night!
I cannot tell you how many of these I made between Thanksgiving and Christmas!  Fast, convenient and SO DELICIOUS!  I got rave reviews!  Thanks!

Text: two delightfully buttery and peanutty cookies sandwiched between a very creamy and peanutty filling.  Each cookie is shaped like a peanut too which is a huge hit with my kids! Add a glass of milk and you have pure peanutty bliss! A great classic cookie.

I really like lentils, but am very tired of soggy, cheap brown superstore lentils. These are a little more expensive, but so much better, easy to cook with and great flavor. outstanding for salads.

It is hard to find salame on line that is so good.  I live in the midwest and you can not find this product here anywhere.  I lived in San Francisco for 40 years and this was my choice of salames and still is.  Thanks for making Taylors Market available to purchase this great choice.

We were so excited  to make this wine for summer parties. We were very disappointed to have it arrive damaged with liquid leaking through the packaging.  Needless to say we were not comfortable making it due to the possibility of bacteria issues.  We contacted Amazon and were very pleased with the way the issue was handled, they resolved it quickly.  We have ordered wine kits through Amazon in the past and will not hesitate to do so again, this was likely just one of those things that happens sometimes during shipping.

Sparkling ice drinks are so good and a guilt free treat! I love all of the flavors i have tried. I have never been able to find the coconut pineapple so haven't tried it. I particularly like anything with mango flavor.
There are only a few stores in my area that stock this and half the time, they are out of it. For a comparable price, I just order them from Amazon . Be careful with the black raspberry and open it over the sink. For some reason, this flavor in particular seems to be high pressure and I have had it squirt all over the place when opening even though it had not been shaken or moved prior. I am assuming it is because it is a lovely shade of red on tan carpet.

My husband and I bought an "Annies" mac and cheese one night at our local store.  It was amazing, and we were so excited that we decided to buy a large lot online.  I couldn't find the exact style we bought, but the lable on this box was almost identical to the other Annies.  I was WRONG, this was awful - the cheese was a powder instead of the pre-mixed packet that came in our original box.  It was watery and smelled like vomit.  It left a bad after-taste.  I do not recommend this particular type of Annies.

This is my first time buying and using goji berries, so I don't have another brand to compare these to, but the price on these is fantastic and they are really tasty. When they arrived, I was worried that they would taste/feel dry and gritty in the mouth, but the taste is subtle and blends into whatever food they're mixed into.

My favorite ways to use them so far are mixing them into oatmeal, adding them to protein smoothies, and mixing them into a granola and Greek yogurt combination.

I had read online that eating about 1-2 tablespoons a day allows for maximum benefit. Since they are pretty expensive, I use about 1/2 to 1 tablespoon a day.

Enjoy!

I bought a variety of these for my grandchildren starting at Christmas, and I heard more about them than the expensive gifts.  Kids still are stuck in many childhood patterns and to have something silly, fun and that tastes good turned out to be the hit of the season.
The instructions were completely wrong. If you actually follow the instructions, you'll be left with gruel to eat. If you like gruel, this probably won't be a problem.

My toddler loves this stuff! She would eat the whole can if I let her but I only give her a handful as a special snack. The cheesy taste is not as strong as goldfish snacks but its cheesy/salty enough to excite young taste buds.
I bought these at my local supermarket and I had to throw them away. You can feel a burnt oil taste, very disappointing.

Text: This product is sweet corn and is nothing like corn nuts. It is a great product but I was hoping for a product similiar to corn nuts.
Tastes like brown sugar.  Use it wherever it calls for brown sugar in recipes and to sweeten drinks.  Great product.

I was kind of surprised after seeing/smelling the biscuits but both of my dogs, including my notoriously picky Chihuahua, eat them up. They seem pretty hard but my little dogs (Chihuahua and Toy Fox Terrier) didn't have issues eating them and they are just the right size snack for little doggies. The only problem I have with them is that, because they are so crunchy, after my dogs get through with them there are crumbs all over the place.

I'm a confessed coffee snob of 20 years or more and brew my own daily from beans.  I prefer the bold to extra-bold coffees, but enjoy most of Starbucks (non-flavored) varieties. I completely avoided instant coffee until I tried Starbucks Via. I was amazed! In the time it takes to boil water, I can have a full-flavored, aromatic cup of coffee. My office has a Bunn hot-water dispenser which cuts the time to seconds! Now I take the VIA packs camping, boating and always have a few in my brief case when traveling on business. They are pricey when bought at the local supermarket, but the Amazon price on the 50-pack brings the cost down to .65 per cup.

Summary: Makes everything taste creamy and Yummy
Text:
ALL I CAN SAY IS , THIS IS THE BEST RICE MILK EVER MADE. I USE IT IN MASH POTATOES, CERAL, PUDDING, CREAM OF CHICKEN SOUP, POTATEO SOUP,. MAKES OUTSTAND SMOOTHIES, . THE RICE MILK TASTE SO RICH AND CREAMING, I USE IT TO MAKE NON-DAIRY ICING,

THE ONLY SAD THING IS THAT WE TRAVEL ALOT AND I WISH THEY HAD THE RICE MILK IN POWDER FORM! IF THEY DO PLEASE LET US KNOW WE WOULD BUY IT. WE TRAVEL AND WE ALWAY LOOK FOR Pacific Natural Foods Rice Non-Dairy Beverage, Vanilla, 32-Ounce Containers (Pack of 12)

I was wary of ordering a plant online but I took a chance and Im glad I did. It arrived quickly and was packaged securely, the plant is beautiful and even taller than I expected, and the vase is exactly as presented. I will be ordering from this company in the future and would recommend it to anyone who needs a plant/vase combo fast!
I took a chance buying this and I'm glad I did.  I grind the beans every morning and make coffee in my french press and it has bold flavor. Delish!

I first tasted this tea in England, and became addicted to it. The taste is strong and bold without becoming overwhelming. It is inexpensive, yet has the same quality as the more expensive brands. I am so happy that Amazon carries this brand. I love being able to order the 5 pack as it I like having it on hand to share with my friends.
I think this is a great substitute for regular mac and cheese.  I thought it kept me full and the taste was pretty good.
We received our case of Good Season Caesar Dressing.  It is very good on chicken etc - just sprinkle some on as you are cooking.  Also good for roast beef in a crock pot.  I use it as a spice.

Summary: definately worth a try for anyone!
Text: i just went into my local grocery store because they USED to carry this stuff-only to see they no longer do.  Im going to let a whole bunch of Fourth of July people down because word quickly spread that I was to make my chicken Khorma and I was getting excited calls...I can no longer find the star ingredient of this simple, delicious and different dish, but Ive found it here on Amazon and I will be buying it for when I get a hankerin'.  It might interest you to know that my toughest critics-two teenaged boys-really love it served over jasmine rice.  And if they like it, then you know it's not too spicey or too different for your family.

I ordered these for my daughter who recently found out she was Gluten sensitive. She had been looking for something to carry with her for quick snacks that was healthy and GLUTEN FREE.  She loved these KIND bars and has told all her friends about them.  I love them too, such good flavors. KIND was a Great FIND!!!!!
Are you living in California, but longing for the taste of "real" pizza--East Coast style?  Try this sauce.  This is as close as I can get to "home."

These are the best cookies!  Sort of like gourmet Lorna D cookies with chocolate chunks. Rich, not too sweet and no gritty GF aftertaste. The only bad thing about them is that you are tempted to eat the whole box. I will definitely buy them again, but not too often.
This is the best chocolate macadamia nuts in Hawaii.  They came shipped enclosed in styoform.  No melting.  They were wonderful.  Thank You.

This is a nice smooth coffee substitute that is easy on the stomach and good flavor.  It is doubtful it has any active Tongkat Ali in it, however. For that you need to buy an extract from a company who specializes in extracts.

GoGo rice is an excellent choice for anyone who wants to have great tasting brown rice that is easily microwavable in a few minutes.  Excellent taste and super convenient for dormitory.  5 stars for sure.

I've tried many Almond butters in hope of finding one that tastes very near to my dear Skippy PB.  This one is even better that Skippy.  My son likes it a lot and that's saying something b/c he hated all the others we tried (can't blame him.) So, if you're looking for a good substitute due to allergies, this is your ticket.  The only downside is that it is expensive.  Its cheaper here at amazon but its not like you can use a coupon when its on sale and get it for $1 like Skippy/Jif brands.

Summary: Cat loves it, healthy & grain free
Text: My cat loves Pet Greens Savory Salmon w/ Wheat Grass Cat Treats (3oz). Salmon is one of his favorite flavors. Due to his digestive problems he can't have grain, and these treats are grain free. He always wants more of Pet Greens treats, especially their fish flavors. These treats help his digestion and he likes them better than dried fish and meats.

I bought this item with some doubt in my mind as I'm not that fond of the usual run of the mill herring, even the fancy kind.  But I do value it's nutritional value and try to incorporate it in my diet once in a while.  I was really surprised at this delicious version. There is no hint of fishiness whatsoever and the smoke flavor is mild and not overpowering.  I LOVE it. Shelf life is long too, another plus.  I would not hesitate to recommend this product to anyone.

This stuff is really good.  It has a rich, full-bodied, complex flavor that is unlike anything I have ever experienced with commercially produced chocolate.  Chocolate lovers will LOVE this!!!  And for those who are worried about consuming non-sustainably produced, pesticide laden chocolate, produced by child laborers, this is a GREAT option!
No problems with this product.  I don't call it mild, more like a medium cup.  It's not as strong a brew as Starbucks T-Disc (but what is!).  I won't hesitate to purchase again.

There are no substitutes for quality fresh ingredients.  Ginger snaps are one of my favorites and these are as good as any homemade cookie recipes I have tried.  I do prefer a bit more spice than these provide but the fresh flavors more than compensate.

I bought this peppercorn ranch dressing one evening at Walmart.  It is the best tasting ranch dressing I've had.  All others pale in comparison.  We began having salad wedges with tomatoes, avocado, real bacon bits, chopped egg and this dressing is just fabulous.  The only problem, Walmart can't keep it in stock, neither can Publix in Florida.  We are now ordering online!

These are nothing like they used to be, they were much larger and had a lot more filling, now there is just a scant of current here and there. They used to be filled with a thick layer of current paste. There also used to be 3 layers to the package, and now only 2. Was very disappointed.

Besides enjoying it straight out of the jar, I also applied the honey to my face after shower, and then washed it off after a few hours. My skin became glowy and smooth, and I also noticed less breakouts, it's like it instantly heals everything. I am amazed. I wonder how it is going to be after a week or so? I probably won't have to apply foundation anymore to cover the unwanted spots, the skin will become perfect naturally.
Hubby & I eat these delicious cherries as a treat and a treatment for arthritis on a daily basis.  Eat a handful or add to salads, muffins, pancakes, breads, etc.  Good and good for you!

Summary: Great way to buy bulk and pinch pennies
Text: This flour is a great flour for GF baking.  However, it is hard to keep enough on hand to do much cooking.  By purchasing it in a 4 pack, it gave me greater flexibility in the kitchen, knowing I had more on hand.  I checked around and this is BY FAR the best price I was able to find!  A great starting place for GF bakers!

My entire family is addicted to this delicious, all natural licorice bar! We love the taste, which is so much better than the usual plastic tasting black licorice you buy in stores. I used to buy this brand at the health food store, but now I can have a box delivered on a monthly basis from Amazon. Natural licorice has been used for many years to support weak adrenals, and also to ease upset stomachs. Of all the brands we've tried, this one is the best!

I love these things, for munching as well as adding to things like cornbread. The "roasted" flavor is noticeable and excellent, and the veggies are sweet and crispy.

Tasty.
This is the worst chili I have ever had.  Used 1 can and took the rest back to Costco for refund.  I have never returned food products to Costco for this reason.

Love this tea,  Our neighbor introduced us to it a month ago.  And we fell in love with it.  Now this tea is packaged in plastic in portion sizes, so you have to use a filter or strainer over your vessel.  But this is a commercial product and I'm using it at home.  it makes approx. 2 gals but we brew in a 1 gal container. So after brewing, before serving we cut the tea by 100% or we would be climbing the walls.... but that's fine.....  we love the stuff.  No after taste, and very clean taste.  And buying in bulk size like this we're saving money on a very fine product.......

Summary: Terrible low quality pressed bits in tiny bags
Text: This turkey jerky is really bad quality jerky. It comes as a bunch of tiny extremely thin pressed bits in tiny bags. The little pieces are dry, bad tasting and look like they are reconstituted without any texture to them at all. I have been getting jerky from a place called Mountain America Jerky which recently raised their prices and so I am trying Amazon.com merchants. This jerky is really really bad. The other Amazon.com merchant I have tried for turkey jerky is Golden Valley which is much much better than this jerky. Don't get this stuff at all. It is really bad. Try the Golden Valley jerky also here at amazon. That at least has some decent flavor and you can tell it once was a turkey! This stuff is just awful.

This soup is very good.  It has a nice flavor and is a solid comfort food. The container makes it practical for a fast meal, especially at work. The soup contains enough chicken to validate it's name "chunky chicken."  The vegetables are substantial and hearty which makes it a real chowder and a meal in itself.  Quick, easy and tasty -- you can't ask for more than that.  Enjoy.

I like to be able to offer coffee to my clients, or tea, so a Keurig coffee maker has become a tattoo studio essential. This tasty flavor means I don't have to keep half&half or creamer on hand, you get a perfect mild creamy brew instantly. Much of the time I like a black tea, but if I'm feeling like something more sweet and milky this hits the spot.

If Amazon would get on the ball and offer this cereal with free shipping, I'd order it regularly!  It's the best gluten free hot cereal!  Reminds me of eating cream of wheat and malt-o-meal!  But if I have to pay for shipping, I'm better off buying it at the store.  Come on Amazon!!

Summary: It's A Party In Your Mouth!
Text:
As an IZZE drinker for years I can tell you there is something special about these 8.4 ounce cans of Clementine
IZZE. Each swallow is bursting with flavor. In fact, I like it so much more than when I buy it in a bottle at the store. For a real thrill, put a can in the freezer for 20 minutes, then pop open and enjoy Heaven in a can!
These are delicious tea biscuit plus these are really cheap comparing to some other brand. I love these. Been buying these since 1980z.

Summary: Great snack for anywhere!!! Good size!!
Text: I'm not a big junk food person so these have been great for the kids & there friends, well yes me too!! Last year I got a case for a end of the year snack to send to school for my daughters class & it was a hit!! They are big enough that you can enjoy them & it cures the Oreo craving without eating a stack of Oreos!!! I bought a second case for the kids for the summer.

Having now tried several Switch drinks, I'm quite pleased with how they've chosen to enter the market with this product-line. The flavors they've introduced are well thought out, generally taste good, and are really a good set of drinks I'd consider purchasing.

The downsides? It's probably not big enough. 8.3 ounces is quite small. I know it's probably more of a specialty drink, but I did feel like I still needed more after drinking the entire can. It's possible they intended that to make you purchase more.

That being said the black cherry was by far my most favorite. Again, these are great drinks. Definitely worth trying and seeing if they can become a part of your regular drink selection.

I love the floral flavor of this green tea. It has a nice flavor without being too strong or too weak. I've been drinking Numi teas for years now and love that their products are organic. One tea blossom makes 2-3 pots of tea depending on the size of tea pot used during brewing.

This is a pretty good flour mix - however has a bean aftertaste. Because if that, I don't like it for bread. However, it is wonderful for breading chicken or fish, and OK for cakes like chocolate where the other flavors hide the bean taste.

I was a little disappointed with the size of the basket for the price.
Very good delivery time for Christmas.
My friends and family where happy with the item.

I had this tea while visiting Ireland this summer.  The tea is robust and I liked it so much I brought some home.  I used it up and still wanted more so I found I could order it via amazon.  It's a wonderful tea.
OH MY GOODNESS!!!! This cheeseball mix is WONDERFUL! Try it once and you'll be hooked!

We like Pop Secret 100 Calorie pop corn. The taste is good takes about one and a half minutes to pop and there is about 3 cups of popped corn. Pretty good snack and just 100 Calories. Good buy and price here on Amazon

I stumbled across this coffee, and I'm so glad I did !!!  Just received it today, was curious so I made a cup.  Great flavor, a bit bold, but very smooth.  I think my husband will love it tomorrow morning.  Signed up for the auto shipments, which takes the price a bit lower and I don't have to place an order every month.  Great product and love the auto ship !!!!

Summary: Coconut Water: Refreshing Choice for Hot Summer Days
Text: LIght, refreshing delicious, a perfect description for a cold coconut water.  We found it to be a perfect replacement for juices or soda on those afternoons when you are thirsty but want a touch of flavor rather than plain water.  To us, this coconut water delivered the same impact as a tropical juice without the heaviness and cloying sweetness.  We plan on trying it next mixed with a shot or two of rum.

Summary: Not the same as previous petco catnip spray
Text: I bought this because our cat just loves the petco catnip spray that we had gotten years ago. Apparently something in the way they make it is not the same, because our cat sniffs and walks away. It's definitely got more of a minty smell than the other, so I'm guessing that's what she doesn't like.

This is a great tea to drink when you are suffering a sore throat due to post-nasal drip.  It soothes without numbifying and leaves a protective coating to prevent further irritation.  The only drawback is the taste - it has a very strong licorice and mediciney flavor, but I guess that is to be expected.  Best drinken plain - it actually tastes worse with sugar.
Tinkyada pasta always cooks well. I am pleased with all their gluten free pastas and I have tried many I truly disliked.

I wish they made this in a non-energy version.  I enjoy the taste.  Caffeine is barely useful to me as I am extremely resistant to it.  I wouldn't pay 58 dollars for a 24 pack when I can buy them from Wawa for 1.99 a piece.  That would be well under 50 dollars.  This would make the cans around 2.42 a piece.  Multiply the 1.99 by 7% sales tax I pay in New Jersey and I would pay 2.12 a can.  This product is a still great and I think I am going to go out and grab one.

I have shoulder-length permed hair. I found that this product didn't do much for frizz, but it does make my hair pleasantly shiny. Only a small amount of oil is needed. My favorite aspect of this product is the applicator tip. You can apply the oil directly to your scalp without having to get your hands oily. While some other reviews complained about the smell, I really didn't notice the scent. I didn't find it unpleasant or too strong. While it's convenient to be able to use this on wet or dry hair, I'd prefer a product that was more effective on frizz. I usually use oil sheen for frizz, shine, and moisture.
My daughter and I love St. Dalfour's tea.  We literally drink it morning, noon and night.  We particularly like the fact that it's organic, and we love the slightly astringent yet comforting flavor.

For the past 5 years my dog has been starting his day with a greenie.  He still gets excited about this morning treat and appears disappointed when I run out.  Since he controls the household, I buy them.

Picked up a teeny bag in a local dollar store and have been on the hunt for them ever since. I am so glad Amazon carries them! They have the same sweet/salty thing going on as fresh kettle corn does-but with the caramel taste. There are 'lumps' of hardened caramel goodness on the chips(like the caramelized sugar/butter chunks you yearn for in kettle corn). Can't wait to get them. Thanks Amazon!

Summary: Cinnabon is tops for a mild smooth coffee.
Text:
I'm thrilled with my order since my grocer stopped carrying this product.
The best coffee I've ever had and that's all I buy.

I really have a terrible addiction, if I bring a can/jar or bag of nuts home, they get eaten as quickly as I can consume them. I've tried a lot of different flavors of all kinds of nuts and even make my own spicy sweet pecans..but I'm not really much of a peanut fan. So, when I tell you these are some of the most delicious peanuts or really one of the most delicious things I've ever eaten...well, give them a try. I HIGHLY recommend them. HIGHLY...I want some right now. These are salty, sweet, spicy and crunchy...did I mention I want some right now. Try them, you won't be disappointed. :)

Summary: Really Good Chocolate Drink Mix - Highly Recommended!
Text:
Nesquick No Sugar Added mix is a welcome treat for me since becoming a Type 2 diabetic. It tastes very close to regular chocolate milk or hot chocolate, but has significantly less carbs. That being said, you do have to watch out for the carbs that milk adds to the 7g that is in the Nesquick.

Great tasting - Highly Recommended!

Before making my boyfriend's birthday cake, I heavily researched which was the best store-bought cake mix. This came out perfect--it is still really moist after storing it in the fridge for a few days. You do have to add a stick of butter so it's not good for the health-conscious, but if you want a really moist, sweet cake in a basic yellow cake recipe, this is definitely it! Will definitely use it again!
ya cant stop eatin them,they are so good,my friends are addicted to them,,were all gonna explode

I have purchased the Organic coconut milk many times.  It has a fresh, coconut taste and is very smooth.  But, it has guar gum added.  I decided to give the regular Natural Value a try (non-organic, no guar gum).  It is a very different product.  The coconut milk has a strange smell and flavor.  It is unpleasant and does not taste like coconut.  The can contains a lot of liquid and the coconut solid is somewhat grainy in texture compared to the organic.  Overall, I am unhappy with this product.  I cannot recommend it.

Added to any tea (Regular OR herbal) makes for a whole new tea drinking experience.
As a topping for pancakes, ice-cream (no kidding) and every type of fruit salad is simply unbelievable.
My personal favorite: sprinkled over fresh blueberries! Yam!!!!!

I must of been tired when I placed this order. The key word here,is "PIECES". Don't be misled. These are the broken pieces that Priester's can't sell in their premium products. They come in a plastic bag sealed with tape. Don't pinch a few pennies to buy this junk. And what ever you do, don't send it as gift, you'll be embarrassed if you do.
These are the bomb! I'm a diabetic & this is a great handy bar to have on hand. Healthy and DELISH!

I am definitely in the minority on this one because I did not care for this Cider at all.  I the flavor of the Cider it to be poorly spiced and quite watered down tasting.  I did try a couple of the cups thinking perhaps the 1st one I selected to large a size for the quantity inside the K-cup but even on the smallest setting I was still unimpressed with the lackluster flavor of this cider, on the plus side it does make your kitchen smell wonderful while it is brewing.

I ordered these because they reminded me of canned brown bread I had as a kid.  My wife frequently reminds me that my memories of things are more pleasant than the actual reality.  That is the case here.  The ones with raisins are fat free.  They taste very artificial.  Not even as good as an MRE (army food).  The flavor is bland.  The consistency is artificial.  I felt nauseous afterwards.  If you just want to experience canned bread, try a different one.

Summary: Dogs now have breath I can breathe
Text: This is easy to use and that is the most wonderful thing about this product.  My older dog would never let me brush her teeth without biting me, so I was always looking for alternatives. I like the fact that you just put some in the drinking water. It took about four days for me to really notice a difference. But now when I get me afternoon "face washes", I don't have to turn my head. I can actually enjoy my welcome home committee! I don't know if there is anything that can completely remove my old dogs foul smelling breath, but this comes close. Thank you!

For a product that has no added sweeteners, this drink is very sweet. It has a strong cherry and something-other-than-cherry flavor, and just enough carbonation to remind you of soda. The 8.3oz serving size was definitely enough for me because I found it cloyingly sweet. The color was the natural color of cherry juice mixed with water or seltzer, so I didn't find that surprising.

If you enjoy very sweet drinks, this is definitely for you. It was way too sweet for me, and I didn't like the something-other-than-cherry flavor. It made it taste "off" to me.

This pasta and all of rustichella d'abruzzo's pasta products are the freshest, most tender, and simply delicious.  You cannot go wrong and this price is the best on the net.  Stock up for those long, winter nights!!!

This peanut butter is addictive!  I love the taste and it's very good anywhere you put Jam.  For another taste sensation, try putting it in the microwave for a few seconds to melt into peanuty goodness!
Very good product, the $4.00 increase did less to change my subscription. I love this product and will continue buying in future.
Dog LOVES it and chews on it contentedly for many hours. Has lasted at least a week or more of consistent use. Highly recommend!

My husband and I have been looking for this mustard for over a year. Walmart used to carry it and then they quit. It's the only honey mustard my husband will use so I was over the moon when I found it at such an affordable price.

I'd never tried these before purchasing so I didn't know what to expect. They were a pleasant surprise. They're not as oily and salty as normal mixed nuts but are still quite flavorful. Most of the peanuts are lacking "skins" also so they're much less messy to eat. I eat a fair amount of nuts for health purposes and I feel good about these. I intend to purchase them again.

Summary: Good, but not the best I've had
Text: This is a nice, dark coffee, but I think I like mine darker than most and I found that this didn't make a big enough, dark enough coffee. I really like the Midnight Magic by Timothy's better. However, if you don't want super dark, this would be fine for you.

I have been eating this particular chocolate covered bacon bar for years. It's the only chocolate covered bacon item that taste amazing. I love it and it's worth every penny. It's hard to find sometimes but when I do find it, I buy up all they have on the shelf. I have seen it for sale at World Market and higher end grocery stores. The saltiness of the Bacon mix with the sweetness of the milk chocolate makes this bar awesome and now that I am pregnant, I crave it all the time. I highly recommend.

Someone with celiac disease shared these cookies with me a long time ago and I've been craving them since!  I LOVE the fresh lemon flavor and rich texture of these shortbreads. Now that I am also off gluten I'm SO GLAD that I can still eat Pamela's Lemon Shortbread cookies. They're wonderful with cream tea! My mouth is watering right now.

The miracle of living pain free for the first time in years!
I have just reordered this fabulous juice. The anti-inflammatory promise of tart cherry juice has changed my life.
After trying numerous brands, i find that this performs the best for me.1/2 a cup twice a day really does keep my arthritis pain at bay.
I have recommended this to numerous people, most of whom have had great results.
Put it out and it immediately started catching flies like crazy.  Love it. And the smell is not a problem.

MY BOYFRIEND AND I BOTH LOVE THIS TEA. ITS GREAT HOT OR COLD, NO SUGAR OR WITH THE WORKS. WE GO THROUGH IT AT QUITE A CLIP, SO IT'S VERY CONVENIENT TO ORDER IT BY THE CASE, AND A SAVINGS TOO. IF YOU'VE NEVER TRIED ARIZONA GREEN TEA WITH MANDERIN YOU SHOULD.  IT'S WONDERFUL.

These are delicious! Nutty, sweet but not too sweet, just perfect. They aren't easily found in stores so I am stocking up. I like to keep a few in the car and one in my purse. The protein in the bars are a nice blend with the sweet. I never feel like I am eating junk. The ingredient list is minimal. No soy lecithin or partially hydronated oil. Okay, so they have 6 grams of sugar in them, but that is better than most snack bars or even yogurt.

I haven't had a chance to call the company to ask about overseas product in this, but I will.
I like these because it's easy to cut them into small training size treats. If I can find out if it's all USA source ingredients I'll give these treats a 4.5.
This stuff rocks!!! I've had it at two different spas and I just love it. It's tart and really unusual. A real treat.

While living in the UK in 1981, I was sitting in church with an USAF family, (Norm and Bonnie Kapaska),who were stationed nearby. "Momma" Kapaska, asked me if I wanted a Gummy Bear.
I said "huh"?
She Handed me a handfull of Haribo Gold Bears.
Now for 27 years I have been an addict, but life is a little sweeter because of that Sunday!

I have not tried this coffee for expresso, but for regular coffee taste... be it in a french press or drip.... this stuff is simply ZERO.  Now of course that is only MY taste and MY opinion, but it is an honest one.

Quaker Soft Baked Oatmeal Cookies are so good! They taste like a homemade cookie! If you want that right out of the oven taste try heating up the cookie for about ten seconds. It will be warm and soft!

Summary: love the ingredients, wish it was organic.
Text: This product has the type of ingredients I look for in a dog food...I just wish it was organic. My dog does love it. He has a sensitivity to many foods, but no problems with this brand.
This has a bit of a hard time standing up to coffee, but it's a good syrup for sodas.

Great tea, but everyone knows that as Yogi teas are available in grocery stores across the country. I got a great deal on 6 boxes though, and for me that's not a whole lot to buy at once. Quick shipping as well.
we have been purchasing the sugar daddy's for awhile - this last batch for soft and chewy.  They should be hard...so they must have been old!!!!!!!!!!!!
Love, love, love this!  I've been eating it nearly every day for breakfast for about a year now.  Nice to see that I don't have to go to BJs to get it anymore!

If you like really sweet chocolate bars, this might be for you.  However, it's advertised as special dark, which is false advertising.  It's only 45% cocoa; real dark chocolate is 70% or more.  This is a scam.

I was having a hard time finding authentic Harissa and I finally found it.  I highly recommend Mina. Very flavorful and delicious. Totally reminds me of our amazing trip to Morocco. It is so hard to find real Harissa and This definitely hit the mark.
This is my absolute favorite nut. It's so hard to find in the stores and even harder to keep in my house since everyone loves it. Great flavor.
I like the slight pineapple flavor in this better than the plain coconut water. Good well chilled. Coconut water is supposed to be a healthy drink.

I originally bought the glaze at a local produce store, but they stopped selling it. I'm so glad I found it on Amazon. I love this glaze, a balsamic vinegar reduction, so much that I've purchased many bottles of it and have given it to friends to enjoy.  They, in turn, are now buying it. It's PERFECT on tomatoes and mozzarella.  My personal favorite is the glaze with cherry, but I'm sure all varieties are equally as good. Verrrrry yummy!!

I love these! I was disappointed when my local supermarket stopped selling these.
They are so easy and taste great. Easy to make in the morning when I'm in a hurry.

Parthenon sent me these Turkish olives by mistake; I had ordered the Greek ones by Angel that are in a glass jar.  I can seen why Ziyad CANS these instead of using glass.  Nobody would buy these brown-spotted, small olives floating in an unappetizing 'stew' of what looks like lemon wedges and a few green finger peppers.  The flavor is reminiscent of tin, with sour lemon. UGH !  Too much of a hassle to pay to mail them back, I just accepted a refund because these olives cost less than the brand I ordered, and much deservedly so.  If I could give them a zero rating, I would.
Ive shopped around a lot and this is the best price I have found online.

This was a gift to my wife for valentine's day and she really liked it.  I was worried the lavender would be overpowering on some of the products, but it's a good balance between noticeable and pleasant.  The sponges/scrubbers are big enough to get the job done - about the size of a hand each.  The mix of items is great for enjoying a bath and lathering on some moisturizers afterward.  The potpourri is bigger than you can tell from picture - at least a liter in volume. The containers are all pretty nice and easy to use.  None of the included items seem cheap or useless.  Finding a nice bathrobe and some candles to compliment this gift basket would really make a special romantic present.
Very happy with the Scottish Breakfast Tea; I hadn't tried it before. It's good hot with milk and as an iced tea with lemon. I'll order it again.

I'm delighted that it's now possible to get Teisseire Mint Syrup here in the US.  Add a bit to ice cold water, and make your own "menthe a l'eau". Mix with sparkling "limonade" or ginger ale for a "diabolo menthe". You'll feel like you're back in Paris sitting at an outdoor cafe. It's delicious!
I take candy to work with me often, but nothing has ever gone over as well as Coconut M&Ms!  People fight over them.  They are delicious with a coconut flavor that is not too overwhelming.  Mmmm....

These are great almonds, especially in these 1.5 oz packages.
I introduced these to my boss and he loves them too.
Great portion control packs.

I really like this version of the Oberto Beef Jerky.  It's not too dry and is quite tasty.  I get it for snacks at work, high protein, low fat and it satisfies my craving something salty so I'm not tempted to buy a bag of chips to nibble on.

We drink lots of Crystal light products,  but my family loves the peach iced tea.  I find it a bit too sweet myself,  so I buy it for them.  This was on sale and I just bought it to see how it would taste.  I like it much better than the peach tea - it's less sweet and has less of that cloying after taste.  It's a  happy find for our household - iced tea with a better level of antioxidants and a nice, not too sweet taste.
My husband ordered these and they are gross.  It's been months and we still haven't finished them because we don't like them very much.  Nissin brand tastes much better.

Summary: I need an IV Drip of Sumatra
Text:
You know what's sad? At the time of purchasing this, I was a Starbucks employee, and this was less expensive than the same product on the actual starbucks site.... with my partner discount included!

Danielle chips are just delicious.  They are also all natural and have no chemicals, preservatives or additives...such a rare occurrence nowadays. I also love that they are a US company right out of Boston, MA...my hometown!! Great value, great product!!

I love this curry paste!  It is very flavorful, quick and easy to make.  Since it is a paste, you can add whatever you like.  I usually make two packets at a time with half chicken and half chickpeas or white beans.  I also like to add sauteed onions and extra curry powder.  It is very tasty.

Summary: True European Taste-Wonderful Cocoa, but Pricey
Text:
This cocoa is a wonderful, rich tasting, not overly sweet, decadent product. Made with milk, it is delicious and one can adjust it to their liking with more or less cocoa and/or milk. That said, since it is already pre-mixed with sugar, this is an extremely expensive product. Green and Black recommends 4 teaspons per cup, which means this little canister will only make a few cups.

I grew up in Britain and cannot drink Swiss Miss or Nestle cocoas as they have no cocoa flavor at all, and are ridiculously sweet. This is a wonderful product, but if buying Green and Black's cocoa, I prefer the straight cocoa powder with which I can mix my own sugar. I can then afford to have good cocoa (hot chocolate) without breaking my piggy bank ;)

I absolutely loved this cookie. I received this as a free sample but I couldn't just have one so I went out on a search for them and found them at my grocery store. I was so happy because that one big cookie was everything I have been looking for, not too sweet, not too bland, not salty, not too many rasins and most of all not many calories. The perfect snack, especially with a cup of tea and a book...

Summary: Sugar Free Part is Okay, But the Recipe Isn't
Text:
I buy sugar free products a lot, and it is hard to find sugar free barbecue sauce. I held out hope for this, and indeed did use the whole bottle. I hate to waste things, and I am generally very easy to please. I won't buy another though because the stuff just doesn't taste like barbecue sauce. In my opinion, it has nothing to do with the artificial sweeteners either. Whatever they are doing with the rest of the recipe just isn't getting the job done.

If you have NO other choices, maybe you could give it a try yourself. I do see some others love it, so maybe you would, too. However, if you have a choice, choose the other brand(s) first before bothering with this.

Summary: Hodgson Mill Whole Wheat Whole Grain - Spinach Spaghetti
Text:
I purchased this pasta because I wanted a whole grain whole wheat pasta to eat with my organic pasta sauce.

Thank you!

Summary: Great alternative to traditional popsicles/ice cream treats!
Text: I was looking for something more natural than traditional frozen treats for my kids to enjoy during the summer, and found Smooze on Amazon and had to try it.  Overall, they are pretty fantastic.  You do need to make sure you shake them REALLY well before freezing or they can get pretty icy and less creamy.  My kids (8,6 and 3) are pretty picky, so I was worried they would reject these.  They love them and we have already devoured the first 2 boxes!  Highly recommend!
My yorkies pretty much love all the flavors. I am very happy having something in a reasonable size serving that is healthy. I usually give out two at a time per, twice a day.

My son is allergic to peanuts, so when I saw this I had to try it because I LOVE peanut butter.  The taste is a little different, but the texture is the same.  It works great in recipies, but if you use it in cookies, sometimes it'll turn green -- tastes the same though!!  I wish they sold it in stores around here!!

Never cooked with cardamom before, so I had no idea how strong it is. We use it to make gallons of spiced tea every week, and it works great. A tiny amount makes this much tastier than the regular cardamom ceylon tea I used to buy.
Been feeding my pups this for years and love it. They have never had problems with it and have put on some weight(they are lazy half the time,lol) I would recommend it to anyone with animals.
Taco Bell Taco Seasoning is the BEST and I can't find it at the grocery store any more.  I was thrilled to find it at amazon!  Thank you, Thank you!

A pleasant, orange flavored gummy candy. Not as artificial as most domestic (US) candies, very bright flavor. Good texture, soft, not sticky (no lost fillings here). A bit pricey for my taste.

Well worth a try if you like this kind of candy.

Freeze-dried liver treats are easy to carry around in a treat pouch, don't have to be refrigerated and, so far as I know, are healthy, high-protein snacks without a lot of chemical additives and preservatives. All of those attributes are nice but wouldn't be so important if the dog didn't like them. Our dog, who gets lots of small, bite-size treats as part of his continuing training, gets tired of diced sausage-shaped moist food from the pet store and cut-up franks from the grocery, but he'll run a mile for a liver treat! I do wish they were smaller and/or less expensive. We usually cut them in quarters with a sharp knife to make them last longer.
Why would anyone pay 11.80 for one of these when it's a couple of bucks in the local supermarket?  Who are they kidding?

Summary: Cats love it; I hate the pouches.
Text:
Whiskas came up with a winner as far as my cats are concerned; they love all three of the "Purrfectly Chicken" varieties.

The pouch it comes in, however, has to be a cost-saving thing because it is totally terrible. It is messy, and the only way to get all the food out is to dig it out with a spoon, and dig some more, and dig some more.

I'd give it 5 stars for the food, and 1 star for the package. I know that averages out to 3 stars, but there is no other food that my cats will eat day after day, so one more star for that.

Summary: like shortbread, but with much more flavor and spice
Text:
Newtons Fruit Thins Fig and Honey cookies are really good. They remind me of shortbread, but with much more flavor and spice. I also appreciate the healthy ingredients, like whole wheat flour, dried fruit, honey, and there is NO corn syrup added. Three of the delicious cookies contain only 5 grams of fat and 8% of your daily fiber.

Bits of the dried figs tend to stick in my teeth, but I still really enjoy the flavor and texture of this snack, and I will definitely buy them again and try the other flavors as well.

If you have two or more cats that like this catmilk, this is a very good bulk deal at the right price.

Decent wintergreen soda, but not muck like root beer, although the stuff smells great.

This drink tastes pretty much like how I like my coffee, except it is cold. The sweetness is there however it does not hide the coffee flavor--it is still strong and stands out. Summary: Glad to see more gluten free Annie's
Text:
My kids plowed through a box of these last night. We all loved them. They have a perfect cinnamon flavor that is a nice change from the typical vanilla and chocolate cookies.
I will be buying these regularly.

My favorite way to eat these little gems is sprinkled over vanilla yogurt or vanilla pudding.  (I crunch the bag to make crumbs.) Text: Yes, these taste surprisingly good, but more importantly they have a 35% of the RDA of fiber in every bar. The salt content is still ridiculously high so I have to limit the salt content in my foods for the rest of the day. Summary: Best I Have Used So Far...
Text:
I usually purchase this from my neighborhood Whole Foods Store. I saw it on here for a comparable price and was going to order something anyway and added it to my order. I started purchasing this brand because it has no alcohol base unlike a lot of the other brands that I have tried, it's more reasonably priced, it doesn't seem (at least to me) to have that bitter aftertaste as strongly as some others and a little goes a long way. I use this in everything, even baking.

I noticed also that they sell a granulated "no bitterness" baking blend of this brand on Amazon and will have to give that a go as well. A bottle usually lasts me about 6 - 8 weeks (I drink herbal tea on a daily basis) as long as there is no holiday involved...lol.

Found this in the grocery store while looking for a healthy (read: no artificials, has whole grain) mix for the kids. It was so easy and so good that it's the only mix we use. Heck, we use it to make cookies too at times.

I'll never use another product. They taste great, and they also have an oat & honey version of the flapjack mix that adds some variety.

Also, as others have noted while they are a little more expensive, we use less and any extras are used for snacks on trips to the zoo, etc.

I also like that it's just a 50/50 ratio of mix & water, so they are a breeze to make either for flapjacks or waffles, though I tend to make it a little thinner for pancakes.

Summary: Best of the Vue coffee. Imo

Summary: A Nice Alternative to Spoon Size Shredded Wheat
Text:
One of the things I appreciated about this product is no sorbitol included; all of the sweetness comes from natural sources including brown sugar and sugar. The grains are all whole grain and include a broad spectrum of vitamins. The size of the individual squares is smaller than one typically gets with a shredded wheat product and they maintained their crispiness much longer. The sodium content is reasonably low at 190 mg and the dietary fiber is respectable at 5 grams as is the protein at 6 grams.

The taste is pleasant and that, along with the sustained crispiness makes for a nice change from shredded wheat and raisin bran. This one is worth a try.

Summary: Great orange soda without being too sweet
Text:

Summary: Dog loves it - do you need as much as the package says?
Text:
Our collie is a fairly picky eater and his mom gives him chicken to supplement and to encourage him to eat his food.
No need for that with Chef Michael's, he has liked it from day 1.

The only part we haven't worked out is whether you really need to feed as much as the bag says.
At 1 cup per 10 pounds we'd be feeding him 7 cups a day, which seems like way too much.

I also liked that the carbonation is not quite as heavy as some sodas.  My family of four tried it and we all decided that we would buy this brand again.

Our dog however thinks they are great so we cut them up in small pieces and hide them around for him or forage out by smell.  After about a week the contents of the bag start to mold. Text: Sumatra has a full, syrupy body with virtually no acidity - so the coffee's intensity lingers in your mouth. The concentrated spicy, herbal notes and earthy aroma are the telltale signatures of this well-loved coffee. This is by far the best cup of coffee that I have found so far.

I love my sleep and nap time.  Especially because I work night shift as a nurse.  Working nights I have to sleep during the day which is near impossible with the sun beeming on me.  With one can of Koma I just knock the hell out.  Love this drink.  =)

Tastes great; healthy; easy to fix.  What more could you want?  Not only do I give an A+ rating to Bob's Red Mill Products, but my sister worked for Bob for years and not only praises his products, but says great things about the man and his business ethics.
I love this chocolates, they taste great and amazon has the best price so i definitely buy again.

I've been trying a lot of different coffee beans lately and this is one of the best.  I would rate this up there with Kona coffee from Hawaii.  This is delicious coffee and I make it with an Aeropress coffee maker.  I will try the French press with these coffee beans tomorrow but I know this will be delicious.  It is not bitter, have a very good french vanilla taste, and the smell is amazing.  I love the smell of this bean when you open the bag and when its steeping in the hot water.  I will deifnitely be ordering this coffee bean again.  I will also be trying more coffee beans from Eight O' Clock cofee.

Text: My dog was hot. I gave him the bun to eat, hoping that it would cool him down. He seemed to be panting as much after eating the bun as he did before. I would have to say that the "hot dog bun" did not do a good job helping my dog keep cool. In the future, I will stick with giving my dog water.

Text: This portion controlled snack is really great when you need something crunchy but still lower carbohydrate and calories.  Eaten with a protein it helps keep my blood glucose levels in line.

The scoop seems pretty large for one serving, also, I have to mix it with at least 16oz. of water otherwise it is just too thick and clumpy. Summary: Sweeter and a bit dry in places but good
Text: I have had Blue Ribbon figs for years in the store.  They were usually a bit more moist than these, perhaps because of packaging (they were in plastic bags like the ones prunes and other dried fruit come in while these are in tubs).  The figs are sweeter and more consistent than the other local source i have for figs here in Utah, and that I like.  These are not as moist as they were long ago, but similar to those days, you will have the occasional fig that's got sort of a dried, tough, perhaps sunburnt edge.  That just comes with the fig territory if you like to eat them out of hand as I do.  Overall - this is a great item to have on hand, a nice change from raisins or craisins, and very yummy.

The best I have ever found! Great chicken flavor with the convenience of a small box full of small packets filled with concentrate. Each packet makes one cup of broth - or use it undiluted to enrich the flavor of any sauce or gravy. It's a bit pricey, but well worth it.

Koala Crisp is a delicious gluten free cereal. It is crispy and has a nice chocolate flavor. It's cheaper than a lot of gluten free cereals I have seen, close to almost half the price. It is a bit higher in sugar content, but sometimes we all want something sweet. And there is more in the box than some cereals. (the ones that are twice the price. Doesn't seem fair does it?) Anyway there is a fun game board for kids on the inside of the box.  Highly Recommended!
This is a favorite side dish for both of my kids.  It's easy to prepare and it makes a great filling for meatless stuffed peppers, too.
but slightly overpriced my one kitty last 3 month more or less with only 2 to 3 pound bags I recently purchased this from petsmart for 8 dollars for a 2 pound bag
This is some of the best BBQ sauce ever. Spicy is Spicy. The original is great also. The one called smokin' is ok, just seems so spicy it covers up the meat. Give it a try.
I really enjoy this product--I just purchased my second bag.  It makes wonderful pancakes and banana nut muffins.  Thank you, Atkins, for a better way!

With English parents, I grew up drinking many many pots of tea. I used to hold Earl Grey as may favourite until I stumbled across Lady Grey.  If you enjoy Earl Grey you will love this tea.  The aroma is magnificent and the flavour excellent.  It is smoother that Earl Grey and even when over brewed lacks the acidity and overpowering tannins that darker blacks can produce.  The nose of the tea greatly enhances the drinking experience.  Don't miss out on a possible favourite!

Summary: It Tastes Like Spicy Catalina Dressing
Text: I guess if I had no other taco sauce to flavor up a taco, I'd be okay reaching for this bottle, but it wouldn't be my top choice at all.  As a taco sauce, it tastes too much like Catalina salad dressing, but spicier, which makes me think I might have liked this better, had it been presented to me as a salad dressing instead of a taco sauce.  I don't love it, I don't hate it, but I wouldn't buy it for my Tex-Mex dining pleasure.
I bought this mostly because i wanted the peppermint hot cocoa, but i fell in love with the milk chocolate one.  The peppermint was pretty good as well...good cocoa!!!

I purchased these K-cups on sale recently on Amazon.  Unfortunately there weren't any product reviews available yet, so I took a risk.  I am fairly certain these cups contain instant coffee.  I think that for a few reasons 1) if you shake these cups they have a distinctly different sound than K-cups of other types that I have.  It's as though the contents are dehydrated and take up significantly less space in the cup than the others; 2) The coffee comes out of the machine initially as dark sludge, then as almost clear water.  Obviously these extremes mix together in the mug; and 3) the flavor reminds me a lot of instant coffee.  Not undrinkable, but not something I would buy again, even if it were on sale.
This package is a good mix of dried fruit and not just mostly raisins as many are. The price at Amazon is better than anywhere else I've checked.
My 8 year old is real picky with rice.  This one was ready in 60 seconds and passed the test.  So i will be ordering more to have ready to go at the pool, hotel, or even at home.

Born and raised in Michigan, I grew up with Vernors. Mom would give it to me and my siblings when we had the flu or upset stomachs. I used it for party punches and ice cream floats.

Vernors is a Michigan original, having flavors of vanilla, ginger and oak to give the "Original Ginger Soda" a taste that is "Deliciously Different"

Living in Wyoming now, I don't get to have Vernors that often, only getting enough when I'm home for a visit. I alwasy bring enough back with me that I can have enough for myself and use it at school for special activities. It's become my little way of keeping part of home with me.

read about manuka honey online, and have bought this brand ever since then.  tastes great, and is amazing for skin, tummy, etc.  love it.

They are always soft and juicy and taste wonderful.  The whole bag is only 2 points on the Weight Watchers points system.  Happiness in a bag.  That is what I call these olives.

This hemp milk is very tasty. It isn't too sweet but it has a very pleasant vanilla flavor. I blend it with my Garden of Life - RAW Meal, 2.6lb tub in the morning. The flavor of the hemp milk makes the Raw Meal a little easier to stomach.

Summary: Great product, works like a charm!
Text:
These treats are a great little invention! Our very energetic 1 year old kitty named Harley Quinn was absolutely not allowing us to give her liquid medicine, and forget pills! We did some research and came across these pill pockets, and boy do they do the trick! She actually comes and waits expectantly for her little pill treat twice a day. I never thought I'd see the day a cat would want medicine!

I love this product and whole-heartedly recommend!

NOTE: I use needle-nosed pliers to insert the pill into the pill pocket, then seal it nice and tight. I never let the pill touch my hands nor the outside of the treat, so no pill scent is left behind.

I bought these in the grocery store because I was looking for a good snack to eat with the roasted red pepper hummus I had just bought. They were on sale, so I thought I'd give them a try. So glad I did! I absolutely love these chips. They're nice and hearty, which means that in addition to them being filling, they don't break up as much in the box. I'm losing weight and counting calories, so it makes it much easier when I can tell exactly how much a portion size is. The serving size of 11 crisps goes perfectly with 2 tbsp of hummus.

I bought this tea as a Christmas gift for my mother. I also got another one tin for myself. Both of us really enjoyed this tea. It has a nice flavor. It can easily be brewed twice.
Also something I thought was odd is that the tin has two lids. When you open one lid, there is a smaller opening on the inside with another lid in it. I had never seen this before, but I'm sure it makes it very air tight.

This is so good! I blend just a tablespoon into a cup of plain yogurt and mix it with blueberries. It makes the best snack ever!! I could eat it raw, but of course that probably wouldn't be too good for me. Can't wait to mix it with my oats! I'm lovin' this stuff!

Text: We love our SodaStream and have found several of the mixes we like including the Root Beer.  It is not as good as A&W root beer but it makes a great root beer float.  It does not taste overly sweet, nor does it leave you with a chemical after taste.  Plus it is nice that you can control how much syrup you add to play with the flavor a bit.  I would recommend at least trying this syrup and definately use it for a root beer float!

They had not only the original spice blend, but a couple of other variations as well.  Delish!

I have to be careful and "parcel" these out into individual snack bags or I'll eat way too many! They have a nice vanilla yogurt flavor, with just enough crunch and salt from the pretzel.

The expiration date is far enough out (I purchased these in mid-August 2010; the expiration date is the end of June 2011) that I'll be able to finish these off before they expire, sometimes a concern when I purchase in quantity like this.

I'm very pleased with these, and I'll likely purchase them again.

We LOVE these chocolate chips! I suffer from a dairy allergy and these are my absolute favorite chocolate chips. They are ever better than the regular ole' chocolate chips. And they make super yummy cookies!

Since the demise of "Mr. Milkman" powdered milk, I have looked for a comparable product. Nido instant milk was suggested to me by other grieving former Milkman customers and I am so glad I tried it. It has good whole milk quality. Excellent taste and texture, especially compared to the low or no fat powdered milks that you find in the grocery store, which taste like chalk. (Try finding powdered WHOLE milk at your local store - good luck!)

It's perfect to add to a hot beverage. It blends easily. (This specific product does NOT have added sugar. Beware, a children's version of Nido does.) Although it is not Mr. Milkman, it's a close second. And I am very grateful that I have found it.

Summary: A Delicious and Interesting addition to the snack bar world
Text: These bars are crunchy and not soft like many others which is their key differentiating factor.  The crumble apart approach seemed to give this a more substantial feel than other bars as I crunched through them.  Nice flavor in that they are not too sweet, but sweet enough.  I love the fact that they are simple and straightforward with 100 calories.  You can eat these relatively guilt free and they were excellent for me when going out the door in the morning to get something in my stomach on the way to work and eat while driving.  A really nice addition to the sometimes bland snack bar world.  Highly recommended!

great product.  made in the usa.  the sticks are long but can be easily broken up into smaller pieces for little dogs.

Summary: Cost effective solution for low budget home recording
Text:
A great tool for low budget home recording. I mic every track to Audacity. I use a low budget dynamic mic and the Icicle gives the right boost for PC recording. I keep the gain at 90 to 100 percent and do volume control on the PC.
I see some complaints out there about durability. Keep in mind it is a piece of computer hardware like a modem or an external hard drive, NOT something that you would use onstage or throw into a gig bag. Another plus is no drivers or setup. That's important to me when I get home from work and want to record a tune. Just plug it in and go!

Summary: The aroma and taste is enough
Text: When first unwrapping the 11 oz. Package of Melitta's Cafe Collection Classique Supreme Ground Coffee, the aroma may bring about the anticipation of what to expect from this brand. With its mild and not as strong taste as a regular cup of Starbuck's, coffee drinkers familiar with Folgers' Gourmet Selections may find this brand as comparable.  Indeed, a coffee worth trying.

Candace from Rochester NY
