Summary: Better if you don't think of it as a mojito.
Text:
Mojitos are my favorite drink, so I thought I'd try this version. I didn't expect much, so I wasn't disappointed to find that it just doesn't taste like a real mojito. How could it?? Mojitos are made with fresh lime and mint, not with chemicals. I even like mine with a real sugarcane stirring stick.

Since I wasn't expecting the real thing, I found that I enjoyed this drink if I didn't think of it as a mojito. It's cloyingly sweet at first, and has that sweetener aftertaste at first, but after I got used to it I found that I enjoyed it as a nice lime-y minty koolaid kind of thing.

I'd suggest doctoring it up a bit with some real mint, if you have it. I grow it in the backyard -- very easy to grow and hard to kill!

I made these according to package directions, and added 1 cup of mini chocolate chips, and they were awesome!  They took longer to cook than the box says, maybe that's because of the chocolate chips.  Either way, they were great and I'll definitely make them again.
I gave these a try for the great price.  Unfortunately in this case, you get what you pay for.  Other more popular well known Keurig brand is MUCH better.

Summary: Bitter and delicious, great quality, and helps animals too.
Text: I love the Endangered Species brand of chocolates. I used to buy them at Target, but my store quit carrying them. I love the 88% Dark Chocolate as it is rich, a bit bitter, but loaded with delicious chocolate flavor. The company only uses 100% ethically traded cocoa beans, and gives a percentage of it's profits to helping endangered animals. I had tried other dark chocolate bars before as high as 86% but have never found a brand that tasted as good as Endangered Species. Every piece of their chocolate has a good consistency and tastes like a very high quality chocolate. I would recommend their chocolate highly.

Good quality ingredients, a very good value in dry dog food.  I feed my dog high quality kibble like this and I also make about half her food.  Variety in dog food is recommended, dogs can develop allergies to food otherwise.

I bought a can of this baby corn from Whole Foods last week to try it out before committing to 6 cans.
The color, texture and taste of the corn was good, so I am back at Amazon to buy the 6 pack.
They are very tasty and actually very filling which I was skeptical about.  I have a shake for breakfast and a meal bar for lunch.  Then i'm good to go!

This is a treasure of the absolutely finest quality chocolate confections. Have had these since my childhood in UK. You will not be disappointed with this choice. Buy and enjoy. Received them in very short time.
Great item for the price....although finding funnel cake mix was a problem and wished the company also sold that.  Would recommend this item.

This is the best instant coffee I've had. I've tried Folgers, no good. Maxwell House, a little better. Nescafe Classico, pretty darn good. Jacob's Cronat Gold is the best!
This decaf. is very hard to find. I could not find it in grocery stores.  Finally thanks to Amazon I have found it and at a GREAT price.  Love it, love it, love it. I WILL order it again.

Summary: Must have in every baby food cupboard
Text: My 3 1/2 month old was eating all the time and reconstituted rice cereal with breast milk just wasn't doing the trick. Summary: "Best by" date -is not- over a year ago
Text:
I originally wrote: "Just received our order on 4/22/11, and all four packages have a "best by" date of 4/16/10. Not so great."

Well, I found out the that there are two codes at the bottom. Although one appears to be a date - APR1610 or something like that - it's not. The other code, which looks less like a date, is the "best by" date.

So I stand corrected, and I'm having a tasty, dark, smokey cup of joe to wash down my shame.

Summary: Great tasting and very easy to make
Text:
It doesn't get much simpler than this. All one has to do is put the pod in the Senseo coffee maker, fill it up with water, press the button for one or two cups and, less than two minutes later, you have yourself some great-tasting coffee.

The machine itself is not expensive and the pods, while not cheap, aren't very expensive, either.

While Senseo is the equivalent of espresso (it looks and tastes strong), the coffee itself will not have you bouncing off the walls. It gives you just the right amount of zing to go about your day.

Senseo is definitely worth a try (but, beware, there is the tendency to love this coffee). - Donna Di Giacomo

Great product.

Don't overdue it with the pump.  I have used the sugar-free French vanilla and sugar-free caramel, I find the regular vanilla to be the best.

I love the taste and smell of bold coffee.  Nothing bugs me more than anticipating a delicious cup of bold coffee, only to taste a bitter, tasteless cup of hot stuff.  I tried several of the K cups, searching for a coffee that was worthy.  This is it!!  I love waking up in the morning , sticking the pod in the warmed up machine (I set it on the timer), and brewing this delicious cup of bold - not bitter - coffee!  My very favorite!!  By the way.. some of the reviewers say it is super strong.  I don't agree.  I've had stronger, and still very delicious cups of coffee!  Don't let it scare you.  It's not THAT strong.  Enjoy!

I find this to be the closest more natural sweetener to using sugar for my hot or cold beverages.  It is at least twice as sweet as sugar so one level teaspoon works for me where I might of used 2 rounded teaspoons of sugar. For people who wish to save some money on this, since it is pricy, I find that mixing this 50/50 with Splenda for baking, which is a granulated mix of sugar and Splenda, works very well and is hard to tell its not really just plain old sugar. And also keeps the one teaspoon proportion. So in one teaspoon you are only actually using 1/4 teaspoon of sugar, for anyone who is watching their sugar intake, plus that 1/4 teaspoon is the sweetness equivalent of 2 teaspoons of sugar.
I get a pack of 6 items every month.  I love the taste.  It takes only 90 sec. in the microwave to cook it.

Being diabetic, it's nice to have a salty\crunchy snack that doesn't raise your blood sugar. The trick with these is to spread them out in a SINGLE layer on a paper towel(and a plate, these things get HOT). Depending on the microwave you have (power wise) I've made them in a 700W microwave and they take right at 4 min. and I've used a 1500W microwave that only took 2.5 min. Don't be afraid to under cook, just keep adjusting the time up 20 sec. or so until they all puff up. I like to take the finished ones off the plate and continue cooking the ones that haven't finished, that seem to take away the burning problem.
These come out fresh and hot, I can't even LOOK at the nasty bagged ones in the store anymore!!

This product is marketed not as a candy but as a vitamin and energy booster. In reality it is a honey candy; it's first two ingredients are sugar and corn syrup. As it is honey, the packaging was pretty sticky and a couple drops had to be discarded because I could not peel the plastic wrapper off the drop.

The take home message is that if you like honey then this is good candy for you. If you are looking for vitamins and energy, look elsewhere.

Text:

I love Earl Grey tea--long before the Captain of the Enterprise made famous those words: "Earl Grey, hot." I have had some lovely Earl Greys over the year but have wanted a decaf version. Enter Twinings Lady Grey tea.

Lady Grey is a very pleasant tea. It is smooth and has a very mild taste. I did find that I need to use 2 bags in my mug to get that nice flavor--I suspect that one bag would be sufficient if you use an actual 4-6 oz tea cup.

Unfortunately, the mildness was just a bit too mild for me. I prefer a more robust bergamot flavor to my tea and will order the decaf Earl Grey next time.

Overall a very pleasant and enjoyable surprise and one I will be definitely buying again.

Summary: Amazon's ingredients list is VERY wrong
Text:
I am so disappointed that the manufacturer has drastically changed the formulation of this food. It can no longer be considered a healthy food. Amazon has not changed its info, which is irresponsible because customers are buying based on the info presented here. The real ingredient list is:

Lamb Lungs, Wheat Flour, Sugar, Lamb, Wheat Bran, Lamb Hearts, Salt, Rice Flour.

So basically, it's like feeding your dog a lamb-flavored doughnut. Sugar as the third ingredient?! More sugar than actual lamb? Why not just label it "lamb candy"...?

Sad. My dog loved this food. Well, no wonder, I guess. I love doughnuts, too... but I don't eat them.

If you like hotel lobby coffee and no rich aroma, then from the price it is not bad.

My daughter had been enjoying this hot chocolate while she was in California, and wanted to find it locally when she got home.  We weren't able to find it in any of the stores, so ordered it here.  It arrived quickly, was well-packed, and the product was fresh.  This Mexican hot chocolate is much more flavorful than the regular kinds, and we're looking forward to enjoying it all winter!

Summary: Uselss product. May as well spray water.
Text: 16 cats and not one even blinked an eye when I sprayed this on their toys and cat condo's. Uselss product. Will go back to buying straight honeysuckle spray available on Amazon. They were sold out for a while. Don't waste your money on this. It's totally useless.

Initially I was skeptical about this product. I mixed it and applied it as directed...and two days later, nothing had happened...then three days, then four...still nothing. It was about five days later that the weeds started wilting. It's been a week and a half now and all the weeds that I sprayed are dead and dry, all the way down to the root! Definitely worth it. And because it's a concentrate, a small amount goes a long way. Very happy with the purchase.

There is nothing fluffy about this product but the box appears to have a picture on the top that seems to advertise that way.  These are hard candy lollipops!  I had wanted cotton candy fluffy lollipops.  They also arrived with about 12 broken or cracked of the 48 in the box and likely came that way from the manufacturer.  Fortunately I only needed 33 for a classroom .. but I would never order these again.
A little too good me pants thinks.  Impossible to stop at one, cravings persist for days.  Prudence suggests abstinence.

Summary: Zero calorie, refreshing and cheap flavored seltzer
Text:
This product is fantastic. Basically, it's just zero calorie, flavored seltzer, so for those who love the carbonation of seltzer, but none of the nasty high fructose corn syrup, this is what you want and probably already buy at the supermarket.

But what makes this so great is the handy 16.9 oz bottle size to bring with you everywhere (as opposed to 2L seltzer bottles), the four-flavor variety pack and the fact that Amazon, at least when I bought this, is selling it cheaply, at about fifty cents a bottle. I'll definitely keep buying this as long as Amazon keeps stocking it and keeps the price reasonable.

Flavors included are: Lemon-line, berry, tangerine and natural (unflavored).

I was very disappointed in this product. I hoped to dissuade the chipmunks from eating the plants on my deck and to stop whatever kind of creatures were munching on and destroying some of my sunflowers in a small side garden in the yard. There did not seem to be any success in either place and I have to say, on my small sampling, that this product did not work as advertised.

Summary: Where have you "bean" all my life?
Text: I found these beans at a local grocery store and tried them for the first time.  I went on the bean company's website to find where I could buy a case of them.  They referred me to Amazon and I bought alot of them here.  Shared them with my sister and my daughters and they loved them, too.  You just gotta try them.  I add a bit of Cumin to them and they are better, by far, than ANY canned variety.

The Greenies Pill Pockets have made pilling so much easier for me and our cat Buffy. She doesn't even realize that she is getting her meds this way. She likes the chicken variety.
The Greenies Treats are also very popular at our house. The cats know the sound of the package being opened and all line up for their treats!!

I am very pleased that I chose to go with this sampler pack.  It arrived in a timely manner(5 days) and the packaging was as described.  The k-cups were all in good shape and none past expiration date.  The assortment was awesome!!  I actually recieved 52 cups, YAY!  I recieved 35 coffee, 12 tea and 5 hot chocolate.  Of the coffee, 18 were flavored(my favorite). I will definately be ordering this sampler pack again!!

Summary: Good product at a good price.
Text: Considering the shortage that we have had on pumpkin this last year, it was a blessing to see it available and at a good price. Yes some of the cans were dented, but big deal. My dog and I were able to enjoy. I hope it comes back out for purchase soon. I don't care about dented cans.

Summary: Best Veggie burger mix I have tried!
Text: I have been a Vegetarian for about a year now, so I am relatively new to the meat substitute market.  But this is by far the best Veggie burger mix I have tried.  Far better then any of the frozen patties you can get in grocery stores.  An added bonus is the versatility of the mix.  You can use it for many different things instead of just being stuck with patty form like the frozen variety.  My meat eating girlfriend really likes this as well, and she tends to be pretty picky.

SBC's French Roast is fantastic!  Yes, I'm a Seattle coffee snob, but after having lived in a lot of different places in the world (many of which grow and roast their own beans), this is my absolute favorite.  This is also my favorite amongst the various French roasts I've tried.  The taste is full bodied yet not bitter (unlike another MAJOR competitor's French roast) and the coffee is never cloudy in the cup.  I've been drinking this French Roast for a long time and have never experienced a weak roast as another reviewer cited.  I will be ordering this coffee again and again. I only wish it was on Subscribe and Save (hint, hint Amazon)!
Great value for 4 boxes (15 pieces of 3 flavors in each box, 15.8 oz per box) of soft, flavorful mochi. Subscribe and save makes it even a better value so thanks Amazon.com!!!

This is a really delicious cereal.  Natures Path usually has good stuff, so I can't say I'm surprised, but I find myself eating this as a snack as well as for breakfast. I love the Vanilla flavor and it stays crunchy in milk just like Kashi lean does.  I would definitely buy this again.

There is something wrong with these peaches.  We have purchased Sun Maid dried peaches from grocery stores and Walmart in the past, and they were wonderful.  These are absolutely FOUL tasting.  I also notice that Dried Peaches are no longer shown as one of Sun Maid's products on the Sun Maid web site.  We also no longer find them in our local grocery stores.  Note that Amazon DOES NOT ACCEPT RETURNS on food products, so I highly recommend against buying these.

Summary: Not overly sweet, but not great tasting either
Text: I reviewed a different flavour- the Kiwi Berry, which was pretty nasty. This Watermelon Strawberry faired a bit better. It wasn't cavity sweet, but it wasn't entirely pleasant either. I actually managed to finish the can. It is slightly carbonated, not nearly as much as regular soda, so I didn't mind it, and has 100% Vitamin C which is good. I'm not sure if I would recommend this product, or this line of products. Even those who like soda may not like something like this because of the false sweetness factor and those who live on water may not appreciate this new type of drink either-I certainly don't. I certainly don't think the price is worth it. Not even close.
Great homemade taste plus it's quick and easy to make!

Summary: GREAT PRODUCT IN PERFECT SIZE CAN!
Text: I have been drinking V-8 juice for many years. Ordering it from Amazon by the case with free shipping(Prime) allows me to have it on hand in a convenient can with the right amount for my needs.

These taste terrible. The Smoked Cheddar are unbearable to eat because they taste like you are eating a campfire. Do not buy these unless you want to eat something that tastes like fire. Absolutely disgusting.

There are delicious and filling. Full of protien and fiber along with a healthy dose of calcium and vitamins, this is a daily nutrition bar for me. Like already stated, these bars do not have any chalky or "health" bar taste or texture. They are crunchy and really satisy my candy bar cravings.
I was estatic when I seen that Splenda was coming out with Flavor Blends for coffee. I wasn't to fond of it after I got it. More sugary tasting .. not as expected, Very disappointed

Summary: This is our favorite k-cup coffee!
Text: We have tried many different types of K-cup coffee flavors and this is the one we keep coming back to.  Neither one of us cares for bitter, strong tasting coffee.  This has a mild, pleasant taste and it never varies from that. Definitely recommend!

I have a black and white tuxedo male that was living outside.  He had been horribly injured by racoons and possibly in a fight with another male cat.  After we took him to our vet where his extensive injuries were tended to. After he was neutered and he recovered, he had started developing what looked like dandruff on his coat.  After trying several foods, we came across this one.  I am happy to report he and his coat are doing great! He loves this food and his coat is so shiny and wonderful.  We named him Sylvester, he is just adorable.  The most cuddly thing in the world.  We are so happy to have him and so glad to have found a product like this for him.

These are and will always be delicious! they are hard to find and was pleased to find it on amazon at a great price! best price found anywhere. my kids love the chocolate but the vanilla were even a better deal and of course also delicious! give it a try, you won't regret it!

So excited that I can get this chai in bulk on Amazon.  It was the chai used in my favorite coffeehouse and I was beyond sad when they closed and I couldn't get it anymore.  Now I can skip the lines in the coffeehouse and it's way more affordable.  Thanks Amazon!

Once you try this piece of chocolate you will fall in love with it. Probably one of the best nonbar chocolates produced in Switzerland and Europe as a whole. And I think it is rather cheap for the quality you get.

I highly recommend these muffins.  I add one or two ripe bananas, in addition to some nuts and chocolate chips.  I'm sure this boosts the point value from 1 to 2 points, but it is worth it. They are very moist and the chocolate is a delicious addition with the banana.  They do not have a sugar-free taste.

Summary: Buyer Beware! Can injure your dog's teeth.
Text: I originally gave this item a glowing review--my dog loved it and it seemed a safe choice for his vigorous chewing. Unfortunately, having just taken my dog to the vet with a cracked tooth that had to be extracted, I must retract my original recommendation. My vet had just seen another dog that same day that also broke a tooth using an antler chew. My vet recommends rope chews as a safer (and softer!) alternative.

Summary: The best jerk seasoning, thank you for distributing in the US
Text: My husband and I had been to Jamaica 20 years ago and discovered Walkerswood, so when we went back 5 years later, we decided to buy a case, giving some away for gifts. We weren't concerned since they had a distributer in the US. We haven't been back to Jamaica since, but were saddened to find out that this product was no longer being distributed from their US plant, the phone number was disconnected.  Needless to say, we were thrilled to find it again.  We were a little skeptical to buy a case, since the packaging changed slighly, so we only bought 6 jars.  Anyhow, we are thrilled, it is the same stuff. YEAH!!!!! Thank you for bringing our little piece of Jamaica back.

My cat doesn't like this food that much but she'll eat way more of it than the KD food the vet prescribed. This food has a nugget texture which my cat prefers to the mush of the KD. I mix this 50/50 with an organic canned chicken type and my kitty is fairly happy.
Veryy good cheeze for fondue, from Switzerland. Quick delivery and it is the real thing!  very tasty.

My cats love these.
They don't just smell it and walk away.
Not to mention not having to paw @ it, as if it was their litter (for heaven sake).

Summary: Best Chocolate Coffee on the market
Text: I have tried several Gourmet chocolate coffee's and this is by far the best.  My wife agrees.  Very Chocolate tasting and a very smooth flavor. The chocolate smell while it brews is just icing on the cake. If you like chocolate, try it, if you like chocolate coffee, try it, if you like different gourmet coffee's, try it, if you want to experiment with something different with Folgers, try it.  You won't regret it.

As always Haribo Products are the best when it comes to taste. This product is hard to find but is great specially if you are into sour gummies.The only reason I give it 4 not 5 stars is the cost. over 5 dollars for a small bag (175gm-5.8 ounces) seems a little pricy to me.
These bags are cute! They are very durable and lightweight. Each bag rolls up to the size of a roll of quarters and fastens closed with a Velcro strap. Absolutely worth every penny!

Summary: disappointed it isn't hazelnut CREAM decaf
Text: The picture shows hazelnut CREAM decaf coffee, but I received plain ole hazelnut decaf.  The hazelnut decaf flavor is fine. I'm not sure there'd even be a taste difference, but I was really looking forward to experiencing the hazelnut cream flavor.
This tea smells like coffee but tastes terrible. It has no tea flavor, just a little weak cinnamon, burnt cocoa taste.

I am sucker for red licorice, always have been.  One day I looked at the ingredients on a pkg. of "red vines" and thought "Oh, my God", Yuk! Red Dye etc.; then I found these in my local grocery store and started purchasing them, they are all natural without dyes and a multitute of preservatives and they tasted great. Then, they disappeared from my grocery store and luckily I found them on Amazon.  I purchased for myself and my friend who loves them too.  They are slightly tart but taste great, nice and chewy, so I can enjoy this sweet treat without guilt.

A box of 5 for 9.99?
What happened to the case of 5 boxes for 37.95?
This single box price is a rip.
Its still the best of the 3 bars made.

Summary: Soft enough to chew, hard enough to suck
Text: These are good; soft enough to chew, hard enough to suck. It is also an acquired taste. I bought this size planning to share during the holidays. 3kg is a lot of salt licorice, especially when I discovered others aren't as receptive to it as am I. If you've never tried salt licorice before, order a smaller size. If you know you like it, this is a healthy supply.

I wanted to switch my two senior dogs (Sheltie mix and pit bull) to a better quality food, and originally was going to try the regular Organix, but the calorie count was too high because they are not highly active. I noticed the difference in their coats after the first month! Also bought the Organix treats, sticking with them! Now they are nice and shiny, and love the taste of the food!

I bought and tried the funky monkey snacks and I like them. They are handy to have around, no cutting, no peeling, just eat and go. I don't really care for fruit, so this is an ideal way for me to get my servings of fruit. I do think it is a little expensive, but I think of my health as a priority. These are also very handy if you travel. I took them on my last few flights for snacks. It felt better to eat the fruit snack than my usual chips and candy.
Also, these are different than your regular dried fruit, they are airy and crispy. The crunch is great and it's a little snack I can gobble up and feel ZERO guilt about.
We  enjoyed product  Arrived quickly  do not enjoy writing review  would prefer a check list of comments  more like feedback from ebay  good luck to all  from  Muriel  in  California

Blows all other GF pizza crust mixes out of the water.  My friends and family are more than happy to mow down on it over their traditional flour crust.  It is definitely important to spread the crust thin, as it will be a bit gummy if spread thick.  Namaste Foods has made pizza eating a joy all over again.

I usually love Darjeeling tea and Twinnings in general. I am not sure what the problem is with this latest batch, but it is very bitter. It almost to the point where I can't tolerate it. I don't understand it but this tea does look to be more cut and have more particles and "dust" than I remember.

I use the product now more than 3 years for all my cooking and everybody in my household or even people I cook for love it. In the summer we sprinkel a little salt over fresh cut up vegetable as cucumbers, tomatoes etc.the kids love their vegetable.
This is the most delicious coffee cake ever!  It is so moist and absolutely addictive!

I got this pancake mix in time for Jan 1st brunch. I did like the other reviewers advised and used buttermilk. We made plain, blueberry, and chocolate pancakes. They were tasty, fluffy and just plain YUM. My mom made pancakes from scratch (even sifting the flour) every Sunday morning for as long as I can remember - and Robby's are better!!!

The only reason I purchased this product was to have a natural sweetener as a substitute for sugar. The ingredients did NOT list sugar (on Amazon page), but when I received the shipment I saw that sugar was one of the ingredients.
My miniature Labradoodle just loves these.  I give her 1/2 at a time because she can rip through these like nobody's business.  I keep them around as a change of pace from the Nylabone Flexi-chews.

Summary: If the name says "variety" -- shouldn't there be some variety?
Text:
My real complaint is not with the coffee that's in the box, as much as with the coffee that isn't in the box. Time to break out the dictionary and look up "variety."

This is Green Mountain -- who make how many different varieties of flavored coffees in k-cups? 12? 16 during the winter months? How about a box with 2 of every favor? Or even 1 of every flavor available, including the regionals? That's variety. This is just too few of too few choices.

Summary: One of my favorite Panko bread crumb products
Text:
I have come to appreciate Panko bread crumbs. I use two different brands--both of which are very satisfying.

Bread crumbs are really good complements and ingredients for many dishes. I prefer Panko to the regular bread crumbs that one can purchase at the nearby grocery store. They add a better texture and provide a crunch that is delightful.

And this product is one of the better Panko bread crumb resources that I have run across.

Summary: Great flavor with lots of protein, but there is one problem...
Text:
We love these bars because they are low sugar and high protein for a reasonable amount of calories. However, some of the bars seem to be old or dried out, and one bar was very strange looking with spots all over it. I couldn't find an easy way to get a partial refund or replacement of only one out of ten bars, so that one bar was simply a waste of money. The product itself is excellent, but we're unsure whether we ultimately save money by buying it from Amazon when we may randomly have to throw away bad bars.

Bottom line: awesome product, but there are some issues with quality control.
Candy is not sour, like a previous review said, I had about 5 red in the tin.  Candy was sticky when opened, and for the $14 it cost (w/ shipping) I will not order again.
This is the best price, best tasteing stevia. Its also the healthiest sweetener I have found. I use it in shakes my kids cereal, coffee and a lot more.

Summary: Not For Little Kids Like Me
Text: My wife purchased this all natural dark chocolate and would give it five stars if she wrote a review. I on the other hand would much rather have sweet milk chocolate over this strong bittersweet taste. This chocolate has a bold taste that is very distinct. Reverie won't deliver a moment of timeless pleasure as they advertise, but if you are sophisticated like my wife, there is a good chance you'll like this stuff. However, if you think Reese's Peanut Butter Cups are da' bomb diggity, I suggest saving your money. Perhaps their Toffee Interlude would be more my flavor.

Summary: I drink more water now than ever before!
Text: I bought the Pomegranate Lemonade on the advice of a co-worker. It's wonderful: one package per 24 oz water bottle -- it's a little strong otherwise -- and I drink all the water my doctor could hope for!
Great Service and coffee was just what i expected, just like the one i like at 7-11.  So who ever likes blueberry coffee from 7-11, this one is it.  Thank you.

Bought this as a back-up to the Raid Flea Spray.  The trap worked well, fortunately we only caught a few as the spray seemed to take care of the problem.  Interesting concept to lure fleas into the trap.  Would recommend.
This is a great substitute for peanut butter. I have a child with a peanut allergy and we have been eating soy butter for 10 years. This is one of the best yet!

I discovered these chips while on a trip in Stamford, CT.  I have loved Stacy's pita chips for a while - so when I saw the bagel chips I was thrilled.  They are even better than the pita chips!  My only complaint is that I had to order them because they are not available in my area.  Also, they are kind of pricey - but for special occasions they are totally the best!!
This is the best tasting low calorie drink I've ever tasted.  I don't have anything else in the house!
The cheese taste is weak and slightly "off". It's okay if I add some cheese to it before serving. Much prefer Annie's.

Summary: Good, but not what the description said.
Text: The description said there are 5 flavors in this mix:  grape, lemon, lime, cherry and orange.  My bag had orange, apple, cherry/strawberry, strawberry/cherry...and that's it.  There's an orange one, a yellowish one (apple?), and two slightly different red/pink ones which I can't determine the exact flavor of.  However, they are good.  The apple? is especially good.  I'd get these again even though I'm not 100% certain of what flavors I'd receive.  Wouldn't matter...they're good regardless.

I love this jam because of it's unique flavor. Unlike many pear jams (which may be good, but different), this one has the distinctive flavor and aroma of Pear Williams liqueur. That being said, it does not have the flavor of alcohol, but the intense fragrance of pure, ripe pear.  It's not dark-colored as pear butter and many pear preserves are, but is golden and caramelized with purest pear flavor. If you love the wonderful flavor and fragrance of pears, you'll probably love this jam. Great with really good butter on hearty toast, or stirred into Greek yougurt!
Not gluten free which is a contradiction to the packaging label. These are also extremely greasy and leave a film of grease on your mouth. I got Celiac reaction from them. Be warned
What can I say? It came on time, was packed perfectly, and tastes great. No reason to buy this stuff from the grocery store, buy from Amazon!

Summary: These are nasty unless you cover them in dip
Text: Out of all the artisan blends this is the nastiest one. I am not sure the term flavor applies. Unless you dunk it in something. It is not satisfying. And it is a bit on the spicy side because of the garlic. I have tried them all. Being a lime tostito fan I have discovered the three cheese artisan blend to be a substitute. Yeah I know you are thinking lime to cheese? Well the blend included not only cheese, but garlic, oregeno, red pepper, and jalepeno amongst other spices. It has just that right Wang to it and the flavor is li,e a super dorito. And of course the southwestern blend is also a great choice, but the flame factor increase on this one. Not too hot, but as a non spicy person I had to put them away.

Summary: Wonderful... Every bit as good as you would get from a cafe.
Text: Great!  Make it all of the time.

I love lemonheads so I decided to try these chewy ones. I was very disappointed, the lemon ones are absolutely disgusting. The only thing that saved the purchase were the cherry and orange ones. I'll stick with a different candy.

I have used this product for many years in three different locations in the Boise, Idaho, area. We have a short growing season, so I use it to give tomatoes and peppers a boost. I apply it every two - three weeks during the summer and have excellent yields. A single box of this lasts me several growing seasons.

Summary: Still doesn't do it for me...
Text: With the consistency of Alka-Seltzer and that artificial sugar flavor in the back of your throat, this `Pink Lemonade' variation of the `eboost' product is really no better than what I experienced with the Acai Pomegranate flavor.  On top of that, there really is no boost to be had here (I'm still waiting to experience what others claim to experience).  It feels chalky going down and at times even makes my mouth pucker.  I think I preferred the `barely there' Pomegranate flavor to this one, actually.  I'm all for `all natural', but not if it tastes like this.  I'm sorry eboost, but I'm still not sold on your product.
Great cake mix.  Quick, no problems.  Small crumb and moist.  May have to bake a little more than recommended.

I love Thai food and when I saw this in the store I had to try it. I am SO glad I took a chance because this dish is super yummy! I used light coconut milk, pre-cooked chicken shortcuts, green beans and water chestnuts. It was easy and quick to throw together! My husband and I have careers that keep us super busy, but we like to cook at home instead of eat out all the time. This gives the feeling of eating out, but with all the comforts of home! I highly recommend it. The spice level isn't high, it is just enough. Jasmine rice is perfect with this (the 90 second bags keep everything fast and easy). Thank you so much Taste of Thai!! This is a *must* buy!!

This is an unbelievable deal. For the same price as the mystery cube o' leaves you find at Asian grocers or internet vendors, you get a full pound of Organic leaves. The Gunpowder Green has a hint of citrus, a hint of nuttiness, but most importantly, it tastes clean. You don't have to worry about undoing the health benefits of green tea with heavy metals or other pollutants in non-organic products. The 16 Oz. bag lasted me over two months with several strong cups per day. I highly recommend this tea.
I love having a soup that is healthy and not full of bad ingredients.  I like the chicken noodle better, but the rice is pretty good too.
My husband loves these cookies,he eats them most mornings and says they hold him over until lunch.  Easy to grab and go and not full of alot of junk.

This product is definitely for licorice lovers.  There is an abudance of flavor and a slightly dense texture which I prefer over softer, or gummy versions of licorice candies.  That makes this particular brand and form of licorice my very top choice at present.  I think it's unlikely I'll find one I like more any time soon.  I don't buy it often, but when I'm really in the mood for a licorice flavored treat this is the one for me.  Well done Haribo!

The easy pore pouch is a great feature. My 7 month old has not eaten any baby food as fast as he ate the pears and greens. The pouch is easy to close and store for later if needed. The pouch is also microwavable. Overall I love this baby food.

I'm a fan of this brand and this one of my favorites of theirs. It is strong, earthy but not bitter or acidic for the strength.

The 5 star rating is vs other kcups, not coffee in general (although its a great whole bean buy too).

If i could give these preserves 0 stars I would.  I bought three jars of different kinds; blueberry, fig and raspberry.  They all tasted like variations of prune and nothing like the flavors they purported to be.  I threw them all away.
It smelled like it, but this tastes closer to Rooibos than chocolate and hazelnut.  And I do not like Rooibos.

What I like about wafers is the lightweight effect. Thought these would be similar to Manner wafers, with many exceedingly thin layers, however they are very different. The three wafers per piece are thick and crunchy rather than lightweight and paper-thin. In addition, the filling is scant and dry. The wafers lose their crispness very quickly when exposed to air, so must be eaten immediately upon opening. Given that these wafers have ingredients similar to those of the Manner competitor, they are overpriced and inferior in taste and texture. Other household members don't like them either, so I will have to give them away. Will not buy again.

I usually make my own gluten free stuff from scratch and I love it, but the days when i feel lazy i feel like using a mix, and this one has to be the best one yet. Their mix tastes closely like the real (wheat) thing. I have made the pancakes, waffles, oven baked chicken, and strawberry shortcakes... absolutely delicious

This shipment arrived carrying the the red hot's, and a couple of jars of pickled eggs which were also Wisconsinmade. The packaging and insert gave the feel of small town artisan pride, which was truly what turned out to be in the box!  These little spicy dandies are not your usual tube meat purchased in the local gas station deli, NO!  They are well made, and have lots more flavor than I have ever experienced in a red hot.  If you are in to the pickled proteins, give the eggs a shot too, they are a wonderful quick and healthy snack.

These Rusks are delicious.  They are not very nutricious, but they are a low caloried alternative to crackers and breads.  I spread them with peanut butter or jelly.  Or I spread low fat cream cheese and top with a slice of turkey.  You can crumble them up in salads as "croutons".  They come tightly packed in a nice box so 90-95% of them aren't broken.  They have a fairly long shelf life so they won't go stale if you keep them tightly sealed in a plastic bag or container after opening a package.
I am very happy with the quality of these peppercorns and it was a good buy....much better than what I can get at the co-op.

Summary: Does not taste like a diet soda
Text:
I am not a huge soda drinker but when I want soda I want a Coke! That's bad in my case because I'm fat! About 6 weeks ago I decided to try the Atkins diet. The Atkins diet is a lower carb diet so I had to give up sweets and sugary drinks. I needed a replacement for my occasional Cokes. I tried regular diet Coke but found that it had an after taste. A friend suggested Coke Zero.

I love it! The taste is very similar to regular Coke (not exact) but a very satisfying alternative.

Overall, if your looking for a GOOD tasting diet soda I don't think you can do better than Coke Zero.
MY 9YR OLD DOG LOVES & BEGS FOR THESE. DIGESTS WELL & EASY ON MOUTH.

Summary: Not for all Tastes but I love it
Text: I ordered a second case.  Makes great Dark and Stormies or very refreshing and medicinal cold out of the bottle.  My wife won't touch the stuff.  You got to like ginger or ginger ale. You will be disappointed if not.
Not spicy enough. A bit sweet. Go with the Hot and Spicy peanuts. They have a bit more zing and do not have a sweet aftertaste
It's four boxes of Pebbles...Have you had Pebbles? Then you know what you are getting into. Candy cereal, probably terribly unhealthy. But for under $2 as box its a steal.
I discovered Giant Chewy Nerds at Easter when they were sold as jelly beans. When Easter was over I couldn't find them any more. Finally found them online. Wish they were carried in stores locally.

Until about a year ago my favorite whole-bean espresso was Green Mountain Organic. They stopped selling that as beans so I searched for a replacement. I wanted something low in caffeine and not expensive. Eventually I learned that Lavazza is the best bargain around and found their Top Class blend to be a very good replacement. Here are my impressions of some of the Lavazza whole-bean espressos:

Pienaroma - high acid, low aroma, fruity, medium roast, mild, low caffeine.
Super Crema - high acid, medium roast, mild, low caffeine.
Grand Espresso - low acid, high aroma, medium roast, spicy finish, high caffeine.
Top Class - moderate acid, aroma, and caffeine; medium/dark roast, spicy finish.
My kids & I love these, they are like rice krispie treats but not as sweet, similar texture and a great snack.

When I bought this, I didn't realize the noodles are different from Ramyun spicy picante.  Ramyun is the thinner yellow noodle and neoguri is the thicker white japanese udon noodle.  Unlike the kimchi flavor, this has enough spices to satisfy your craving and since I do not dislike udon noodles, I give it 4 stars.  But it is not as good as Ramyun picante and I give ramyun 5 stars.  My boyfriend is german / irish American and he loves these noodles...even this spicy neoguri. Summary: Tastes okay but not very filling

I guess they'd be good for on the go in case you were starving and wanted a tiny snack, but otherwise I'd skip them and go for something a bit more substantial.

Summary: Consistently Excellent. "Turkish Delight" as made in USA
Text: We lived in Turkey for a couple of years in the past and enjoy Lokum aka "Turkish Delight". (Warning! Sugar is not good for you. Go easy.) These are consistently Excellent, but if you go to the right shops in Istanbul, you can do even better. Otherwise, I'd give 5 stars. That said, these are here and cheaper than a flight to Turkey. Read the story about how these came about. They are addictive. Use caution. Best if you never try the 5 star version. You might hurt yourself.

Fortunately, I did because this tasted just awful. It wasn't bitter or bold. It just tasted lousy. I ran to the fridge dumped a load of Hazelnut flavored creamer in there to mask the nastiness, was about to head out again and it was still too gross to drink. So, long story short, basically, this morning I had a great big mug of Hazelnut creamer with a little bit of coffee in it.

This one definitely isn't for me. I'd rather just have a cup of Maxwell House Breakfast Blend and and some flavored creamer to it.

Summary: The best tasting vanilla bean paste out there
Text:
I love this stuff. I use so much of this stuff I have to buy the 32 oz jug. It dissolves easier in fluid than just the powder. I also use their extract. Between these two products and my raw vanilla bean powder, I eat vanilla like it's a food group.

I was going in with low expections and was so surprised. 250 calories about for the entire can...okay that's about the going rate anyway and it's so full of Vitamin A (about 90%), protein (5-6 g) and FIBER (7-8g).  AND it's organic to boot? How can you go wrong?  I think eating healthy soups like this for lunch will really help me on my "diet" since the healthy ingredients and fiber will keep me from craving more food (which is often one's body in search of more nutrition).  I hope Amazon offers the chicken soup soon. And free shipping - thank you Amazon.com for making my life easier and giving me more value!  I'd be lost without you.

The pouch of treats came fairly well crushed. I now have Grizzly NuTreat crumbs. The treats seem to be very well liked by my dog. I have been using them for years but got them from a different vendor who I will go back to.
I can't vouch for the taste personally but my dog seems to love them!  I have substituted these treats for her bed time treat to replace the much more expensive and fatty pigs ears.

Summary: Great to find no sodium options
Text: This is a great no salt seasoning option.  My husband is on a restricted sodium diet and finding seasonings and food items is tough.  We use this on all of our grilling! Items came quickly and in great shape.

Summary: Lowest price for a high quality sweetener!
Text: We normally use fruit to sweeten, but for things like vegan pancakes, french toast, and certain baked goods this is a great sweetener to replace Maple Syrup and sugar.  It has a mild taste, and according to the company it is a "low glycemic index sweetener, so it is slowly absorbed into the body preventing spikes in blood sugar."  They don't show the fiber content on the nutrition facts label.  That information would convince me that this statement is true.  In any case, it's a great price on Amazon, lower than any wholesaler offer I've seen.
This is one of the healthiest and tastiest snacks I've ever had. It is a must buy for on-the-go snacking!

my cat loves this toy. its her favorite one!!! she carries it all over the house. she'll even play tug of war with it. the feathers do wear out fairly quick but i keep a few replacements on hand all the time.

I don't usually like to share when things are amazing - I like to keep it to myself, but this is the best tasting spice ever. Mix it with apple cider and the aroma is intoxicating. For Christmas, we like this drink hot, and we add a little bit of whipped cream on top, and drizzle a little bit of caramel on top. It's so delicious! My parents have requested it as part of the Christmas tradition.

I just do not understand why Amazon has a continued relationship with company which goes by many other names. It sells very poor products, but they keep appearing on Amazon with their other names. I think a couple names are "The Crab Place" and "The Lobster Store". The picture is exactly the same. I have really appreciated Amazon for monitoring their suppliers, but something is really wrong here.

Okay, I can't tell you how the price is on these since honestly I can't remember how much they are at our local Meijer. What I can tell you is this: take Corn and Rice Chex, blend them together, and make them better than the sum of their parts. Now you have Crispix.

I've been looking for a good wet food to feed my picky cat. Previously went through every brand of canned cat food, and he'd eat the first portion out of the can, and turn his nose up at everything after that. But he has kidney issues so the vet strongly recommends wet food...
Found this food and he LOVES it. It actually looks and smells like something I might eat (at a pinch), and I love that I can prepare only as much as he'll eat right then. It also feels more environmentally friendly - one small bag vs. dozens and dozens of tin cans. It appears to have all the nutrients and such that he needs as well.

Good candy! I made my money back with a profit by selling these to my friends. They love them too but Loca Cola is my least favorite while Orange Crash is my favorite. This contains 72 individual bottles.
Okay, yes it is sugar free, but they didn't say anything about weird texture and flavor!

Packaging: The packaging for this product was hassle-free, easy to open, and reasonable given the amount of product supplied.

Product quality: The crackers were very fresh and tasted just fine. It was consistent the the quality that I have come to expect from the brand name Nabisco. These were the perfect size for dunking into a small cup of milk as an after-dinner snack.

Overall opinion: I would highly recommend this product to someone looking for a mildly sweet, yet low-fat snacking option.

Summary: Quaker Soft Baked Banana Nut Bar
Text: I was super lucky to recently receive a full sized sample bar to try from Influenster and loved it! As a Weight Watcher I checked the points and found that each bar is only 4 points which makes it ideal for a light breakfast or an excellent anytime snack!Quaker Soft Baked Cereal Bar, Banana Nut Bread, 7.4-Ounce Packages (Pack of 6)

I haven't eaten other Jack's products, but this one is great - bought on impulse, which I seldom do.  Kind of wish I wouldn't have as I can see these becoming a craved addiction.  As other's have said, they're a little spicy, but certainly not hot.  As a grease-o-phobe, I didn't find them greasy at all.

My husband was hesitant to try this pasta because, in his experience, low carb (or lower carb) pasta tasted like cardboard. I ordered this to try it out. I made 1/2 a box for the two of us and covered it with Alfredo sauce, grilled chicken, and some shredded cheese. It tasted BETTER than Noodles and Co.! My husband was so surprised!

It still has some carbs in it but not so much that it should be a dealbreaker. I could've made 1/3 of a box for the two of us to shared and added more chicken to bulk it up to dinner size. I would HIGHLY recommend!

Summary: The Best Chai; and a Great Price
Text: I've pretty much tried all the bagged Chai tea commonly available and this is without a doubt my favorite.  I'm diabetic so I sweeten it with "Splenda", then add a small amount of Vanilla Soy Milk and the flavor and smells take one to a different world.  I'm buying this in "bulk" so I certainly don't expect high-quality packaging as some seem to think there should be. This is a huge savings over buying it retail at my grocery store and as I use at least three bags a day I am absolutely pleased to buy in bulk.

Summary: Paris Vanilla Bistro is a good choice
Text: This coffee has a great flavor.  If you like flavored coffees you won't be disappointed.  Also try the Vienna and Cappuccino.

I tried it at a friend's house and couldn't stop thinking about it. It's so yummy! I ate them alone as snacks and did not have the metallic after taste like a few others said.

The downside? It's 10 bucks for the same size in Sam's Club. For triple the price here, you might as well get a Sam's Club membership...

Summary: This is the secret spice of KFC chicken
Text: Telicherry  pepper is one of the 2 less common secret spices of KFC chicken (the other being Jamaican ginger).  This gives chicken that unique aftertaste specific to KFC.  This is a must-have for your pantry.

I'm a health concious person, so eating something with a good source of fiber and low sugar is a big plus for me. This tasted great especially with the variety and was very easy to make especially with my fast paced lifestyle. I love the taste and quality of the product.

I highly recommend it.

I gotta review this product because my pooches can't write reviews (if they could I'd be a rich man, haha!)

i love this stuff! and it was such a great deal! cereal + saving money = happy mommy. it arrived at my house in perfect condition. =)

I LOVE these dried cherries from the cherry capital, Traverse City, Michigan!  I have purchased them many times before, but in 4lb containers.  These smaller, resealable containers are much more convenient and each have just the amount you'd normally use at a time.

He was really pleased with this garden and it is growing exactly as they said it would. The only reason I didn't give it a five is because the light is so extremely bright that we moved it around several times before we found a suitable place for it. Summary: Great coffee!  If you like a strong flavorful coffee this one's for you.
Text: I have been drinking this coffee since it was introduced a few years ago. Its taste is very flavorful and hardy. Never bitter. I buy the coffee beans and grind them.  Only one store carried it and it sold so quickly one had to be there practically at delivery time.  Since i moved a few months ago i found that it is not available anywhere, not even wal-mart(wasn't carried in wal-mart where i did live either.) Anyhow, Amazon ships to me monthly at a lower price and no shipping costs.  great service. arrives quickly.
Although Zico may claim to be natural, I disagree since it is made from concentrate. I prefer to drink Vita Coco, which is a much more flavorful brand of coconut water and is actually 100% NATURAL!

If they would do this, I would do the subscribe and save option as I use this item every day. I would have given this item 5 stars if it wasn't for Amazon's price/shipping.

Summary: Julius Ceasar, the Saint Bernard, loves this dog food
Text: My daughter has a Saint Bernard named Julius Ceasar but we call him Ju Ju.  He is a gentle giant indeed.  Castor and Pollux Large Breed dog food is his favorite by far.  I save 15% through subscribe and save and have it delivered monthly for free.  Terrific!!

My dogs absolutely love these chews and pick them over anything else! They have never choked on them and they last awhile (depending on the size of your dog). My Lab likes the large size and it takes about 5 minutes, but my King Charles Spaniel takes about 15 minutes to chew a medium. Their teeth are also pretty clean, but I do brush them about once a week, so I am not sure if it is from the chews. Enjoy!!

I picked up a bottle of Sudden Death and Beyond Death. I have previously had After Death, which is very similar, except half as hot. After Death is the best in terms of pure taste. Sudden Death is almost as good but twice as hot. I didn't really care for Beyond Death which is just as hot as Sudden Death, but had both a sweet and a sour flavor at the time time that didn't sit well with me.

To date, I have mixed this sauce in with ketchup on a burger, and with BBQ sauce on chicken drumsticks. I was able to use a good amount of it without finding it overly hot, but my threshold for heat is a lot higher than most people.

I purchase these in large quantities and make large batches at a time. I then place them on a baking pan in the freezer.  Once frozen, they are packed in zip lock bags and put back in the freezer. Whenever bisquits are requested there is no problem with homemade bisquits being available. Just butter the bisquit sheet, take as many as needed out of the zip lock bags and place them in a 400 degree oven and cook until done. Voila!! Bisquits on command.. PS make sure you grease the pan you place the bisquits on in the freezer..

These candies rock!  I am totally addicted to these.  When I open a bag of these they are usually gone with a half hour because I can't stop.  I can't explain it either.  I'm not a big cola drinker, not a big soda drinker at all but I love the taste of these.  Maybe that's why I like these.  I get the cola taste anytime without having to drink it.  I don't know.  But like I said, I'm addicted and I would recommend these to everyone.  Haribo makes some other wonderful candies also.  Their pink grapefruit slices are sooooo good!  When I was on Lipitor I couldn't have pink grapefruit but the grapefruit slices satisfied my craving for it!  So by all means, pick some of their candy up!  They rock!

Fast delivery; got it the day after Labor Day. Items just as described, packaged well, and the least-priced of this same item as compared to other web offerings. A very pleasant transaction. Done And Done!

Coffee Bean and Tea Leaf products have always been a favorite of mine. However, we do not have one where we live. To buy directly from the company for one container of tea was much more expensive than to purchase from Amazon (and I got a 3 pack).

The price was right, and it shipped quickly!

YUM!

I absolutely love Lana's Snowflake tea! I received a sample when I ordered the Finum Permanet Filter through Amazon (which, by the way, is the best filter I have ever used!). I fell in love with the Snowflake tea and had to order some for myself. It's fantastic!
Love this product, easy to make and convenient.  The bag fits in freezer easily and travels well in a cooler.

My favorite Lapsangs to date have been Wagner's loose (now out of business, apparently), and Numi's tea bags. Unfortunately, Numi discontinued their bags a while back, and for some reason, their loose tea doesn't seem the equal, which is pretty weird. Still, Numi is quite good, and far better than Twining's pathetic effort.

I find this a very convenient way to get protein when I'm out and about and unsure where I could get a healthy gluten free snack. Not the best tasting, but it's not terrible. I've tried the creamy peanut and the white chocolate chip. I would order them again because it's good to have a healthy go-to food when you have Celiac and don't want to get accidentally glutened. They keep well in the bottom of my purse.

Had order these a couple years ago.  Wonderful.  Ran out and needed more.  Doubled my order this time around.  They last forever in the refrigerator.  Excellent item to top a summer dinner salad. Text: I have been in the coffee biz since I was 18, and I'm a self-proclaimed coffee snob.  This coffee is the best I've ever had.  If you had told me that I would love instant coffee this much, I'd have told you to take a long walk off a short pier.  THE BEST COFFEE.  It's not cheap, but it IS worth it.

Summary: Delicious, but fragiles and NOT tooth-friendly
Text: This product has citric acid as the second ingredient. Talk to any dentist about the damage citric acid can do to soften enamel and you will see why this product is NOT tooth-friendly as the company advertises. Yes, it's tasty, tastier than any other sugar-free candy out there, but the citric acid completely counteracts any benefit provided by the xylitol.  It's not a great idea to bathe your teeth in citric acid, and you can verify this by asking a dentist what happens if you suck on lemons too much.  The company needs to make a version that is NOT sour or just doesn't have citric acid in it.  Also, the other reviewers are right. 90% of the time, the containers arrive with mostly powder, not solid candy inside.

I read the other reviews, then tried for myself.  I've never tried canned artichokes before only large jars from Costco.  Only problem is that they were in oil and I prefer in water for calorie counting.  To my surprise these were great, a little seasoning a bit of fresh lemon.  I really enjoyed them.  Also told my family about how good they were.

Summary: HBP individuals; can interefere with your meds
Text:
Love the taste of the tea. However, I strongly urge people with high blood pressure not to use this product without talking to their physician first. After drinking the tea on and off for two weeks, I discovered that my blood pressure was increasing. A review of my habits indicated that the only new introduction into my routine eating and drinking habits was the Slim Life tea. It appears that the Eleutro root can interfere with your medication to the point that it renders your HBP medication ineffective. Needless to say, I immediately discontinued using the product and as a result, my pressure went back down.

Yogi teas are great but it appears that this one is not for us (consumers with HBP).

Nothing else even comes close to the taste and quality of this mix. One of the few traditions we have around here is waffles on the weekends w/ berries and whipped cream, and while there have been incremental improvements to the idea over time, such as using home-made whipped cream and organic, locally grown berries, trying this product was a game changer. Great tasting fruit snack. As others have commented, it is somewhat on the sweet side, but it is still better than corn syrup and hydrogenated oil filled candy bars. I have to keep gum or candy in my mouth. Not to mention that I have been tremendously constipated, to the point that I passed blood! Im not sure if I should continue to take these or not. Love the packaging of these teas. This ensures the freshness. Smells wonderful as soon as you open the tin. Upon brewing, the smell is heavenly and it is a very good after meal tea.  Helps when you've eaten too much. This will be my 2nd purchase of this tea.

This is really good coffee.  We were on vacation and needed coffee - the local Publix store (we don't have those where we live) happened to carry this so we gave it a try. Summary: Perfect substitute for wide rice noodles!
Text:
These are a perfect substitute for wide rice noodles; I made a stir fry tonight and it was delicious! These noodles hold up much better than rice noodles - don't break and don't get soggy. Also I don't have to obsessively time these since they are cooked and really only need blanching to warm them through (it usually takes about 30 min to soak rice noodles and it's easy to overdo it; not a problem with these).

I WOULD NOT use them in a "pasta" recipe like carbonara, marinara, etc. 'Cause you wouldn't use rice noodles in those recipes, that's why! Personally, I think it's a mistake that the company is labeling these as "Fettucini". This sets up a wrong expectation. They should label these as "wide noodles".
These are simply delicious, and so good for you! I would highly recommend them as the perfect snack. Great with soups, sandwiches or the base for your home made trail mix.

I truly love this product and always carry it with me when I travel.  My only complaint is the packaging used on the product which is sold at Costco, which contains 24 packets.  Short of a hacksaw, there's no easy way to get it open.  The product inside makes it worthwhile, but come on, guys.  You advertise it as being a 'green' product, but this package had to have used up at least one tree and some mighty tough plastic.

Summary: Like my mama made her spaghetti sauce.

This tastes just like my mama used to make. And she was Italian, No Olive Garden watery ketchup taste here. Nice and thick, great smelling and tasting. And in the quantity size I like. I just love it and recommend it highly to anyone wanting to do something healthy for themselves. So drink to good health. Thanks Goji.

I had these scones at a tea house on the Central Coast of California and had to buy the mix.  Ate the mix we bought there, so we were so glad to find them available on line.  They are more traditional "bisquit" type scones (not the sweetened pastry type we Americans are getting used to seeing at places like Starbucks). Very disappointed with purchase.  The dates were so dried up where it tasted like leather instead of dates.  Must have been sitting there for a long long time.

I order the Jelly Belly gummi bears often and I am always impressed with the flavor and freshness.  I appreciate this brand using kosher gelatin; which coincides with my religious preferences.  The only thing I am not too happy about is whenever I or a friend orders this, it should be 24 packs that come, but lately we have only been receiving a box of 12. The cinnamon taste isn't overbearing like in kids cereals, and the past several months I've even swithced my kids over to Kashi.  Even though they won't admit that they like it, my cereal is always gone within a day or two, so I know they are sharing my cereal.  What I like about Kashi is that it doesn't have high fructose corn syrup, it is organic and all natural, it really tastes good and not artificial like so many other food products.

Summary: Odd bitter taste; not like Postum.
Text:
If you are looking for a substitute for the discontinued Kraft hot drink mix Postum, Pero doesn't taste much like Postum. Postum had a much smoother, slightly sweet taste. Pero has bitter flavor, that to me tastes like stale coffee. If you are a coffee drinker and want to cut down on caffeine, a good brand of decaf coffee tastes much better than Pero.

By the way, Postum was made from from wheat bran, wheat, molasses, and maltodextrin made from corn. The ingredients of Pero are malted barley, barley, and chicory; so it is quite different.

Summary: Berry flavor too fake for my taste.
Text:
Saw this new cereal at the grocery store for the first time yesterday and decided to try it. I have found Kashi cereals to be of high quality in the past (as well as being healthy), so I had high hopes. I just had my first bowl, and I am sorry to say that my high hopes have been dashed--at least in one major way.

The cereal is a nice size (small bite-size), and has a nice crunch, not over-sweet, but the "kiss of berry flavor" the box promises ends up tasting like berry-scented candles, perfume or bubblebath. VERY fake-tasting. Eesh.

Unless my tastebuds get used to the fake-tasting berry flavor, I expect this to be the last box I ever buy. Too bad, because I liked everything about it EXCEPT the fake berry taste.

I can't wait to try the chocolate varitey!  Mmmm, coconut macaroons, you are my new best friend.

I was really happy to see this organic paprika offered as an option in Amazon's Add-on program. I use paprika in many ways: spice rubs, stew and goulash, sloppy joe mix, sauces, or any dish that needs a boost. For example, it's great to sprinkle on french fries (after frying, as paprika can burn, or before I've baked them), along with salt and black pepper.

This particular product is a "sweet" (not spicy or smoked) paprika, so keep that in mind when reading or creating a new recipe. Also, since it comes in a glass bottle, I recommend keeping it in either a pantry or, as my grandmother advised, the refrigerator; sometimes light can affect the flavor of spices.

Recommended!
